14\. Among all the directions, a vase of bell metal or bronze should be placed and separate offerings should be made in a proper order The recitation should then be made appropriately. This performance is known as Sanmaya yajna.

## \|\| 2.7.15 \|\|

*śītodakaṃ madhu kṣīraṃ sitekṣvośca raso guḍaḥ \|*  
*sagarbhaśca paro jñeyaḥ ṣaṇmayaścāparo baliḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The offerings made with cool water, honey, payasam, the white sugar and sugarcane balls are called Sanmaya-bali.

## \|\| 2.7.16 \|\|

*śālitaṃḍulaprasthaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam \|*  
*kṣīreṇāpi ca saṃbhaktaṃ yavakṣīramidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A tandula of Sali-rice, or half or a quarter of this quantity should be used for the making of payasam and the offerings should be made thereafter. This is known as Yavaksira-bali.

## \|\| 2.7.17-20 \|\|

*kṣīraṃ bhāgāṣṭakaṃ grāhyaṃ saptabhāgena saṃsthitam \|*  
*haimaṃtikaṃ sitākhyaṃ ca tāṃḍulaṃ prapaceccarum \|\| 17 \|\|*

*aśītipalamānena siddhamāsādayettataḥ \|*  
*bhāgārdhena dadetpaścānmākṣikaṃ vā sitāmapi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*guḍamiśreṇa yo dadyātsaṃparko jāyate kvacit \|*  
*saṃpṛktaṃ mākṣikeṇāpi dadyādikṣurasaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā yācakaḥ śuddhaḥ śṛṇuta dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śṛṇute vādhīyāno yo dadyāddhaste ca pustakam \|*  
*samutthāya ca gṛhṇīyātpraṇamya vinivedayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. Separating one eighth part of it, the rest seven parts of the milk should be added with sugar and rice, which is known as Haimantika bali. In the payasam weighing a tandula, sugar or die honey of half of its weight should be added to it. Further the sugarcane balls could further be added to it. As far as possible the learned people should use the sugarcane juice only. О best of the Brahmanas, thus the listener should listen to the purana purifying himself completely. The book of purana should be presented to someone in land only. The receiver should also get up and receive the sacred book with honour and grace.

## \|\| 2.7.21-22 \|\|

*pūrvasthaḥ śrāvako vipro vikhyātastasyadakṣiṇe \|*  
*paścimāśāmukhenaiva tarjanyāṃguṣṭhayā saha \|\| 21 \|\|*

*prastareṇāpi hastena vinyāsaḥ paṃḍitaiḥ sadā \|*  
*itonyathā na kartavyaḥ kṛtvā nyāsamathāpnuyāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The Brahmana who listens should be seated facing the east, while the orator or the reciter should be seated in front of him facing the west. The reciter should explain the tattvas of the purana joining the forefinger with the thumb, adorned with rings studded with precious stones. Things sb id not be made to move in a reverse manner.

## \|\| 2.7.23 \|\|

*asakṛdvinyasedviprāḥ pāvamānīṃ jale japet \|*  
*vedāṃtāgamavedāṃtavidhireṣa smṛto budhaiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The nyasa should be performed inhaling air and standing in the water. The learned people have described it as the process of Vedanta.

## \|\| 2.7.24 \|\|

*yamadiksaṃmukhe śrotā vācakaścottarāmukhaḥ \|*  
*purāṇabhāratākhyāna eṣa vai kathito vidhiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. According to the scriptures, the listeners of the Purana and Mahabharata should face the south, while the orator should face the north.

## \|\| 2.7.25 \|\|

*vaiparītyena vidhinā vijñeyo dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*rāmāyaṇe dharmaśāstre harivaṃśe ca sattamāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. To the contrary, the Ramayana, Dharmasastras and Harivamsa have to be listened in the reverse manner.

## \|\| 2.7.26 \|\|

*ito'nyathā yātudhānāḥ praluṃpaṃti phalaṃ yataḥ \|*  
*tasmādvidhividhānena śṛṇuyādatha vā paṭhet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In case the listeners listen to these Puranas in a different way, their merits are spoiled by the Rdkfasas. Therefore, these scriptures should be listened in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 2.7.27 \|\|

*śrutvā prati puṇyavidyāṃ yo'śnīyānmāṃsameva tu \|*  
*sa yāti gārdabhīṃ yoniṃ yadi maithuninaḥ kvacit \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. By listening to these auspicious learnings one who consumes meat, and the one who indulges in cohabiting with the woman, has to be bom as an ass.

## \|\| 2.7.28-29 \|\|

*yadi devālaye tīrthe vācayecchṛṇuyādatha \|*  
*yasya devagṛhe tasya tasya tīrthasya varṇanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*māhātmyaśravaṇādeva godānasya phalaṃ labhet \|*  
*mahāgurośca māhātmyaṃ pitroragre na ca smaret \|*  
*piturmāhātmyaṃ yatputrairvācyaṃ saṃsadi parvaṇi \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. As far as possible, one should listen to the recitation in a temple or at a holy place, because by so doing the listener attains the merit of giving a cow in charity. The great preceptor should not be praised in front of the parents. During each occasion of festivity, a son should praise his own parents alone.

## \|\| 2.7.30 \|\|

*vāsudevāmataścāpi rudramāhātmyavarṇanam \|*  
*rudrāgre vāsudevasya kīrtanaṃ puṇyavardhanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. To sing the praise of Siva in the presence of lord Vasudeva and to sing praise of Vasudeva in presence of &iva is quite meritorious.

## \|\| 2.7.31 \|\|

*durgāgre śivasūryasya vaiṣṇavākhyānameva ca \|*  
*yaḥ karoti vimūḍhātmā gārdabhīṃ yonimāviśet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A person who praises £iva in presence of Durga besides the glory of Surya and Visnu, such a fool has to be reborn as an ass.

## \|\| 2.7.32 \|\|

*guroranujñayā pitroḥ prakuryādabhivādanam \|*  
*anujñayā tathā pitrorhareḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Accepting the command of the preceptor, one should honour bis parents and with the permission of the parents one should go round the image of Hari.

## \|\| 2.7.33-35 \|\|

*na viṣṇurna ca brahmā ca na ca rudraḥ śacīpatiḥ \|*  
*sarvavedena tattulyaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sarvajñānamayaṃ caiva sarvajñena ca tatsamam \|*  
*tasmāddvijanmanpitrorhi sevanādbrahmaśāśvatam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*gurubhyo vaṃdanaṃ vyartha pitaraṃ yo na tarpayet \|*  
*jīvanna tarpayenmukhyaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ maraṇepi ca \|*  
*ubhayostarpaṇaṃ nāsti jīvannapi na jīvati \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Even Brahma, Visnu, Rudra and Indra cannot equate him. Because of their having become the past masters in dharma, only the Vedas can equate them, because they enshrine in them all the knowledge and are omniscient. Therefore, their comparison has been conceived to be improper. Therefore, O Brahmanas! By serving the parents, one achieves Brahma. One who does not offer oblation to his parents, bis adoration for the preceptor is of no use. Even when he dies in the Ganga, offering oblation for him is of no consequence, because when the living person do not offers oblation inspite of bis being alive, he is not considered to be alive.

## \|\| 2.7.36 \|\|

*purāṇaśravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śūnyaṃ bhāgavataṃ yadi \|*  
*vyarthaṃ bhāgavataṃ viprā nārasiṃhavihīnakam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Listening to the Puranas is said to be meritorious, but not for a person who has been deprived of Bhagavata. О dear ones, the listening of the Bhagavata without the episode of Narasimha does not bestow merit on him.

## \|\| 2.7.37 \|\|

*ādiparvaṇi hīne tu bhāratākhyaṃ na dhārayet \|*  
*vināśvamedhikaṃ viprā vinā yajñānanaṃ vinā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О Brahmanas, the listening of the Mahabharata without the Adi-parva, Asvamedha Parva and Yajna parva is also of no consequence.

## \|\| 2.7.38 \|\|

*dānakarmavihīnaṃ ca mokṣadharmaṃ na dhārayeta \|*  
*bhārataṃ ca divārohadhāraṇādau varaṃ vrajet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Without the charities, the process for attaining moksa should not be undertaken. For departure towards the heaven and the observing of all the rules, listening to the Mahabharata is essential.

## \|\| 2.7.39 \|\|

*vāyupurāṇamaśrutvā śāstraṃ ca yaugikaṃ vinā \|*  
*vāyuhīnaṃ dehikulaṃ vṛthā tasya na dhārakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. It is totally impossible for a person to survive without the vital air (oxygen). Similarly, without the Yogasastra besides without listening to Vayu Purana, listening to other scriptures is of no consequence.

## \|\| 2.7.40 \|\|

*tathā vāyupurāṇaṃ yadvihīnaṃ śravyamanyakam \|*  
*yathā sundarakāṃḍena āraṇyaṃ ca na dhārayeta \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. As the conclusion of Aranya and other kandas cannot be resorted after the conclusion of the Sundara-kanda, similar is the case of listening to the other Puranas without the Vayu-Purana.

## \|\| 2.7.41-42 \|\|

*laṃkāṃ vinā cādikāṃḍaṃ tallikhitvā na dhārayet \|*  
*pārāśaraṃ vinā vyāsaṃ yājñavaktyaṃ vinā makham \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dakṣaṃ vinā na śaṃkhaṃ ca śaṃkhahīnaṃ bṛhaspatim \|*  
*vahnīyaṃ śravaṇādyena na ca yuktimathāpayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Lanka kanda should not be patronised without Adikanda. Similarly, Vyasa without Parasara or a yajna without Yajnavalkya, a yajna without a conch or the fire without Brhaspati Sravana should not be consecrated.

## \|\| 2.7.43 \|\|

*saṃsthāpanādeva vinā na ca kimapi rākṣasaiḥ \|*  
*na dadetprārthakādibhyo na vikrīyetkathaṃcana \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. With consecration by the Raksasas, nothing should be given in charity or nor should anything be sold.

## \|\| 2.7.44 \|\|

*na haretpustakaṃ cāpi na haredakṣarāṇi ṣaṭ \|*  
*brahmākṣarasya haraṇādrauravānna nivartate \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. A book should in no case should be stolen. Similarly, the Sadaksara mantra or six letter hymn should not be stolen. A person who steals the Brahmaksara mantra, he can never be redeemed from the Raurava hell.

## \|\| 2.7.45-46 \|\|

*ādyākṣarasya haraṇāttāmrakuṣṭhī bhavediha \|*  
*mukhavṛttasya haraṇādyāvadācaṃdratārakam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*kuvale asipatre ca patatīha na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*svākṣarasya haraṇe svamātṛharaṇe'pi yat \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. By stealing the first letter, the thief attracts the leprosy of the copper type. By stealing the foremost meters or passages, the enmity lasts till the existence of the moon and stars after which he falls in the Asipatra hell. There is no doubt about it. He also becomes entitled to the same punishment, as one receives by kidnapping one’s own mother. With the usurping of Svaraksara, one receives the same punishment.

## \|\| 2.7.47-48 \|\|

*tasmātpustakamātraṃ yo harennarakamāpnuyāt \|*  
*yadbhārataṃ yatpurāṇaṃ stotrarūpāṇi tāni ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

*tāni vedāgamādīni pustakeṣvapi vācayet \|*  
*vedānāṃ pustakaṃ yatra likhitvā tanna vācayet \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Thus the people who usurp the books of others, have to face the suffering in the hell. The Mahabharata and all the Puranas are in the form of stotras. The Vedas together with the Agamas should be turned as books of stotras and then the recitation should be made. But Vedas should not be recited in the form of a book, by writing them.

## \|\| 2.7.49-50 \|\|

*tathā tantroditānmaṃtrāṃllikhitvā tanna vācayet \|*  
*pustakaṃ nigamānāṃ ca mantravyākhyānasaṃgraham \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sphuṭaṃ kṛtvā puraḥ sthāpya yāvatkālaṃ pravartate \|*  
*tāvatsa narake ghore pretatvaṃ janmajanmani \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Similarly, the tantras and mantras should not be recited by writing them. A person, who himself writing the Vedas and the collection of the mantras, projects before the people, he earns the hell equivalent to the time he will propagate the same. He also becomes a goblin after the birth.

## \|\| 2.7.51 \|\|

*na vācayecca vyākhyātā vācako'pi pravācayet \|*  
*pauṣkare ca śloka pādamāśvamedhaṃ padepade \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The orator should not perform the parayana and the speaker should not deliver the discourse because the audience there, with the listening of even half a verse, achieves the merit of performing the Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.7.52 \|\|

*vedārthaṃ vācayedyasmādviparīto'pavācakaḥ \|*  
*tāvubhau patitau jñeyau pāvamānīśataṃ japet \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The irregular speaker, who delivers discourse on die interpretation of the Vedic hymns, then the speaker as well as the listener both fall in the hell. Both of them cannot be relieved of impurity without performing the japam a hundred times by inhaling air only.

## \|\| 2.7.53 \|\|

*ādimadhyāvasāne ca mantre ca praṇavaṃ diśet \|*  
*balibhirgaṃdhapuṣpaiśca pustakaṃ devanirmitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. At the time of the completion of the recitation of a book, at its beginning, middle and end, while reciting the mantras, Omkara should be used invariably. Besides offering the perfume, flowers and presents, the book should be honoured. It is because, the bock had been created by the divine force.

## \|\| 2.7.54-55 \|\|

*tridevaṃ pustakaṃ vidyātsūtraṃ vāsukirucyate \|*  
*amānakaraṇe doṣastasmāttacca na hāpayet \|\| 54 \|\|*

*patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā ūrdhvadīrghāṇi yāni ca \|*  
*janārdanaścākṣarāṇi mātrā prakṛtiravyayā \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. The book should be treated as Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the string with which it is bound, should be taken as Vasuki and a person who showers insult over the book, has to earn a great blemish. Therefore, the sacred book should be always respected. The leaves of the book are the form of Brahma, the letters or words are the form of Janardana, the Matras (vowels) and particles are the form of Prakrti.

## \|\| 2.7.56 \|\|

*lipī bhaṃgī maheśaḥ syāttasyā mātrā sarasvatī \|*  
*ekarekhā ca ekātmā pādācca pādavicyutiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The signs of full-stop are the form of Mahesvara and the vowels represent Sarasvati. Each one of its lines represents Brahma and in case they are without roots, they get blemished.

## \|\| 2.7.57 \|\|

*catuṣpādāṃtare yugmaṃ madhyamoṃ'te yugaṃ yugam \|*  
*vipatkaraṃ yugmapaṃktāvayugme svargasādhanam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. In the middle of four roots there are two lines, while in the middle and the end, four lines are created. By performing the parayana of the twin lines one faces misery and with the performing of the ayugma or without twin lines, one achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 2.7.58 \|\|

*bhārate cetihāse ca purāṇe dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*ayugmapaṃktau svargaḥ syādyugme narakamāviśet \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. О best of Brahmanas when the Mahabharata, Itihasa (history) and Puranas are recited with ayugma passages one achieves the heaven and when the recitation of yugma passages is done, one falls into the hell.

## \|\| 2.7.59-60 \|\|

*vaktṛnāmākṣarairyuktaṃ paṃktibhedena sattamāḥ \|*  
*upanyastasya yannāma tatkalau mātrayā saha \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ātmasaṃśuddhisaṃśuddhyā dhārayeddharma saṃhitām \|*  
*ito'nyathā bhaveddoṣastasmāttatparivarjayet \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. О excellent listeners, when the speaker, together with the letters of his own name, using the difference in passage, and utters a name in the age of Kali, the recitation of the Dharma Samhitas in an auspicious way, he perform it for self purification. The other being blemished are recommended to be discarded.

## \|\| 2.7.61 \|\|

*ripuḥ sūryastayārāmo yakṣo'naṃtaḥ sarasvatī \|*  
*brāhmī ca yakṣiṇī caiva gāyatrī navamī smṛtā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The nine types of the forms of the Panktis are known as Suryanta, Ripu, Rama, Yaksa, Ananta. Sarasvati, Brahmi, Yaksini and Gayatri.

## \|\| 2.7.62-64 \|\|

*viṣṇvante ca bhavenmuktiḥ sūryāṃ'te pādavicyutiḥ \|*  
*ripuṃkaraṃ bhavettasya yakṣe durgatimādiśet \|\| 62 \|\|*

*anaṃte vipulā kīrtiḥ sarasvatyāṃ dhanāgamaḥ \|*  
*brāhmyā brahmatvamāpnoti yakṣiṇyā yakṣamandiram \|\| 63 \|\|*

*muktimāpnoti gāyatryā iti paṃktiphalodayaḥ \|*  
*caturdhā pratibhaktiḥ syātpustakaṃ dharmanirmitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

62-64. When Visnupankti is recited till the end, one achieves redemption. In Suryanta, there is a blemish of Padacyuta. Ripu is the form of an enemy, Yaksa stands for misfortunes, Ananta bestow the vast glory, Sarasvati grant enough of riches, Brahmi leads one to Brahman, Yaksini to Yaksa temple and Gayatri to salvation. Thus the fruits of the Panktis have been spelt out. Because of the book being a religious one and by performing its parayana one achieves devotion in four ways.

## \|\| 2.7.65-66 \|\|

*brahmendravaiṣṇavaṃ śaivaṃ śāktikaṃ ca maheśvarī \|*  
*brahmarūpaṃ cetihāsamaiṃdraṃ rāmāyaṇātmakam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ daivaṃ yacchaivaṃ tallalāṭakam \|*  
*pāvako'sya tathā mūle madhye bhāge śatakratuḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. Brahma, Indra, Vaisnava, Saiva and sakta besides Mahesvari are the representative deities. Itihasa is the form of Brahman, Aindra is the form of Ramayapa, Visnu is the best of die gods, Saiva is the form of the forehead, in the base of which is the fire and Indra is in the middle.

## \|\| 2.7.67-68 \|\|

*agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśāmīśāstathā dvijāḥ \|*  
*meruḥ sumeruruddiṣṭaḥ saṃgavānkāma ucyate \|\| 67 \|\|*

*dvāvāpṛthivyau pātālaṃ tasyāṃtaḥ samudāhṛtam \|*  
*paurāṇikakathāyuktapustako devapūjitaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. In its forepart are lodged all the planets and in the directions, all the representative gods are lodged. The Merus are known as Sumeru mountain, one passage is linked with the other and represents the form of Kama. The sky, the earth and the nether world are the middle of the book. The book containing the stories of Puranas is adored by the gods.

## \|\| 2.7.69-71 \|\|

*na śasyaḥ pūjanīyaśca gṛhe sthāpyeta mānavaḥ \|*  
*yo yasmai śūdro viprāya vṛttiṃ dadyācca mānavaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*sa yāti brahmasadanaṃ maṇivartmādikuṭṭimam \|*  
*na śasyaḥ pūjanīyaśca gṛhe sthāpyeta mānavaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*patrāṇāmagrabhāge tu vedhaṃ kuryātsuvartulam \|*  
*śravaṇāttatra mātreṇa tatra padmaṃ ca vartulam \|\| 71 \|\|*

69-71. The people should not consecrate the book which is praiseworthy and adorable in the house when a Sudra provides the living to a Brahmana, he achieves the path studded with gems, besides the temple of Brahmana. Each and every page should be decorated with beautiful roundish and flowery designs.

## \|\| 2.7.72 \|\|

*saṃhitāgamatantreṣu prativedhe ca saṃkulam \|*  
*prakuryāccittatāpena tataḥ śakrapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. At every chapter of Samhita, Agama and the Tantras when dense foliage is drawn by a person with disturbed mind, he achieves the place of Indra.

## \|\| 2.7.73 \|\|

*madhyaṃ tasya haredāyuḥ pārśvavedhaḥ śivaṃ haret \|*  
*yugmavedhe jayaṃ dadyādekavedhe balirbhavet \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. When the middle of it is suitably decorated, it results in the loss of life. By decorating the back results in the loss of welfare, but when the yugma-vedhas (joints) are decorated, one achieves victory and by decorating singly, one achieves offerings.

## \|\| 2.7.74 \|\|

*paramaṃ prakṛterguhyaṃ sthānaṃ devairvinirmitam \|*  
*pūrayettāmraliṃgena atha raityamayena vā \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The place which is created by the divine force by nature, becomes the secret slot and it should be filled by the copper or brass.

## \|\| 2.7.75 \|\|

*aśakto bilvakāṣṭhasya tathā śrīparṇikasya ca \|*  
*na kāṣṭhasya navaṃ śasyaṃ na lauhaṃ yojayetkvacit \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. According to one’s means, it should be filled with the wood of a creeper or the silk cotton tree.

## \|\| 2.7.76-78 \|\|

*prāgāraṃbhaślokaśataṃ dharmaśāstrasya vai likhet \|*  
*saṃhitāyāṃ purāṇāyāṃ yugmakalpaṃ tadardhakam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*brahmacaryeṇa vilikhenna mohādbrahmaṇaḥ kvacit \|*  
*tathāpi cākhilavyāsa lekhanātsaṃtatikṣayaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*anāmātve hemayutāṃ balākaṃ cittameva ca \|*  
*na likhetkhilabhāgaṃ ca harivaṃśasya sattamāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

76-78. While writing the dharma-sastra, one should rest and after completing every set of a hundred verses, there should be an interval. Similarly, in the ancient Samhitas, after each one of the kalpas, there should be an interval. The process of writing has been prescribed by which one should observe Brahmacarya, while writing the scriptures one should not get discharged anytime under passion. Even when inspite of observing strict discipline, the discharge takes place, even when the name of the writer is not written, the same blemish has been mentioned. One should not write with a disturbed mind. The writing of Harivamsa should never be left incomplete.

## \|\| 2.7.79-81 \|\|

*gāruḍasya ca skāndasya na likhenmadhyatantrakam \|*  
*lekhanaṃ harivaṃśasya vratastho niyamairyutaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*gṛhastho na likhedgraṃthaṃ likhecca mathurāṃ vinā \|*  
*lekhane pārijātasya matsya māṃsāśinaṃ likhet \|\| 80 \|\|*

*vālmīkisaṃhitāyāśca lekhane ca tathā kvacit \|*  
*stotramātraṃ likhedviprā avratī na likhetkvacit \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. In the middle of the Garuda and the Skanda Purana, the tantra portions should be deleted. The Harivamsa should be written by performing all the vratas and rules A householder should not take to the writing of the religious books. But in case he is inclined to do so, he should omit the chapter on Mathura. While writing the event of Parijata only the non-vegetarian should do so. In case one is inclined to write the Valmiki Samhita or the Ramayana, then only the stotras contained therein should be written. But this writing work should not be done without performing the vratas.

## \|\| 2.7.82 \|\|

*abrāhmaṇena likhitaṃ niṣphalaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Similarly, writing of the same by a non-Brahmana has been termed to be of no consequence.

## \|\| 2.7.83 \|\|

*patitairapi pākhaṃḍairna strī vilikhati kvacit \|*  
*durvicāro duṣṭabhāryo durmatiścāpi lekhakaḥ \|*  
*na likheddharmaśāstraṃ ca purāṇaṃ stotrasaṃhitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. There is no provision for the writing of the sacred books by the fallen people, the wicked people and by a lady. The people with evil thoughts, the husband of an evil woman and a person without a far sight should not write the scriptures. In case someone is bent upon writing the same, then except the Dharam sastras, Puranas, Stotras and Samhitas he can write other books.

## \|\| 2.7.84-86 \|\|

*tacca prāpnuvankartavyaṃ suvarṇarajatasya ca \|*  
*kajjalairmalinaṃ kuryānmantrī niryāsamaṃtritaiḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*jīvantyāśca rasairyuktairmaṇikardamalolupaiḥ \|*  
*vaṃgunyānmukhyāyutairvāpi pītayogairathāpi vā \|\| 85 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇe vāyupradaṃ vidyātpīte vāyukṣayo bhavet \|*  
*rakte puṣṭimavāpnoti kṛṣṇe ca saṃpadāgamaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

84-86. The ink should be made of the gum collyrium, gem dust and the essence of jivanti. The metals should also be added to it. There is a provision for adding the turmeric and yellow orpiment But the black colour results in the war in air. With the red colour, one gets progress and with the black ink, one achieves the wealth.

## \|\| 2.7.87-88 \|\|

*itihāsapurāṇānāṃ vilikhedyanmukhācchṛṇu \|*  
*vāyavyādimukhenaiva kāṣṭhavedaṃ ca saṃlikhet \|\| 87 \|\|*

*pūrvāmukhe cārthahāniruttare ca mukhe śriyaḥ \|*  
*maraṇaṃ dakṣiṇāsye tu paścimāsye dhanakṣayaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. I am now speaking about the posture seated in which the Puranas should be written. You please listen. First, one should write about the directions. The writing work should be stated facing the north-west direction. In case one writes facing the east, it causes loss of wealth, whereas writing facing the north one achieves honour, one faces death while writing facing the south. One faces loss of riches while writing facing the west.

## \|\| 2.7.89-90 \|\|

*pitṛmedhe bhuvaḥ kaṃpe na likhejjanmavāsare \|*  
*aśauce mṛtake sūtāvamāyāṃ ravisaṃkrame \|\| 89 \|\|*

*atra lekhāddaridraḥ syāttathā putravināśanam \|*  
*baladharmaṃ kṣayaṃ caiva tasmādyatnena varjayet \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. One should not write on the day of sraddha for the father during earthquake; or his own birthday. Both the types of impurities should be discarded. By writing on the first day of the month or on moonless day, one has to face poverty.

## \|\| 2.7.91-97 \|\|

*pitṛśrāddhadine lekhaḥ kulakṣayakaro bhavet \|*  
*ekarātraṃ bhuvaḥ kaṃpe tasmiṃllekhe dhanakṣayaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*aśoce'pi daridraḥ syājjanmāhe cāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ \|*  
*lipicchaṃdaḥ padajñaśca yuvā dhīmāñjitāsanaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*drutalekhī ca tejasvī yo lekhayati lekhakaḥ \|*  
*asaṃvalitabhāvena ūrdhvordhve syātsamākṣaram \|\| 93 \|\|*

*lipiyuktaḥ samāyuktaḥ evāgamalekhakaḥ \|*  
*nāṃdīnāgarakairvarṇaiḥ śuddhanāgarakairapi \|\| 94 \|\|*

*kāmarūpākṣarairvāpi yāvacca saṃhitāgaṇaḥ \|*  
*acetanena likhitaṃ yāvatkālaṃ pravartate \|\| 95 \|\|*

*yāvadakṣarasaṃsthānaṃ tāvatsvarge mahīyate \|*  
*anukto vācayedyastu dharmaśāstrasya vetanam \|\| 96 \|\|*

*likhitvā yastu pāpātmā yāvadakṣara saṃkhyayā \|*  
*tāvatkālaṃ tu narake pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

91-97. Writing on the Sraddha day of the father deprives one of loss of age. A person who is well aware of dialect, meters and the words, besides the intelligent, illustrious and young writer should, controlling his sense organs, be seated over his seat and with a clean brain should write with speed. The words of the upper lines should be equal. Thus a person engaged in meditation with concentrated mind has been termed as the writer of Agamas. By writing in the language of the gods or using the pure Nagari dialects, the scriptures should be written. Till such time, by writing in an unconscious state, he exists and the number of words that are included therein, the writer gets honoured for the same period in the heaven. A person, who writes or arranges for a Dharma-sastra without asking or on payment, such a person remains in the hell for the number of years equivalent to the number of words written by him. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 2.7.98 \|\|

*kuṭuṃbabharaṇārthaṃ tu gṛhṇīyādvāpi vetanam \|*  
*na jīvati sa duṣṭātmā dhanavastraphalānvitaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. A person who accepts salary for the maintenance and upkeep of his family inspite of having enough of riches, costumes and fruits, he being an evil soul, cannot live for long.

## \|\| 2.7.99-100 \|\|

*patitairaṃtyajairmlecchai rogī kuṣṭhī kṣayī tathā \|*  
*rogī śilīpadaiścaiva mūko'pi dharmasaṃhataḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*etairvilikhitaṃ yacca dhārayenna gṛhāśramī \|*  
*anāyuṣyakaraṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. A householder should not make use of the books written by the degraded, Sudras, Candalas, Mlecchas, an ailing person, a leper, a person suffering from consumption, one with a heavy foot and dumb person. By making use of such a book, the age of the user is reduced. Therefore, its discarding has been said to be beneficial.

## \|\| 2.7.101 \|\|

*hīnāṃgā pratimā caiva pustakaṃ mānahīnakam \|*  
*na kalau dhārayeddeha anāyuṣyakaraṃ bhavet \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. An image with its limbs broken and dishonoured book, when made use of in the age of Kali, reduces the age.

## \|\| 2.7.102-103 \|\|

*dvātriṃśadagulairyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ pustakottamam \|*  
*sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ khyāto dhāraṇācca kuto'pyalam \|\| 102 \|\|*

*catuviśāṃgulaṃ yacca tadvai svadhanamucyate \|*  
*śaṃkaraḥ sa tu vijñeyo dharmakāmaphalapradaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. The book should be of the size of thirty two angulas or fingers. Such an excellent book is known as Narayana, who can maintain it? The book with the size of twenty four angulas is known by the name of Siva. By possessing such a book one attains dharma and all his desires get fulfilled.

## \|\| 2.7.104-106 \|\|

*aṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhavedyacca tatkaniṣṭhamihocyate \|*  
*tasmādbrahmamayaṃ jñeyaṃ trivarga phaladāyakam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*tāḍitā jalapatre ca atha vā cāgurutvaci \|*  
*etyāḥ patrakṛte mānaṃ bhūrje mānaṃ na vidyate \|\| 105 \|\|*

*dvādaśāṃgulakaṃ yacca bhūrjataiḍādinirmitam \|*  
*aṃgulānāṃ pramāṇaṃ yattenāpi jñānapustakam \|\| 106 \|\|*

104-106. A book with the size of eight angulas is known as Kanistha. It is therefore is the smallest. It is also called as the Trivarga of Brahman (representing dharma, artha and kama) which bestows success. The water leaf (lotus leaf) or the skin of Agaru should be used for the writing of book. The size of the book would depend on the material so collected. It is no use describing the size of the book when it is written on the Bhoja-patra (the leaf and bark of a birch tree). Otherwise the book written over the palm leaf, because of its measure in fingers is also considered to be the holy book of knowledge.

## \|\| 2.7.107 \|\|

*hastasaṃsthāpite tasya tenāyuṣyakaraṃ bhavet \|*  
*dharmaśāstrasya sāhasre dharmaśāstrasya vetanam \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Bу reading it, holding in the hand, the age of the holder is enhanced. By writing a thousand copies of a Dharma-sastra, the writer should accept the remuneration.

## \|\| 2.7.108-109 \|\|

*svargamārgasya gamane bhārate ca tadardhakam \|*  
*harivaṃśe svarṇamāne kṛte mūlyasahasrake \|\| 108 \|\|*

*yugeyuge pādahīnaṃ dharmaṃ kuryādyathāruci \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā sarvānvyāsādīnsaṃhitāśrutān \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. While writing the Svargarohana parva of the Mahabharata, the writer should accept half of part as his wages. Similarly, by writing down the Harivamsa, a thousand gold (coins) should be paid in each one of the yugas to Vyasa and other sages, who are well-versed in the writing of the Samhitas. One should offer salutation to them, lowering his head and the faultless dharma should be followed willingly.

## \|\| 2.7.110 \|\|

*jaiminiṃ ca tato vyāsaṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā harim \|*  
*namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu ādimadhyāvasānake \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Thereafter, the salutation to Jaimini, Vyasa, Sankara and Hari and the book should then be offered salutation at the start, in the middle and at the end of its recitation.

## \|\| 2.7.111 \|\|

*tataḥ pravācayedvipro dharmaśāstrārthakovidaḥ \|*  
*alakṣitamanāstadvadyadrūpaṃ spaṣṭamuccaran \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. In the performing of the parayana of the Puranas, the Brahmana well-versed in Dharma-sastras should be offered the salutation before the start of the recitation. The orator should start the recitation slowly, patiently and in deep voice in such a way that all the listeners are able to hear him clearly.

## \|\| 2.7.112-114 \|\|

*asaṃyuktākṣarapadaṃ spaṣṭabhāgasamanvitam \|*  
*saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ saptanādavibhūṣitam \|\| 112 \|\|*

*sāmagāthāḥ samāśritya rāgayuktāṃtaraṃ paṭhet \|*  
*maṇivāro dhanaṃ yatsyādgaurāṃdhāṃ saṃtikastathā \|\| 113 \|\|*

*śrīrāgaścaiva hillolarāgo vājāvikastathā \|*  
*evaṃ prakramamāṇena śṛṇuyāddharmasaṃhitāḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

112-114. Speaking the words and the passages quite clearly, one should keep in mind the seven voices and seven tunes. Like the gathas of the Samaveda, several types of tunes are used in the same like : Manivarodana, Gaurandha, Santika, Sriraga, Hillola and Vajavika. The Samhita should be heard with these Ragas.

## \|\| 2.7.115 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|*  
*pāpaiḥ pramucyate sarvairmahāpuṇyaṃ ca viṃdati \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. The Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and especially the Sudras by gaining the merit of the Asvamedha sacrifice, get relieved of all the sins and earn the merits.

## \|\| 2.7.116 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyo vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriyaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyāṃte tathā viprāḥ śṛṇuyuścāgrataḥ sadā \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. For the listening of the same, the Vaisyas should be seated ahead of the Madras. The Ksatriyas should be seated ahead of the Vaisyas and the Brahmanas should be seated ahead of the Ksatriyas. All the people should listen to the discourse in this order.

## \|\| 2.7.117 \|\|

*na śūdraḥ kathayeddharmāṃstapaadhyāpane tathā \|*  
*naihikatvaṃ paratvaṃ ca na śubhaṃ na parāṃ gatim \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. The Sudras should not perform any type of tapas or the adhyapana or the religious discourse. Similarly, the Sudras should not try for the achieving of the loka-paraloka, dharma and the highest position.

## \|\| 2.7.118 \|\|

*śūdreṇādhigataṃ nāsti viśeṣācchabdalakṣaṇam \|*  
*yaddvijasya kṛto dāso brahmaṇā'vyaktayoninā \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. The Sudras have been deprived of learning of the grammar, because they had been declared as the servants of the Brahmanas

## \|\| 2.7.119 \|\|

*śvaśṛgālakharīkṣīramapeyaṃ hi yathā bhavet \|*  
*evaṃ śūdramukhāddharmā na grāhyāḥ śabdasaṃskṛtāḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. As the milk of a bitch, she jackal and the she donkey has been declared to be unfit for human consumption, similarly the religious auspicious words coming out of the mouth of the Sudras are unfit to be heard.

## \|\| 2.7.120-121 \|\|

*amedhyaṃ śudhyate toyaiḥ śūdraḥ śrotā hi śudhyati \|*  
*evaṃ śūdro'pyaśuciḥ syādyadi vyākaraṇārthavit \|\| 120 \|\|*

*yaḥ śūdra uddiśeddharmaṃ tathā cāgamavaidikam \|*  
*sa vai vadhyo nareṃdreṇa jihvāṃ cakreṇa chedayet \|\| 121 \|\|*

120-121. An impure object is purified with water, similarly, a Sudra gets purified by listening to the scriptures. A Sudra who studies the grammar, is basically impure. The rulers should cut off the tongue of a Sudra, who is well read in the Sastras.

## \|\| 2.7.122 \|\|

*budhyamānaḥ sadā hyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnameva ca \|*  
*ya evaṃ kathayetsamyaksa vipro vyāsa ucyate \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. A person who is well-versed in all the scriptures and who can explain them in a beautiful way, is known as a Vyasa.

## \|\| 2.7.123 \|\|

*vasetsa pattane grāme puṇye deśe sa kīrtitaḥ \|*  
*te dhanyāste kṛtātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*vasaṃti pattane tasminvyākhyātā yatra saṃvaset \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. A village or a town, in which such a Brahmana resides, it becomes an auspicious place. Similarly, the village or town in which an orator lives, it becomes graceful, successful as well as the one who has accomplished the taste. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 2.7.124-125 \|\|

*yathārkahīnaṃ divasaścaṃdrahīnā yathā niśā \|*  
*na rarāja sabhā tadvadvyāsena rahitā dvijāḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

*yadgṛhe naiva śiśavo na rarāja gṛhaṃ kvacit \|*  
*yathaikato grahāḥ sarve ekatastu divākaraḥ \|*  
*tathaiva sodara gehe dṛṣṭvā puṣkaradarśanam \|\| 125 \|\|*

124-125. A day without the sun or a night without the moon are not graceful. Similarly, a gathering is not graceful without a Vyasa. A house without the children can never be graceful. As all the planets twinkle on one side and the sun shines on die other side, similarly finding a child among the brothers, one enjoys the great ecstasy.

## Chapter 8. The glory of Puranas

## \|\| 2.8.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇudhvaṃ viprasaṃghātāḥ purāṇaṃ devasaṃmatam \|*  
*yacchrutvā mucyate pāpātpuruṣo brahmahatyayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tṛtīyaṃ śaivamākhyātaṃ tato bhāgavataṃ param \|*  
*paṃcamaṃ ca tathā mātsyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ṣaṣṭhamucyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

*asāmarthye ca mātsyoktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca bhaviṣyakam \|*  
*bhārate cāpi parvaṃ ca śāṃtibhaiṣmīyakaṃ tathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Suta said - О Brahmanas, I am now going to speak about the Puranas, listening to which, as per the opinion of the Devas, a person is relieved of Brahmahatya. You please listen The third one is Siva Purana, the fourth is the Bhagavata Purana, the fifth is the Matsya Purana, the sixth is the Bhavisya Purana These Puranas should be beard, besides the Santi and Вhismа parvas of the Mahabharata

## \|\| 2.8.4 \|\|

*parāśaramataṃ gṛhyaṃ gobhiloktāni yāni ca \|*  
*kātyāyanoktamaparamabhyasennigamāditaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The Smrtis composed by Parasara, Grhya-sutras, all the books composed by Gobila and the Katyayana Sutra should be heard and studied. One should start the study from Nirukta.

## \|\| 2.8.5-8 \|\|

*aṃtareṇāgate martye śāstraṃ nādhyāpayetkvacit \|*  
*ekarātraṃ gate martye trirātramajameṣayoḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*maṃḍūke paṃcarātraṃ tu sarpe rātricatuṣṭayam \|*  
*saṃvatsaraṃ tu turage gaje dvādaśavatsarān \|\| 6 \|\|*

*māsamekaṃ khare kāke sthānatyāgānna kutracit \|*  
*kerave vā rave caiva ahorātraṃ pracakṣate \|\| 7 \|\|*

*trirātramapi mārjāre nakule mūṣake khare \|*  
*haṃse dinamanadhyāyaṃ kṣudrajaṃtau na dūṣaṇam \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. While the preceptor and the disciple are engaged in study and it is interrupted with the arrival of another person, the study should be discontinued for a night on the arrival of a sheep or a goat; for three days on the arrival of the frog; for five days on the arrival of a snake; for five nights on the arrival of a horse; for a year on the arrival of an elephant; for twelve days on the arrival of an ass or a crow; and for a month, the studies should be discontinued. No holiday is to be observed when the place of study is changed On hearing of some uncertainty or disturbance, the interruption should be observed for a day and night. On the arrival of a cat, mongoose, rat and the donkey, the halt in studies should be carried out for three nights. Similarly, on the arrival of swan, the study has to be halted for a day. When some other small insects arrive, there is no blemish for them.

## \|\| 2.8.9 \|\|

*adhyāpayedguroḥ putraṃ jñāninaṃ dhārmikaṃ śucim \|*  
*bhaktaṃ śāṃtaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca jitakrodhaṃ jiteṃdriyam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Such a Grhyasutra should be taught to a person who is knowledgeable, religious-minded, observes purity, a devotee, a Vaisnava, having controlled his sense organs.

## \|\| 2.8.10-12 \|\|

*adhyātmādhyāpayedebhyaḥ śaṭhaṃ pāpaharaṃ dviṣam \|*  
*anyāyenaiva yacchatamabhayaṃ dāṃbhikaṃ dviṣam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nirarthakaṃ maṃtharaṃ ca viśuśrūṣumayājakam \|*  
*ṣaṇḍaṃ caivānṛjuṃ kruddhaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vyasanārthinam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*niṃdakaṃ cāvidhijñaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet \|*  
*apracchannanataṃ brūyātputrapautrādikādṛte \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. No spiritual person should teach a wicked, sinful, jealous, injudicious person, fearless, a cheat, enemy, who indulges in useless talk, terrific, who walks slowly, who does not serve the preceptor, who does not perform the yajna, eunuch, crooked, angry by nature, a coward, one who indulges in vices, back bites and the one who is unaware of the rules. Such people should not be given the education or should not be taught and should be discarded from a distance. Except one’s own sons and the grandsons, all other people should be addressed politely.

## \|\| 2.8.13-15 \|\|

*vidyayā saha martavyaṃ na dadyācca pṛthagjane \|*  
*ato vidyā vadatyevaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ dvijottamam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mā dadyādbhaktihīnāya durjanāya durātmane \|*  
*apramādāya viprāya śucaye brahmacāriṇe \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sārthakāya vidhijñāya sādhave dehi sattama \|*  
*dadyādyadi niṣiddhāya vidyādhanamanuttamam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. A teacher should die carrying his knowledge with him, but should not impart education to the aforesaid people. Therefore, Vidya speaks to the Brahmanas- “those who are devoid of devotion, wicked and blemished people should not be educated. In case you have to educate a person, he should be free from arrogance, should be observing purity, a Brahmacari, a companion, well-versed in the procedures and a noble Brahmana.”

## \|\| 2.8.16-18 \|\|

*tayorekataro gacchedacireṇa yamakṣayam \|*  
*anyāyena grahaṃ vidyāmanyaṃ pāṭhayate sukhāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ vidyāvarjyaḥ sa ucyate \|*  
*ādhyātmikaṃ vaidikaṃ cālaukikaṃ vātha yo vadet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*mānamādau praṇamyātha tato'dhīyīta suvrataḥ \|*  
*karmakāṃḍaṃ jyotiṣasya tadvinā na samabhyaset \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. In case the excellent wealth of knowledge is imparted to a degraded person, then either of the two shall have to face the sufferings at the hand of Yama for a long time. When a teacher is lovingly teaching a noble disciple and someone else also get educated stealthily by unfair means, then he has to fall in a terrific hell, because he had been declared unfit to get himself educated. In the study or the teaching of the Vedanta, Vedic or other divine scriptures, the student should first bow down and then start the study. Similarly, the study of Karma-kanda and astrology should not be started without offering the salutation.

## \|\| 2.8.19-22 \|\|

*cūtabhogasamabhyāsāddaridraścābhijāyate \|*  
*vādabhāgasamabhyāsāddhananāśāya jāyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

*nidhibhāgasamabhyāsājjāyate nārake kule \|*  
*yānyanuktāni śāstrāṇi mānanīyāni yāni ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

*mlecchoktāni mahimnāni nābhyaseddūratastyajet \|*  
*lokānāṃ jñānavṛddhyarthaṃ yaḥ kuryāddharmasaṃgraham \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pravartayitvā sa gururbhavejjānapradaḥ pitā \|*  
*jñānadātā ca lokānāṃ teṣu dharmaḥ pravartate \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. By practicing Cutabhaga one faces poverty, by practicing Vadabhaga there is loss of riches and by practicing the Nidhibhaga one has to fall in the hell. The scriptures which have not been respected besides the glory of which has been defined by the Mlecchas, should be discarded from a distance. To increase the knowledge of the people one who gets himself engaged in dharma, he is known as the preceptor, because of his having initiated the same. Since he bestows the knowledge, he is also known as the father. He alone bestows knowledge or education to the people. Therefore, he is known as the combination of all the dharmas.

## \|\| 2.8.23-25 \|\|

*nigamānāṃ jyotiṣāṇāṃ vedānāṃ nāṭakasya ca \|*  
*vyākhyānasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā kalau nāśamavāpnuyāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

*vedānāṃ dharbhaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*mīmāṃsājyotiṣāṃ caiva nāṭakānāṃ viraṃcinī \|\| 24 \|\|*

*bhāgāvasāne kathitaḥ purāṇādhyāya eva ca \|*  
*puṣpakaśca paricchedaḥ khaṃḍaśca pratikhaṃḍakaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. In the age of Kali one who collects the commentaries of Nigamas, astrology, die Vedas and the plays, meets with his destruction. Similar is the case with the Vedas, Dharmasastras, Puranas, Mimamsa, Astrology, Plays etc. At the end of each part and at the aid of the chapter of a Purana, a mark of bunch should be drawn. Besides the divisions, sub-divisions should also be made.

## \|\| 2.8.26 \|\|

*vyavahāraścārthaśāstramaśvaśāstrasya caiva hi \|*  
*yasya bhāgāvasāne tu prayoktavyaḥ sa eva hi \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The Artha-sastra should be put into use. Similarly, the treatises on the horses should also be made use of.

## \|\| 2.8.27 \|\|

*tatsaṃgrahepi kavinā niyoktavyaḥ sa eva hi \|*  
*yasya nātropadeśe tu pravartayati saṃgrahaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When a discourse has to be made in the name of someone, a poet should be engaged for the purpose, because he happens to be the creator of the collection.

## \|\| 2.8.28-29 \|\|

*tattadakṣarasakhyānāṃ brahmalokānna taccyutiḥ \|*  
*na saṃgrahastaṃtramaṃtre vedamaṃtre ca varjayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

*mohātkṛtvā homadhenuṃ dattvā śuddhirbhaviṣyati \|*  
*kṛtvā cākhyāyikāgraṃthasvarūpānsa divaṃ vrajet \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. The person who does so, does not have to fall from the heaven for a period equivalent to the number of the alphabets used in the work. The collection of the mantra, tantras and the hymns of the Vedas is prohibited. In case someone out of ignorance does so, he gets purified by giving away in charity a cow made of gold. By making the form of the treatises or stories, the writer achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 2.8.30-31 \|\|

*dharmaśāstrasya gamyasya vyavahārasya caiva hi \|*  
*kalau yaḥ saṃgrahaṃ kuryātprasupte caiva keśave \|\| 30 \|\|*

*yāvatpravartate lokastāvatsvarge mahīyate \|*  
*siṃhe pauṣe ca caitre ca na kuryātsaṃgrahaṃ kvacit \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. A person who in the age of Kali, for all practical purposes, brings out a simple and more practical collection in the Caturmasa and other persons enjoy the benefit for the same, he is respected in the heaven. But when the sun is in the Simha rasi, besides the same should not be done also in the Pausa and Caitra months.

## \|\| 2.8.32-34 \|\|

*prātaḥkāle na kurvīt tathā madhyaṃdine dvijāḥ \|*  
*pakṣāṃte bhūbhidāhe ca bhuvaḥ kaṃpe dinakṣaye \|\| 32 \|\|*

*malamāse viśeṣeṇa sandhyayośca vivarjane \|*  
*amedhyāktaṃ ca patraṃ ca lipyakṣaravibhūṣitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*pūtaṃ syāttatkṣaṇādviprāścatuḥ paṃcākṣareṇa vā \|*  
*nārasiṃhasya vinyāse pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. The collection should not be made in the morning, at noon, at the end of the fortnight, when the earth is in flames during earthquake, when the day is on the decline or during an intercalary month falling once in three years or an extra month and particularly at both the times of Sandhyas. О Brahmanas, when there is the possibility of impurity of the writing script or the words, with four or five letters of Narasimha Purina it gets purified at the same time.

## \|\| 2.8.35-36 \|\|

*māyāvibhavavinyaste mahāpāpakalevare \|*  
*muhūrtārdhena pūtatvaṃ prabhoryāṃti parāṃ gatim \|\| 35 \|\|*

*striyo vā niṃdito vāpi mleccho yāti parāṃ gatim \|*  
*yo mūḍho manyate doṣaṃ tasya śaucaṃ samācaret \|*  
*sa gardabhīṃ kharīṃ yoniṃ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The bodies get blemished in the world which is full of pleasures and illusion. Therefore, it has been prescribed that for its purification in case a person recites the name of the lord even for a moment, then he gets the best position. Irrespective of the person’s being a woman or a denounced Mleccha (he gets redeemed). The fools who find blemish in the same, they are required to be purified. Otherwise, they shall have to be bom as an ass or a Raksasi. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 2.8.37-39 \|\|

*ekamevātmakaṃ brahma tatprakṛtyātmakaṃ dvayam \|*  
*navātmako bhairavaśca daśamaśca janārdanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rudra ekādaśaścaiva arkārkaścāpi dvādaśaḥ \|*  
*trayoviṃśe ca bhūtātmā ṣaḍviṃśe manurīritaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tithyātmakaṃ paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśākhyā kalāparā \|*  
*vātātmakaḥ saptadaśo mantraḥ samanuvartate \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. Brahman is one, but takes to two forms, when he unites with Prakrti. His ninth form is Bhairava and tenth form is Janardana. The eleventh form is Rudra and twelfth one is Surya. Bhutatma is the twenty third form, while Manus are said to be twenty six in number. There are fifteen tithis (or moon days), sixteen is the number of his kalis (digits) which form his part. V3yu is his seventeenth form who is clearly indicated by the mantras.

## \|\| 2.8.40-45 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśākṣaro maṃtraḥ purāṇātmaka eva ca \|*  
*ūnaviṃśaścaṃdramāḥ syādviṃśo nārāyaṇo vapuḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*jyotirmayaścaikaviṃśo dvāviṃśe keśavārcanam \|*  
*nakṣatrāṇi trayoviṃśe caturviṃśe ca tānakam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*paṃcaviṃśe ca tīrthāni ṣaḍviṃśe ca triyaṃbakaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭāviṃśe dhaneśaśca ūnatriṃśe sarasvatī \|\| 42 \|\|*

*triṃśadyoge śivaḥ proktaḥ pātālamekatriṃśake \|*  
*ahorātraśca dvātriṃśe catustriṃśe ca jāhnavī \|\| 43 \|\|*

*paṃcatriṃśe tadaṃtaḥ syācchate pūrṇe divākaraḥ \|*  
*sahasre ca śivo jñeyaścāyute merurucyate \|\| 44 \|\|*

*lakṣe brahmā tathā koṭyāṃ devo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*puṃprakṛtyātmakaṃ cānyacchāradālipimātṛkā \|\| 45 \|\|*

40-45. The mantras are of eighteen tithis, and the eighteen Puranas are the form of lord. The moon is the nineteenth while Narayana is the twentieth one. The twenty first form is that of flower. Kesava is the twenty second form, the constellations are his twenty third form, the tunes of the music are his twenty fourth form. The tirthas are his twenty fifth form. Trayambaka is his twenty sixth form. Kubera is his twenty eighth form. Sarasvati is his nineteenth form, Siva is his thirtieth form. The thirty first is Patala. Days and nights are his thirty second form. The Ganga is his thirty fourth form. Thirty fifth is his last form. The hundredth part is Divakara. Lord Siva at thestage of a thousand, while Meru comes at the stage of ten thousand. Brahma comes at the stage of a lakh, while Narayana has been placed at the point of a crore. The same Brahman stands as Purusa and Prakrti or Sarada the goddess of learning.

## \|\| 2.8.46 \|\|

*śuddhabrahmamayaṃ nityaṃ jñānarūpaṃ paraṃ mahat \|*  
*yasminna vyasanādeva śucau cāpyaśucisthale \|*  
*kṣaṇe brahmamayaṃ yāti ityāha bhagavānmanuḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The same spotless Brahman is eternal, form of knowledge and immensely great. Living at an auspicious or inauspicious place because of his being her beloved, he is turned as a Brahman in a moment. This has been spoken by Manu.

## Chapter 9. Decision about wells and pillars

## \|\| 2.9.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*aṃtarvediṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇoktaṃ yugāṃtare \|*  
*bahirvedaṃ tathaivoktaṃ śastaṃ syāddvāpare kalau \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - Now, I am speaking about antarvedi which was described by Brahma at the start of the yuga and also the Bhairvedi which was famous during Dvapara and the age of Kali.

## \|\| 2.9.2 \|\|

*jñānasādhyaṃ tu yatkarma aṃtarvedīti kathyate \|*  
*devatāsthāpanaṃ pūjā bahiveṃdirudāhṛtā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Such of the activities which get established through knowledge are known as antarvedi, while the consecration of the images of the deities and their worshipping process is known as bahirvedi

## \|\| 2.9.3 \|\|

*prapāpūrtādikaṃ caiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca toṣaṇam \|*  
*gurubhyaḥ paricaryā ca bahirvedī dvidhā matā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The setting up a place for supply of free drinking water, giving in charity a tank, or to please the Brahmanas with the giving away of the food etc. besides serving the preceptors, are the two forms of bahirvedi.

## \|\| 2.9.4 \|\|

*akāmena kṛtaṃ karma karma ca vyasanādikam \|*  
*aṃtarvedī tadevoktaṃ bahirvedī viparyayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The performing of the deeds without desire and with desire are the forms of bahv-vedi. The deeds performed besides the above fall under bahir-vedi.

## \|\| 2.9.5 \|\|

*dharmasya kāraṇaṃ rājā dharmametadbhavennṛpaḥ \|*  
*tasmānnṛpaṃ samāśritya bahirvedī tato bhavet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The king is the cause of dharma arc auspicious deeds. Therefore, the bahir-vedi deeds should be performed, depending on the long.

## \|\| 2.9.6-7 \|\|

*saptāśītirbahirvedī sārameṣāṃ tṛtīyakam \|*  
*devatāsthāpanaṃ caiva prāsādakaraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*taḍāgakaraṇaṃ caiva tṛtīyaṃ na caturthakam \|*  
*paṃcamaṃ pitṛpūjā ca gurupūjāpuraḥsarā \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Under the bahirvedi karmas, eighty seven types of deeds are performed. But its third form is the essence. Consecration of a deity, building of the palaces with the temples and digging of tanks or rivers - rhese are the three activities over which a person should concentrate. The fourth one is insignificant The fifth one is the worship of the parents as well as the preceptors, which also needs special attention.

## \|\| 2.9.8-9 \|\|

*adhivāsaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca devatānāmavikriyā \|*  
*pratimākaraṇaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāmatha ropaṇam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*trividhā sā vinirdiṣṭā uttamā cātha madhyamā \|*  
*kaniṣṭhā śeṣakalpaśca sarvakāryeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Building of temples for the deities and to consecrate them in a spotless manner, the making of the images of the deities, to grow the gardens which are of three types i.e. the best, medium type as well as the ordinary one - this process should be made use of all the jobs.

## \|\| 2.9.10 \|\|

*tridhā bhavati sarvatra pratiṣṭhādividhirmataḥ \|*  
*pūjāhomādibhirdānairmānataśca tribhāgataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The consecration of the deities should always be done in an appropriate manner, their worship and the performing of the homa and the giving of charities is of three types.

## \|\| 2.9.11 \|\|

*tryahasādhyavidhānena aṣṭāviṃśatidevatāḥ \|*  
*tridhā bhavati sarvatra pratiṣṭhādividhirmataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The process by which the consecration ceremony has to be completed in three days, twenty eight gods and goddesses are invoked in that process, in that process also, the method of consecration is of three types.

## \|\| 2.9.12 \|\|

*pratyahaṃ pūjayettatra jāpakāstatra ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*uttamo'sau vidhiḥ kṛtsno hyaśvamedhaphalapradaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Under this process, sixteen Brahmanas are to be adored daily. This process is said to be the best, because one who performs this, he earns the merit of an Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.9.13-15 \|\|

*catvāro yājakāstatra trayoviṃśatidevatāḥ \|*  
*brahadikpāla vāruṇyaṃ pṛthivī ca śivastathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ekāhenaiva pūjā ca madhyamaḥ kathito vidhiḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśagrahadikpālānvaruṇaṃ ca śivaṃ tathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya pūjyate yatra kaniṣṭho'sau vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*ekavṛkṣaścaikarūpaiḥ pratimākṣudradevatāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Accordingly, there are four yajakas (the performers). Twenty three deities are invoked and consecrated, besides the planets, Dikpalas, Varuna, Earth goddess and Siva. All of them are to be consecrated with Siva. This process is complete in a day. It has therefore been described as the middle process. The process in which Ganesa, planets, Dikpalas, Varuna and Siva are initially worshipped and thereafter the ceremony of consecration is performed, is known as the shortlist process As the tree has several types of branches, similarly, initially the image also remains in an insignificant form.

## \|\| 2.9.16-17 \|\|

*nalinīdīrghikāgartavāpīmalaprapādikam \|*  
*eṣāṃ saṃskārakāryeṣu pratimānāṃ pariṣkriyā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā na kuryādvidhivistaram \|*  
*gaṇeśagrahadikpālānpūjayedupacārataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Using the water of the tank with lotus flowers, small tanks attached to houses, stepwells and with the water flowing through the household water channels, the images should be washed and then purified in the fire. This process is not required to be followed in an extensive manner. In this case, the worship of Ganesa, planets and Dikpalas should be performed.

## \|\| 2.9.18-20 \|\|

*vāpyādeḥ puṣkariṇyāśca kṣipedgaṃgājalaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*ulūkhaladvayenāpi jīrṇānāṃ tu kadācana \|\| 18 \|\|*

*setuprāsādavāpīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet \|*  
*prāsādaḥ setavaścaiva taḍāgādyāstathaiva ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tribhirvarṇaiḥ pratiṣṭhārhā jīrṇānāṃ tu samudgatāḥ \|*  
*munayo mānamicchaṃti amānaṃ na hi dṛśyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. In the water of step-well or in the water of the tank with lotus flowers, the water of Ganga should be mixed. The shattered step-wells, temples or the bridges should never be consecrated. The temples, tanks and the bridges are required to be consecrated by the people of the three varnas. The sages have regarded the size of the structure in all the cases to be important. Therefore, none is visible to them without the size or measurements.

## \|\| 2.9.21-22 \|\|

*tasmānmānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ phalam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭihastapramāṇena taduktaṃ vāraṇoditam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ekaṣaṣṭihastamitaṃ prāsādaṃ cottamaṃ viduḥ \|*  
*madhyaṃ tadardhaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tatparaṃ smṛtam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Therefore, whatever merit is achieved by a person with a particular type of self respect, is being related by me. The size of the elephant stable should be of the length of sixty cubits. The learned people have said that a palace of sixty one cubits would be best. The one which is half of its size has been termed as the medium one. Those which are of other sizes have been termed as the small.

## \|\| 2.9.23-26 \|\|

*atha vā devamānena kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|*  
*yastaḍāgaṃ navaṃ kṛtvā jīrṇaṃ vā navatāṃ nayet \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ kulaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaloke mahīyate \|*  
*vāpīkūpataḍāgāśca udyānapravahāstathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*punaḥ punaśca saṃskāryo labhate mauktikaṃ phalam \|*  
*guṇānāṃ ca pramāṇena pratimānaṃ vibhāgataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dviśatena śatenāpi prāsādasyaiṣa niścayaḥ \|*  
*sahasrahastavistāraṃ dairghyeṇāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. Otherwise, according to the measure of gods, the temples should be built. This would be beneficial for those who are desirous of huge fortunes. According to the same measure, those who build a new tank or renovate the existing one, they redeem all their races and are honoured in the heaven. By renovating again and again the step-wells, wells as well as the tanks, which are the source of the supply of water to the gardens, the person achieves salvation. A palace has been described to be built in an area of two hundred cubits. The tank should be of expansion or width of a thousand cubits and the length should be eight times more of the width. This happens to be its first measure.

## \|\| 2.9.27 \|\|

*taḍāgaṃ taṃ vijānīyātprathamaṃ mānamīritam \|*  
*madhyaṃ catuḥśatenāpi prastāve daśahīnakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The reservoir spread in an area of four hundred cubits is said to be of medium type. Its size could initially be reduced by ten cubits.

## \|\| 2.9.28-31 \|\|

*kaniṣṭhaṃ triśataṃ caiva prasthe syādviṃśahīnakam \|*  
*tadardhena kalau jñeyaṃ tadardhena tadardhakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*taḍāgamānaṃ vijñeyaṃ trivargaphaladāyakam \|*  
*atha puṣkariṇīpakṣe dve śate mānamuttamam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*taḍāge dviguṇā nemī mānārdhe gartamīritam \|*  
*tatkṣetraṃ vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ tryuditaṃ tadbahiḥ smṛtam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*caturthaṃ caiva gāṃdharvaṃ paiśācaṃ paṃcamaṃ viduḥ \|*  
*yakṣasthānamitā bhāge evaṃ sarvakramāṇi hi \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. Similarly, a tank of three cubits area is said to be of the lowest type. This could be reduced by twenty cubits, when required. In image of Kali, in case a tank of the half of the earlier size or further half or one fourth of the same is built, it yields the merits of trivarga or dharma, artha and kama. A small pond has been prescribed to be of two hundred cubits. The land of the banks of the pond should be double of its size. Half of the total area should be dug for the purpose of making a pond It becomes the dwelling place of Varuna. Similarly, the construction of a pond has to be the third praiseworthy activity under the category of the bahirvedi performances. There is no fourth because the one comes under Gandharva and the fifth are the activities of the Pisacas. The rest is the place of Yaksas.

## \|\| 2.9.32 \|\|

*aśītihastamānena nalinyā maṇirucyate \|*  
*pañcahīnaṃ ca prastāve evaṃ mānavido viduḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The lotus pond where the lotuses are grown is said to be of eighty cubits which is

known as mani. At the time of digging of the same, its size could be reduced by five cubits according to the requirement.

## \|\| 2.9.33 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭihastena nalinī prastāve turyahīnakam \|*  
*catuḥṣaṣṭihastamitā dīrghikā ca prakīrtitā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The lotus pond of sixty cubits could initially be reduced by four cubits. Similarly, a step-well spread in an area of sixty four cubits should be prepared.

## \|\| 2.9.34 \|\|

*turyahīnaṃ ca prastāve garte mānaṃ na vidyate \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Initially, its size can be reduced by four cubits. No measure of its pit has been described.

## \|\| 2.9.35 \|\|

*agnau rogo baṃdhunāśaśca yāmyāṃ mṛtyuścograḥ prāpyate rākṣase ca \|*  
*bhītiścogrā prāpyate vāyavīye tasmādetā varjanīyāḥ prayatnāt \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. In case the water reservoir is built in the south-east direction, the disease spreads. By building it to the south, the loss of relatives occurs. When built in the southwest, one has to face terrific death and when built in the north-west, one has to face danger. Therefore, these directions should be discarded.

## \|\| 2.9.36 \|\|

*viprādīnāṃ devatānāṃ samāje merusthāne yatra tatraiva kuryāt \|*  
*nadyāstīre varjayedvā smaśāne taḍāgādvai āśramādīñjanānām \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. In the communities of the Brahmanas, in desert land as well as the gods, the tanks can be built as per one’s liking. The tank should not be built close to the river bank, cremation ground and close to the aramas of the people.

## \|\| 2.9.37 \|\|

*yadā pratiṣṭhāṃ na karoti mūḍhaḥ prāsādavāpyādiṣu pāpacetāḥ \|*  
*bhayaṃ samāpnoti ca pāpamugraṃ pade'hinā vai vadhabhāgitāṃ vrajet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Such of the foolish people, who do not formally consecrate the buildings, step-wells etc., they earn, besides the danger, terrific sins. Such people should be put to an end with a snake bite.

## \|\| 2.9.38 \|\|

*yadā tu dīrghāsarasītaḍāgaprāsādakūpādiṣu nirmitāni \|*  
*kurvaṃti cānyāni yadā makhāni bhavaṃti naivāsya phalapradāni \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. After the new construction of a step-well, a pond, a tank, a palace, well etc., the people who while consecrating them, also perform some yajnas, they do not earn the related merit.

## \|\| 2.9.39 \|\|

*yadapratiṣṭheṣu nipānakeṣu prāsādakūpeṣu vanādikeṣu \|*  
*pratiṣṭhite yatphalamāpnuvaṃti phalaṃ tadālpālpakamāhurasya \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. A lake, a palace, a well and an orchard, which are not formally consecrated after then construction, one gets half the merit as compared to the one achieved after formally consecrating the same. It would be equivalent to nothing.

## \|\| 2.9.40 \|\|

*tasmātpratiṣṭhāṃ vidhinā jalādeḥ kuryādyatheṣṭaṃ prayato manuṣyaḥ \|*  
*puṇyārjanenaiva dhanena kāle svavittasādhyena śubhāśayena \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Therefore, a person for the establishment of a water reservoir, should make all the efforts to consecrate the same. Out of the auspicious earnings of a person, one should spent (for a noble cause) according to his means.

## \|\| 2.9.41-42 \|\|

*prasāde mṛnmayaṃ puṇyaṃ mayaitatkathitaṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*tasmāccaturguṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhamaye tathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tṛṇamaye śatamayaṃ tadardhaṃ navavalkale \|*  
*tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛte dārumaye bhavet \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. О Brahmanas, one earns great merit by building a palace in mud. I have already spoken about the same. In case the same is built in wood, the related merit is multiplied to four times, when it is built with straw the merit is increased to a hundred times. The merit is reduced to half if the same is made in fresh bark. In case it is made in wood, it increases to ten times.

## \|\| 2.9.43-44 \|\|

*tato daśaguṇaṃ proktamiṣṭikāracite śubhe \|*  
*tasmācchataguṇaṃ śaile sahasraṃ tāmraraupyake \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tataśca śatasāhasraṃ sauvarṇe dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*anaṃtaphalamāpnoti ratnādi racite tathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. In case the same is built with bricks, the merit is enhanced to ten times; in case the same is built with copper, the merit is enhanced to hundred times; in case the same is built with gold, the merit is enhanced to thousand times; and in case the same is built with gems, one earns boundless merit.

## \|\| 2.9.45 \|\|

*yadatītaṃ bhaviṣyacca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*viṣṇulokaṃ nayatyāśu kārayitvā harergṛham \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. When a person builds a temple for the lord, he atonce sends ten thousand of his families (relatives) to the place of Visnu,

## \|\| 2.9.46 \|\|

*kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārayitvā harergṛham \|*  
*ardhaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ mokṣaṃ ca labhate kramāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. By building the temples of lower type, medium type and the best type, he respectively earns half of merits, Visnuloka and moksa respectively.

## \|\| 2.9.47 \|\|

*hastānāṃ poḍaśairyāvatprasthe syātkarahīnakam \|*  
*tṛṇavaṃśamaye mānaṃ madhyaṃ cārkakaraṃ bhavet \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. By building a temple with bamboos and straw, the size for the same has been prescribed of sixteen cubits and could be reduced by a cubit in the beginning. This is known to be of medium measure.

## \|\| 2.9.48 \|\|

*kaniṣṭhaṃ tārahastaṃ syāduttamaṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ \|*  
*sarvottamaṃ ca dvātriṃśaccatuṣkoṇe mahāphalam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. One of the size of tara and hasta is known to be the lowest, while the one with twenty five cubit size is said to be the best. Similarly, the one with the size of thirty two cubits is said to be the best. In case the building is designed as square, it is said to be the best, which earns an enormous merit.

## \|\| 2.9.49-50 \|\|

*puradvāraṃ ca kartavyaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃ bhavet \|*  
*aṣṭakoṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ tripuraṃ ca kalau yuge \|\| 49 \|\|*

*suraveśmani yāvaṃto dvijendrāḥ paramāṇavaḥ \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. The gate of the building should also be in square shape. In the age of Kali, a three storey with octagonal design should not be built. О Brahmanas, the number of the petty insects live in a temple of the god. The person who builds the temple lives in the heaven with all the honours, for a period equivalent to the number of insects multiplied by a thousand.

## \|\| 2.9.51-52 \|\|

*karturdaśaguṇaṃ proktamāpānaparipālakaḥ \|*  
*patitānyuddharedyastu sa sarvaṃ phalamaśnute \|\| 51 \|\|*

*patitaṃ patamānaṃ ca tathārddhasphuṭitaṃ tathā \|*  
*samuddhṛtya harerveśma dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Those who arrange for katha-bhumi (place for delivering discourses), they earn ten times more the merit and a person who renovates the temples which are in shattered condition, he earns all the merits. By renovating the totally damaged Visnu temples, one earns double the merit.

## \|\| 2.9.53 \|\|

*patitasya tu yaḥ kartā patamānasya rakṣitā \|*  
*viṣṇoradhitalasyaiva mānavaḥ svargabhāgbhavet \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. By renovating totally damaged Deva temples and carrying out the necessary repair of the same, one decorates the palace below the heaven.

## \|\| 2.9.54-55 \|\|

*yaḥ kuryādviṣṇuprāsādaṃ jyotirliṃgasya vā kvacit \|*  
*sūryasyāpi viriṃceśca durgāyāḥ śrīdharasya ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

*svayaṃ svakulamuddhṛtya kalpakoṭiṃ vaseddivi \|*  
*svargādbhraṣṭo bhavedrājā dhanī pūjyatamopi vā \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. A person, who builds a temple for lord Visnu or a similar type of temple for Jyotirlinga, Sun temple or the temples for Brahma and Durga, he besides redeeming his entire race, lives in the heaven for crores of kalpas. After his fall from the heaven, he becomes a wealthy and adorable king.

## \|\| 2.9.56 \|\|

*devīliṃgeṣu yonau vā kṛtvā devakulaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*smaratvaṃ prāpnuyālloke pūjito divi sarvadā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. By constructing the Siva temples at Saktipithas, he is always remembered in the world besides being adorable.

## \|\| 2.9.57 \|\|

*prāvṛṭkāle sthitaṃ toyamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*śaratkālasthitaṃ toyaṃ yajñatoyādviśiṣyate \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. In case the step-well is filled with water during the rainy season, (the person who built it) earns the merit of performing the Agnistoma yajna. In case the step-well contains water in the winter season as well, then it becomes more auspicious than the water of a yajna.

## \|\| 2.9.58 \|\|

*nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati vāpinaḥ \|*  
*svargaṃ gacchetsa narakaṃ na kadācidavāpnuyāt \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. In case the same step-well stores water during the summer season as well, then the concerned person achieves heaven, after which he has never to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 2.9.59 \|\|

*ekāhaṃ tu sthitaṃ toyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*kulāni tārayettasya sapta sapta parāṇi ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. By keeping that water for a day, his seven past and seven future generations get purified.

## \|\| 2.9.60-70 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ pitṛkule sapta tadvanmātṛkule dvijāḥ \|*  
*caturdaśamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śatalekhaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu \|\| 60 \|\|*

*piturūrdhvaṃ kulaṃ viṃśaṃ māturūrdhva kulaṃ tathā \|*  
*tadvatparaṃ vijānīyādbhāryāyāḥ paṃca eva ca \|\| 61 \|\|*

*paṃca vai mātṛtaścāsya piturmātāmahe kule \|*  
*paṃca paṃca vijānīyānmāturmātāmahasya ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

*guroḥ pitṛkule paṃca tasya mātṛkule tathā \|*  
*ācāryasya kule dvaṃdvaṃ daśarājakulasya ca \|\| 63 \|\|*

*rājño mātāmahakule paṃca caiva prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*ekottaraṃ śatakulaṃ parisaṃkhyātameva ca \|\| 64 \|\|*

*ātmanā saha vipreṃdrā uddhāraḥ saṃmataḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*kuryāddevārcanaṃ tīrthe svavimukte daśārṇave \|\| 65 \|\|*

*samuddharetkulaśataṃ śṛṇu viṃśakulaṃ dvija \|*  
*paṃca paṃca ca pitrośca piturmātāmahasya ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

*māturmātāmahasyaiva jātiṃ dvaṃdvamudāhṛtam \|*  
*guroḥ saṃtānake dvaṃdvaṃ tadvadyādavasāttvatau \|\| 67 \|\|*

*parapakṣasya caikaṃ syādekaviṃśaṃ kulaṃ kramāt \|*  
*pānīyametatsakalaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 68 \|\|*

*pānīyena vinā vṛttirloke nāstīti karhicit \|*  
*vārasvasthaṃ puṣpakhaṃḍaṃ toye patati yāvati \|\| 69 \|\|*

*tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge cānte brahmatvamāpnuyāt \|*  
*tasmāttoyopari gṛhaṃ prasādopari varjayet \|\| 70 \|\|*

60-70. О Brahmanas, among the fourteen generations, the seven are of parental line, while the Seven are of maternal line. Now I am describing about the hundred generations. You please listen. The twenty generations before the father and twenty generations before the mother, similarly five earlier generations of the wife, five generations of the mother, five of the past generations of mother, five of the father, five past generations of mother’s grandfather, five generations of the father of the preceptor, five generations of his mother’s side, two generations of Acarya, ten generations of the king and ten generations of the mother’s grandfather have been reckoned. Thus, a vast family of a hundred generations has been formed. О best of Brahmanas, their redemption at the same time is essential. For getting redeemed, one should worship the god at Dasarnava-tirtha and should redeem the hundred generations. О Brahmana, I am now describing the ten generations. You please listen. They are five from the mother’s family, five from father’s side, two of grandfather of the father, two of grandfather of the mother, ten from the race of the preceptor and ten of others. Thus, twenty one generations are I formed as a single family. Their redemption also is essential and a person should make all the constant efforts to do so. The mobile and immobile lord is competent enough to protect all the three lokas for all times to come. No one can sustain without the water. When the auspicious deeds merge in water, upto that time a person remains in the heaven. Thereafter, he gains the position of the Brahman. Therefore, the building of a palace over the water has been forbidden.

## \|\| 2.9.71 \|\|

*sūryaraśmiyutaṃ yadvai tattoyaṃ tu viniṃdatam \|*  
*caṃdraraśmivihīnaṃ yannāmṛtatvāya kalpate \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The water affected by the sun rays is not said to be praiseworthy one. On the other hand, the water without the moon rays is not said to be beneficial.

## \|\| 2.9.72 \|\|

*tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ kuṃḍe tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ hrade \|*  
*devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryādavimuktaphalaṃ śubham \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. A person gains ten times more merit by creating a water кир^а. Ten times more credit is earned by constructing a tank. By consecrating the gods, one earns besides salvation, many other benefits of auspicious nature.

## \|\| 2.9.73 \|\|

*susthitaṃ duḥsthitaṃ vāpi śivaliṃgaṃ na cālayet \|*  
*cālanādrauravaṃ yāti na svargaṃ na ca svargabhāk \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. A Sivalinga, irrespective of its being in a good or bad condition, should not be carried from one place to the other, because one who does so, cannot reach the heaven and has to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 2.9.74 \|\|

*ucchannagaragrāme sthānatyāge ca viplave \|*  
*punaḥ saṃsāradharmeṇa sthāpayedavicārayan \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Because of some calamity or after the destruction of a town or a village, the Sivalinga should also be consecrated at any place without much thought.

## \|\| 2.9.75 \|\|

*bāhudaṃtādipratimā viṣṇoścānyasya sattamāḥ \|*  
*na cālayetsthāpite ca vipravṛkṣaṃ na cālayet \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. When the arms and the teeth of the image of Visnu are broken or any other limbs get damaged, the same should not be worshipped even after its consecration. Similar is the case with a tree.

## \|\| 2.9.76 \|\|

*keśavaṃ harivṛkṣaṃ ca madhūkaṃ kiṃśukaṃ tathā \|*  
*nākāle sthāpayejjātu cālanādbrahmahā bhaveta \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Kesava or Hari-vrksa, Basia lotifolia, Butea frondesa are the trees which should never be planted untimely and when they are so planted, they should not be transplanted again, because one earns by so doing, the sin of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 2.9.77 \|\|

*devālayasya purataḥ kuryātpuṣkariṇī dvijāḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ samāje ca rājadvāre catuṣpathe \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. О Brahmanas, the collective village of the Brahmanas should be built in front of a temple at the crossing of the royal gate, besides a pond with lotus flowers should also be built there.

## \|\| 2.9.78 \|\|

*devātheṃ brāhmaṇārthe ca mukhaṃ kuryācca sarvataḥ \|*  
*paścime puṣṭikāmaṃ tu uttare sarvakāmadam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. All types of comforts should be provided to the gods as well as the Brahmanas, the faces of the water tanks etc. should be turned towards the west which increases strength, when turned towards the north, it fulfils all the desires.

## \|\| 2.9.79-81 \|\|

*yāmye svārthaṃ na kurvīta koṇe tu narakaṃ bhavet \|*  
*mukhaṃ prakalpayenmadhye keciduttaralaṃghanam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*kuryāddakṣiṇapūrve tu arkahastapramāṇataḥ \|*  
*taḍāge tu phalāhastaṃ hastikaṃ hrāsayetkramāt \|\| 80 \|\|*

*tṛpye hastaṃ nalinyādāvato hīnaṃ na kārayet \|*  
*gartatṛṇaṃ kalāhastaṃ taḍāge'tra pracakṣyate \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. While turning the face to the south, no one should be desirous of anything. Tinning of the face to the south-east or south-west is strictly prohibited. One who does so attains the hell. There it is required to face the middle. Some people are of the opinion that it should face the north. The face should be made to the south-east of the size of twelve cubits, which could be reduced in the tank. The water tank with lotus flowers should not be reduced in size in anyway. There should be a pillar in the middle of die tank, with the size of sixteen cubits.

## \|\| 2.9.82 \|\|

*hīne hīnataraṃ kuryāddhastamānena hrāsayet \|*  
*yūpastathā khādira eva kāryaḥ śraiparṇiko dhātrisamudbhavaśca \|*  
*mānastathā ṣoḍaśahastasammito ratnātsagaṇḍīyugakāmayojitaiḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. In case the tank is of a small size, then it could be reduced respectively according to the size of the tank. The pillars of catechu, silk cotton or Myrobalan tree, made of sixteen cubits in height should be created, decorating the same with gems.

## \|\| 2.9.83-84 \|\|

*ānāhabhagne ca bhavecca tasya viṃśāṃ gulo dviguṇo madhyagaśca \|*  
*madhyeṃ'gulaiśca hīnaḥ kāryaḥ śubhadaḥ sarvadā syāt \|\| 83 \|\|*

*evaṃvidhaścaiva taḍāgayūpo madhye tathā ṣoḍaśahastasaṃmitaḥ \|*  
*kūpe ca yūpopyatha hastamātrastataścaturhastamitaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. When the length of the pillar (is sixteen cubits), then it should be reduced in circumference at the middle by forty angulas or so made them in the middle, it becomes auspicious. The pillar of this type, which is sixteen cubits in length, has been prescribed to be installed in the middle of the tank. For the well, a pillar of a cubit or four cubits has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.9.85-86 \|\|

*ārāmayoge'pyatha maṇḍape ca kāryaścaturhastamito'tha yūpaḥ \|*  
*saṃpūrṇamāne kathitaṃ pramāṇaṃ hīne tu hīnaṃ pravadaṃti tajjñāḥ \|*  
*hastadvayaṃ prāpitavyaṃ taḍāge hastaḥ sārdhaḥ puṣkariṇyāṃ praropaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*prādeśaṃ vai hastamānaṃ kūpayūpasya ropataḥ \|*  
*na kuryājjalamagnaṃ ca yūpaṃ sarvatra sattamāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Similarly, in an orchard or а mandapa, a pillar of four cubits should be installed. Thus all the measures have been intelligendy described that in a tank of large size, big pillar should be installed and in the tank of the smaller size, a smaller pillar should be provided. As for example, the pillar of a big tank should of two cubits and for Pu$karipl tank, the one of the size of one and a half cubits would do; which should be installed in the middle. Similarly, the size of a pillar for a well is required to be of one cubit. It should be kept in mind that the pillar should not be drowned tn the water.

## \|\| 2.9.87 \|\|

*taḍāge cāpi ārāme sthāpayecca jalopari \|*  
*hastamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ syānmānenānena dāpayet \|*  
*vāpyāṃ garte puṣkariṇyāṃ prakuryājjalasaṃmitam \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. The pilars of the tank and orchards should be of half cubit in size and half a cubit of them should remain above the surface of the water. Similarly, the pillars of step-wells, pits or small tanks should remain at the water level.

## \|\| 2.9.88 \|\|

*yāvatpratolīgatareṇusaṃgasaṃkhyāgaṇo no jaratāmupaiti \|*  
*tāvatsureśaḥ suralokavāsī prāsādakṛjjātu na jāyate hi \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. As many particles of dust are there in the streets, and for the number of days, for an equal period of time, the person who builds the temple for the gods, becomes the chief of the gods in the heaven in a graceful way.

## \|\| 2.9.89-90 \|\|

*kiṃ vā vācyaḥ puṣkariṇyā prabhāvaḥ kartā yaḥ syādvāruṇo brahmalokāt \|*  
*yāvatkālo bāhumātroddhatā syād dṛṣṭiḥproktā na nivartetkadācit \|\| 89 \|\|*

*lakṣaikamārāmamayottamaḥ syānmadhyaṃ tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhamānam \|*  
*tadardhaṃ vā praśastaṃ tadananyaṃ munayo vadaṃti \|*  
*vinārjunairbadaraiḥ śailukaiśca hīnaṃ kuryācchānalaiḥ pātilaiśca \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. Who can describe the glory of the tank with lotus flowers, the builder of which himself takes to the form of Varuna, lives in Brahmaloka, till the time the universe exists? The pillar of iron, which is established in an orchard is required to be of a lakh of size. The pillar which is half of its size, is said to be of medium type and the one which is still half of it, is known as of the lowest size. The highest pillar is said to be the best as per the opinion of the sages. While making the pillars of wood, the trees like Arjuna, jujube, a tree with glutinous fruits, Sanala and Patala should be discarded.

## Chapter 10. The completion

## \|\| 2.10.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śodhayetprathamaṃ bhūmiṃ mitāṃ kṛtvā tato dvijāḥ \|*  
*daśahastena daṇḍena pañcahastena vā punaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - О Brahmanas, initially, the five or the ten cubits of land should be purified and then the digging of a tank or pond should be started.

## \|\| 2.10.2 \|\|

*vāhayetsadā vṛṣabhaistaḍāgārthe'pi bhūmikām \|*  
*devāgārasya yā bhūmiḥ śvetaiśca vṛṣabhairapi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. While digging the tank, the earth so dug should be heaped at some other place. Similarly, at the time of the building of a temple, the earth should be carried by the white bullocks.

## \|\| 2.10.3 \|\|

*yā bhūmirgrahayāgārthe tanna vāhairapi spṛśet \|*  
*ārāmārthe kṛṣṇavṛṣaiḥ kṛṣārthakhananairapi \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. At the time of the building of a mandala for the construction of a house, the earth should not be moved by a vehicle, because its use for the purpose is prohibited. While digging an orchard or a well, the bullocks of black colour should be used for carrying the earth.

## \|\| 2.10.4-5 \|\|

*vāhayettridinaṃ viprāḥ pañcavrīhīṃśca vāpayet \|*  
*devapakṣe saptaguṇa ārāmakaraṇe guṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*mudgamāṣau dhānya tilāḥ śyāmākaśceti pañcamaḥ \|*  
*masūraśca kalāyaśca saptavrīhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The work of the removal of the earth should be completed within three days. Thereafter, five types of cereals should be grown. When the temple of a deity or an orchard is to be built, the seven types of cereals should be grown, which include green gram, black gram, betel, sesamum and black millet. These are the five types of grains to be used or alternatively, these five, the small grained pulse or beans should be used, making the number to be seven.

## \|\| 2.10.6 \|\|

*sarṣapaśca kalāyaśca mudgo māṣaścaturthakaḥ \|*  
*vrīhitrayaṃ māṣamudgau śyāmāko mahiṣo gaṇaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The mustard, beans, green gram, black gram and millet have been described as the Mahesa-ganas.

## \|\| 2.10.7-8 \|\|

*suvarṇamṛttikā grāhyā varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ \|*  
*bilvavṛkṣairiyaṃ kuryādyūpaśūnadhvaje dine \|\| 7 \|\|*

*aratnimātraṃ vijñeyaṃ praśastaṃ yaṣṭihastakam \|*  
*ūrṇāsūtramayīṃ mūrtiṃ kṛtvā kuryāccatuṣṭayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The people of all the castes, while building a house, the circular pillars of wood apple tree and on the day of setting up a flag, should get an image prepared and should be covered with the woollen cord.

## \|\| 2.10.9-12 \|\|

*kṣīradārugartayutaṃ dvādaśāṃgulameva ca \|*  
*jvālayettilatailena tathā keśarajena vā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pūrvadikpraṇave siddhiḥ paścimāśāgatiḥ śubhā \|*  
*maraṇe dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca hāniḥ syāduttare sthite \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kalpe vipatkaraṃ vidyāttathā caiva ca diggate \|*  
*nārasiṃhena manunā cāgniṃ prajvālya dāpayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*māse ghaṭe tathā māsaṃ kuryādbhūmiparigraham \|*  
*sūtrayetkīlayetpaścānmahāmāne dvijottamāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. It should then be soaked in mustard oil or the saffron oil and lighted. In case Pranavas is lodged to the east, the person achieves success; when on the west, he achieves auspicious place; when in south, he has to face death; and faces loss when it is towards the north. Similarly, when the Kalpa is lodged in middle of the directions, one has to face misfortunes. О best of Brahmanas, getting the land in a month or half a month, it should be tied round a nail.

## \|\| 2.10.13 \|\|

*tato vāstubaliṃ dadyātkhanitraṃ paripūjayet \|*  
*ābrahmanniti mantreṇa khanayenmadhyadeśataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thereafter the offering of vastu should be made and the digging instruments should be worshipped in an appropriate manner. Reciting the mantra Abrahmanniti, the digging should be started in the centre.

## \|\| 2.10.14-18 \|\|

*ājyena madhuyuktena gātramekaṃ pralepayet \|*  
*svarṇatoyaistathā ratnatoyaiḥ snātvā pralepayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*īśānābhimukhenaiva kūpapakṣe vidurbudhāḥ \|*
