*akṛtvā vāstuyāgaṃ ca yastaḍāgaṃ samutsṛjet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tasya vaivasvato rājā dharmasyārdhaṃ nikṛntati \|*  
*prāsāde ca tathārāme mahākūpe tathaiva ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gṛhāraṃbhe ca vipreṃdrā dadyādvāstu baliṃ tataḥ \|*  
*śālaiśca khādiraiścaiva palāśaiḥ keśarasya ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bilvasya bakulasyaiva kalau yūpaḥ praśasyate \|*  
*śunā cakrodarakṛtaṃ tatpārśve tu dhvajadvayam \|\| 18 \|\|*

14-18. With the water of gold and gems, the place should be washed and the ght mixed with honey should be applied over it. All these performances should be done facing north-cast. This is the opinion of the learned persons in respect of the digging of a well. Without making the vastu offering in case a tank is built, then half of its merit is destroyed by the king Vaivasta. О Brahmanas, the palace, orchard, big well, start of the building of a house and in all other construction works, the vastu offerings is absolutely essential. The pillars of catechu, wood apple, Butea frondasa. saffron, wood apple tree, Minusop elengi and wood pillar has been considered to be praiseworthy in the age of Kali. At the rear side of it, two flags of the type of a dog with a round belly should be hoisted.

## \|\| 2.10.19-21 \|\|

*sarpākārastaḍāge ca kūpe kumbhākṛtirbhavet \|*  
*ārāme padmapuṣpābhaśchatrakārastu maṃḍale \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kuryācchunākṛtiṃ setau viṣṇugehe gadākṛtim \|*  
*aśvākāraṃ cāśvamedhe naramedhe narākṛtim \|\| 20 \|\|*

*goyāge ca vṛṣākāraṃ gṛhayāge dhvajākṛtim \|*  
*śmaśānagopracārārthaṃ caityavṛkṣālayottamāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. In the tank, it should be of serpentine shape; in the well it should be in the shape of a pitcher, in an orchard, it should be of the shape of a lotus flower, an umbrella like in the mandala for a bridge, it should be of the size of a dog; in the temple of Visnu, it should be of the shape of a club; in the Asvamedha yajna it should be in die shape of a horse; in the Naramedha yajna it should be of the shape of a human, in the Gayajna it should be of the shape of a bull and in the cremation ground as well as for (he propagation of the cow, it should resemble the pipala tree.

## \|\| 2.10.22 \|\|

*cakrākāro lakṣahome koṭihome halākṛtiḥ \|*  
*nakṣatrāṇi tathā mūlaṃ śasyate drumaropaṇe \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In the homa in which a lakh of offerings are to be made, it should be of circular shape; in the homa of offering a crore of offerings it should be of the shape of a plough; and in the function for the planting of a tree, it should be drawn at the base like a constellation.

## \|\| 2.10.23-25 \|\|

*evaṃ śasyoditāṃ bhūmiṃ śuddhāṃ pūrvaplavānvitām \|*  
*parigṛhya yajeddevaṃ vanapālaṃ śikhidhvajam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*somaṃ ca nāgarājānaṃ tato bījaṃ suśodhayet \|*  
*ānayeddhārayetpaścādraudratāpena tāpayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dinadvayāṃtare caiva maṃtraiśca parimaṃtrayet \|*  
*garbhādhānaṃ tataḥ kuryādviṣṇumaṃtraṃ japaṃstridhā \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Therefore, in the praiseworthy irrigated land in which the water is initially filled, the Vanapala with the peacock flag should be adored. Thereafter, Soma - the king of the serpents, should be adored. The seeds should then be purified. The procedure of bringing holding and other rites should be performed, which make it suffer from heat. Then the place should be sanctified for two days. The rite of conception should then be performed thrice, reciting the Visnu mantra.

## \|\| 2.10.26 \|\|

*evamasyeti maṃtreṇa tridhā japtvā vimārjayet \|*  
*dehi meti ca maṃtreṇa saṃprokṣya daśavāriṇā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Thereafter, reciting the mantra Asyeti etc. thrice, sprinkling of water should be done for purification. Then reciting the mantra Dehi meti, the water should be sprinkled.

## \|\| 2.10.27-28 \|\|

*ityagṛhītamanunā pañcadhā parimaṃtritam \|*  
*tryaṃbakeneti maṃtreṇa bījamāropayettataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhāryāmṛtumatīṃ snātvā pañcame'hani sattamāḥ \|*  
*utsaṃge sthāpayitvā ca cumbayenmaṃtrayettataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Those who do not follow the words of Manu, have prescribed the sprinkling of the water five times. Thereafter, reciting the mantra Tryambakama, the seeds should be planted. О excellent persons, a woman in period is purified after five days taking a bath, the seeds should be carried by her in her lap and after kissing them, they should be sanctified.

## \|\| 2.10.29 \|\|

*evaṃ vṛkṣasya saṃskāramadhye'pi tvanugacchati \|*  
*tena putratvamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. This procedure should also be followed at the time of planting a tree and by so doing, the lady surely gets a son. There is no need to think further in this matter.

## \|\| 2.10.30-31 \|\|

*tulasyā bījamādāya vaiṣṇavarkṣe dvijo'hani \|*  
*khānayedapi gomūtrabiṃdutoyaiḥ prasecayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*etāṃ tu svargamāpnoti sitakuṃbhe nipātayet \|*  
*ekarātraṃ paristhāpya tata āropayedbhuvi \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. On the constellation of lord Visnu, carrying the seeds of Tulasi plant (holy basil) a Brahmana should plant them digging the earth. These seeds should be watered mixed with few drops of the cow’s urine. By so doing, he achieves the heaven. Then they should be placed in a white pitcher or a flower vase for a night and then plant them over the land.

## \|\| 2.10.32 \|\|

*avidhau kūpavāpyādau khanane sūyate kvacit \|*  
*kurvaṃti sahakārādiropaṇaṃ ye narādhamāḥ \|*  
*labhaṃte na phalaṃ teṣāmiha cābhyetyadhogatim \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Such of the people, who dig the wells or step-wells or plant mango trees without following the correct method, such degraded people, instead of earning merits for the same, achieve the degraded position.

## \|\| 2.10.33 \|\|

*nadītīre śmaśāne ca svagṛhasya ca dakṣiṇe \|*  
*tulasīropaṇaṃ kṛtvā yāti kartā yamālayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In case the Tulasi plant (holy basil) is planted over the river bank, the cremation ground or to the south of one’s house, he falls in the hell.

## \|\| 2.10.34-35 \|\|

*patrapuṣpaphalānāṃ ca rajoreṇusamāgamāḥ \|*  
*poṣayaṃti ca pitaraṃ pratyahaṃ pratikarmaṇi \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yastu vṛkṣaṃ prakurute chāyāpuṣpaphalopagam \|*  
*pathi devālaye cāpi pāpāttārayate pitṝn \|*  
*kīrtiśca mānuṣe loke pratyabhyeti śubhaṃ phalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. A person who offers the leaves of the planted trees or their flowers or the fruits or their dust to the manes in all the rites, or the one who plants trees of thick shade yielding flowers and fruits on a road or a crossing, his pitrs are freed from the sins and he earns fame in the heaven, besides auspicious merits.

## \|\| 2.10.36 \|\|

*atītānāgatāścātaḥ pitṝnsa svargato dvijāḥ \|*  
*tārayedvṛkṣaropī ca tasmādvṛkṣaṃ praropayeta \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Brahmanas, one who plants the trees, he frees all his earlier and other manes from the sins and earns for them the heaven. Therefore, planting of the tree is absolutely essential.

## \|\| 2.10.37 \|\|

*aputrasya hi putrattvaṃ pādapā iha kurvate \|*  
*yatnenāpi ca vipreṃdrā aśvatthāropaṇaṃ kuru \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О Brahmanas, the trees in the world bestow the sons to a sonless person, therefore the pipala tree also known as Asvattha should be planted by a person making all the efforts.

## \|\| 2.10.38 \|\|

*śataiḥ putrasahasrāṇāmeka eva viśiṣyate \|*  
*kāmena ropayedviprā ekadvitriprasaṃkhyayā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Out of hundreds and thousands, only one becomes a prominent person, who patronises this. A person should plant one, two or three trees with a desire in his mind.

## \|\| 2.10.39-40 \|\|

*muktihetuḥ sahasrāṇāṃ lakṣakoṭīni yāni ca \|*  
*dhanī cāśvatthavṛkṣe ca aśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*plakṣo bhāryāpradaścaiva bilva āyuṣyadaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*dhanaprado jaṃbu vṛkṣo brahmadaḥ plakṣavṛkṣakaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Therefore, for the seeking of redemption, one should plant thousands, lakhs or crores of trees (as far as possible). By planting the Pipala tree, one achieves the treasure; by planting Asoka tree, the grief of a person is removed; by planting an Indian Fig tree, one achieves a beautiful wife and Brahmatva; by planting wood apple tree one gets long life; by planting silk cotton tree, one gets wealth.

## \|\| 2.10.41 \|\|

*tiṃdukātkulavṛddhiḥ syāddāḍimī kāminīpradaḥ \|*  
*bakulo vaṃjulaścaiva pāpahā balabuddhidaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. By planting above tree the family grows; planting pomegranate tree, one achieves a beloved one, by planting Bakula tree, one is treed from the sins, besides increase in strength is achieved.

## \|\| 2.10.42-46 \|\|

*svargapradā dhātakī syādvaṭo mokṣapradāyakaḥ \|*  
*sahakāraḥ kāmaprado guvākaḥ siddhimādiśet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sarvaśasyaṃ balabale madhuke cārjune tathā \|*  
*kadaṃbe vipulā kīrtistiṃtiḍī dharmadūṣikaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*jīvaṃtyā rogaśāṃtiḥ syātkeśaraḥ śatrumardanaḥ \|*  
*dhanapradaścaiva vaṭo vaṭaḥ śvetavaṭastathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*panase maṃdabuddhiḥ syātkali vṛkṣaḥ śriyaṃ haret \|*  
*kalivṛkṣaṃ ca śākhoṭa udarāvartakaṃ tathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tathā ca markaṭīnīparopaṇātsaṃtatikṣayaḥ \|*  
*śiṃśapāṃ cārjunaṃ caiva jayaṃtī haya mārakān \|*  
*śrīvṛkṣaṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva ropaṇātsvargamādiśet \|\| 46 \|\|*

42-46. By planting the myrobalan tree, one achieves heaven; by planting a banyan free one achieves moksa; by planting the mango tree all the desires of a person are fulfilled; the planting of betel nuts leads one to success; by planting Balavela one achieves all types of cereals. By planting of Madhuka and Arjuna, one achieves the same types of merit. By planting Kadamaba, one earns huge fame; by planting tamarind, one achieves the unblemished dharma; by planting black myrobalan, one is relieved of the ailments; by planting saffron, one is freed from his enemy. By planting the banyan tree one achieves riches; by planting of jack fruit tree, one is deprived of wisdom. Like the navel which is deprived of any grace, the Kali-vrksa has also been equated with Sakhota. By planting the prickly plant, the children of a person arc lost but by planting Simsapa, Arjuna, Jayanti, oleander, Sri-vrksa and Butea frondosa, one achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 2.10.47 \|\|

*na pūrvāṃ ropayejjātu samidhaṃ kaṃṭakīdrumam \|*  
*kuśaṃ padmaṃ jalajānāṃ ropaṇāddurgatiṃ vrajet \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The thorny trees and Acacia Suma trees should not be planted first. When kusa grass, the lotus flowers and other aquatic plants growing in water are planted by a person, he has to face misery.

## \|\| 2.10.48 \|\|

*maṃdāre kulahāniḥ syācchālmale śukabuddhimān \|*  
*niṃbe paśuvināśaḥ syācchatrāke kulapāṃsalaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. By planting a coral tree, the entire race vanishes; by planting Salmala, one becomes intelligent rapidly. By planting a nima tree, one has to face loss of animals. By planting of the banana, the entire family becomes wicked.

## \|\| 2.10.49 \|\|

*utpanne kulapātaḥ syā tpaśoreva kṣayo bhavet \|*  
*śatruvṛddhiḥ kākanāde balapūge hataśriyaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In case the same is self grown in a compound, it result in the destruction of the race besides the loss of animals. By planting Kakanada tree, the enemies increase and with the planting of Balapuga, the grace is lost.

## \|\| 2.10.50 \|\|

*vinā kratau viruddhaśca na siṃhaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*kratau hi syādviruddhaśca prāpnuyānnarakākṛtim \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. O best of the Brahmanas, one should not oppose in a yajna without a lion and when someone is in opposition in Kratu, he achieves the form of a hell.

## \|\| 2.10.51 \|\|

*sahakārasahasrāttu variṣṭhaṃ dhātakīdvayam \|*  
*tasmāccaiva sahasrāddhi pāṭalaikā viśiṣyate \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Instead of planting of a thousand mango trees, the planting of two Dhataki trees (woodfordia floribanda) would be more meritorious. This has been ordained by the people of wisdom. Similarly, the planting of a Patala or a rose coloured tree or the tree of trumpet flowers would be more beneficial than a thousand Dhataki trees.

## \|\| 2.10.52-55 \|\|

*pāṭalānāṃ śatātpaścādekaraktavaṭo bhavet \|*  
*vaṭānāṃ dvisahasrācca paṃcakaṃ nāgakeśaram \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tasmādvariṣṭhaḥ śrīvṛkṣo jaṃbūvṛkṣaḥ praśasyate \|*  
*tasmāddhimavato jñeyaḥ śrīparṇīvṛkṣa uttamaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tiṃdukasya trayaścaiva jaṃbūvṛkṣasya paṃcakam \|*  
*kadaṃbārjunavṛkṣasya nārikerasya ca trayam \|*  
*evamuktvā sa dharmātmā kārayetkīdṛśaṃ balam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca \|*  
*svargabhogaṃ samaśnāti vidhivaddrumaropaṇe \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. Of a hundred Patala trees, planting of Rakta-vata would be better. Of the two thousand Rakta-vata trees, planting of five trees of Nagakesara are better, still the planting of a Sri-vrksa and the silk cotton trees are included in those five trees. Still the planaintg of Parni tree, three Abony trees, five silk cotton trees and three trees of Kadamba and Arjuna gives strength to a noble person. This is what I tell you. One attains all the pleasures in the heaven for a thousand crores of kalpas, a hundred crores of kalpas, with the planting of several types of the trees.

## \|\| 2.10.56-58 \|\|

*janmatrayādikaṃ pāpaṃ vināśya svargamādiśet \|*  
*śataropī ca brahmatvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca sahasrake \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tulasīropaṇāccaitra ādhivyādhiyuto bhavet \|*  
*vaiśākhe kīrtimāpnoti jyeṣṭhe tu maraṇaṃ vrajet \|\| 57 \|\|*

*āṣāḍhe kīrtimāpnoti śrāvaṇe paramāṃ gatim \|*  
*bhādre dhanāgamaścaiva āśvine kārtike kṣayaḥ \|*  
*tulasī trividhā loke kṛte śvetā praśasyate \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. The sins of his last three births get destroyed and he achieves the heaven soon. By planting of a hundred trees, a person achieves Brahmatva and with the planting of a thousand trees, one achieves Visnu-hood. By planting a tree of holy basil in the month of Caitra, all the mental and bodily ailments are removed. By planting it in the month of Vaisakha, one achieves fame and doing so in the month of Jyestha, one invites death. By planting it in the month of Asadha, one achieves glory. By doing so in the month of Sravana, one achieves the supreme position. By doing so in the month of Bhadrapada, one achieves wealth and while so doing in the month of Kartika, one has to face decline. Out of three types of Tulasi (holy basil) that are found in the world, the one with white colour is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 2.10.59 \|\|

*kiṃcicchedaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādaśvatthasya vaṭasya ca \|*  
*śrīvṛkṣasya ca vipreṃdrāḥ sa bhavedbrahmaghātakaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О best of Brahmanas, in case even a small part of pipala (holy fig tree), banyan tree, besides the Sri-vrkfa is cut off, the person who does so is known as a killer of a Brahmana.

## \|\| 2.10.60-61 \|\|

*mūlacchedena vipreṃdrāḥ kulapāto bhavedanu \|*  
*vṛkṣacchedī bhavenmūka ādhivyādhiśataṃ bhajet \|*  
*sāyaṃ prātaśca gharmāṃte śītakāle dināṃtare \|\| 60 \|\|*

*phalamāmakulatthaśca māṣo mudgāstilā yavāḥ \|*  
*nṛtyagītapayaḥkeśaphalapuṣpaprado bhavet \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. О best of the Brahmanas, in case these trees are cut at the roots, one has to face the destruction of the entire family. Besides the person who cuts the tree, becomes a dumb and he suffers from hundreds of ailments in his body. In the early morning, in the evening or at the end of the sunshine or during the winter season, the mangoes, beans, black gram, green gram, sesamum and barley are given. Besides this, dancing and singing is carried on, besides beverages, fruits and flowers are also given.

## \|\| 2.10.62-66 \|\|

*avikākasakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇāni yāni ca \|*  
*gomāṃsamudakaṃ caiva saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet \|\| 62 \|\|*

*tamekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidam \|*  
*rohimatsyasya pittāni dhānyākaṃ tatra sthāpayet \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tenodakādisekaśca kṛto vai vṛddhimādiśet \|*  
*tittiḍībījamādāya ikṣudaṃḍena mardayet \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tenāśoke prasekaḥ syātsahakārasya vṛddhimān \|*  
*nālikerodakaṃ caiva mākṣikaiḥ saha secayet \|\| 65 \|\|*

*dohadaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ pūgādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*daśaśirābījayutādabhiṣekācca jīvati \|\| 66 \|\|*

62-66. Each onе of these contributes to the yielding of rich fruit, harvest of flowers and fruits. In case, the cereals are kept in the belly of Rohi fish and the water of the same is poured for the purpose of irrigation to a tree, it grows rapidly. When the tamarind seeds, after pounding woll with a mortar of wood, are put around the Adoka and mango trees, they yield good harvest. Burning the wax in the coconut water when it is sprinkled around the trees, particularly the betel nut trees, they sprout quickly. By mixing the seeds of Dasasira while mixing in water and when the same water is poured around the trees, they start sprouting again.

## \|\| 2.10.67 \|\|

*prākprasūtirgavādīnāṃ chāgādimahiṣasya ca \|*  
*jarāsu toyaṃ vṛkṣāgre sthāpayedavicārayan \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The first letter of the cow should be mixed in the embryo of a goat or a buffalo and then washed with water. The same water should be used for the irrigation of the trees. There is no need of a second thought.

## \|\| 2.10.68-71 \|\|

*parasya sahakārasya phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*meṣasya ca vitālasya yavāgūṃ ca samāharet \|\| 68 \|\|*

*tatra māsaiḥ sarṣapaiśca pūrayenmardayettataḥ \|*  
*guvākavṛkṣakaṃ deva gharṣayenmardayettribhiḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*mṛto'pi jīvayecchīghraṃ mriyamāṇo'pi jīvati \|*  
*niṃbapatraṃ yogapatraṃ śatāvaripunarnavām \|\| 70 \|\|*

*kṣīrikātāmrakaiḥ patrairdhūmaṃ dadyāddinatrayam \|*  
*sahakārasya mūlena kīṭa rodho na jāyate \|\| 71 \|\|*

68-71. By so doing the yield of the mango fruits is increased to the maximum. Making a paste of mesa and vitala, then the mustard seeds should be added to it, making a powder of the same. It should be kept for a month and rubbed with a betel nut tree for three days. It becomes activated even when it is dead. In case the same is on the verge of death, it survives. In case the leaves of nima and yogs trees, besides Satavara, Punamava and Ksirika should be mixed with rakta-patras and then all of them should be dried in the sunshine. When these are served at the roots of the mango tree, it serves as an insecticide.

## \|\| 2.10.72 \|\|

*tataḥ prādhānyato vakṣye drumāṇāṃ dohado'nyathā \|*  
*matsyodakena siktena āmrāṇāṃ vṛddhiriṣyate \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Thereafter, I am telling you the method of the quick sprouting of the trees. In case, the fish water is sprinkled at the root of the mango tree, it sprouts and grows quickly.

## \|\| 2.10.73 \|\|

*pakvāmraṃ rudhiraṃ caiva dāḍimānāṃ praśasyate \|*  
*yavodakaṃ sagomāṃsaṃ ketakīnāṃ praśasyate \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. For the rapid growing of the mangoes and red pomegranate, it is said to be quite useful. Similarly, for the Ketaki, the beef with the barley water is quite useful.

## \|\| 2.10.74-75 \|\|

*kṣīrake balavṛddhiḥ syāttiṃdukaḥ karamardakaḥ \|*  
*māṃsapūti rasāmajjā śokatāle guvākake \|\| 74 \|\|*

*sapūtimāṃsaṃ saghṛtaṃ nālikerasya rohitam \|*  
*madhuyaṣṭyudakaiḥ sekātsāmānyaṃ nihitaṃ bhavet \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. By using the same, the milky plants gain strength. The honey and the betel roots are poured by mixing. Similarly, with the tindu or abony tree, one develops scratching in hands and with the betel nut tree, there flows the fluid with bad smell. With the use of water of Rohita fish, one develops bad smell in coconut as well ghi, besides the swelling in the flesh. With use of the water of honey and liquorice, the growth gets normal.

## \|\| 2.10.76-80 \|\|

*kapitthabilvayoḥ sekaṃ guḍatoyena secayet \|*  
*jātīnāṃ mallikānāṃ ca kuṃdānāṃ raṃtikasya ca \|\| 76 \|\|*

*gaṃdhatoyasitakaraṃ sarpanirmokadhūpakam \|*  
*kūrmamāṃsamannarasaṃ viḍaṃgasya ca puṣpakam \|\| 77 \|\|*

*rathyāvṛkṣe pratiṣṭhāpya phalavāñjāyate tataḥ \|*  
*vātasarpasya nirmokaṃ tagarājagavasya ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

*dadyāddhūpaṃ dhānyamadhye dhānyavṛddhiśca jāyate \|*  
*mayūrapatramādāyacchāgaromāṇi sapta vai \|\| 79 \|\|*

*eraṃḍatailayogena dadyāddhūpaṃ niśāgame \|*  
*hiṃgukusumasaṃyogānmūṣikāṇāṃ parinyaset \|\| 80 \|\|*

76-80. For the rapid growth of Feronia elephantum) and wood apple, the sugarcane water should be supplied to the trees. The jasmine plants of different types Juhi and Camell), Kunda (or lotus) flowers, besides the Rantika flowers, when served with the incense made of a serpent skin, become more fragrant. In case, the flesh of a tortoise, juice of food and the flowers of Vidariga, are when spread around the trees in the middle of the villages and the streets of the towns, they are well grown. The skin of serpent is of the nature of Vdyu and the incense of aromatic powder is when burnt in the cereals crops, there is an increase in their growth. The wings of peacock mixed with goat’s hair and castor oil are when burnt in the field, its makes the rats to flee from the field at the dead of night. In case the asafoetida is mixed with flowers, it produces the same effect.

## \|\| 2.10.81 \|\|

*kariviṣṭhāmṛcchaviṣṭhāṃ kṛttikāyāṃ samāharet \|*  
*niśātoye prasekaḥ syāttatkṣātramūlakaṃ haret \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. On the day of Krttika constellation, the dung or refuse of elephant and a bear should be mixed in water and then sprinkled in the fields, by which the force of the rodents gets destroyed from the roots

## \|\| 2.10.82 \|\|

*aśvatthamūle daśahastamātraṃ kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ puruṣottamasya \|*  
*aśvatthacchāyāsalilasya madhye viśeṣato vai tripathaiva gaṃgā \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. In the holy fig tree, the height upto ten cubits is known as the Purusottama ksetra. In case the shade of the holy fig tree falls in a river water, it becomes as auspicious as the holy river of Ganga.

## \|\| 2.10.83 \|\|

*bāhuviṃśāṃtare ropetsahakāraṃ sa dharmavit \|*  
*kalāhastāṃtaraṃ dhātrī bakulaṃ vaṃjulaṃ tathā \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. A person well-versed in dharma should plant the mango trees at a distance of twenty cubits each; and the myrobalan, Bakula and Vanjula at a distance of fifteen cubits each.

## \|\| 2.10.84 \|\|

*śraiparṇikaṃ ca punnāgaṃ śrīvṛkṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tarau \|*  
*haste śailamaye caiva uttamaṃ mānamīritam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The trees of silk cotton, Nagakesara and holy fig trees should be planted at distance which is double the size of a hasta.

## \|\| 2.10.85-86 \|\|

*śaileṣṭakādiracite caturhaste tu saṃmite \|*  
*vāpyādīnāṃ tu kūpānāmekavṛkṣādikasya ca \|\| 85 \|\|*

*śrīviṣṇorvṛkṣapakṣe ca varuṇeṣṭaṃ ca kūpake \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ pūjayetkumbhaṃ dikpālāṃśca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. A pedestal of four cubits should be made in stones or bricks. During the consecration of the trees Ganesa should be adored, while in the consecration of a well, Varuna is to be adored. Initially, the kalasa or pitcher should be consecrated. Ganesa and Dikpalas should be initially worshipped essentially.

## \|\| 2.10.87-88 \|\|

*agnikāryaṃ vinā kuryātprakuryācca satāṃ gatim \|*  
*śrutvā kṛtiṃ vidhānena anyeṣāṃ vā tathodbhavam \|\| 87 \|\|*

*anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣe ca tathā ca tulasīvane \|*  
*kumbhe vanaspatiḥ sthāpyaḥ pūjayeddhomayettataḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. Even in case one does not perform the homa in such eases he achieves the highest position As per the above process, whichever nee has to be planted, in that ease the tree should be planted Initially, the tree should be consecrated in the Tulasi-vana in a pitcher, where it should be adored performing the homa.

## \|\| 2.10.89 \|\|

*vṛkṣānvānena saṃskṛtya vāsobhirabhiveṣṭayet \|*  
*śucyamānamidaṃ jñeyamanyeṣāṃ vā tathodbhavam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The pitcher should then be covered with a cloth Thereafter, it should be planted observing all die formalities.

## \|\| 2.10.90 \|\|

*tulasyāḥ sahakārasya brahmavṛkṣasya caiva hi \|*  
*aśvatthasya vaṭasyaiva svarṇatāmatha vedhayet \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. The gold should be offered to the holy basil, mango, Brahma-vrksa, holy fig tree and the banyan tree.

## Chapter 11. Tantrika Consecration

## \|\| 2.11.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha taṃtravidhiṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣvapi gīyate \|*  
*tantre caiva pratiṣṭhāṃ ca kuryātpuṇyatame'hani \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - I am now discussing the process of the Tantra, which has been discussed in the Puranas. The process of the consecration should be carried out on some auspicious day.

## \|\| 2.11.2 \|\|

*śatavṛkṣakṣudravṛkṣe daśadvādaśa vṛkṣake \|*  
*dṛṣṭimātrāṃtare setau kūpayāge samutsṛjet \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Taking up a hundred small saplings or ten to twelve small plants, then instead of consecrating them individually they should be consecrated clubbing up the function with the establishment of a well.

## \|\| 2.11.3 \|\|

*na kūpamutsṛjejjātu vṛkṣayāge kathaṃcana \|*  
*tulasīvanayāge tu na cānyaṃ yāgamācaret \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The kuра-yajna should never be joined with vrksa-yajna. Similarly, the yajna of holy basil-vana should not mixed with any other yajna.

## \|\| 2.11.4 \|\|

*taḍāgayāge setvādīnna cārāme kadācana \|*  
*na setuṃ devayāge tu taḍāgaṃ na samutsṛjet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The yajna establishment of a bridge or an orchard should not be clubbed with any other yajna. At the same time in the Deva-yajna, the Setu-yajna (sacrifice for bridge) and the tank yajna should not be combined.

## \|\| 2.11.5 \|\|

*taṃtre śrāddhaṃ pṛthaṅnāsti karturbhede pṛthagbhavet \|*  
*śivaliṃgasthāpanāyāṃ na cānyaddevasthāpanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the procedure of the tantras, separate performing of a Sraddha has been prohibited. Because of the difference of the performers, the separate performance is not recommended. Similarly, while consecrating a Sivalinga, the consecrating of some other god should not be done.

## \|\| 2.11.6 \|\|

*svadeśe varjayettaṃ taṃ svatantreṇa vidhīyate \|*  
*viparīte kṛte cāpi āyuḥkṣaya iti smṛtiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The consecration of each and every sacred object or the deity should be carried out separately and nothing else should be mixed up with the same. In case it is done contrary to this, there happens the loss of age. This has been ordained by the Smrtis.

## \|\| 2.11.7 \|\|

*taḍāge puṣkariṇyā vā ārāme'pi dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*mānahīne mānapūrṇe daśahaste na dūṣaṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O best of tlie Brahmanas, we have already spoken about the consecration of a tank, a pool of lotus flowers and the orchards that they should be strictly according to the measures or alternatively the one without measure should only be of ten cubits. In such a case no blemish is involved.

## \|\| 2.11.8 \|\|

*dvisahasrādhikaṃ yatra tatpratiṣṭhāṃ samācaret \|*  
*daśa dvādaśavṛkṣe ca ārāme pūrvavaddvijāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Only such an orchard has to be formally consecrated which has a minimum of two thousand trees. When the consecration of ten or twelve mango trees is required, the aforesaid procedure should be adopted.

## \|\| 2.11.9-10 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāṃ bilvavṛkṣe ca anyathā karṇavedhanam \|*  
*kuryāddohadadānaṃ ca tatra nirmaṃthanādikam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anaṃtaraṃ pradātavyā lājā mūrdhnyakṣatādikam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. On the occasion of consecration of the wood apple tree, piercing of the ears, giving away of charities, during pregnancy, or the rubbing of wood, the fried paddy should be poured over the head with unbroken rice.

## Chapter 12. Iconography of Images

## \|\| 2.12.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*pratimālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yathāśāstramataṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*pratimāṃ lakṣaṇairhīnāṃ gṛhītāṃ naiva pūjayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - О Brahmanas, I am now speaking out the essential features of the images of the deities. An image without the proper iconographical features should not be worshipped.

## \|\| 2.12.2 \|\|

*śailajā dārujā tāmrī mṛdbhavā sarvakāmadā \|*  
*ekahastā dvihastā vā sārdhahastā tathāpi vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. An image of a deity should be made in stone, wood, copper, clay and should be one, two or one and a half cubit in size, which yields all the desires.

## \|\| 2.12.3 \|\|

*prāsādamānamathavā athavā sarvalakṣaṇam \|*  
*aṣṭāṃgulotsedhakaṃ ca na gehe'rcayetkṛtī \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Like a palace, the image should be worshipped in a temple. The image should possess all the auspicious symptoms, the height should be of eight angulas measure. Such an image should not be worshipped in one’s own house.

## \|\| 2.12.4 \|\|

*devāgārasya yaddvāraṃ tasmādaṣṭāṃgulena tu \|*  
*tribhāgapiṃḍikā kāryā dvau bhāgau pratimā bhavet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The image should be created according to the area of the size of entrance gate of the temple. Eight angulas should be the total area of the main entrance of the temple and the pedestal should then have the size of one third of the total area so worked out. The image should be made of the two parts of the height.

## \|\| 2.12.5-7 \|\|

*aṃgulaṃ vai bhavedvṛddhiraśītiścaturuttarā \|*  
*vistāramānataḥ kāryaṃ vadanaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mukhatribhāge cibukaṃ lalāṭaṃ nāsikāṃ tathā \|*  
*karṇau nāsikayā grīvātulyau vā niyatau tu yau \|\| 6 \|\|*

*nayane dvyaṃgule syātāṃ tribhāgā tārakā bhavet \|*  
*tṛtīyatārakābhāge śubhadṛṣṭiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The length, breadth and the limbs should be of the eighty four angulas. The face should cover the area of twelve angulas in length and breadth. The chin, the forehead and the nose should be of three angulas each. Both the ears should be of the size of neck and the nose. The size of the eyes should be of two angulas and one third part of it should form the eyelids. The pupil of the eye should be a third of the same, which has been considered to be the best by the people of wisdom.

## \|\| 2.12.8 \|\|

*lalāṭamastakagrīvaṃ kuryāttatsamameva tu \|*  
*pariṇāhastu śiraso bhaveddvātriṃśadaṃgulaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The forehead, the head and the neck should be made accordingly. Usually, the size of the head is said to be of thirty two angulas.

## \|\| 2.12.9-11 \|\|

*tulyau nāsikayā grīvā mukhena hṛdayāṃtaram \|*  
*atha vistārapaṃktistu tato'rdhaṃ tu kaṭiḥ sadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bāhū ca bāhutulyau ca ūrū jaṃghe ca jāghanam \|*  
*gulphāvasthnastu pādaḥ syāddhāṭitaścaturaṃgulaḥ \|*  
*ṣaḍaṃgulastu vistārastulyāṃguṣṭhoṃ'gulatrayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pradeśinī ca tattulyā hīnā śeṣānnakhānakham \|*  
*caturdaśāṃgulaḥ pādasyāyāmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. The ears should be of the same size as that of the nose. The middle part of the heart should be made resembling the neck and the face. The waist should be half of the size of the length of die image. Similarly, the arm should be like the forearm. The thighs should be like the high thighs. The heels and the feet should not be of the size of four angulas. The size of the feet has been given to be of six angulas. The thumb should be of three angulas and the forefinger should be of the same size. The rest of the fingers should be made in different sizes respectively. In this way, the size of the foot works out to be of fourteen angulas.

## \|\| 2.12.12-13 \|\|

*evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sā pūjyā pratimā śubhā \|*  
*adharoṣṭhastathaivorubhrūlalāṭamanīṣikam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gaṃḍaṃ ca niyataṃ mūrtau kuryādaṃgasamunnateḥ \|*  
*viśālanayanastāmrapado vāyatalocanaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The image with these symptoms is said to be fit for worship. Accordingly, the image should have thighs, eyebrows, forehead, tongue and cheeks which should be well developed. The eyes should be broad, the soles of the feet should be red and the eyes should be made quite lengthy.

## \|\| 2.12.14-15 \|\|

*savitānala patrasya cāruvidyādharastathā \|*  
*vatsaprokto'timukuṭaḥ kaṭakāṃgadahāravān \|\| 14 \|\|*

*abhyaṃgapadabandhādi sāmānyenopaśobhi ca \|*  
*suprabhāmaṃḍalā cāru vicitramaṇikuṇḍalā \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The images of Surya as well as Nala have been described accordingly. Similarly, the beautiful image of Vidyadhara should be made and should be decorated with Srivatsa mark, a crown bracelet, armlets, besides the garland. It should also be decorated with paste, anklets and other ornaments. The lustre of its halo should be beautiful. It should also be decorated with several gem, studded ornaments besides the earrings.

## \|\| 2.12.16-19 \|\|

*karābhyāṃ kāṃcanīṃ mālāṃ prodvahaṃtīṃ śiroruhān \|*  
*evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kārayedvihitapradām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*susnigdhāṃ varadāṃ saumyāṃ dvitīyāśramiṇāmimām \|*  
*navatālo bhavedviṣṇurvāsudevastritālakaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nṛsiṃhaḥ pañcatālaḥ syāddhayagrīvastu paṃcamaḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇaścāṣṭatālo maheśaḥ pañcatālakaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*navatālā bhaveddurgā lakṣmīścaiva tritālikā \|*  
*vāṇīṃ tritālikāṃ vidyātsavitā saptatālakaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. His hands should hold the golden rosary and the hair over the head should be beautifully dressed. When an image with these symptoms is made, it would grant the desires of the person who makes it. Its smoothness, display of varada-mudra and the pleasant appearance is absolutely essential. Such a type of image is beneficial for the householder. The image of Visnu should be of nine palms, of three palms of Visnu. Vasudeva should be of nine palms; of three palms of Visnu, Narasimha and Hayagriva should be of five palms; that of Narayana of eight palms: and Mahersvara should be of nine palms. Laksmi should of three, Sarasvati to be of three and Surya should be of seven palms.

## \|\| 2.12.20-21 \|\|

*dakṣiṇe vāsudevasya kare cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*śaṃkho bhavecca tadadho vāmārdhe tasya vai gadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tadadhaśca bhavetpadmaṃ śrīvatsenopaśobhitam \|*  
*savye'rdhe tārakāsyaṃ ca trinetramubhayātmakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Vasadeva should hold a cakra in his right hand, a conch in the lower right hand, the left upper hand should hold a club and the lotus should be held in the lower left hand. The image should be decorated with Srivatsa mark. Then the eyeball should be established in his right hand followed by the left eye.

## \|\| 2.12.22 \|\|

*pārśve nalinasiṃhau dvau subhadrāṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset \|*  
*rukmiṇī vāmabhāge ca tadadhastāddivīṃdrakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In the rear, a lotus and a lion should be shown. Subhadra should stand to his left, while Rukmini and Indra should be displayed below him.

## \|\| 2.12.23 \|\|

*kṛtāṃjalipuṭasthaśca nāradaḥ kapilastathā \|*  
*dharmādharmāvubhau pārśve kartavyau sragviṇāṃ varau \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In his folded hands, Narada and Kapila are to be shown, while Dharma and Adharma wearing garland, should stand at his back.

## \|\| 2.12.24-25 \|\|

*yadugraṃ vāsudevasya tathā nārāyaṇasya ca \|*  
*vaiparītyaṃ vijānīyānmādhavānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tīrthe girau taḍāge ca samīpe sthāpayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*nagaragrāmamadhye vā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. The terrific limbs of Vasudeva and Narayana should be treated as advene for a person. Similar is the case with Midhava. Thor images should be consecrated in Orthos or holy places, over the mountains, bank of a lake, in cities or the villages or in the habitation of the Brahmanas

## \|\| 2.12.26-28 \|\|

*avimukte viśeṣaṇa siddhakṣetre daśārṇake \|*  
*trīṇyuttarasahasrāṇi paṃcapaṃcottarāṇi ṣaṭ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kulāni pūrvaṃ vipreṃdrāḥ samuddharati nānyathā \|*  
*kalau dārumayaḥ kāryo hyaśakto mṛnmayotha vā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*caṃdanāgurubhiḥ kuryādbilvaśrīparṇikasya ca \|*  
*padmakāṣṭhamayaścaiva vāmamasya tathaiva hi \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. The consecration of his images in Avimukta-ksetra (Varanasi). Siddha-ksetra or in the Dasarna country is said to be quite meritorious. With the consecration of tins image of Vasudeva, nineteen thousand families are redeemed, During the age of Kali, one should make the images of wood as per one's means or alternatively even of die day. Besides these, the image could be of sandalwood, Agaru, wood apple tree, holy fig tree and of beautiful wood.

## Chapter 13. Construction of Kunda or altar

## \|\| 2.13.1-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kuṃḍānāmatha nirṇayam \|*  
*tasyoddhāraṃ ca saṃskāraṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*caturasraṃ ca vṛttaṃ ca pādārdhaṃ cārdhacaṃdrakam \|*  
*yonyākāraṃ caṃdrakaṃ ca aṣṭārdhamatha paṃcamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*saptārdhaṃ ca navārdhaṃ ca kuṃḍaṃ daśakamīritam \|*  
*bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya vidhivattuṣakeśādivarjitām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhrāmayeccordhvatastasyā bhasmāṃgārāṇi yatnataḥ \|*  
*aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kuryātsaptāhādeva buddhimān \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Suta said - О best of Brahmanas, thereafter, I am going to speak about the kundas (altars). You please listen. These arc said to be of ten types, viz., square, circular, octagonal, crescent, resembling the vagina, moon like, astardha (half of eight), half of five (arms), Saptardha (half of seven) and Navardha (half of nine). Initially, tire land should be freed up of all the hay or vegetation growth and a roller should be rolled over the same. Thereafter, the intelligent person should sow the seeds over the land and get them sprouted.

## \|\| 2.13.5 \|\|

*sthānaṃ vimarditaṃ kuryātkhanitvā secayejjalaiḥ \|*  
*puṣṭihastocchrāyamitaṃ prakuryātparisūtrayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The ground should be dig again and water should be poured in the same. Thus making a kunda a cubit in height, it should be spread in all the four sides.

## \|\| 2.13.6-7 \|\|

*arkāṃgulamitaṃ sūtraṃ caturasraṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*aṣṭādaśāṃgake kṣetre nyasedekaṃ bahistataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*māpayettena mānena trivṛttaṃ kuṃḍamujjvalam \|*  
*pūrvavadvibhajetkṣetraṃ bhāgaikaṃ purato nyaset \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. While digging a square kunda, the sutra or thread should be of twelve angulas. In the area of eighteen angula-kunda, a part of it should be set aside, the size of the same should be completed thrice. Its area should be completed as stated earlier, and one part of it should be set in the front.

## \|\| 2.13.8 \|\|

*vṛttāni kālikādīni bahistrīṇi vivarjayet \|*  
*padmakuṃḍamidaṃ proktaṃ vilocanamanoharam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. There should be three points like Kalika and the outer part should be left aside. Such a kunda, the sight of which pleases the eyes, is known as Padma-kunda

## \|\| 2.13.9 \|\|

*daśadhā bhedayetkṣetre urdhvādhordhvāṃguladvayam \|*  
*saṃparipātayetsūtraṃ pāṭayettatpramāṇataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The front area should be marked with ten sutras up and down. The sutra should then he arranged in two angulas each.

## \|\| 2.13.10 \|\|

*paṃcadhā bhedite kṣetre kāmaṃ vā vibhajetsudhīḥ \|*  
*nyasetpurastādevāṃgaṃ koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A learned person can divide the area with five divisions as per his liking. The half part of a triangle and still half of the same should be marked in the front.

## \|\| 2.13.11 \|\|

*yonisthānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya aśvatthasya dalākṛtiḥ \|*  
*sūtradvayaṃ tato dadyātkuṃḍaṃ parimitaṃ bhavet \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The construction of the yoni-kunda of the design of the leaf of a holy fig tree is known as yoni-kunda. By adding two sutras to the same, the side of the kunda is sanctified.

## \|\| 2.13.12 \|\|

*caturasraṃ samuddhṛtya sūtraṃ saṃkalpayogataḥ \|*  
*diśaṃ prati yathānyāyaṃ pātayecca dvijottamāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О group of Brahmanas, all the sutras should be picked from all the sides and placed towards the justified sides.

## \|\| 2.13.13-15 \|\|

*śṛṃgāṭakaṃ yugmapuṭaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ kuṃḍatrayaṃ budhāḥ \|*  
*jalāśayārāmakūpe nitye gṛhamaye yathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*catusraṃ bhavetkuṃḍaṃ dvijasaṃskārakarmaṇi \|*  
*devapratiṣṭhāyāge ca gṛhavāstau caturthakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vasuṃdharāyogabhede prapaṃce vartamādiśet \|*  
*some'ṣṭau paṃkajaṃ proktaṃ naramedhāśvamedhayoḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. The three types of kundas - one with Sikhara, with two coverings and the hexagonal ones should be built in a lake, orchard or a well. In the yajna for the Devos, start of the building of a house, the yogic divisions of Vasundhara which are circular in shape should be built. In the Naramedha and Asvamedha sacrifices, eight petalled lotus like kunda has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.13.16 \|\|

*aṃkurārpaṇayāge ca vaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi \|*  
*śivadevyośca janmādāvaṣṭamyāṃ cārdhacaṃdrakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. For the sprouting of the seeds, during a Vaisnava yajna, on the occasion of the birth of Siva and Parvati and on the day of Astami or the eighth moon day, crescent type of kunda has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.13.17-18 \|\|

*mārjārapauṣṭike vairaṃ ramye ca śāṃtike tathā \|*  
*śāṃtipratiṣṭhāyāge tu śāktānāṃ kāmyakarmaṇi \|\| 17 \|\|*

*puraścaraṇakāmyeṣu jvarādīnāṃ vimokṣaṇe \|*  
*evaṃvidheṣu kāryeṣu yonikuṃḍaṃ praśasyate \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. During the performing of the Paustika-karma in which the hair of the cat are used, during pleasant and peaceful rites, performing of the peaceful yajnas, performing of the Sakti rites, Kamya-karmas, for the rites performed after the fulfilment of the ceremonies relating to the removal of the fever and for the performing of the similar rites, the yoni-kunda is used.

## \|\| 2.13.19 \|\|

*devatātīrthayātrādau mahāyuddhapraveśane \|*  
*saure śāṃte pauṣṭike ca ṣaṭpuraṃ kuṃḍamuttamam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. For the pilgrimage of the gods, at the vast battleground, performing of the solar rites, performing of peaceful rites and for the development activities, the hexagonal kunda is made use of.

## \|\| 2.13.20-21 \|\|

*māraṇoccāṭane caiva tathā rogopaśāṃtaye \|*  
*vaiṣṇavānāṃ koṭihome nṛpāṇāmatiśocane \|\| 20 \|\|*

*aṣṭāsramabjakuṃḍaṃ ca saptāsraṃ nidhisādhane \|*  
*rājñā sādhye ca paṃcāsraṃ kanyāprāptau trirasrakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. During the rites of killing or uprooting, removal of ailments, performing of Visnu yajna in which a crores of offerings are made, or when the kings are in grief, the octagonal or Padmakunda should be made. When one is desirous of achieving the hidden treasure, the kunda of septangular type should be used. For the success of the king, the kunda of pentagonal type has to be used. For the achieving of a noble girl, triangular kunda should be used.

## \|\| 2.13.22 \|\|

*yāvannimnaṃ bhavedeva vistārastāvadeva tu \|*  
*kuṃḍānurūpataḥ kāryā mekhalā sarvato budhaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The chain of the kunda should also be made by the people of wisdom, according to their length and breadth.

## \|\| 2.13.23 \|\|

*ayutādiṣu homeṣu mekhalāṃ yojayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*nimna pramāṇe cātrāpi mūle sārdhāṃgulaṃ tyajet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In the sacrificial altar in which ten thousand offerings are to be made, the chain must be arranged. The kunda of the lower types are required to be discarded by one and a half angulas at the base.

## \|\| 2.13.24 \|\|

*koṇavedarasairmānaṃ yathāyogyamanukramāt \|*  
*muṣṭihaste samutsedho sārdhāṃgulapariṣkṛtaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The height of triangular kunda should be discarded by three, four and the upper layer of the kunda upto a first and a half should be discarded.

## \|\| 2.13.25 \|\|

*aratnimātre kuṃḍe tu triścaikāṃgulataḥ kramāt \|*  
*ekahastamite kuṃḍe vedāgninayanāṃgulāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Similarly, in the kunda in which only sacrificial sticks alone are to be used, above the kunda should be four, one or two angulas.

## \|\| 2.13.26 \|\|

*saptamekhalakaṃ yuktaṃ lakṣahome na śasyate \|*  
*paṃcamekhalakaṃ vātha lakṣakoṭyāṃ ca yojayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In the fire altar in which a lakh of offerings are to be made, the seven chains should not be arranged. On the other hand in the yajnas with a lakh or a crore of offerings, only five chains are to be arranged.

## \|\| 2.13.27 \|\|

*ekāṃgulādimānena nemiṃ saṃvardhayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*caturhastamite kuṃḍe tāvadeva guṇāṃgulāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The learned people should increase the circumference increased by one angula. In the altars of four cubits, skill should be increased.

## \|\| 2.13.28 \|\|

*vasuhaste bhānupaṃktiryugmahīne'pi tāḥ kramāt \|*  
*sarvāḥ samā grahamakhe mekhalāśca sahasrake \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the fire altar of twelve cubits, the chain of twelve lines should be added, minimum of which should be the half of it. Similarly, in the domestic yajna of a thousand offerings, the number of chains have been described to be equal.

## \|\| 2.13.29 \|\|

*pārśvato yojayettatra mekhalāstā yathākramam \|*  
*sārdhāṃgulādimānena nemiṃ saṃvardhayetsudhīḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. At the back side of the kunda, the chains should be arranged and the circumference should be increased by an angula and a half.

## \|\| 2.13.30-31 \|\|

*ekamekhalayāgena yojayecchaktibhāvataḥ \|*  
*homādhikye bahuphalamanyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kuṃḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyātparamaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ \|*  
*tato home śataguṇaṃ sthaṃḍile svalpakaṃ phalam \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. In the yajna, according to one’s own means in case a chain is arranged, it yields to the performer several merits. The kunda should be treated as the beautiful body of the Prakrti and because of that its construction yields excessive merits. With the performing of homa, it is multiplied to a hundred times. Besides with the building of a pedestal, the related merit that is achieved is nominal.

## \|\| 2.13.32 \|\|

*ṣaṭacaturdhā guṇāyāmavistāronnatiśālinī \|*  
*ekāṃgulaṃ tu yonyagraṃ kuryādīṣadadhomukham \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. At the time of building of a yoni-kunja of ten angulas square, the forepart of the yoni should be lowered by an angula.

## \|\| 2.13.33 \|\|

*ekaikāṃgulato yoniṃ kuṃḍaśūnyeṣu vardhayet \|*  
*samamadhye mekhalāyāḥ saparyā yā sulakṣaṇā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The yoni of Sunya-kunda there should be increased gradually by an angula, which should be in the middle of the chain and which being adorable, possesses all the symbols or symptoms.

## \|\| 2.13.34 \|\|

*sthāpayetkuṃḍakoṇeṣu yoniṃ tāṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*kuṃḍānāṃ kalpayennābhiṃ sphuṭamaṃbujasannibhām \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О group of Brahmanas, at the comers of the kundas, the making of a yoni each has been described. The navel of the kunda should resemble the blossomed lotus flower.

## \|\| 2.13.35 \|\|

*tattu kuṃḍānurūpaṃ vā suvyaktaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*yonikuṃḍe yonimabjaṃ kuṃḍe nābhiṃ ca varjayet \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The lotus should be as beautiful as the altar itself, besides being complete and extremely charming. The yoni should not be made in the yoni-kunda and the navel.

## \|\| 2.13.36 \|\|

*yāvaddvayapramāṇena ardhāṃgulakramādbahiḥ \|*  
*nābhiṃ pravardhayedekaṃ kuṃḍānāṃ rūpato yathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. According to the size of both of them, half an angula should be extended on the outer space. According to the size of the kundas, it’s size should be increased by an angula in the navel.

## \|\| 2.13.37 \|\|

*tatra tatra bhavetkuṃḍaṃ biṃbaśūnyaṃ na homayet \|*  
*śivaśaktisamāyogātkāma utpadyate yataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. At all the places, the performance of homa should be done after the making of the kundas and never without the images. Because it is with the equal union of Siva and Sakti, the passion is generated.

## \|\| 2.13.38 \|\|

*avaṭopi umādevī biṃbaḥ khyātaḥ sadāśivaḥ \|*  
*na kuryādekayā hīnaṃ maraṇaṃ ca samuddiśet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The pit of the kunda stands for the goddess Uma and the image stands for Sadasiva. Therefore, in case either of them is not present there on the spot, it would result in destruction.

## \|\| 2.13.39-40 \|\|

*trayodaśāṃgulaṃ hitvā vahnihastamathāpi vā \|*  
*mahātīrthe siddhakṣetre yatra śaṃbhugṛhe kule \|\| 39 \|\|*

*tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge agrato maṃḍalaṃ likhet \|*  
*tatra pūjā prakartavyā pūrvamānena cāśrayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. In a Siva temple at a siddha-ksetra or a great place of pilgrimage, a mandala should be made on its southern side, which should be of thirteen angulas or alternatively, it should be drawn leaving the cluster of trees. The masala should be drawn in the front and should then be worshipped in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 2.13.41 \|\|

*arkahastāṃtare kuryācchatordhvāṃte śatena vā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. It should be made within the twelve cubit area, ending at a hundred angulas or at the end of a hundred angulas or in the centre.

## Chapter 14. Performing of Yajna

## \|\| 2.14.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*yasya yajñasya yanmānaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet \|*  
*amānena hato yajñastasmānmānaṃ na hāpayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - The standard that has been prescribed for a particular type of yajna, the kunda also has to be made in that particular yajna of the same standard, which is essential. Because the yajna without a standard gets destroyed. Therefore, special attention should be paid towards its standard.

## \|\| 2.14.2 \|\|

*śatārdhaṃ prathamaṃ mānaṃ śatasāhasrameva ca \|*  
*ayutaṃ ca tathā lakṣaṃ koṭihomamataḥ param \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The yajnas has been prescribed with fifty, hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, lakh and of crore of offerings.

## \|\| 2.14.3 \|\|

*ataḥ paraṃ tu vibhave rājā vānyo ddhijottamāḥ \|*  
*na sa siddhimavāpnoti ayāgaphalabhāgbhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О Brahmanas, in case a ruler initiates a yajna other than these because of the excess of his riches, he fails to achieve success in that sacrifice, besides losing the related merits.

## \|\| 2.14.4-5 \|\|

*vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvaṃ naraḥ prāpnoti sarvadā \|*  
*śubhāśubhaṃ tato nityaṃ prāpnoti manujaḥ kila \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yuktāścāpi grahāstatra nityaṃ śāṃtikapauṣṭike \|*  
*tasmātprayatnato bhaktyā nityaṃ pūjā yathāvidhi \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. A person always achieves the reward of his deeds and gains experience from the same. Because of the same, he also gains good and bad rewards of his deeds. With the performing of the peaceful and the supportive deeds, his evil planets also become favourable and bestow welfare on him. Therefore, one should make all the efforts to worship them always with devotion.

## \|\| 2.14.6-8 \|\|

*adbhute ca tathā śāṃtiṃ kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tasmādgrahābhijanitaṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ khalu \|\| 6 \|\|*

*adbhuteṣu ca sarveṣu ayutaṃ kārayennaraḥ \|*  
*homaṃ yathābhirucitaṃ pauṣṭike kāmyakarmaṇi \|\| 7 \|\|*

*lakṣahomaṃ koṭihomaṃ rājā kuryādyathāvidhi \|*  
*anyaḥ śatādikaṃ kuryādayutaṃ vibhave sati \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. For the evil planets one should become peaceful with devotion, which is essential, because it is by planets that a person gains good or bad results. This is certain. In case of hostility of a number of the planets, a person should perform the yajna with ten thousand offerings. In the supportive as well as the desirable deeds, the homa is required to be performed in a yajna with a crore of offerings. But for the other people inspite of their having enough of meant, the yajnas with a thousand or a hundred offerings have been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.14.9 \|\|

*grahāṇāṃ lakṣahomastu koṭihomastathā kalau \|*  
*nidhihomaṃ cābhicāraṃ tanna kuryādgṛhāśramī \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the age of Kali, the householders should perform Нота of a lakh or a crore of offerings to remove the ill-effect of the planets. The nidhi-karmas or for the pleasant karmas, this has been prohibited.

## \|\| 2.14.10 \|\|

*yatra yatra japaḥ kāryo homo vā yatra kutracit \|*  
*mānaṃ naiva ca kartavyaṃ mānādau cāṣṭakaṃ nyaset \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Wherever the japam is to be performed or the Нота it to be performed, then there is no need of the standard. In the standard, eight has to be discarded.

## \|\| 2.14.11 \|\|

*yugmasādhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ yugmato bhayamādiśet \|*  
*lakṣe saptatālasaṃkhyā koṭihome ca viṃśatiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. It should not be done by two persons in a combined manner, because if it is so done, there appears the growth of something else. In the homa for a lakh of offerings, seven talas are achieved, while in the yajRa for a crore of offerings the number of talas is said to be twenty.

## \|\| 2.14.12-14 \|\|

*ekatriṃśaddinairvāpi na kuryādvyatyayaṃ kvacit \|*  
*āraṃbhastrisahasraḥ syāddvitīye'ṣṭasahasrakaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tṛtīye tu sahasraṃ syādgrahasādhyaḥ smṛto vidhiḥ \|*  
*pañcāhe ca samāraṃbhe sahasraṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dvitīye'hni dvisāhasraṃ tṛtīye tu sahasrakam \|*  
*guṇasāhasrakaṃ turye pañcāhe śeṣamīritam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Or a disturbance should be caused to it upto twenty one days. Accordingly, initially the number of offerings should be three thousand; on the second day, the number should be increased to eight thousand; on the third day, it should be one thousand, as it has been prescribed for the householders. During the yajna which is to be completed in five days, on the first day the one thousand offerings should be made; on the second day the number should be increased to two thousand. On the third day the number of offerings should be a thousand; on the fourth day it should be nine hundred and the rent should be given on the fifth day.

## \|\| 2.14.15 \|\|

*navāhe kalpayellakṣamekaikāṃgaṃ dine dine \|*  
*paṃcame ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe kule bhāgadvayādhikam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The offering of a lakh of ahutis should be spread over to nine days. Under this arrangement, one limb should be completed on each one of four days and thereafter on the fifth and the sixth days, the offerings should be doubled.

## \|\| 2.14.16 \|\|

*koṭihome ca tithyaṃge śatabhāgena kalpayet \|*  
*na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kāryametanmānamudāhṛtam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16.During the yajna of the crores of offerings, the performance should be spread over to fifteen days. The offerings should be divided in a hundred parts with samkalpa. There is no provision for the increase or decrease in this practice. Because of that, the standard has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.14.17 \|\|

*nityamekaṃ dine dadyātpṛthaṅnityaṃ na cācaret \|*  
*sa samāje japennityaṃ pañcatāreṇa sviṣṭakṛt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The performer of the yajna should make at least one set of offerings daily. Besides, he should perform the highest japam in the society.

## \|\| 2.14.18-19 \|\|

*ayute lakṣahome ca koṭihome ca sarvadā \|*  
*prathame divase kuryāddevatānāṃ ca sthāpanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mahotsave dvitīye tu balidānaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*tryahasādhye trirātre ca pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā visarjayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. In the sacrifice of ten thousand offerings, a lakh of offerings or a crore of offerings, the gods should be invoked and consecrated on the first day. The making of offerings should be commenced on the second day. In the homa to be concluded in three days, the final or Purnahuti should be made and then the ceremony of sending off should be performed.

## \|\| 2.14.20 \|\|

*pañcāhe tu tṛtīye'hni balidānaṃ praśasyate \|*  
*saptāhe cāṣṭadivase navāhe paṃcame'hani \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In the homa lasting for five days, the making of offerings is said to be praiseworthy on the third day. Similarly, in the functions spreading on to seven, eight and nine days, the offerings should be made on the fifth day.

## \|\| 2.14.21 \|\|

*pañcāhe dvādaśāhe tu dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśe'hani \|*  
*ito'nyathā na kurvīta nātra yajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Similarly again, in the functions spreading over to five, twelve, thirty two or sixteen days, the same process could be repeated, but during the functions for longer days, one cannot achieve the merit for the performing of the yajna.

## Chapter 15. Establishing of the altars

## \|\| 2.15.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*kuṇḍānāmatha saṃskāre vakṣye śāstramataṃ yathā \|*  
*asaṃskṛte cārthahānistasmātsaṃskṛtya homayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - I am relating to you the Samskaras of the fire altars, because an altar when made use of without properly consecrating it, one has to face loss of riches. Therefore, the homa should be performed in altars after properly consecrating it.

## \|\| 2.15.2 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśa syuḥ saṃskārāḥ kuṇḍānāṃ tatra darśitāḥ \|*  
*tāreṇāvekṣayetsthānaṃ kuśatoyaiḥ prasecayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. In this connection, it has been ordained that there are eighteen types of the samskaras of the kundas. Initially, the lands should be properly examined with wire. Thereafter, the water should be sprinkled over it with kusa grass.

## \|\| 2.15.3 \|\|

*trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ paścādvṛttasūtraṃ nipātayet \|*  
*vāreṇa kīlakaṃ dadyānnārasiṃhena kuḍmalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. After performing the rite of trisutri, the circular sutra should be placed, over which the blossoming birds have to be offered like a nail.

## \|\| 2.15.4-5 \|\|

*jihvāṃ prakalpayetpaścāttasmādagniṃ samāharet \|*  
*na ca mlecchagṛhādagniṃ na śūdranilayātkvacit \|\| 4 \|\|*

*nadīparvataśālābhyaḥ strīhastātparivarjayet \|*  
*saṃskṛtya parigṛhṇīyāttridhā kṛtvā samuddharet \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The tongue should be made therein by which the fire could be brought. The fire should not be accepted from the houses of Sudras, the houses standing over the banks of a river or the mountains as well as from the hands of a woman. The fire on the other hand should be accepted as per the provision of scriptures and should be divided with three parts and distributed accordingly.

## \|\| 2.15.6-7 \|\|

*tamagniṃ pratigṛhṇīyādātmano'bhimukhaṃ yathā \|*  
*vahnibījena matimāñchivabījena prokṣayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vāgīśvarīmṛtusnātāṃ vāgīśvarasamāgatām \|*  
*dhyātvā samīraṇaṃ dadyātkāmamutpadyate tataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Accepting the fire in the presence of all and uttering the seed mantra Ram of fire as well as the seed mantra of Siva, it should be spread. Thereafter, the goddess Vagisvari who has since been purified after the bath of the period and who arrives with Vagisvara, should be meditated upon. The fire should be ignited with the wind, because by so doing, the desired task is established.

## \|\| 2.15.8 \|\|

*kālabījena caiśānyāṃ yonāvagniṃ vinikṣipet \|*  
*paścāddevasya devyāśca dadyādācamanīyakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the yoni lodged in the north-east direction, with the use of kamabija the fire should be consecrated. Thereafter, the sipping water should be offered to the goddess as well as the god for the rincing of mouth.

## \|\| 2.15.9-10 \|\|

*pitṛpiṅgala dahadaha paṃcayugmamudīrya ca \|*  
*sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā mantroyaṃ vahnipūjane \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vahnibarhiṣi saṃyuktāḥ sādiyāṃtāḥ sabiṃdavaḥ \|*  
*vahnimantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā dvijānāṃ maṃtra īritaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Then reciting the mantras- “cit-pingala, dahadaha, pancayugma etc.’, the fire should be adored. Thereafter, soaking the kusa grass in ghi, it should be poured into the fire.

## \|\| 2.15.11 \|\|

*jihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā yajñadattena sattamāḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyāmājyahomeṣu homayetsaṃyatātmakaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О seven sages, yajna-datta has described the three types of the tongues of the fire using the same, in the homa of ghi, the tongue of gold should be given as an offering.

## \|\| 2.15.12-14 \|\|

*trimadhvaktairyatra homaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca homayet \|*  
*kanakāsyāttu kṛṣṇāsyāddhirṇyā śubhratā tathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bahurūpātirūpā ca sāttvikā yogakarmasu \|*  
*viśvamūrtiṃ sphuliṃginyau dhūmravarṇā manojavā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*lohitāsyātkarālāsyātkālībhāsasya ityapi \|*  
*etāḥ sapta niyuṃjīta vijñeyāḥ krūrakarmasu \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. The three types of honeys (ghi, honey and sugar) should be used in the pericarp while performing the homa. The tongues like Kanaka, Krsna, Hiranya, Subhra, Bahurupa and Atirupa are known as the Sattvika tongues, which are to be used in the yoga-karmas. Similarly, the other tongues known as Visvamurti, Sphulingini (sparsa), Dhumra-varna (smoky), Munojava (having the speed of the mind), Lohita (of red colour), Karala and Kali having the lustre of the goddess Kali, are the four types of tongues which are made use of in the ruthless or harsh activities.

## \|\| 2.15.15-19 \|\|

*samidbhedeṣu yā jihvāstāstu tenaiva yojayet \|*  
*hiraṇyāmājyahome homayetsaṃyatātmakaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*trimadhvaktairyathā homaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca homayet \|*  
*śuddhakṣīreṇa raktāyāṃ naityikeṣu prabhā smṛtā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bahurūpā puṣpahome kṛṣṇā cānnena pāyasaiḥ \|*  
*ikṣuhome padmarāgā suvarṇā padmahomake \|\| 17 \|\|*

*lohitā padmahome ca śvetā vai bilvapatrake \|*  
*dhūminī tilahome ca kāṣṭhahome karālikā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*lohitāsyā pitṛhome tato jñeyā manojavā \|*  
*vaiśvānaraṃ sthitaṃ home samiddhomeṣu sattamāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. The difference of the sacrificial sticks are akin to those of the tongues. They have also to be combined with these. For example, while performing the homa for ghi, the tongue named Hiranya should be used. In the homa of trimedha (honey, ghee and sugar) the same process has to be followed as is done while performing it in the pericarp. In the homa performed with pure payasam, Rakta is to be used. In the formless karmas, Prabha has to be used; Bahurupa has to be used in the homa for the flowers; performing homa with the payasam of the cereals, Кrsna is to be made use of; in the homa of sugarcane, the one with ruby is to be used; Suvarna or Lohita is to be used in the homa of lotus; in the homa for the wood apple the one with white complexion should be used; in the homa for the sesamum seeds Dhumini (or smoke) should be used, Karali should be made use of in the homa for wood, Lohita and Sattamaganas should be used in the homa for pitrs, while the fire should appear there in its own form. Manojava who can move with the speed of the mind, should also be invoked.

## \|\| 2.15.20 \|\|

*samānamājyahome ca niṣaṇṇaṃ śeṣavastuṣu \|*  
*āsyāttu juhuyādvahnau pipartti sarvakarmasu \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In the homa of ghi, the fire bums equally well but in the homa when performed with other things, it looks as if sleeping with the pouring of the offerings in the mouth of the fire and ail the desires are achieved with success.

## \|\| 2.15.21 \|\|

*karṇahome tu vai vyādhirnetre taddvayamīritam \|*  
*nāsikāyāṃ manaḥpīḍā mastake'dhvā na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. By performing homa in their ears, one attracts ailments, the same in both the eyes, the mental agony in the nose and by making the offerings in the head, one has to proceed on to a journey. There is no doubt about it

## \|\| 2.15.22 \|\|

*putraṃ vipatkaraṃ caiva tasmāttatra na homayet \|*  
*sādhāraṇamatho vakṣye vahnerjihvāśca kīrtitāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In case the offerings are poured in the acceptable spots, all the obstructions get removed. Therefore, one should not perform homa at these spots. Henceforth, I am speaking about the ordinary tongues or flames of fire, which have also been described elsewhere.

## \|\| 2.15.23-25 \|\|

*pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ yadviśeṣaṃ punaḥ śṛṇu \|*  
*ghṛtāhutau hiraṇyākhyā gaganā pāṇihomataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*vakrā khyātā mahāhome kṛṣṇābhā sā kratau matā \|*  
*suprabhā modakavidhau bahurūpātirūpikāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*puṣpapatravidhau home vahnerjihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*na vā saṃkalpayetkuṇḍe śūdrākāra vibhedataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. The process and the special features there of are also being highlighted. In making the offerings of the ghi, the names of the tongues of the fire have been described to be Hirapya; Gagana in case the offering is made by the hand; Vakra in the great yajna; Krsna in a yajna; Suprabha when the offering of sweet balls is made; Bahurupa when the homa is made with flowers and Atirupa when the offering is made with (dry) leaves. These are said to be the tongues of fire. No samkalpa should read out because of the difference of Sudrakara.

## \|\| 2.15.26 \|\|

*indrakoṣṭhaṃ mastakaṃ syādīśāgneye ca mastake \|*  
*tatkāṣṭhapārśve dve netre dvau karau ca padakramāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The cubicals of Indra, the one in the northeast and south-east are treated to be the heads of Agni or fire. At the back of their wood, both the eyes are there, besides both the hands and the feet respectively.

## \|\| 2.15.27 \|\|

*aviśiṣṭaṃ bhavetpucchaṃ madhye codarasambhavam \|*  
*udare homayetpuṣṭimannaṃ pāyasakaṃ ca yat \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The rest of the said part is treated to be the tail and the middle of die belly. Therefore, the homa of cereals and payasam should be made for the purpose of growth from there.

## \|\| 2.15.28 \|\|

*hutvā vrīhigaṇaṃ tatra karṇe puṣpāhutiṃ hunet \|*  
*vāmakarṇe vāmanetre hunedabjādikaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. After performing the homa in an appropriate manner in the belly, the offering of the flowers should be made in the ear. The learned people have prescribed the offering of a lotus flower in the left ear and left eye.

## \|\| 2.15.29 \|\|

*śravaṇe caiva netre ca dakṣiṇe cekṣukhaṃḍakam \|*  
*vāmapāde vāmakare abhicāreṣu śasyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The piece of sugarcane should be poured in the left hand and the left foot, during the incantation rites.

## \|\| 2.15.30 \|\|

*māraṇe puṣpadeśe tu na cānyaṃ homayetkvacit \|*  
*vipatkaraṃ vijānīyāddhvaniḥ sarvavināśakṛt \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. For the purpose of destruction or for any other auspicious rite, no other homa should be performed, because by not so doing such a type of obstruction could be created by which wholesale destruction could be possible.

## \|\| 2.15.31 \|\|

*candanāgarukarpūrapāṭalāyūthikānibhaḥ \|*  
*pāvakasya suto gaṃdhaḥ samaṃtātsumahodayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The offering of the sandalwood, Agaru, Patala tree or jasmine or other similar fragrances cause enormous upliftment. This has been revealed by the son of Agni.

## \|\| 2.15.32 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇastyaktakalpā chatrākā śithilā śikhā \|*  
*śubhadā yajamānasya rājyasyāpi viśeṣataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Like the circumambulation or like extraordinary umbrella, the fire flames are auspicious for the performer or like chatra, the fading fire are beneficial for the performer. It is particularly so in case of the rulers.

## \|\| 2.15.33 \|\|

*chinnavṛttāḥ śikhāḥ kuryānmṛtyurdhanaparikṣayaḥ \|*  
*nirvāpyaṃ maraṇaṃ vidyānmahādhūmākule'pi ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. A shattered branch causes death and loss of riches. When enormous smoke emerges out of die fire, it causes death.

## \|\| 2.15.34-35 \|\|

*evaṃvidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittaṃ samācaret \|*  
*aṣṭāviṃśāhutīstyaktvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*mūlenājyena juhuyājjuhuyātpañcaviṃśatim \|*  
*mahāsnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ trikālaṃ haripūjanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. With the appearing of such obstructions, the repentance is essential. For that purpose, twenty offerings should be dropped in the fire and thereafter, food should be served to the Brahmagas. Twenty five offerings should be poured of ghi and one should take a great bath and then Visnu should be adored thrice a day, which is said to be essential.

## Chapter 16. Puja at the conclusion of the Yajna

## \|\| 2.16.1 \|\|

*sūt uvāca \|*  
*nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva yāgādau ca samāptake \|*  
*homāvasāne prajapedupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - At the conclusion of the casual or a regular yajna and at the end of the performing of homa, then the puja has to be performed by sixteen means.

## \|\| 2.16.2 \|\|

*dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścātpīṭhapūjāṃ samācarat \|*  
*gṛhītvā raktapuṣpaṃ ca dhyāyedvahniṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The fire should be ignited with the air and the pedestal of the pitha should be worshipped. Thereafter, holding the red flowers, one should meditate upon Agni appropriately.

## \|\| 2.16.3 \|\|

*iṣṭaṃ śaktisvastikābhītimuccairdīrghairdorbhirdhārayantaṃ varāṃtam \|*  
*hemākalpaṃ padmasaṃsthaṃ trinetraṃ dhyāyedvahniṃ baddhamauliṃ jaṭābhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. One should then meditate upon the form of Agni, who has absorbed the weapons like Svastika and Sakti etc. in his arms, is seated over the lotus seat resembling the gold, whose head is adorned with the crown of the maned locks of hair.

## \|\| 2.16.4 \|\|

*pūrvādidvāradeśeṣu kāmadevaṃ śatakratum \|*  
*varāhaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ caiva gaṃdhādyaiḥ sādhu pūjayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Indra, Kamadeva, Varaha and Karttikeya who are lodged at the eastern and other gates, should be worshipped.

## \|\| 2.16.5 \|\|

*āvāhya sthāpayetpaścādaṣṭau mudrāḥ pradarśayet \|*  
*dattvāsanaṃ svāgataṃ ca dadyātpādyādikatrayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After invoking and consecration of the gods, all the mudras should be displayed before them. Lodging them over the seats, the padya and arghya should be offered to them for washing their feet.

## \|\| 2.16.6-8 \|\|

*ataḥ pūrvādipātreṣu yāvatā ca hutāśanam \|*  
*suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mahodaraṃ mahājihvamākāśatvena pūjayet \|*  
*tārakādīnsamāpte ca gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tatraiva jihvāstrividhā dhyāyenmaṃtrapuraḥsarāḥ \|*  
*vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa upacārairanaṃtaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Thereafter, the god Agni, with the complexion of gold, who is spotless, shining, having the faces on all the four sides, a big belly and a protruding tongue, should be worshipped like the sky. Then at the end, the stars should also be adored separately with fragrant flowers. Thereafter, reciting the mantras, one should meditate upon the three tongues.

## \|\| 2.16.9-11 \|\|

*tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ \|*  
*paramajyotīrūpastvamāsanaṃ saphalī kuru \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dadyādāsanametena puṣpagucchatrayeṇa tu \|*  
*puṭāṃjaliṃ tato baddhvā pṛcchetkuśalapūrvakam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vaiśvānara namaste'stu namaste havyavāhana \|*  
*svāgataṃ tu suraśreṣṭha śāṃtiṃ kuru namo'stu te \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. You are the foremost of all the living beings and also makes one to cross the ocean of the universe. Your form is the supreme flame, therefore you bestow success by occupying the seat.” Thus speaking, the seat should be offered with three bunches of flowers. The hands should be joined saying- “O Vaisvanara, salutation to you. Salutation to the carrier of havya. You are the best of the gods. You are welcome here. You please accept it and bestow peace on me. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.16.12-13 \|\|

*namaste bhagavandeva āponārāyaṇātmaka \|*  
*sarvalokahitārthāya pādyaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇaparaṃ dhāma jyotīrūpa sanātana \|*  
*gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ viśvarūpa namo'stu te \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О lord of Bhuvanas, О lord Narayana, for the welfare of all the people, you please wash your feet with this water. О form of Narayana, you represent the highest place. You are eternal form of flames. You kindly accept the arghya so offered by me. О lord with the universal form, salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.16.14 \|\|

*jagadādityarūpeṇa prakāśayati yaḥ sadā \|*  
*tasmai prakāśarū pāya namaste jātavedase \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. You are the one who illuminates the world in the form of Surya. Salutation to the resplendent lord Agni.

## \|\| 2.16.15 \|\|

*dhanaṃjaya namaste'stu sarvapāpapraṇāśana \|*  
*snānīyaṃ te mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. You are the destroyer of all the sins, salutation to you. I am offering water for your bath to get all my desires fulfilled. (You kindly accept it.)

## \|\| 2.16.16 \|\|

*hutāśana mahābāho devadeva sanātana \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ te prayacchāmi dehi me paramaṃ padam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О lord Agni, having long arms, you are the eternal god of gods. I take refuge with you. You bestow salvation to me.

## \|\| 2.16.17 \|\|

*jyotiṣāṃ jyotīrūpastvamanādinidhanācyuta \|*  
*mayā dattamalaṃkāramalaṃkuru namostu te \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. You are the light of all the lights and Acyuta, beyond birth or death, you kindly accept the ornaments offered by me. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.16.18 \|\|

*devīdevā mudaṃ yāṃti yasya samyaksamāgamāt \|*  
*sarvadoṣopaśāṃtyartha gandho'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The god by meeting whom all the gods and goddesses feel delighted. To him, I offer the fragrant flowers for the removal of all the blemishes of mine. You kindly accept the same.

## \|\| 2.16.19 \|\|

*tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ hi brahmā ca jyotiṣāṃ gatirīśvara \|*  
*gṛhāṇa puṣpaṃ deveśa sānulepaṃ jagadbhavet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. You are Visnu as well as Brahma, besides being the movement of the rulers. О Isvara, O Devesa, you kindly accept the flowers and the whole universe would get involved with the same.

## \|\| 2.16.20 \|\|

*devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca sukhamekaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*dhūpo'yaṃ devadeveśa gṛhyatāṃ me dhanaṃjaya \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Eternity is the only comfort for the gods and the manes. Therefore, О Dhananjaya, you accept the incense.

## \|\| 2.16.21 \|\|

*tvamekaḥ sarvabhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca \|*  
*paramātmā parākāraḥ pradīpaḥ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In all the mobile and immobile beings, you are lodged as the supreme soul. You please accept the lamp.

## \|\| 2.16.22 \|\|

*namo'stu yajñapataye prabhave jātavedase \|*  
*sarvalokahitārthāya naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. You are the lord of the yajnas, salutation to lord Agni. You kindly accept the eatables, for the welfare of all the people.

## \|\| 2.16.23-24 \|\|

*hutāśana namastubhyaṃ namaste rukmavāhana \|*  
*lokanātha namaste'stu namaste jātavedase \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ityanena tu mantreṇa dadyāddivye'pyadhītakam \|*  
*sarvasvaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca paramānnaṃ samākṣikam \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Salutation to you. О Hutasana, salutation to the lord of the universe, salutation to Jataveda-Agni.” Reciting this mantra, all the yajna-sutras, the honey and excellent food should be offered.

## Chapter 17. Various types of Yajnas

## \|\| 2.17.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*yajñabhedaṃ tribhedaṃ ca vakṣye śāstramataṃ yathā \|*  
*yathāvedānusāreṇa yathāgrahaṇa yojanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - According to the provision of the Sastras as well as the Vedas in which three types of the yajnas are prescribed, are being spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 2.17.2-6 \|\|

*śatārdhe vahniruddiṣṭaḥ śatārdhe kāśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*ghṛtapradīpake viṣṇustilayāge vanaspatiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sahasre brāhmaṇo nāma ayute harirucyate \|*  
*lakṣahome tu vahniḥ syātkoṭihome hutāśanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*varuṇaḥ śāṃtike jñeyo māraṇe hyaruṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*nityahome'nalo nāma prāyaścitte hutāśanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*lohitaścānnayajñe yo grahāṇāṃ pratyanukramāt \|*  
*devapratiṣṭhāyāge tu lohitaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*prajāpatirvāstuyāge maṃḍape cāpi padmake \|*  
*prapāyāṃ caiva nāgākhyo mahādāne havirbhujaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

2-6. During the half of a century, the name of Agni as Кasуара should be uttered. Similarly, in the yajna ghi, the name of Visnu has to be uttered; in the homa of sesamum, Vanaspati should be uttered; in the yajna of a thousand offerings, the name of Brahma should be uttered; in the homa of ten thousand the name of Hari has to be uttered; in the homa of a lakh of offerings, Vahni should be uttered; in the homa of a crore of offerings. Hutasana should be uttered; in the homa performed for achieving the peaceful means, Varuna should be maintained; in regular homa, Anala should be uttered; in the food yajna which is performed for the pleasing of the planets and the consecration of the Devas, Lohita should be uttered. In the yajna performed for the building of a house, which is decorated with lotus mandala. Prajapati should be mentioned. In the building of a place for supply of the drinking water. Naga should be mentioned. In the Mahadana or great charities, Havirbhuja is to be mentioned.

## \|\| 2.17.7-10 \|\|

*godāne ca bhavedrudraḥ kanyādāne tu go'jakaḥ \|*  
*tulāpuruṣadāne ca dhātāgniḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vṛṣotsarge bhavetsūryo'vasānāṃte raviḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*pāvako vaiśvadeve ca dīkṣāpakṣe janārdanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*trāsane ca bhavetkālaḥ kravyādaḥ śaradāhane \|*  
*parṇadāhe yamo nāma hyasthidāhe śikhaṃḍikaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*garbhādhāne ca marutaḥ sīmaṃte piṃgalaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*puṃsave tviṃdra ākhyātaḥ praśasto yāgakarmaṇi \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Rudra should be remembered in giving a cow in charity. Gojaka is to be mentioned at the time of kanyadana or marriage of a daughter. During tuladana, Dhata is to be mentioned. During the annual festival, Surya is to be mentioned. At the end, Ravi is to be mentioned. In Vaisvadeva, Pavaka is to be mentioned; at the time of initiation ceremony, Janardana is to be mentioned, Kala is to be mentioned for frightening; Kravyada in Saradaha; Yama in Parnadaha, Sikhandika in the burning of the bones; Maruta during conception; Pingala in the Simanta rite; and Indra in the milk ceremony which is said to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 2.17.11-13 \|\|

*nāmasaṃsthāpane caivamupanyaste ca pārthivaḥ \|*  
*niṣkrame hāṭakaścaiva prāśane ca śucistathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ṣaḍānanaśca cūḍāyāṃ vratādeśe samudbhavaḥ \|*  
*vītihotraścopanaye samāvarte dhanaṃjayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*udare jaṭharāgniśca samudre vaḍavānalaḥ \|*  
*śikhāyāṃ ca vibhurjñeyaḥ svarasyāgniḥ sarīsṛpaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Parthiva should be uttered at the time of giving of a name to the child; Hataka should be uttered at the time of departure; Suci at the time of giving cereal; Sadanana is to be mentioned during hair removing and Vratadesa. During thread ceremony, Vitihotra is to the mentioned; Dhananjaya during the return of a disciple after completing his studies; Jatharagni in the belly; Jataveda in the ocean; the tuft in Visnu and the tune in fire known as Sarisrpa.

## \|\| 2.17.14 \|\|

*aśvāgnirmaṃtharo nāma rathāgnirjātavedasaḥ \|*  
*gajāgnirmaṃdaraścaiva sūryāgnirviṃdhyasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The fire of the horse is to be known as Manthara; the fire of a chariot is known as Jatavedas; fire of an elephant is known as Mandara; Vindhya is known as the fire of the sun.

## \|\| 2.17.15 \|\|

*toyāgnirvaruṇonāma brāhmaṇāgnirhavirbhujaḥ \|*  
*parvatāgniḥ kratubhujo dāvāgniḥ sūrya ucyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The fire of water is called as Varuna, Havibhuja is known as the fire of Brahmana; Kratubhuja is the name of the fire of the mountain; Davagni is known as the fire of the sun.

## \|\| 2.17.16 \|\|

*dīpāgniḥ pāvako nāma gṛhyāgnirdharaṇīpatiḥ \|*  
*ghṛtāgniśca nalo vāyuḥ sūtikāgniśca rākṣasaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Pavaka is known as the fire of a lamp; Dharanipati is known as the fire of a house; the fire of ghi is known as Nala and the fire of the birth is known as Raksasa.

## Chapter 18. Materials for performing Yajnas

## \|\| 2.18.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*athāto homadravyāṇāṃ pramāṇamabhidhīyate \|*  
*pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca niṣphalaṃ bhavati dhuvam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - Now I shall speak to you about the material required for homa, because by keeping the same in little or excess quantity or by keeping the unauthenticated things, the homa becomes useless.

## \|\| 2.18.2 \|\|

*karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam \|*  
*tatsamaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca dadhi dugdhaṃ tathā madhu \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. In a karsa (a measure) of ghi, a small shell full of milk and pancagavya of similar quantity (milk of cow, the curd, ghi, urine) the curd, milk and honey should be mixed.

## \|\| 2.18.3 \|\|

*muṣṭimānena pṛthukā lājāḥ syurmuṣṭisaṃmitāḥ \|*  
*śarkarā muṣṭimātrā ca śarkarātolakaṃ viduḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The fried paddy fist in quantity, the sugar measured in a musti should be added. This is the measure of the sugar as prescribed by those well-versed in the measure.

## \|\| 2.18.4-5 \|\|

*tritolakaṃ guḍaṃ vidyādikṣuparvavi dhirbhavet \|*  
*ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi śālūkasya trimuṣṭikam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ekalagne na juhuyānna pṛthagjuhuyātkvacit \|*  
*savṛṃtakaṃ japāpuṣpaṃ keśaraṃ tatsavṛṃtakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. By adding three tolas (one tola is equal to nearly twelve grams) of the sugarcane cakes, such a mixture is known as Iksuparva-vidhana A leaf, flowers and sugar candy should also be added. The homa of the bunches of green grass and the bunches of saffron should not be used separately.

## \|\| 2.18.6-8 \|\|

*ekaikaśaśca padmānāṃ jalajānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*jīvaṃtyāḥ phalamānena piṣṭakānāṃ prasaṃkhyayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vasaṃtakaṃ dhātrimāne modakasya pramāṇataḥ \|*  
*ekaikaśaḥ phalānāṃ ca mātuliṃgatrikheḍakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*aṣṭadhā nālikerasya panasaṃ daśadhā bhavet \|*  
*padmabījapramāṇena kūṣmāṃḍaṃ cāṣṭadhā bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. A lotus, the saffron and the Jayanti fruit should be mixed together and round ball should be made of the size of a sweet ball and then they should be used in homa. A part of the fruits, three parts of a citron or a lemon, eight pans of a coconut, ten parts of a jack fruit and eight parts of the pumpkin of the size of lotus seeds should be added.

## \|\| 2.18.9 \|\|

*urvārukaṃ cāṣṭadhā ca guḍūcī caturaṃgulam \|*  
*pūgamānaṃ ca māṃsasya saguḍaṃ tatra dṛśyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Eight parts of cucumber, four parts of guduci, four pieces of flesh of the size of betel nut should be collected and then they should be mixed with the sugarcane balls.

## \|\| 2.18.10-13 \|\|

*anyatra badarīmānaṃ tiṃdukaṃ ca tridhā kṛtam \|*  
*kāṣṭhaṃ prādeśamātraṃ syāddūrvā yāśca tripatrakam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bhūrjapatraṃ ca gṛhṇīyācchamīṃ prādeśamātrikām \|*  
*vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syuḥ śuktimānena sarṣapāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*maricāḥ syurvimā nena mṛṇālaṃ cātha mūlakam \|*
