*saptakhaṃḍaṃ ca vārtākaṃ tripuṣṭaṃ ca tridhoditam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*caṃdanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca \|*  
*tittiḍībījamānena samuddi ṣṭāni deśikaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. For other usages, the size of the ball should be equal to those of the Badari fruits, which has been prescribed. The musk melon should be cut into three parts, the wood sticks should be used as prescribed, three bundles of durva grass, birch-bark and the wood of Sumi tree should be of the prescribed size, a fist full of Vrthi rice (which ripens during the rainy season), a conch full of mustard seeds, black pepper, the roots of lotus plant, seven pieces of brinjal and three energetic things should be divided into three parts. Then sandalpaste, Agaru, camphor, musk, kumkuma (saffron) and the tamarind seeds should be mixed and taken together.

## \|\| 2.18.14-15 \|\|

*samidāplavane tryaṃgatilānāmapi madhyataḥ \|*  
*daśakaṃ plāvanenaiva sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ vinā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*evaṃ vrīhiplāvane ca kāṣṭhavadi kṣudaṃḍakam \|*  
*prokṣaṇaṃ mṛdupuṣpāṇāṃ latādīnāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. While bathing, the sacrificial sticks should be put in the sesamum seed upto three fourth of their size. In the yajna in which the offerings of a hundred or a thousand or not to be made, the pieces of sugarcane should be put into the boiled rice. Then they should be stirred with soft flowers and the creepers.

## \|\| 2.18.16 \|\|

*pāyasānne tathānne ca modake piṣṭake'pi ca \|*  
*śālyāsaktena juhuyādvyatyaye vyatyayaṃ phalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The payasam, the food, sweet balls and the Salt rice should be powdered which should be used in the performing of homa. In case things move to the contrary, one can face the adverse effect of the same.

## \|\| 2.18.17 \|\|

*bilvapatrasya plavanaṃ daṃḍaṃ hitvā ca plāvayet \|*  
*vṛṃtasaṃplāvanādeva phalaṃ harati rākṣasaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Making use of the wood apple leaves, the part of branches should be left out and the bathing or washing should be done. By stirring with the bunches, the reward is usurped by the Raksasas.

## \|\| 2.18.18 \|\|

*bilvapatrasya pūrvārdhaprāptamātreṇa yoja yet \|*  
*patratrayaṃ tathā home chinnebhinne'tidūṣaṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Even when the forepart of the leaf is received, the same should be accepted. During the performing of homa, three leaves of wood apple should be used. But with the shattering of these leaves, one can earn blemishes as well.

## \|\| 2.18.19-20 \|\|

*na dvitriplavanaṃ kuryātkṛtvā yāti rasātalam \|*  
*tasmācca putraśiṣyādyairbrāhmaṇaistattvakovidaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pāvayecca yathākramāt \|*  
*na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kuryācchāṃtipakṣa udaṅmukhaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. The stirring should not be done twice or thrice, because by so doing it moves to the nether world. Therefore, the son or the Brahmana well-versed in the tattva and facing to the east, he should try to purify the same During the peaceful ceremony, one should face the north, one should not resort to more or less in performance, because such a process has not been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.18.21 \|\|

*pāyasānyanyadeveṣu yatnena pariva rjayet \|*  
*na cāgnau dāpayedyatnādetebhyaḥ pratipādayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The homas which are performed for the sake of the other gods, the offerings of payasam should not be offered to them.

## \|\| 2.18.22-23 \|\|

*kaniṣṭhāṃgulimāsādya prakuryātparvabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*guṇadorakamānena tāvaddhomagatirbudhāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*aṃgulairdvitricaturaiḥ patrahomākṛtikramāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. According to the quality, the size of the homa should be organised. The sequence of homa should be made with leaves of the size of two, three or four angulas.

## Chapter 19. The use of Sruva or ladle

## \|\| 2.19.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śrīparṇī śiṃśapā kṣīrī bilvaḥ khadira eva ca \|*  
*sruve praśastāstaravaḥ siddhidā yāgakarmaṇi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said The ladle made of sandalwood, Dilbergia sisu, the tree with milk, wood apple tree and of catachue is said to be quite praiseworthy. These trees bestow success in the un/ltas.

## \|\| 2.19.2 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāyāṃ praśastāstu dhātrīkhadirakeśarāḥ \|*  
*saṃskāre śaśibhinnau ca dhātrī dhātrā vinirmitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. During the activities for achieving fame, the ladle made of the wood of myrobalan or catechue are said to be praiseworthy. For the performing of Candra-bhinna samskara, the use of a ladle of myrobalan is said to be praiseworthy because Brahma had produced it for the same purpose.

## \|\| 2.19.3 \|\|

*saṃprāśe yaḥ sruvaḥ proktaḥ saṃskāre yajñasādhane \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu kathitāsta danye śāstravedibhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. During the yajna-karma of tire tasting of the good, ladle of the same wood has been prescribed. The same type of ladle has been prescribed for the ceremony of the consecration of images.

## \|\| 2.19.4 \|\|

*sruvaṃ srucamatho vakṣye yadadhīnaśca jāyate \|*  
*yajñe na sarvakaṃ dhāryamakṣareṇa ca vyatyayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Now I am going to discuss the difference between a Sruk and a ladle (Sruva). I am also speaking about the one under which they function. Since they are the part of the yajna, it is the yajna, which bears them. Because of their being the parts of yajna, both are said to be equals. The only difference between them is that of a letter.

## \|\| 2.19.5-7 \|\|

*tasyādau ca sruvaṃ vakṣye yacca mānaṃ yadāspadam \|*  
*kāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā bilvasya riktāditithivarjite \|\| 5 \|\|*

*samupoṣya ca racayedāmiṣāṇi na ca smaret \|*  
*varjayedgrāmyadharmaṃ ca nirmāṇe sruksruvasya vai \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā vibhajedbhāgāṃstriṃśattathā punaḥ \|*  
*viṃśatyaṃgulamānaṃ tu kuṃḍavedisamodaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Therefore, I am speaking about Sruva, its size and the place. During the defective tithis, the Sruva of wood apple tree should he made. While making it, one should fast and should not touch the meat which should not be thought about at all. Besides it, one should not have a union with the woman. This rule is also applicable during the making of a Sruk. The wood of Sruvd should first be divided into thirty parts and the length of Sruvd should be kept as twenty angulas, the belly of which resembles the altar.

## \|\| 2.19.8 \|\|

*kaṭāhākāranimnaṃ ca sruvaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*dhātrīphalasamākāraṃ svadhānimnaṃ suśobhanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. An intelligent person should make a Sruva lower or deep like the trying pan, resembling the shape of myrobalan and low like Svadha (the word used while making an offering to manes) and should be beautiful in shape.

## \|\| 2.19.9-10 \|\|

*vedīṃ śūrpākṛtiṃ kuryātkuṃḍāni parikalpayet \|*  
*haṃsavattriguṇā vāpi hastenā'numukhaṃ likhet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sruvaṃ caturviṃśatibhirbhāgaiśca racayeddhruvam \|*  
*dvitriṃśaṃ syātkuṃḍamānamadaive tasya kīrtitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Like a winnowing basket, the pedestal should be prepared, in which the altars should be made close to it, and a triangular altar resembling a swan should be made. Thereafter, a Sruvd of the length of twenty four angula should be made. At the same time, an altar of the size of thirty two angulas should be made.

## \|\| 2.19.11 \|\|

*caturbhiraṃgairānāhaṃ karṣādyagraṃ tataḥ sruvam \|*  
*aṃgadvayena vilikhetpaṃke mṛgamadākṛtim \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A small cabin of four angulas square, the portion should be made, which should be filled with ghl while making an offering. The remaining part of the wood should be used for making the ladle. The part which remains like a musk and the marsh should be made in it.

## \|\| 2.19.12 \|\|

*daṃḍamūlāśraye daṃḍī bhavetkaṃkaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*sauvarṇasya ca tāmrasya kāryā darvī pramāṇataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The base of the handle should be decorated with a bangle, besides a spoon of gold or the copper should also be made according to the size of the Sruva.

## \|\| 2.19.13-15 \|\|

*śraivarṇikodbhavaṃ yacca iṃduvṛkṣasamudbhavam \|*  
*kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ dvādaśāṃgulasaṃmitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dvayaṃgulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ tasya darvī sā yajñasādhane \|*  
*catvāriṃśattolikābhiriti tāmramayasya ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*paṃcāṃgulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ ca aṣṭahastaṃ ca daṃḍakam \|*  
*annādipāyasavidhau darvī yajñasya sādhane \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. The spoon of silk cotton tree, pine, wild fig tree and trees measuring twelve angulas in length has to be made, in which the sire of its mandala has to be of two angulas only. This type of spoon is said to be quite praiseworthy in the yajna. When the spoon is of copper, it should be of forty tolas (one tola is equal to twelve grams). Its mandala is required to be of five angulas, while the stick should be of eight cubits in length. Such a spoon is also said to be praiseworthy for making food or payasam in the yajna.

## \|\| 2.19.16-18 \|\|

*daśatolakamānena sā ca darvī udāhṛtā \|*  
*ājyasaṃśodhanārthaṃ tu sā tu tāmramayasya ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśāṃgulamānena sarvābhāve ca paippalīm \|*  
*ājya sthālīṃ ghṛtamayīṃ mṛnmayīṃ ca samāśrayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*atha tāmramayī kāryā na ca tāṃ tatra yojayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. A spoon of ten tolas of gold would be required for warming up of the ghi in the yajna. In the absence of these things, a spoon of pipala tree should be used for the purpose, which should be of the length of sixteen angulas. The earthen vase can also be used for keeping of the ghi. As far as possible, the spoon and the vase of ghi made of copper should not be used in a yajna.

## Chapter 20

## \|\| 2.20.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha pūrṇavidhiṃ vakṣye yathā caṃdrārthavedinām \|*  
*yasya samyaganuṣṭhānātsaṃpūrṇaṃ syāditi sthitiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - I have spoken about the Candrartha-Vedis (pedestals) in an appropriate manner. The related rites are to be performed in a proper manner, as per the provision of the scriptures.

## \|\| 2.20.2 \|\|

*homapūrtau mokṣakalpaḥ pūjāṃte'rghyaṃ vidhīyate \|*  
*atha tasyāmapūrṇāyāṃ hataśrīryajñabhraṃśatā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. After completing the homa in a proper manner, a sense of contentment is developed. Because of this, the offering of arghya at the conclusion of the puja has been prescribed. In case this is not performed, the yajna remains incomplete and its glory is lost and the yajna is considered to have been shattered.

## \|\| 2.20.3 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena sruvādho vinyaseccarum \|*  
*pūrṇaṃ dattvā savitre'rghyaṃ brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Therefore, making all the efforts, keeping cam under Sruva, an arghya should be offered to the Sungod, after which food should be served to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.20.4 \|\|

*gṛhaṃ praviśya ca tataḥ kulapūjāṃ samācaret \|*  
*saptate dehi me pūrṇāṃ punātviti ṛcā kramāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Thereafter, reaching home, the performer, according to his own family tradition, should utter the Reas like “Saptate Dehi" and the yajna should be completed.

## \|\| 2.20.5-6 \|\|

*niyojayetpratiṣṭhāyāṃ nityanaimittike śṛṇu \|*  
*punātviti ṛcā pūrṇā prathamā parikīrtitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*saptateti dvitīyā syāddehimeti tṛtīyikā \|*  
*pūrṇā darvī caturthī syātkulevasthāpya deśikaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. During the regular or casual functions, some Reds are made use of which are being spoken by me. You please listen. “Punatviti-ricapurna", then Sapteti, then Dehimeti and then Purnadarvi are the Reas to be made use of, which according to one’s family tradition should be recited while worshipping the gods. This has been prescribed in the scripture.

## \|\| 2.20.7 \|\|

*utthāya dadyātpūrṇāṃ tu nopaviśya kadācana \|*  
*kanakāyāṃ ca jihvāyāṃ raktāyāṃ grahayāgake \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The fourth Rica — Рurna should be recited appropriately while standing. It should never be recited while seated. This offering is made in the foremost tongue of the Fire-god. In the yajna for the planets, the offering with this is made into the Rakta-jihva.

## \|\| 2.20.8 \|\|

*grahahome śatāṃte ca pūrṇā ekā vidhīyate \|*  
*sahasrāṃte yugaṃ dadyādayutāṃte yugadvayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. At the end of a hundred offerings in homa of the planets, a purnahuti has been prescribed at the end. Similarly, at the conclusion of the yajna of a thousand offerings, four purnahutis are prescribed. In the yajna of a thousand offerings, four purnahutis are prescribed and in the yajna of ten thousand offerings, eight pUrnahutis have been prescribed, which form the essential part of the yajna.

## \|\| 2.20.9 \|\|

*sahasrāṃte dadedekaṃ puṣpahome ca sattamāḥ \|*  
*pūrṇā tvekasahasraṃ tu dadyādyajñaphalepsayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the homa of flowers of a thousand offerings, one purpahuti is prescribed. For the achieving of the reward of the yajnas, one purnahuti is prescribed. For the achieving of the reward of the yajtias, offering of a thousand purnas has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.20.10 \|\|

*mṛdupuṣpākṛtau tvekā kevale cekṣuhomake \|*  
*śataṃ dve ca śate caiva garbhādhānānnaprāśane \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the homa with soft flowers only, one purna is prescribed, while in the homa of sugarcane, a hundred of them are required. During the rites of first tasting of the food and conception, there is a provision for two hundred offerings.

## \|\| 2.20.11 \|\|

*sīmaṃtonnayane caiva prāyaścittākṛtīṣu ca \|*  
*vaiśvadeve ca nitye ca pūrṇā tvekā vidhīyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the Simantonnayana (a ceremony performed at the sixth or eighth month of the conception), Vaisvadeva rites or daily rites, a single purna has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.20.12 \|\|

*evaṃ srucau samau kṛtvā uparyupari vinyaset \|*  
*yathā na vyayate kṛtvā na kalpayati yāvatā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Then both the ladles should be placed over the vases of the yajna, so that they can remain handy.

## \|\| 2.20.13 \|\|

*ṛṣichaṃdādikaṃ śrutvā pratimaṃtrasya sattamāḥ \|*  
*anyathālpālpakaphalaṃ tasmātsaṃnyasya homayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A head of the reciting of each one of the hymns, the mention of the related Rsi and its chanda or the meter is essential. In case it is no so done, the reward of the yajna is reduced to minimum. The aforesaid vases of the yajna should be discarded and the homa should be performed uttering the name of the Rsi.

## \|\| 2.20.14 \|\|

*saptateti brāhmaṇasya ṛṣiḥ kauṃḍinya īritaḥ \|*  
*jagatī ca bhavecchaṃdo devatāgniḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Kaundinya is the Risi for the hymn - Sapteti Brahmana, the meter is Jagati, while Agni is the god.

## \|\| 2.20.15 \|\|

*dehi meti ca maṃtrasya prajāpatirṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*anuṣṭup ca bhavecchaṃdo devatāsya prajāpatiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. For the mantra - Dehi-meti, Prajapati is the Risi, Anustupa is the meter and Prajapati is the god

## \|\| 2.20.16-17 \|\|

*pūrṇā darvīti mantrasya śatakraturṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*chaṃdonuṣṭupsamākhyātaṃ vahniścaivātra devatā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*punātviti ca mantrasya ṛṣiḥ syātpavanaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*chaṃdo'pi jagatī khyātaṃ devatāgniśca kīrtitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. For the mantra - "Purnadarvi, Satakratu is the Rsi, Anustupa is the meter and fire is the god. Similarly, for the Punatviti mantra, Pavana is the Rsi, Jagati is the meter, while Agni is the god.

## \|\| 2.20.18 \|\|

*turyapūrṇā yajñamadhye nakule dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*na cāśiṣaṃ yajñamadhye abhiṣekaṃ ca tarpaṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O best of Brahmanas, in the yajna in which the fourth purna is made use of while performing anusthana, till its conclusion, the blessing for the family, abhiseka and the offering of oblation should not be performed.

## \|\| 2.20.19-22 \|\|

*ṛtvikchaṃdaḥ spṛśansamyagdakṣiṇāṃgamathāpi vā \|*  
*yajamānaḥ sapatnīko mahotsavapuraḥsaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

*viśvāmitro'yutaṃ tatra homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*lavalī badarī śastaṃ picumaṃdakacchatrakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*nāgaraṃgaṃ dhātakīṃ ca pūrṇāyāṃ ca vivarjayet \|*  
*japyahānirasaṃkhyāte homabhraṃśaśca jāyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tasmātprāgeva satilāngaṇitvā sthāpayetpṛthak \|*  
*yugapadgaṇayedvātha na cāṃgena kadācana \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. The yajamana then with his wife, should, while touching the hota and uttering the meters, after touching his right limbs, should perform the yajna of ten thousand offerings like Visvabandhu. At the start of the purna, the use of scur fruit, jujube fruit, branches of nima tree, orange and myrobalan is prohibited. A japam without count is sure to cause harm. The homa also is lost. Therefore, the counting should be arranged beforehand. One should not do so alone.

## \|\| 2.20.23 \|\|

*dhātakyāśca phalaiḥ saṃkhyā kartavyā phalamicchatā \|*  
*badaryāśca lavalyāśca phalaiḥ sarvārthasiddhaye \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A person who is desirous of the reward should arrange for the counting with the myrobalan fruit. For the success of all the desires, the puja should be performed with scur and jujube fruits.

## \|\| 2.20.24 \|\|

*nāgaraṃgaphalaireva dhātakyā bakulaiḥ phalaiḥ \|*  
*yajñahānikaraṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The orange, myrobalan and the fruit of Ninsops dengi, when used for the purpose of counting, cause harm to the performer. Therefore, to discard them while counting is said to be beneficial.

## \|\| 2.20.25 \|\|

*karpūracaṃdanaiḥ kuryāddholikāṃ yajñasiddhaye \|*  
*gaṃgāmṛttikayā yuktaḥ śunikāmatha vā dvijāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The camphor and sandal paste should be used for the success of the yajna, performing a holy rite with the same. The sand of the Ganga or shell powder could also be used for this purpose.

## \|\| 2.20.26-27 \|\|

*raktaguṃjāphalaiḥ saṃkhyāṃ puṣṭikāmeṣu yojayet \|*  
*vātārdhe ca śate caiva sahasre ca tathaiva hi \|\| 26 \|\|*

*hotā syādayutenāpi ekāhe vedasaṃkhyayā \|*  
*ṛṇasādhye bhaveddhotā traya eva dvijottamāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Those desirous of the progress in their activities should make the counting with the seeds of the shrub Guhja. Those who perform the Vatardha yajnas or the yajnas with a hundred, a thousand or ten thousand offerings, are called the Hotas. They also function as such in the yajnas in which four thousand offerings are made in a day and in Ae Rnasadhya yajnas. Thus there are three types of hotas (who pour offerings in the fire).

## \|\| 2.20.28 \|\|

*lakṣahome tu hotāraḥ ṣaḍeva parikīrtitāḥ \|*  
*koṭihome tu viprāḥ syuḥ praśastāḥ paṃktisaṃkhyayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. There are six hotels in the yajnas of a lakh of offerings and on this yajna of a crore of dhutis (offerings), the Brahmanas are arranged in lines, who are said to be quite praiseworthy.

## \|\| 2.20.29 \|\|

*nava paṃca daśadaśakaṃ paṃcaviṃśamathāpi vā \|*  
*kāmakrodha vihīnāḥ syurṛtvijaḥ śāṃtacetasaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. For the performance of the yajna, fourteen, twenty or twenty five Brahmanas are engaged for the performing of homa, who are selected being free from desires, anger, with a peaceful mind.

## \|\| 2.20.30 \|\|

*navagrahamakhe viprāścatvāro vedavedinaḥ \|*  
*athavā ṛtvijau śāṃtau dvāveva parikīrtitau \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. During the yajnas of the nine planets, four Brahmarias well-versed in the Vedic practices should be choosen who are with peaceful minds and who could serve as Rtvijas or the performers of yajnas.

## \|\| 2.20.31-32 \|\|

*kāryāvayutahome tu na prasajyeta vistare \|*  
*tadvatsadaśadhā cāṣṭau navahome tu ṛtvijaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*kartavyāḥ śaktitastadvaccatvāro'pi vimatsarāḥ \|*  
*tameva pūjayedbrahmā dvau vā trīnvā yathāvidhi \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. These provisions are applicable for the yajnas upto ten thousand offerings and not for the extensive types of yajnas. During the homa, as per one’s own means four, ten, nine or eight Rfis well-versed in the Vedas, having auspicious heart, should be made to take their seats. According to the rules, Brahma gets pleased with these or two or three Rsis, with whom the puja should be completed.

## \|\| 2.20.33 \|\|

*ekamapyarcayedbrahmā sahasre tvekabrāhmaṇam \|*  
*dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena nirvahedalpavittavān \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. When only one such Risi is available, then one should adore him alone appropriately like Brahma. A person with limited means should adopt only one Brahmana in the yajna of a thousand offerings, who should be pleased

## \|\| 2.20.34 \|\|

*lakṣahomastu kartavyo yadā vittaṃ bhavettadā \|*  
*yataḥ sarvamavāpnoti kuryātkāmavidhānataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. At the same time, for a person with enough of wealth, a yajna with a lakh of offerings has been prescribed for him. With the performing of the same yajna, all the desires of the performer get fulfilled. Therefore, it should be performed appropriately.

## \|\| 2.20.35 \|\|

*pūjyate śivaloke ca vasvādityamarudgaṇaiḥ \|*  
*yāvatkalpaśatānyaṣṭāvaṃte mokṣamavāpnuyāt \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By so doing, he is honoured in the places of Siva, Vasus, Aditya and Marudganas for upto eight hundred kalpas and then he ultimately achieves moksa.

## \|\| 2.20.36 \|\|

*akāmo yastvimaṃ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ yathāvidhi \|*  
*śatakāmamavāpnoti padaṃ cānaṃtyamaśnute \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A person, who with a detached mind, performs a yajna with a lakh of offerings, his hundreds of desires are fulfilled and he ultimately achieves the place of the lord.

## \|\| 2.20.37 \|\|

*putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam \|*  
*bhāryāthīṃ labhate bhāryāṃ kumārī ca śubhaṃ patim \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. One who is desirous of having a son, gets the same; one desirous of wealth gets the wealth; one who desires a spouse gets a spouse; and a maiden gets the best of a husband.

## \|\| 2.20.38-39 \|\|

*bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt \|*  
*yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃ brahmādhigacchati \|*  
*tasmācchataguṇaḥ proktaḥ koṭihomaḥ svayaṃbhuvā \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. A ruler whose kingdom is shattered, gets back his kingdom. The one who is desirous of glory, attains the glory. Besides whatever others desire, they get the same. One who perforins the yajna with a detached mind, he attains the supreme Brahman. The yajna of a crores of offerings of Brahma is hundred times more rewarding than this.

## \|\| 2.20.40 \|\|

*ācārya eva hotā syādbrāhmaṇānāmasaṃbhave \|*  
*na yojayedekameva cāyute homakarmaṇi \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In the absence of the Brahmanas, the Acarya can officiate as a Hold, but in the yajna of ten thousand offerings, it should not be left to a single Brahmana to do so.

## \|\| 2.20.41 \|\|

*darbhāsane'to na kuśe tṛṇe pattre tvace'pi ca \|*  
*pāṣāṇe mṛttikāyāṃ ca na ca vastrāsane kvacit \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The performance of puja has to be done seated over the kusasana or the mat of the kusa grass. Such a performance should not be made over the dry grass or hay, the leaves, skin of the trees, stones, the land or the cloth.

## \|\| 2.20.42 \|\|

*tatra dārumayaṃ kuryādāgamaṃ bhajate dvijaḥ \|*  
*dānaṃ dadyācca homāṃte pūrṇādau ca yathā bhavet \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. In the yajna, a wooden seat should be used for the reciting of the Vedas. The process of the completion of the yajna should be followed as prescribed in the scriptures and the daksind should be offered after the completion of yajna or homa.

## \|\| 2.20.43 \|\|

*dvijasaṃskārakāryeṣu pūrṇādau cāpi dakṣiṇā \|*  
*maṃtropāsanakāryeṣu somayāgāśvamedhake \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. During the samskaras of the Brahmanas, after the completion of the yajnas, the recitation of the manlras and after performing the Somayaga or Ahvamedha yajna, the daksina should be given accordingly.

## Chapter 21. Making of the Mandalas

## \|\| 2.21.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*athāto maṃḍalaṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣu yathoditam \|*  
*yadadhīnā bhavetsiddhistasmātkuryātsamāhitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - I am describing the mandalas as per the provision in the Puranas by which one can achieve various Siddhis.

## \|\| 2.21.2 \|\|

*devāḥ padmāsanasthāśca bhaviṣyaṃti vasaṃti ca \|*  
*vinābjaṃ nārcayeddevīmarcite yakṣiṇī haret \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The gods should be lodged over the lotus seats because they reside in them. Therefore, the adoration of the gods without the lotus is said to be quite inappropriate. In case it is not so done, the Yaksinis usurp the puja of the deity.

## \|\| 2.21.3 \|\|

*ato maṃḍalavicchedaṃ yasmāddaśaguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*rajaḥsādhye śataguṇaṃ kevale dviguṇaṃ phalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Therefore, the creation of a mandala and its partition is essential. In case it is created with the dust of flowers, one earns a hundred times more merit and in case it is done as a whole, one earns double the merit.

## \|\| 2.21.4 \|\|

*triśataṃ vaṃdane sādhye sahasraṃ ca rajo'ṣṭakam \|*  
*rajobhiḥ ṣoḍaśairbiṃbaṃ śataṃśatamanaṃtakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. By making it feasible by praising, one earns three hundred times more merit; by making of eight images, one gets a thousand times merit; and by creating sixteen images, one earns hundreds of times more merit.

## \|\| 2.21.5 \|\|

*yantre maṇau śālagrāme pratimāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*mahālaye mahāyonau raktaliṃge ca sādhikam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. By creating an image of emerald, gem, particularly of Salagrama, Mahalaya, Mahayoni or Raktalinga, one achieves much more merit.

## \|\| 2.21.6 \|\|

*rajoyuktaṃ likhedyastu pūjākārye vibhūtaye \|*  
*karaṇādiphalaṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. While performing the pOjd, the people, who with the wealth at their disposal, make image with silver, they achieve only a single merit for the same. Therefore, to abandon the same seems more beneficial at that point of time.

## \|\| 2.21.7-10 \|\|

*caturasraṃ navaṃ vyūhaṃ krauṃcaprāṇaṃ catu rvidham \|*  
*kāmabījaṃ vajranābhaṃ vighnarājaṃ gajāhvayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam \|*  
*śatapatraṃ sahasrāraṃ navanābhaṃ ca muṣṭikam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*paṃcābjaṃ caiva mainākaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca puṣkaram \|*  
*aṣṭāsraṃ caiva śrībiṃbaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ tryasrameva tu \|\| 9 \|\|*

*catvāriṃśattathā paṃcasvādhikaṃ parisaṃkhyayā \|*  
*caturasraṃ navavyūḍhaṃ vaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. The quadrangular with nine logistics, Kraunca ghrana, or like die beak of the heron bird, which is of four types, Kama-bija, Vajranabha, Vighnaaraja, Gaja-Parijata, Candrabimba, Syryakanta, Sekhara, Satapatra, Sahasrara, Mustika, Pancabja, Mainaka, Kamaraja, Puskara, Astakona, hexagonal, triangular are some of the types of mandalas which are said to be forty five in number. In Visnu-yaga, the quadrangular or Navavyuha type of mandala should be made.

## \|\| 2.21.11 \|\|

*praśastaṃ cāpi gomedhe krauṃcaṃ ghrāṇaṃ caturvidham \|*  
*subhadraṃ cāśvamedhe ca naramedhe narāsanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the Gomedha-yajna, the mandala known as Krauncaghrana which is of four types, is said to be praiseworthy. Similarly, in the Asvamedha, the Subhadra type should be used and in the Naramedha, Narasana type is to be made use of.

## \|\| 2.21.12 \|\|

*sarvatra sarvatobhadraṃ caturasraṃ subhadrakam \|*  
*kāmarājaṃ tathā tryasramaṣṭāsraṃ ca ṣaḍasrakam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Sarvatobhadra is to be used at all the places. It is also known as quadrangular as well as Subhadra. Besides the mandalas of triangular type, hexagonal and octagonal types are also to be made.

## \|\| 2.21.13 \|\|

*śaktānāṃ kāmapakṣe ca paṃcasiṃhāsanaṃ mahat \|*  
*dhyānācale merupṛṣṭhaṃ maṇimuktācaleṣvapi \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. For the rich people, the Kamapaksa mandala in which five lion thrones are also to be made, should be made. In Dhyanacala, a mandala known as Meruprstha is to be created. In the fixed type of this mandala, the gems and beads are also used.

## \|\| 2.21.14 \|\|

*sahasraṃ śatapatraṃ ca annadāne tilācale \|*  
*harivallabhaṃ rājasūye somayāgeṣu śasyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. During die giving away of food or the heap of sesamum seeds, Sahasrara and Satapatra types of mandalas are used. In the Rajasuya and the Somayaga, the mandala known as Harivallabha is used.

## \|\| 2.21.15 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāyāṃ subhadraṃ ca sarvatobhadrameva ca \|*  
*jalāśayapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vighnarājaṃ praśasyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Dining the function of the consecration of the gods, Subhadra and Sarvatobhadra are used; in die tanks consecration, the Vighnaraja mandala is considered to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 2.21.16 \|\|

*ghaṭaprasthāpane caiva gajāhvaṃ turagāsanam \|*  
*śatapatraṃ lakṣahome ayute caturasrakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. At the time of the consecration of a kalasa, mandala named Gaja and Turagasana can be used. In the homa for the lakh of offerings, Satapatra', and in the offerings of ten thousand, square mandala is to be used

## \|\| 2.21.17 \|\|

*yasya yajñasya yadbiṃbaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet \|*  
*ito'nyathā bhaveddoṣo viparīteṣvadhogatiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thus the image prescribed for each one of the yajna should be used in a proper way. In case the mandalas other than those prescribed above are used, one earns blemish for the same

## \|\| 2.21.18 \|\|

*dvihastā caturasrā ca vedikā parikīrtitā \|*  
*caturaṃgulocchrāyamitā ṣaḍaṃgulā hyathāpi vā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The pedestal should be of two cubits square the height of which is required to be of four or six angulas.

## \|\| 2.21.19 \|\|

*ṣaḍaṃgulā navavyūhe vardhayedyajñakovidaḥ \|*  
*ekāṃgulasamutsedhaḥ kartavyassusamāhitaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. In the mandala known as Navavyuha, the pedestal is requited to be raised to the height of six angulas and the thickness should be one angula only and should be made by the one well versed in the yajna practices, quite carefully

## \|\| 2.21.20 \|\|

*krauṃcaprāṇe turyahastaṃ muṣṭihastaṃ samucchritam \|*  
*madhyadvaye hīnakaraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tryaṃgulādhikam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In the Кranca-prana mandala, the pedestal should be of the size of four cubits. It should be of it fist in height. Its central part should he of the size of its length upto little finger.

## \|\| 2.21.21-22 \|\|

*kuryāddvitrikramāddhīnamucchrāye dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*grahāṇāṃ pauṣṭike pakṣe bāhyagrāmādisādhane \|*  
*niyojayettatratatra vedikācakrakatrayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Its height could be reduced by a finger or two. Similarly, the Parijata, Candrabimba, Suryakanta and Sekhara mandalas are created for the pleasing of the planets or the exterior sources of the villages. The pedestals are made in circular shapes of all the sizes.

## \|\| 2.21.23 \|\|

*prathame muṣṭihastaḥ syātsaṃpūrṇe śeṣamānakaiḥ \|*  
*navalābhe ca paṃcābjaṃ karatrayamudāhṛtam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The first pedestal which is to be of a fist in height is considered to be useful in all the tasks. In a new name, Pancabja mandala which is of the size of three cubits, has to be made

## \|\| 2.21.24-26 \|\|

*śeṣā caiva variṣṭhā ca lavalī bhitti vedikā \|*  
*vijñeyā dvijaśārdūlā yathākāmyeṣu yojayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ayathāvyatyaye doṣastasmādyatnena sādhayet \|*  
*daśahaste cāṣṭahaste aṣṭahaste ca ṣoḍaśam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*muṣṭibāhuñca prādeśaṃ vardhayetṣoḍaśāṃśake \|*  
*hastotsedhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ hīne hīnaṃ ca hrāsayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. О lion among the Brahmanas, the building of other pedestals, with a wall, has to be used in the Kamya rites. Any change, when caused to it, makes it unsuitable for use. Therefore, one should remain quite alert while dealing with the same, making all the efforts. The pedestal of ten, eight or of sixteen cubits, should have the height of a fist. In the pedestal of sixteen cubits, the breadth is of the same size.

## \|\| 2.21.27 \|\|

*darpaṇākārakaṃ kuryādyāgake śāṃti karmaṇi \|*  
*hīnaṃ kuryātprayatnena vaprākāraṃ paristave \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. While performing the yajna for achieving peace, the pedestal should be of the type of a mirror and should be stupa type in expansion and is made with little thickness.

## \|\| 2.21.28 \|\|

*niśāraṇairgomayaiśca vedikāṃ ca pralepayet \|*  
*svarṇaratnamayaistoyairabhiṣicya kuśodakaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The pedestal is required to be plastered with cowdung. Thereafter, the gold or silver dust or the water should be sprinkled over it.

## \|\| 2.21.29 \|\|

*hīnavīryagavānāṃ ca purīṣaṃ dhenukaṃ tathā \|*  
*kapilāyāśca yatnena kuṃḍamaṃḍalalepane \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The cowdung of a cow or the Kapila cow has been said to be praiseworthy for the use of plastering the pedestal.

## \|\| 2.21.30 \|\|

*varjayetsarvayāgeṣu sthaṃḍileṣu prayatnataḥ \|*  
*vinā sūtraiḥ kīlake na maṃḍale naiva sūtrayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Аll the pedestals which do not conform to the prescription should be avoided. There is no need of the sutras in the pedestal.

## \|\| 2.21.31 \|\|

*tasmātprayatnataḥ kāryaṃ yatsūtraṃ yacca kīlakam \|*  
*arkahastamitaṃ sūtraṃ mṛdu lākṣāmayaṃ tathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Therefore, making all the efforts, the Sutra of twelve cubit length, which should be of die colour of lac, should be made. Its nail should also be of the same type.

## \|\| 2.21.32 \|\|

*pītakāryasrajaṃ caiva kīlakaṃ svarṇanirmitam \|*  
*raupyatāmramayaṃ kuryādvaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Of Visnu’s part, the garland of yellow flowers, the nail of gold or preferably of the silver or gold should also be made.

## \|\| 2.21.33-34 \|\|

*gaṇanāyake supraśastaṃ śaiṣepāmārgameva ca \|*  
*grahapakṣe tatheśasya kacchapasya dvijottamāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśe cārkahaste ca tatra nemiyutaṃ bhavet \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. О best of the Brahmanas, in the yajnas of Ganesa, Sesa - the serpent, planets, Siva and tortoise, the nail should be of Apamarga, while the pedestal should be of twelve or sixteen cubits in length and with a wheel.

## Madhyaparva Part 2

## Chapter 22. Creation of gods in mandalas

## \|\| 2.22.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*athoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturasrādikasya ca \|*  
*arkāṃgulamitaṃ kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ prakalpayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

*guṇāṃgulaṃ pratidiśaṃ vardhayetsuvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*caturasraṃ samaṃ kuyādiṣṭeraṣṭādaśāṃgulam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said - I am going to talk to you about the release of the quadrangular mandalas. In the area of twelve angulas, a quadrangular mandala is formed. The people of intelligence increase it from all the sides by three angulas. Like the quadrangular one, the mandala of eighteen angulas is also said to be desirable.

## \|\| 2.22.3-4 \|\|

*dvihaste caiva sūtrāgre tryaṃgulāni samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*caturasrīkṛte paścāddvihastamapi jāyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*evaṃ poḍaśahastāṃtaṃ vardhayetkramataḥ svayam \|*  
*haste vinirṇayaṃ viprā racayenmaṃḍala sudhīḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. In the sutra of two cubits, while measuring, the increase of three angulas should be made on all the four sides. Similarly, in the creation of a quadrangular mandala, increase of two cubits is possible. By so doing it gets increased to sixteen cubits. The learned people should create the mandala on the measure of the cubits.

## \|\| 2.22.5 \|\|

*dvādaśāṃgulakalpābhyāṃ madhuhaste ca maṃḍale \|*  
*dvihaste hastamātraṃ syāddvihastaṃ tu catuṣkare \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. With the kalpas of twelve angulas each, the Madhuhasta-mandala should be created. Similarly, the increase of a cubit is found in the mandala of two cubits and one cubit as well as of the one with four cubits.

## \|\| 2.22.6-7 \|\|

*padmamānaṃ caturddhā tu vṛttaṃ kuryātsamaṃtataḥ \|*  
*prathame karṇikā kāryyā keśarāṇi dvitīyake \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tṛtīye dalasaṃdhīṃśca dalāgrāṇi caturthake \|*  
*karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena śuddhena paṃkajaṃ likhet \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The mandala which is created in the form of a lotus, the portion which remains covered in all the sides, it is known as a masala with four parts. The pericarp stands in its first part, the saffron in the second part, in the third part are all the joints and in the fourth part are the creations of the foreparts of the leaves. The pericarp is created with the yellow colour and the lotus is created with the white colour.

## \|\| 2.22.8 \|\|

*keśarāstrividhāḥ proktā mūlamadhyāgradeśataḥ \|*  
*mūle śuklāruṇā madhye pītāścāgre pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. At the base, middle and the foreparts, saffron is said to be of three types. Its base is white, middle is red and the forepart is yellow. These parts have to be decorated accordingly.

## \|\| 2.22.9 \|\|

*pātrasaṃdhirbhavecchyāmaḥ koṇe raktena raṃjayet \|*  
*devāstrāṇi likhedbāhye puramadhye ca koṇake \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The joints of the leaves are of black colour, the portion in the comer is to be of red colour and should be decorated accordingly. In the middle of the outer part and in the parts of the comers, the weapons ofthe gods should be made.

## \|\| 2.22.10 \|\|

*aṣṭāṃgulapramāṇaṃ yadyathāvarṇaṃ vināditaḥ \|*  
*śaṃbhurgaurī tathā brahmā rāmakṛṣṇetyanukramāt \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Sambhu, Gauri, Brahma, Rama and Krsna should be represented in paintings. All of them should be represented in the respective complexion and drawn in eight angulas size.

## \|\| 2.22.11 \|\|

*sīmarekhāṃgulocchrāyaṃ tattadardhena yojayet \|*  
*śivaviṣṇvormahāyāge śaṃbhumārabhya dāpayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The boundary line of the yajna should be made of the height of half an angula. The yajna of Siva and Visnu should be started from Siva and Visnu.

## \|\| 2.22.12 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rāmāṃtaṃ kṛṣṇāṃtaṃ ca jalāśaye \|*  
*durgāyāge ca śrīpakṣe brahmādīnparikalpayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In the consecration of the gods, there should be Rama and Kr$na in the water. In the yajnas of Durga and Sri, Brahma and other gods must be represented.

## \|\| 2.22.13 \|\|

*grahayāge ca pītādīnkuryācca na tadanyathā \|*  
*navavyūhamatho vakṣye purāṇamatasammatam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In the yajnas of the planets, if they are created with the yellow colour, then I am going to speak the creation of Nava-vyuha as per the Purana. You please listen.

## \|\| 2.22.14 \|\|

*sarvaṃ ca pūrvavatkāryaṃ paṃkajaṃ sulikhetsudhīḥ \|*  
*tāvatsaṃkhyāharaṇayorveṣṭayetprakramādapi \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A learned person should create all of them as before, the lotus should be added to each one of them. They have to be surrounded by such decorations.

## \|\| 2.22.15 \|\|

*śuklāruṇaistathā pītaiḥ pītāruṇasitairapi \|*  
*pītāruṇasitairevaṃ svabhāve pratibhāgake \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The white, red, yellow and bright colours should be suitably added to each one of them according to their nature.

## \|\| 2.22.16 \|\|

*kalāyaṃtraṃ tadaṃte ca guhyapatrā grakeṇa tu \|*  
*ṣoḍaśairviṃśamāne tu saliṅgaṃ cāṣṭapatrake \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Similarly, in the creations of the sixteen and twenty (cubit size), decoration with eight leaves should be carried out. The linga should also be displayed.

## \|\| 2.22.17 \|\|

*evaṃ maṃḍalamaṃtrāṇāṃ varjayetparamārthataḥ \|*  
*tadvanmūleṣu koṇeṣu keśarāṇi prakalpayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. At the same time in the setting up of the mandalas, the display of the mantras has been made essential. It has also been desired that the saffron should be shown at the base and comers of the same.

## \|\| 2.22.18 \|\|

*daśadaṃḍasamākāraṃ trivarṇaṃ pratiraṃjitam \|*  
*araṃ dadyāddaśāgre tu sarvāṃgulapramāṇataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Ten spokes are drawn of equal shape and size and coloured accordingly. Their foreparts should be decorated with three colours. In the foreparts, the spoke of the size of all the angulas resembling the actual ones should be made.

## \|\| 2.22.19 \|\|

*pītenāraṃ ca sarvatra tanmadhye śoṇatuṃḍakam \|*  
*navavyūhamidaṃ proktaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The spoke should be painted yellow on the whole of it, the middle and the top portions should be painted red. This is called the Nava-vyuha which bestow Dhrama, Artha and Kama.

## \|\| 2.22.20 \|\|

*na śūdro maṃḍalaṃ kuryānna kuryādbrāhmaṇabruvaḥ \|*  
*kuryācca saṃgame tīrthe devatāyataneṣu ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. A Sudra or a person who is a Brahmana by name only, should not be associated with the mandala. The mandala is usually created at a place of the confluence of rivers or the temples of the gods only.

## \|\| 2.22.21 \|\|

*likhitvā nārcayedya stu agnikāryavihīnakaḥ \|*  
*aviddho jāyate so'pi yato janmanijanmani \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A person who after creating a mandala, does not perform the homa or does not complete the worship, he becoming illiterate, is reborn again and again on earth.

## Chapter 23. The measure of Kraunca

## \|\| 2.23.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*krauñcamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvedārthavādinām \|*  
*saṃmataṃ sarvataṃtreṣu gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - I now speak to you about the measure of Kraunca, which has been unanimously accepted by learned people well-versed in the Vedas and is secret from all the tantras.

## \|\| 2.23.2 \|\|

*ātmano'ratnimānena dviguṇaṃ parikalpayet \|*  
*madhye vṛddhyā tu tatsūtraṃ bhrāmayetkīlakopari \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Creating double the size of Aratni, the nail of the sutra of Vrddhyarth in its centre should be turned around.

## \|\| 2.23.3-5 \|\|

*catuṣṭayaṃ nyasedvṛttaṃ madhyamādhamabhāvataḥ \|*  
*karṇikā prathame vṛtte dvitīye tvatha keśaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tṛtīye padmapatrāṇi caturthe ṣoḍaśacchadāḥ \|*  
*śobhopaśobhe kuryācca caturasre same śubhe \|\| 4 \|\|*

*taddakṣiṇāgraṃ sulikhetpārśvayoḥ pakṣakadvayam \|*  
*tatra padmayugaṃ kuryānmadhye cāṃgulamaṃtaram \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. It is also created in four parts including the middle and the lowest. The pericarp comes in the first part, the saffron in the centre, the lotus leaf in the third and in the fourth part the sixteen leaves are drawn and given the quadrangular shape. It should be made quite beautiful and auspicious. In its right forepart and both the rear parts, the wings should be created. In the centre of it, four lotuses should be drawn at a space of an angula each.

## \|\| 2.23.6 \|\|

*śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lohitasannibham \|*  
*saṃkhyātaṃ tāmraparṇaṃ ca śyāmalaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ rajaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. There are eight types of powders of white, yellow, red, black, brown, Saakhyta, copper like and black These are the eight types of powders which are used in the formation of the wings etc.

## \|\| 2.23.7-10 \|\|

*śuklaṃ taṃḍulacūrṇotthaṃ pītaṃ tu niśayā smṛtam \|*  
*raktaṃ tu niśayā yogācchaṃkhacūrṇādibhāvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaṃ pulakādidagdhaṃ raktaṃ pītāsyayogataḥ \|*  
*kuṃkumābhaṃ pāṃḍuraṃ ca raktaśvetairvinirmitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tāmravarṇaṃ kusuṃbhena śyāmalaṃ bilvapatrajam \|*  
*yavagodhūmacūrṇādiyogena tu rajaḥ smṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sarvarekhāsu vibhajecchuklaṃ madhye tu pītakam \|*  
*karṇikāyāṃ keśareṣu śubhrameva nipātayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. The white colour should be made of the powder of rice. Turmeric should be used for the yellow colour. The powder of a conch is used for the making of the red colour. The powder of the gem pulaka can be used for black colour. In case turmeric is added to the black colour, it becomes red. In case the white powder is added to it, it becomes saffron yellow. The copper colour emerges out of Kusumbha tree. The black colour is made out of the leaves of the wood apple. With the mixed powder of barley and wheat, the Raja is made.

## \|\| 2.23.11 \|\|

*pūrvādikramayogena śuklādīni prayoja yet \|*  
*patrasaṃdhau tu vibhajedrajaḥ sekāṃtarakramāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. All the lines should be drawn in white colour, the middle part should be yellow. The pericarp as well as the kesaras should be given the shining colour.

## \|\| 2.23.12 \|\|

*tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūrvādikramato bhavet \|*  
*śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā tāmraṃ tataḥ saṃkhyātameva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In the east and other directions, the white and other colours should be used. The joints of the leaves should be adorned with the silver powder,

## \|\| 2.23.13 \|\|

*śyāmalaṃ kuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ ca kṛṣṇakam \|*  
*pītaṃ tāmraṃ ca saṃkhyātaṃ śyāmaṃ kuṃkumaraktakam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thereafter, in sequence of sixteen leaves from the east, the colours like white, yellow, copper colour, Sankhyat, dark, yellow like saffron, red, white, black, yellow, copper like, black, saffron, and red colours should be there

## \|\| 2.23.14-15 \|\|

*evaṃ dadyāddvijaḥ pūrve īśānāṃtaṃ vibhāvayet \|*  
*krauṃcamūrghni bhavedraktaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tuṃḍabhāge bhavetpītaṃ grīvāyāṃ śuklameva ca \|*  
*pucche viṃśatipatrāṇi ādau paṃca rajaḥkramāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Thus, the decoration should be beautifully made by the Brahmanas from the east to northeast directions. The head of kraunca bird (heron) of the size of four angulas should be made m red colour. The beak should be yellow and the neck should be white. Twenty leaves should be placed at its tail, of which the first five should be of silver powder and well decorated.

## \|\| 2.23.16 \|\|

*ṣaḍaṃguleṣvaṃḍabhāge pītena parikalpayet \|*  
*grīvāyāṃ śuklarajasā bhāvitāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Its egg part should be of six angulas size and of yellow colour. The neck should be of white colour in which the silver powder should be used.

## \|\| 2.23.17 \|\|

*tatra pītādikaṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca yathā bhavet \|*  
*śuklādikaṃ pradadyānu pātreṣvekaikaśaḥ pṛthak \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The yellow colour etc. should be so placed that appear as discussed earlier. The white colour should also be used. The colours should be used separately.

## \|\| 2.23.18 \|\|

*caturaṃgulake pāde jānorūrdhve tu pītakam \|*  
*adhastāttu bhavedraktaṃ tadeva caturaṃgulam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The claws should be four angulas, the upper part of the knees or thighs should be of yellow colour, while the lower part should be of red colour.

## \|\| 2.23.19 \|\|

*dvyaṃgulena bhavecchyāmamaṃgulīṣvapi vinyaset \|*  
*evaṃ pakṣadvayenāpi likhecchuklaṃ vibhāvayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The toes should be of the length of two angulas each and should be of black colour. Both the wings should be of white colour.

## \|\| 2.23.20 \|\|

*pade śuddhaṃ cāṃgulīṣu raktaṃ śyāmena bhāvayet \|*  
*pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syādvāradeśataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Both the feet should be of white colour, the finger should be of red colour as well as of black colour. The eastern and western gates should have white colour.

## \|\| 2.23.21-22 \|\|

*dakṣiṇottarataścaiva raktavarṇaṃ vinirdiśet \|*  
*mahākrauṃcamidaṃ jñeyaṃ madhyakraucamidaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kaniṣṭhaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidyānāṃ saptamuttamam \|*  
*athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvataṃtramataṃ kramāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The south and north parts should be of red colour. By so doing, it would be known by the name of Maha Kraunca. You please listen. The one which is the smallest of all the yajnas, the best in all the lores, is seventh and accepted by all the Tantras, resembling each other. I am speaking about them.

## \|\| 2.23.23 \|\|

*raktapītaṃ raktapītaiḥ kuryātpucchacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*pūrvādikramayoge tu patrāṃte dharaṇītale \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Its tails should be coloured as red and yellow with the respective colours, which according to the sequence of directions like east etc. appear at the end of the leaves.

## \|\| 2.23.24 \|\|

*sulikhenmūlasaṃlagnaṃ bahiṣkoṇacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*kaniṣṭhe'ṣṭakulaṃ kuryātpucchaṃ kuryāccaturvidham \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The outer four corners should touch the base and they should also be beautified. In the smaller five parts, only four of the five of them should be decorated.

## \|\| 2.23.25 \|\|

*trivṛttaṃ veṣṭayetpaścātsitaraktāsitaiḥ kramāt \|*  
*dṛṣṭaṃ janmaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thereafter, the white, red and black should be used in the three circles decorating them beautifully, the very sight of which removes the accumulated sin for hundred of births.

## \|\| 2.23.26-28 \|\|

*pītaṃ vā vilikhedviprā naśyaṃti sakalāpadaḥ \|*  
*ataścakraṃ bahiścakraṃ kṣetre ca pratidarśanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tasya kalpaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam \|*  
*mayūraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ krauṃcaṃ ca vai kapim \|\| 27 \|\|*

*pramādādvā gṛhe kṣetre vṛkṣāgre cāpi bho dvijāḥ \|*  
*utthāya vaṃdanaṃ kuryādbrahmahatyāśataṃ dahet \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. O Brahmanas, with its formation with yellow colour, all the dangers or obstructions get removed. With the formation of the inner and outer circle and a look at them in the respective region, the sins accumulated for the hundreds of years/kalpas get destroyed. O Brahmanas, by painting the peacocks, bulls, lions, kraunca birds (herons) and monkeys over the house walls and over the trees, the sins of hundreds of Brahmahatyas get removed by offering salutation to them in the morning.

## \|\| 2.23.29 \|\|

*poṣaṇātkīrtimāpnoti darśanātpāpavicyutiḥ \|*  
*darśanādvardhate lakṣmīrāyurvṛddhiśca jāyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. One earns grace by talking at them, a look at them removes the sins besides increasing the age and riches.

## \|\| 2.23.30 \|\|

*mayūro brahmaṇo mūrtirvṛṣabhaśca sadāśivaḥ \|*  
*siṃhe ca saṃbhaveddurgā vaiṣṇavo vidhirucyate \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The peacock stands for the image of Brahma, the bull stands for the image of Sadasiva, while the lion stands for the image of the goddess Durga according to the Vaisnava belief.

## \|\| 2.23.31-32 \|\|

*krauṃco nārāyaṇo devo vyāghrastripurasuṃdarī \|*  
*kālikā kṛṣṇavyāghraśca lakṣmīścitrakapotakaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*snātaḥ paśyati pratyahni grahadoṣo na jāyate \|*  
*tasmātprayatnato bhūtvā dhārayetpoṣayedgṛhe \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Kraunca (heron) stands for Narayana, the tiger stands for the goddess Tripura Sundari. The black tiger stands for the goddess Kali, the pigeons of different colours stand for Laksmi. In case one has a look at them after taking his bath in the morning, the blemish of the planets does not cause any harm. Therefore, all of them should be kept in the house and food should be served to them.

## \|\| 2.23.33-40 \|\|

*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃḍale maṃḍaleṣvapi \|*  
*rajodravyapramāṇaṃ ca yathoktaṃ yatnavarjanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*taṃḍulotthaṃ yavotthaṃ vā varjyaṃ makararopaṇam \|*  
*yadbālyaśrāvaṇe jātaṃ hiṃgulaṃ gaṃdhakaṃ tathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*haritālaṃ subhadraṃ ca sadā vighnaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*haimaṃtikodbhavaṃ yacca sitapāṣāṇameva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kāṃcanyāśca prabhedaṃ yacchastaṃ śuklaguṇaṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*śephālivṛttaṃ niśayā atasīkusumāni ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kiṃśukasya ca puṣpāṇi śastaṃ pītaṃ guṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*nāgajaṃ gairikaṃ caiva kusuṃbha kusumāni ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kuśītaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva maṃjiṣṭhāṃ paṃcaraṃgakam \|*  
*vijayāpatrakaṃ caiva bilvapatraṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*punarnavāyāḥ patraṃ ca keśarasya bakasya ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva kṛṣṇābhraṃ samayūthakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*nāgapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva punnāgaṃ dagdhapaṃcakam \|*  
*śaṃkhacūrṇaṃ lohaviṣṭhāṃ nāgaviṣṭhāṃ ca varjayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

33-40. Then for the making of the powder for use in the mandalas, the quantity of the stuff required in each case is being spoken by me. You please listen. The powders of rice and barley are the main requirements, but they should not have been sown on the day of Makara-samkranti, the stuff grown in the month of Sravana (articles of red colour), sulphur, yellow orpiment, and Subhadra which cause obstructions, should be discarded. The white stone which is made in the winter season, the different types of crystal stones which are praiseworthy and of white colour should be used. The custard apple, tuermeric, linseeds flowers, flowers of Plasa tree are said to be of yellow colour, which grow over mountains heights, Kusuma flowers, Kuita, Gudaka, Manjistha, Vijaya, wood apple, hog weed, saffron, five leaves of Agastya tree, black stone, Kalakrama, Samayuthaka, Naga-kesara, Punnaga, Dugha pancaka, conch powder, powder of iron and glass have to be discarded.

## \|\| 2.23.41-43 \|\|

*karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva rocanārocanāṃ śrayet \|*  
*yavaśālīyakairbhinnaṃ śuklaṃ ca kārayetsudhīḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*lākṣāṃ ca yadi gṛhṇīyāttadbharjitvā pradāpayet \|*  
*ākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva bhaumaṃ rāmaṃ tathā śanī \|\| 42 \|\|*

*dharaṇīṃ sadanasthāne pañcadhā vibhajedbahiḥ \|*  
*padmamullikhya prathamaṃ karṇikāṃ tadanantaram \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. The camphor, saffron, red lotus, powder of barley and rice should be used for the making of the white colour. In case a learned person is in need of the lac, then it could be made use of by frying the same. The outer space of the earth should be divided for the sake of accommodating the effigies of the sky, the earth, Mars, Rahu and Saturn. A lotus should be made initially, followed by its pericarp.

## \|\| 2.23.44-45 \|\|

*tarjanyamadhyā pūrvotthaṃ vibhajedvā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogairvā tṛṇamārabhya yadbhavet \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tṛṇamārabhya sāmānye śakto vā madhyamāditaḥ \|*  
*rākṣasādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahapakṣe'gnimāditaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. In the sequence of forefinger and the middle finger, the division should be made. Similarly, with the thumb and the forefinger the first part should be caused with a straw. This process has been prescribed in the establishment of the Raksasas. In the homa of the planets, the process is initiated with Agni.

## \|\| 2.23.46 \|\|

*aṃgulyagre ca vibhajetsarvakāmārthasiddhaye \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahamakhe kāmyeṣu parivarjayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. During the yajna for the planets, for the fulfilment of all the desires, the forepart of a finger is created but not in the yajna for Kamya karmas.

## \|\| 2.23.47 \|\|

*subhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye śubhadaṃ śubhamādiśet \|*  
*ataḥ subhadramuddiṣṭaṃ svargamokṣapradāyakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. I am now speaking about the process of the auspicious mandala known as Subhadra, which bestows the heaven as well as the moksa.

## \|\| 2.23.48 \|\|

*sārdhahastena mānena kuryānmaṃṇḍalamuttamam \|*  
*caturviśāṃgulaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvatra hastamādiśet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. A best mandala of one and a half cubits should be made, in which all the cubicals should be of twenty four angulas each.

## \|\| 2.23.49 \|\|

*karturmadhyasahasrasya madhyamā madhyaparvaṇi \|*  
*madhyamā dīrghamānena mānāṃgulamiti smṛtam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Of the thousand people the size of the finger of the performer should be adopted because the knot of his middle finger has to be accepted as the standard of the fingers.

## \|\| 2.23.50 \|\|

*vasu 8 dig 10 viṃśakaiścaiva 20 catvāriṃśat 40 śatārdhakam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The middle of the two lines should not be based on the basic line. Both the nails of the thumbs of an old person, besides the finger have been accepted as the standards.

## \|\| 2.23.51-52 \|\|

*madhye nibadhya śaṃkuṃ ca muṣṭibāhupramāṇataḥ \|*  
*trivṛttaṃ kārayenmadhye jyeṣṭhottarakanīyasam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*prakalpya karṇikādīni madhye cāṣṭadalaṃ likhet \|*  
*bahiścārkadalaṃ kuryādvarṇānāṃ kramakeṇa tu \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. A nail should be placed in the closed fist and three high and low lines should be drawn. At that point of time, the position of the little and the ring fingers should remain the same. After the creation of the pericarp, a lotus with eight petals should be created. Its outer space should be decorated with different colours.

## \|\| 2.23.53-54 \|\|

*paṃcamaṃ śvetavarṇena bahiḥ kuryāttriveṣṭanam \|*  
*sitapītāruṇaṃ kuryātpaścādvedāṃgulāṃtare \|\| 53 \|\|*

*veṣṭayecchuklavarṇena madhye kalpalatāṃ likhet \|*  
*subhadraṃ maṇḍalātpūrvaṃ sarvatobhadrakaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. There should be five leaves of white colour. In the outer space, there should be three enclosures of white, yellow and red colours. Thereafter, a kalpalata of the size of four angulas should be made in white colour. I am now speaking to you about the Sarvatobhadra mandala, you please listen.

## \|\| 2.23.55 \|\|

*sarvakāryeṣu yajñeṣu sarvakalyāṇamāpnuyāt \|*  
*maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvayajñeṣu puṣṭidam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The mandala of Sarvatobhadra bestows welfare and progress in all the yajnas.

## \|\| 2.23.56-57 \|\|

*sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya īśvareṇaiva bhāṣitam \|*  
*caturviṃśatyaṃgulena hastaḥ prathamato bhavet \|\| 56 \|\|*

*koṇe sūtradvayaṃ dadyānmadhye sūtradvayaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*tato matsyānviracayetkarṇe sūtrāṇi sādhakaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. For the benefit of the Sedhakas, the same was revealed by lord Siva himself. In this, first of all, the cubit should be of twenty four angulas. The Sadhaka should initially create two sutras in a comer and then in the middle. In the karna portion, the figure of Matsya should be created besides the sutras.

## \|\| 2.23.58 \|\|

*catuḥ sūtraṃ pātayecca pūrvāparavibhāgataḥ \|*  
*punardadyāccatuḥsūtraṃ karṇasūtraṃ punardadet \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. In the upper eastern side, four sutras should be made twice and then the karmasutra should be made.

## \|\| 2.23.59-60 \|\|

*śatadvayapadaṃ yāvatṣaṭpaṃcāśādhikaṃ tathā \|*  
*pātayecca tathā sūtramevaṃ saptadaśaṃ bhavet \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ūrdhvapaṃktyā padayugaṃ cādye padacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*dvārapārśve bhavedyāvaddaṃtapaṃktyā padatrayam \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. Thus by so doing, two hundred and fifty six cubicals are formed. It is seventeen times pointed with sutras. In the start and the upper part, there are four places. At the back of the gate, there are thirty two cubicals, which arc formed over the three spots.

## \|\| 2.23.61 \|\|

*rekhāṃ sarvatra śuklena racayedyajñiyottamaḥ \|*  
*paṅkajaṃ śuklavarṇena vaiṣṇavo yāgakarmaṇi \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Vaisnnva in the performing of the yq/iias, has to be displayed in white colour with a lotus.

## \|\| 2.23.62 \|\|

*śaktiyoge bhavedraktaṃ śaive pītaṃ vinirdiśet \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāsu ca sarvāsu śuklameva praśasyate \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. In the performing of Sakti worship, the red colour has to be used. During the yqjfla for Siva, the yellow colour has to be used. In all other rites of consecration, white colour is to be used.

## \|\| 2.23.63 \|\|

*pītena karṇikā kāryā caturbhāgena mānataḥ \|*  
*śubhaṃ cakorāvasthāne tāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In the fourth part, the pericarp of yellow colour should be drawn, which should have been caused during moon light (Cakoravarttama). This should be followed by the learned people.

## \|\| 2.23.64-66 \|\|

*karṇikāmūlamārabhya rekhāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalpayet \|*  
*rekhāmūle bhavecchuklaṃ madhye raktaṃ nipātayet \|\| 64 \|\|*

*agre pītaṃ bhavedevaṃ kṛtvā paṃkajaveṣṭanam \|*  
*śubhravarṇena taddadyātpītavarṇena sarvataḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*madhye raktaṃ bhavettacca evaṃ ṣoḍaśakalpayet \|*  
*koṇeṣu raktaṃ dadyācca padmaṃ kṣetreṣu nirdiśet \|\| 66 \|\|*

64-66. Starting from the base of the pericarp, sixteen lines of the same type should be drawn, which should be white at the base, red in the middle and yellow at the top. The lotus should also be surrounded in the same way. The creation of sixteen lines has been proscribed. The corner should be decorated with red colour. The same standard has been prescribed in other regions.

## \|\| 2.23.67 \|\|

*śuklena pīṭhagātrāṇi pīṭhakoṇe padatraye \|*  
*pītavarṇena racayeddvidhā paṃktidvaye tathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The pedestal should be painted white on all the sides. The three corners of the pedestal should be of white colour, while its three corners should be painted as yellow, where two human figures should be drawn separately.

## \|\| 2.23.68 \|\|

*śuddhena racayetpādau punaḥ pītādivarṇakaiḥ \|*  
*citraṃ suśobhanaṃ kāryaṃ tatra kalpalatāṃ nyaset \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Their both the feet should be of yellow colour. The figures should be beautifully drawn, using several colours. They should be surrounded with kalpalata.

## \|\| 2.23.69 \|\|

*mānaṃ kalpalatāyāstu dvyaṅgulaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*dvedve śastaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ śaṃkhāvartakramāttrayam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The six of kalpalatas is said to be of two angulas in which three lines should be drawn like a conch.

## \|\| 2.23.70 \|\|

*graṃthaugraṃthau puṣpaphale nānāvarṇena bhāvayet \|*  
*nānāpaśugaṇairyuktaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇairyutam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. At its each and every knot, the flowers of different types should be poured. Besides the birds and animals of various types should also decorate the place.

## \|\| 2.23.71 \|\|

*vaiṣṇave gāruḍaṃ śastaṃ śaive kīśavṛṣaṃ likhet \|*  
*śākte vyāghraṃ tathaiśe ca śarabhaṃ harimālikhet \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. During the yajna of Visnu, Garuda has to be projected, while in the yajna, the bull Nandi should be displayed with the face of a monkey. In the yajna of Durga, a tiger has to be shown, while in the yajna of Siva, the image of Hari in the form of Sarabha should be shown.

## \|\| 2.23.72-75 \|\|

*śobhāṃ pītena racayedupaśobhāṃ ca pītakaiḥ \|*  
*koṇeṣu kṛṣṇavarṇena bahiḥ syādveṣṭanatrayam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śuklapītāruṇaiḥ kāryaṃ maṇḍalaṃ syānmanoramam \|*  
*sarvatobhadramaparaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*sarvajñānamayaṃ śuddhaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam \|*  
*caturasraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā digbhyo dvādaśadhā dvijāḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*pātayettatra sūtrāṇi koṣṭhānāṃ dṛśyate śatam \|*  
*catuścatvāriṃśadādyaṃ paścātṣaṭtriṃśadaṃbujam \|\| 75 \|\|*

72-75. In its outer part, yellow colour should be used. The same colour should be used in the other region. The comers should be painted black. Three enclosures should be made which should be beautifully decorated. Thus, the mandala should be beautified with white, yellow and red colours. This is said to be Sarvatobhadra which bestows all the success». It is conceived to be the storehouse of knowledge, spotless and makes the efforts in dharma, artha and kama successful. О Brahmanas, for the making of the square cubicals in all the directions, the (existing) formations have to be lighted again and again, which result in the formation of a hundred cubicals, of which forty four in the front and thirty six are at the back.

## \|\| 2.23.76 \|\|

*koṣṭhaṃ prakalpayetpīṭhaṃ paṃktyā caivātra vīthikām \|*  
*dvāraśobhe yathāpūrvamupaśobhaṃ ca dṛśyate \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. While making the cubicals over the pedestal, the lines are drawn like the streets or the lanes. The beautiful gates look quite charming.

## \|\| 2.23.77 \|\|

*avaśiṣṭaiḥ padaiḥ kuryātsadbhistaṃtrāṇi mantravit \|*  
*vidadhyātpūrvavaccheṣamevaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ bhavet \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The Brahmanas well-versed in the mantras should compose tantras towards the east. This is the formation of the mandala.

## \|\| 2.23.78-80 \|\|

*pūrvoktamaṇḍale vidvandharaṇīsadanaṃ bahiḥ \|*  
*madhye kalpalatā kāryā bahiṣkoṇeṣu sattamāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*gulālītūryavarṇena mahāmatta iti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*śobhopaśobhe śobhāgrāṃ kuryādvai maṇḍalaṃ bhavet \|\| 79 \|\|*

*etaddhi sarvatobhadraṃ rāśiyuktamataḥ param \|*  
*śatapatraṃ vajranābhaṃ biṃbanābhaṃ sahasrakam \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. О learned ones, on the outer space of the aforesaid mandala, the abode, earth, kalpalata in the centre and the outer comer is decorated with pink colour. It is called Mahamata. By adding beauty in the outer and inner comers besides the interior of the same, it gets turned into a mandala. This is called Sarvatobhadra. Besides this, there are other mandalas known as Satapatra, Vajranabha, Bimbanabha and Sahasra.

## \|\| 2.23.81 \|\|

*gajāhvaṃ ca gajākāraṃ madhye tu samalaṅkṛtam \|*  
*catuścandre candrabimbaścandrakāṃtamudāhṛtam \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The Gaja-mandala is made resembling an elephant. The middle part of it is My decorated. In the Candra-mandala, four moons arc drawn. The middle part of it is My decorated. It is also known as Candrakanta mandala.

## \|\| 2.23.82 \|\|

*bahirdvādaśabhiḥ sūryaiḥ sūryākrāṃtaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*śekharī tripuṭaṃ caiva śatapatraṃ ca prakramāt \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. In the outer space of this mandala, twelve suns arc made, because of which this is known as Candrakdnta mandala. The mandalas with Sikhara, Tripura and Satapatra are also made.

## \|\| 2.23.83 \|\|

*sahasrameva viprendrāḥ padmānte yasya svastikam \|*  
*svastikaṃ tadbhavedviprāḥ puṣkaraṃ vajrasaṃmatam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. О group of Brahmanas, the Sahasra mandala is made. In the interior of the Svastika mandala, a symbol of Svastika is placed. Like Puskara, a Vajra-mandala is also made.

## \|\| 2.23.84-89 \|\|

*cintāmaṇiṃ kuṃkumāṃśaṃ khātaṃ ca harivallabham \|*  
*pañcasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pañcasiṃhāsanaṃ viduḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*tadvadvṛṣāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ śikhirūpaṃ śikhidhvajam \|*  
*nārasiṃhaṃ padmagarbhaṃ kapotāsyaṃ tathā bhavet \|\| 85 \|\|*

*gāruḍaṃ merugarbhaṃ ca nīlakaṇṭhaṃ narākṛtim \|*  
*śatakratugajārūḍhaṃ śrībiṃbanavasūtrakam \|\| 86 \|\|*

*aṣṭāsramaṣṭakoṇādyaṃ bahiḥ padmavanaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*kāmadvayena puṭitaṃ sahasraṃ padmaveṣṭitam \|\| 87 \|\|*

*tryasragarbhaṃ paṅkajaṃ ca tryasraṃ tatparikīrtitam \|*  
*aṣṭa patrāṇi vai meruṃ sumeruṃ tadviparyaye \|\| 88 \|\|*

*mahāmahāmerupṛṣṭhaṃ śatatrayacchadairvṛtam \|*  
*chidravyaktiṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā mānena bho dvijāḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

84-89. Then there is Cintamani in which a part of saffron is placed. Harivallabha has seven pits, then there are the mandalas known as Harivallabha, Panca-Simhasana having five lion thrones, Vrsabhasana resembling the bull, Sikhidhvaja, having the banner of a peacock, Narasimha, Kapotasya resembling the pigeon, besides these, there are the masalas known as Merugarbha, the one resembling a human beings, Nilakantha besides Indra mounted over the elephant Airavata, wearing the Navasutra. Then there is a mandala known as Bimba the forepart of which is octagonal and the outer part is made resembling the lotus. It fulfils all the desires. Sahasranabha, Kamandala remains surrounded with the lotus flowers. The lotus with a trident shape is known as Trikona (or a triangle). Similarly, the one with eight leaves is known as Meru. Sumeru emerged out of it. The one with three hundred leaves is called Mahameru. I am also speaking about its measure as well.

## \|\| 2.23.90-91 \|\|

*daṃḍiśravaṇasaṃpanna 60 mākāśaṃ vasusaṃmitam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*śataviṃśādhikaṃ caiva 120 dalāni tadanantaram \|*  
*śuklaraktaṃ cāṣṭavaṇairbiṃboṣṭhaṃ paripūrayet \|\| 91 \|\|*

90-91. Thereafter, the white lotus is encircled eight, ten, twenty, forty, fifty, sixty besides hundred and twenty times. The leaves should be of white and red colour, besides eight other types of colours. Then the part of the leaf is created.

## \|\| 2.23.92 \|\|

*śuklena paṅkajaṃ tatra paścātkuryāttriveṣṭanam \|*  
*śatapatramatho vakṣye bimbarājeti kathyate \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Then the white lotus is encircled thrice. Now, I am talking about Satapatra mandala also known as Bimbaraja.

## \|\| 2.23.93-94 \|\|

*sthaṃḍile kuśahaste ca pūrvavadveṣṭayetkramāt \|*  
*vasu 8 pañcakalā 16 pañcaviṃśakaṃ 25 tannapatrakāt \|\| 93 \|\|*

*catvāriṃśattataḥ paścā 40 daṣṭottaraśataṃ 108 bhavet \|*  
*śuklaṃ śoṇaṃ tathā pītaṃ śyāmaśuklairanaṃtaram \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Holding the kusa in hand, it should be encircled from the east. There are eight, sixteen, twenty five, forty and hundred and eight. It is decorated with white, red, yellow, then again with black and white colours.

## \|\| 2.23.95 \|\|

*vilome dalasandhīni śākte śaive tu ṣaṭpuram \|*  
*veṣṭayetpaṃcavarṇena śuklādīni samaṃtataḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. The joints of the leaves are made in. reverse order. In the Sakta and Saiva mandala six cubicals are made in the mandalas, it is encircled with five colours in a beautiful way. Then it should be covered with white colour.

## \|\| 2.23.96 \|\|

*raktapītaiḥ samāstīrya koṇāñchuklena pūrayet \|*  
*sthaṃḍile tārahastena aṣṭahastaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. The white and- red colours should be placed in equal proportions. The comer should then be made of white colour. In this way, it is spread on the ground in an area of eight cubits.

## \|\| 2.23.97 \|\|

*maṃḍalaṃ biṃbarājasya aṣṭottaradalairvṛtam \|*  
*vasupañcaśaktiviṃśaccatvāriṃśacchatārddhakam \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. This masala is known by the name of Bimbaraja and is adorned with eight, sixteen, twenty, forty and fifty covers of leaves.

## \|\| 2.23.98-99 \|\|

*tryṛtupatraṃ suvṛttaṃ syādvṛttayuktaṃ sabilvakam \|*  
*catvāriṃśaddvayaṃ caiva gaganena samāvṛtam \|\| 98 \|\|*

*śataṃ viṃśādhikaśataṃ dviśataṃ viṃśamuttamam \|*  
*veṣṭanāṃse ca triśataṃ prakramādatha vardhayet \|\| 99 \|\|*

98-99. It includes three leaves of the season which should be circular and beautiful. It should be surrounded with eighty mandalas. The encircling starts from a hundred leaves, then a hundred and twenty, then two hundred and twenty, and finally with three hundred leaves. This represents the gradual growth.

## \|\| 2.23.100 \|\|

*lavalyābhamatho vakṣye sārddhahastapramāṇataḥ \|*  
*navaviṃśaṃ kalpayettu catuḥsūtrāṇi pātayet \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Now I shall describe the form of the lavanya tree, the size of which is a cubit and a half It consists of twenty nine cubicals. Four spots are earmarked for the purpose.

## \|\| 2.23.101 \|\|

*dakṣiṇottarataścaiva tadvadeva vijānīhi \|*  
*pītena retapuḥṭitā madhye śuklaṃ vibhāvyate \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. In its creation, the yellow colour should be used in the north and the south. The middle part should be white.

## \|\| 2.23.102 \|\|

*grahapakṣennapītena madhye raktaṃ pratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*sarvā rekhāśca śuklena pauṣṭike pītamādiśet \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. For creating the mandala for the purpose of the planets, the yellow colour is used with the exception of the middle part, which is required to be of red colour. But all the lines are drawn in white colour. In the supportive activities, it shines with yellow colour.

## \|\| 2.23.103-104 \|\|

*saśāṃtike na yoktavyaṃ kāme raktaṃ vinirdiśet \|*  
*madhye tu paṅkajaṃ raktaṃ yugme somasya paṅkajam \|\| 103 \|\|*

*śuklavarṇena tatkuryātpītavarṇamudasya ca \|*  
*aiśānyāṃ cottare bhāge guroḥ pītaṃ tu paṅkajam \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. The red colour is used in the performing of the peaceful rites as well as the kamya-karmas. The red lotus flower has to be placed in the centre The white lotus should also be decorated. In the north-east comer of the northern part, the yellow lotus is created for the sake of Brhaspati.

## \|\| 2.23.105-106 \|\|

*pūrvasyāṃ diśi śukrasya paṅkajaṃ śubhravarṇakam \|*  
*vāruṇe tu śanaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nairṛtyāṃ dhūmravarṇakam \|\| 105 \|\|*

*rāhoḥ prakalpayettacca ketorapi niyojayet \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ diśi saṃyojya paṅkajaṃ vilikhettataḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

105-106. Similarly, in the eastern direction, the white lotus is required for Sukra. In the western direction, Saturn is of smoky colour In the north-west direction, for the images of Rahu and Ketu, the lotus of black colour should be created.

## \|\| 2.23.107 \|\|

*vilome dalasandhīni pūrayatsuvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*bahiḥ pañcarajaiḥ kāryaṃ yuvadurgavibhūṣitam \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. The intervening joints should be made attractive by the learned people. On the exterior, the castles of Java should be made in five colours.

## \|\| 2.23.108 \|\|

*pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syāddvāradeśataḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇottaradigbhāge raktameva praśasyate \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. The gate’s eastern and western parts should be white and in the south and north, the use of red colour has been said to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 2.23.109-110 \|\|

*tristhāne samamadhye ca dvādaśāṃgulaprakramāt \|*  
*dvihastādāvaṃgulena varddhayettadvibhāgataḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

*pañcābjamaṇḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ catuḥsvastikabhūṣitam \|\| 110 \|\|*

109-110. Then five mandalas should be created with four Svastika marks. Their middle part should be equal, spread over three points with a difference of twelve angulas at three points. At every two cubits, an increase of an angula is done.

## Chapter 24. The Daksina

## \|\| 2.24.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*na kuryāddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ mānahīnaṃ na kārayet \|*  
*amānena hato yajñastasmānmānaṃ praśasyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said A yajna without a standard or daksina should never he performed, because such a yajna is known as the polluted or detiled. Because of this, the standard of a yajna has been praised.

## \|\| 2.24.2 \|\|

*yasya yajñasya yanmānaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet \|*  
*amānena kṛte sarve vrajeyurnarakaṃ punaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Whatever standards of a yajna have been fixed, it should be established according to the daksina, otherwise all those connected with the same have to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 2.24.3-7 \|\|

*iti śrībhaviṣpe mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge mūlyakathane tṛtīyo' dhyāyaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*aśītibhirvarāṭaiśca paṇa ityabhidhīyate \|*  
*taistu ṣoḍaśabhirjñeyaṃ purāṇaṃ saptabhistu taiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*rājataiścāṣṭabhiḥ svarṇaṃ yajñādau dakṣiṇā smṛtā \|*  
*mahārāme dvisauvarṇaṃ kūpe svarṇārdhameva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tulasyāmalakīyāge suvarṇaikaṃ pracakṣate \|*  
*yakṛlloke ca sauvarṇaṃ lakṣe svarṇaṃ catuṣṭayam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*navame koṭihome ca devatānāṃ ca sthāpane \|*  
*prāsādasya samutsarge aṣṭādaśa suvarṇakāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. The Acarya, Hota, Brahmana, the one who knows the processing of the yajna, as well as the Yajamana are the limbs of the yajna. The yajna in which a person of a degraded caste gets an entry, he has to suffer a punishment of eighty cowries of papas, Similarly, the punishment of sixteen papas has been prescribed for the recite of the Purina. The daksina of seven papas of gold or of silver should be given in the yajna to all. In the establishment of a garden, it should be two panas, in the construction of a well, it should be half a pana. In the yajna of tulasi or of the myrobalan, it should be a pana of gold. Pining conception, it should be a single pana. In the reciting of a lakh of mantras, it should be four panas of gold. In the nine crores homo, for the consecration of the gods, creation of mandalas and for entry into the same, daksina of eighteen papas of gold has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.24.8 \|\|

*taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca ardhārdhaṃ pari kīrtitam \|*  
*mahādāne ca dīkṣāyāṃ vṛṣotsarge ca sattamāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the consecration of a tank or a lotus luke, one fourth of a pana of gold has to be paid. О excellent one, during the giving of great charities, initiation, setting a bull free, the same amount of daksina should be given.

## \|\| 2.24.9 \|\|

*jīvataśca vṛṣotsarge gayāśrāddhe tathaiva ca \|*  
*avittasādhyamānena yajñaṃ kuryātkalauyuge \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the vrsosarga for a living person or during the Sraddha at Gaya, Avitta-sadhya yajna is required to be performed during the age of Kali.

## \|\| 2.24.10 \|\|

*daṃpatyośca vṛṣotsarge mānamekamudāhṛtam \|*  
*bahubhiḥ kiyamāṇopi yāga eko mahottamaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. During the Vrsosarga yajna for a couple, a standard has been fixed. Similarly, some excellent people should perform the yajna collectively.

## \|\| 2.24.11-12 \|\|

*rājñaḥ karagrahe caiva dīkṣāyāṃ dāna karmaṇi \|*  
*aśītirattikaṃ svarṇaṃ śravaṇe bhāratasya ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*grahayāge pratiṣṭhāyāṃ suvarṇaśatarattikaḥ \|*  
*lakṣahome cāyute ca koṭyāmeva vidhīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. For the giving of the tax to the ruler, for the giving of daksina or for the listening to the Mahabharata, the gold equivalent to eight grains of rice; in the yajna for the planets or in the consecration rites; in the offering of a lakh, ten thousand or a crore hundred grains, the daksina has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.24.13 \|\|

*devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ yasya prakalpitam \|*  
*tasyaiva deyaṃ taddānaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The same charity with the daksina should be given over to the same priest of the yajna.

## \|\| 2.24.14 \|\|

*nānāsya kiñciddātavyaṃ saṃgabhaṃgo bhavedyataḥ \|*  
*gṛhī tu kṛtvā yaddānaṃ tadā tasya ṛṇī bhavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. In the presence of several people, something or the other should be given. Otherwise, with the same standard, the couple gets separated. A householder, who after conceiving to give some charity, does not actually do so, he gets indebted to the same.

## \|\| 2.24.15 \|\|

*yajñeṣu home yaddravyaṃ kāṣṭhamājyādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*tannāyakasya pūjāyāṃ dravyamāhurvinirmitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The material like wood, ghi, etc. for use in die yajnas has been prescribed. The same articles are prescribed in the worship of the presiding deity.

## \|\| 2.24.16 \|\|

*anādidevatārcāyāṃ pūjāsnānādikarmaṇi \|*  
*yasyārhaṇādikaṃ dravyaṃ tasya devasya tadbhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In the worship of the eternal god and for the rites for bathing and other activities, whatever things have been prescribed, they happen to be the prominent things for the same god

## \|\| 2.24.17 \|\|

*pratyakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyajñadānavratādike \|*  
*adakṣiṇaṃ naiva kāryaṃ prakuryādbhūridakṣiṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In the performing of the yajna, charities and other rites, the daksina is said to be given openly. The same should not be started without giving away of daksina. At the same time, efforts should be made to give as much of daksina as possible.

## \|\| 2.24.18 \|\|

*ato dattaṃ purā dattaṃ dātavyaṃ caiva saṃprati \|*  
*parasvodārabuddhīnāṃ sā sā hi dakṣiṇā bhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Therefore, whatever has been given as a form of daksina ... tally or whatever is going to be given or will be given for an intelligent and bountiful Brilhmana, the same should be considered as the daksina.

## \|\| 2.24.19-20 \|\|

*dattāni vidhivatpuṃsāṃ devadānāni yāni hi \|*  
*dāsīdāsagavādīni manasā yāni karhi cit \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dātavyānyapi tānyeva kārayetparivarttanam \|*  
*ekasyānekadānaṃ ca dadetkaścitpṛthakpṛthak \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Whatever is appropriately given for the sake of the gods, including the male or female slaves, cows and others, or whatever is mentally given away, the same should be given over to all the people. These could also be exchanged as a person gives away several types of articles to a person.

## \|\| 2.24.21-24 \|\|

*varaṇaṃ ca kadā kuryāttantre kuryācca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*ratnasya dakṣiṇā deyā kāṃcanaṃ samudāhṛtam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kāṃcanasya bhavedraupyaṃ raupye kāṃcanamudviśet \|*  
*bhūmerbhūmirdakṣiṇā syādvastrasya vastradakṣiṇā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pānīyasya tu pānīyaṃ vrīhīṇāṃ vrīhidakṣiṇā \|*  
*gajasya dakṣiṇā chāgo hyaśvasya meṣa īritaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*paśūnāṃ ca catuṣpādā devasya devadakṣiṇā \|*  
*yajño mānasya ṣaḍbhāgo dviguṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. When should something be accepted? According to the provision of tantra vidhana, daksina should be given; while giving gems in daksina, gold should also be added to the same, because silver could be purchased with gold and the gold gets graceful when mixed with silver. Similarly, in the cause of the earth, the daksina of the costumes should be given. In the rites for drinking, daksina should be in the form of beverages, while in the food items, the daksina should be of food items alone. Similarly, in the cause of an elephant, a goat has to be given as daksina; in the cause of a horse, a sheep could be given as daksina. For the sake of animals, the Devas or quadrupeds could be given in daksina. The sixth part of standard is known as a yajna.

## \|\| 2.24.25 \|\|

*ācāryasyaiva bhāgaikaṃ yajamānaḥ pradāsyati \|*  
*pāpakaistu kalatrāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ tadanaṃtaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The yajamana should be given away a portion of the collection or the wealth of the yajna to the Acarya and another part to his wife and the children as a mark of repentance for the sins.

## \|\| 2.24.26 \|\|

*pātrāṇāmṛtvigādīnāṃ bhāgatrayamudāhṛtam \|*  
*sarvasattvasya bhāgaikaṃ svalpaṃ cecchiṣṭagauravāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The performer of the yajna and others should receive three parts of the daksina and for the rest of the people, the remaining part of the daksina should be given.

## \|\| 2.24.27 \|\|

*ācāryādyaṃśataḥ kaścitkṣīṇavittaṃ samāharet \|*  
*amūlyaṃ vargamūlyaṃ yadbhavedvai dakṣiṇottamā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Out of the share of the Acarya, something of very little value, but should be costly in comparison to other things, should be accepted as daksina.

## \|\| 2.24.28-29 \|\|

*mānāśaktau tu yajñānāṃ yaddeyaṃ yajñasiddhaye \|*  
*devatā pustakaṃ ratnaṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ tilāstathā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*nameruphalapuṣpāṇi deyānyetāni sarvataḥ \|*  
*catuścakrāṃkito yastu sāṃdro vṛtto janārdanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. In case, in the yajnas in which the performer is unable to pay the daksina according to the prescribed standards, then in order to make the yajna a success, the gods, books, gems, cows, cereals, the fruits of Mem tree as well the flowers should be given as daksina. A person who has accepted Janardana with unique form who carries four cakras, he indeed is the best.

## \|\| 2.24.30-32 \|\|

*devatāpratimādyaṃ ca śironābhistathaiva ca \|*  
*śvetaliṃgaṃ ratnaliṃgamindranīlādikaṃ ca yat \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāvartaśaṃkhaṃ ca harivaṃśastathā khilaḥ \|*  
*kapilo nīlavṛṣabhaḥ somadhānyaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*amūlyānyāhuretāni dattvānantaphalāni ca \|*
