*svarṇapādo bhavenmūlyaṃ śālagrāmasya dakṣiṇā \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. The image of the god, his head, his navel, white linga, Ratna-linga, Indranila, the conch named daksinavarta, the entire Harivamsa, cuckoo, Nila-vrisa, as well as some cereals are known as priceless. By giving them away, one achieves enormous merits. For the lord Salagrama, the daksina of a golden food is prescribed.

## \|\| 2.24.33-34 \|\|

*kṣudraliṃge svarṇamūlyaṃ pādārdhaṃ śrīdharepi ca \|*  
*anantonantamityuktaṃ pādārdhaṃ bāṇaliṅgake \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yathā pustakamātreṇa svarṇa pādārdhamiṣyate \|*  
*jyotiṣerdhaṃ suvarṇasya rajatārdhaṃ vṛṣe tathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. For the Rudralinga, gold is given as daksina for lord Sridhara half on foot, the same is the quantity for Anantadeva to be given as daksina. As for the sake of a book, half of gold (foot) is given as daksina. Similarly, for the Sun-god, half the part of gold is given; while for the bull, half portion of silver is given.

## \|\| 2.24.35 \|\|

*harivaṃśe ślokaśate svarṇamekaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*dharmaśāstrasya sāhasre rajatatrayamīritam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. For the recitation of a hundred verses of Harivamsa, a gold medal has been prescribed. For the reciting of a thousand verses of Dharmasastra, three silver pieces are to be given as daksina.

## \|\| 2.24.36-39 \|\|

*kapilāyāṃ suvarṇārdhaṃ dhenumātre purāṇakam \|*  
*prāyaścittavidhau jñeyaṃ dhenumātraṃ purāṇakam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*purāṇatritayaṃ cānye vīryahīne dvayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*kṛṣṇe vṛṣe ṣaṭpurāṇaṃ śvete navapurāṇakam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*dvātriṃśacca purāṇaṃ syādvṛṣe nīle tathaiva ca \|*  
*nameroḥ praticakre ca dvādaśa svarṇarattikāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*mūlyaṃ śrīphalamātre'pi purāṇatritayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*paṅktyāpi turyakaṃ vivātkalau paṇavyavasthayā \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. For the Kapila cow, half a piece of a gold coin is to be given. For any other cow and for repentance. Purana has been prescribed. Some people are of the opinion that three Puranas should be presented at a time. Two Puranas should be offered for the sake of a semen less bull. For the sake of a white bull, nine Puranas should be given and for the sake of a blue bull, thirty two Puranas have been prescribed. For the adverse c a kra (or adverse enemy formation) of Rudraksa, twelve grains of gold is to be given and for Sriphala, three Puranas have been prescribed. In the age of K a li, in the pana arrangement, it has been considered as die fourth.

## \|\| 2.24.40 \|\|

*dhātrīphalasya pratyekaṃ bhavedrajatamā ṣakam \|*  
*etānyāhuḥ praśastāni mūlayoge paraṃ viduḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. For the sake of each one of the myrobalan fruit, eighteen grains of silver are required to be given.

## Chapter 25. Paying of the price

## \|\| 2.25.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*pūrṇapātramatho vakṣye yajñe sādhāraṇe'pi ca \|*  
*kāmahome bhavenmuṣṭirmuṣṭayoṣṭau tu kuñcikā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ekaika kuñcimānena kuryātpātrāṇi vai sadā \|*  
*pātrāṇi ca pṛthakkṛtvā sthāpayeddvāradeśataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*siddhānāṃ khaḍgadhārāṇāṃ pratyekasya dinakramāt \|*  
*tatraiva dadyā nnānyatra na kuryādvyatyayaṃ kvacit \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Suta said - In the simple type of the yajna the full vases which are to be given, are being spoken by me. In the Kamya homa, a fist is kept. The eight fists form Kuncika. At some distance from the door, the key should be kept in a vase and during the ceremony of the yajna, it should be daily given to the Siddhas, carrying the sword. There should be no interruption in this process.

## \|\| 2.25.4-6 \|\|

*kuṇḍānāṃ kuḍmalānāṃ ca vedanaṃ yādṛśaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*caturasrapadasyāpi raupyārdhaṃ ca kalau yuge \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dve raupye sarvatobhadre krauñcaghrāṇe caturthakam \|*  
*mahāsiṃhāsane pañca daśapātre tadardhakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sahasrāre merupṛṣṭhe turyaraupyavṛṣādhikam \|*  
*vṛṣe gale ca vṛṣabhaṃ śeṣe raupyasahasrakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. I am now speaking about the knowledge kundas (altars) as well as the kundalas (earrings). During the age of Kali, half of I rupee is to be offered for the square altar. For Sarvatobhadra, the fixed price is two rupees. For Kraunca ghrana, it should be quarter of a rupee. For the making of Maha Simhasa five rupees are to be paid for its making. For Dasapatra, the amount payable would be the half of it. For the making of Sahasrara and Meruprstha, the amount payable would be four rupees. For a bull or a Vrsabha, a bull is to be given and for the rest, a thousand rupees shall have to be given.

## \|\| 2.25.7 \|\|

*caturasrasya nirmāṇe svarṇapādaḥ kalau yuge \|*  
*mahākuṇḍe tu dviguṇaṃ vṛtte raupyaṃ nivedayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. During the age of Kali, for construction of a square altar, the fourth part of a gold coin is to be given. For creating of a Mahakunda, the wages would he twice the above amount. For the making of a circular altar, a rupee should be given.

## \|\| 2.25.8-9 \|\|

*padmakuṇḍe tu vṛṣabhamardha candre tu raupyakam \|*  
*yonikuṇḍe dadeddhenumaṣṭārdhasvarṇamāṣakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ṣaḍasre tu tadardhaṃ syādyāge māṣadvayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*śaive codyāpane caiva pratyahnā svarṇamāṣakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. A bull is to be given for the making of a lotus altar. A rupee has to be given for the making of a crescent-shaped altar. For the making of a yoni-kunda, a cow is to be given and for die making of an octagonal altar, a masa of gold is to be given. For the making of a hexagonal altar, half of the above price has to be paid. For the yajna, two masа's of gold is to be given. For the performing of Saiva rites or on the completion of a religious rite, a masa of gold has to be given.

## \|\| 2.25.10-12 \|\|

*dāraṇe hastamātraṃ syātsvarṇakṛṣṇakalaṃ bhavet \|*  
*iṣṭikākaraṇe caiva pratyahnā syātpaṇadvayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*khaṇḍe daśavarāṭaṃ syādbṛ hanmāne tu kākiṇī \|*  
*taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca khanane prathamāṃgake \|\| 11 \|\|*

*saptahastamite kuṇḍe niṣṭhe ābaddhamātrakam \|*  
*purāṇasya ca ekāṃśaṃ vetanaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. During the performing of a yajna for the digging of a cubit of earth, a gold Кrsna-kala has to be given in its wages. Similarly, for the setting up of the bricks therein, two panas of gold has to be paid daily. For the making of a part thereof, ten lotus seeds are to be given. A cowrie is also to be given to increase its standard Similarly, while digging of a tank or a lotus tank, besides digging of an altar of seven cubits, the base of which is laid with bricks, the worker should be paid a part of the Purana.

## \|\| 2.25.13 \|\|

*vardhayetpaṇamātreṇa nimne patre ca prakramāt \|*  
*bṛhatkūpasya nirmāṇe pratyahaṃ ca paṇadvayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Till such time one reaches the lowest level, the increase of a papa should be made gradually. While digging a great well, two papas of daily wages should be given.

## \|\| 2.25.14 \|\|

*śaile jñeyaṃ kāñcanasya rattikā gṛhakarmaṇi \|*  
*koṣṭhe jñeyaṃ sārddhapaṇaṃ raṃgādiracite paṇam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. While building the house in stone, eight grains of wages should be given daily.

## \|\| 2.25.15 \|\|

*vṛkṣāṇāṃ ropaṇe dadyātpratyahnā sārdhamāṣakam \|*  
*setubaṃdhe ca paṃkile ca paṇadvayaṃ ca kākiṇī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. For the planting of the trees, the daily wages should be a masa and a half. For building a bridge over the marsh land, the wages should be two papas and a cowrie.

## \|\| 2.25.16 \|\|

*paṇepaṇe tu tāmrasya dadyātpaṇacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*ghaṭane kāṃsyasīsānāṃ paṇatrayamudāhṛtam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. For making a pana in copper, four papas are to be given and for the melting of bronze and the glass, the wages of three papas have to be paid daily.

## \|\| 2.25.17-19 \|\|

*atha vā dinasaṃkhyānaṃ paṇaikaṃ ca sakākiṇi \|*  
*suvarṇasya paṇaike tu purāṇaṃ ratnakuṭṭime \|\| 17 \|\|*

*rajate tu tadardhaṃ syātsphaṭikasya ca dāraṇe \|*  
*dinasaṃkhyāpaṇadvaṃdvaṃ ratnānāmatha kuḍmalam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*maṇivedhe maṇau jñeyaṃ kākiṇī parikīrtitā \|*  
*caturvarāṭamadhikaṃ sphāṭike maṇivedhane \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. For the counting of the days, a papa and a cowrie should be paid. For gold also, a papa has to be paid; for making the surface, a purana has to be given. In the making of silver articles, half of the above has to be paid as wages. For the breaking of the crystal stone, two papas have to be paid. Similar is the case for the making of the earrings of gems. For piercing into the gems, a cowrie has to paid. For making a hole in the crystal stone, excess of four cowries has to be paid.

## \|\| 2.25.20-21 \|\|

*kāṃsyatālasya nirmāṇe dhamane tu paṇatrayam \|*  
*lākṣānirmāṇake kārye tadardhamapi kīrtitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*gavāṃ ca dohane caiva varāṭe turyavetanam \|*  
*vetane vastranirmāṇe patre hastapaṇatrayam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21.bFor the making of an item of bronze or a stone, three papas have to be paid. For using lac in work, one should be paid half of it. For the making of a cow, four cowries have to be paid. For the making of the cloth, three panas shall have to be paid and for a cubit of the cloth made.

## \|\| 2.25.22 \|\|

*avivastrasya nirmāṇe syaṃdanaṃ daśakākiṇī \|*  
*pidhānavastranirmāṇe tripaṇaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. For the making of the woollen cloth, ten cowries have to be paid, while for the making of the apparel, three panas have to be paid.

## \|\| 2.25.23 \|\|

*daśa kākiṇī ūrdhvādhastadvyaye paṇyavetanam \|*  
*vaṃśājīvasya pratyahnā paṇasyārdhe sakākiṇi \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. For spreading the cloth up and downwards, ten cowries of daily wages have been prescribed. Half a part of a papa has also to be given.

## \|\| 2.25.24-27 \|\|

*lohakārasya ca tathā nāpitasya ca vetanam \|*  
*śirasā tasya vapane vijñeyā daśa kākiṇī \|\| 24 \|\|*

*saśmaśrunakhamāne tu pradadyātkākiṇīdvayam \|*  
*nārīṇāmatha saṃskāre nakhacitrādirañjane \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sakākiṇi paṇaṃ tacca savitre ca payodhare \|*  
*paṇānāṃ turyakaṃ dadyātsīmaṃtasyālake tathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*padacitre tu sārddhaṃ syādgrīvāṇāṃ guhyadhāraṇe \|*  
*dhānyānāṃ ropaṇe caiva dinaike paṇa vetanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. The blacksmith and the barber has to be paid ten cowries for the shaving of the head. For the shaving of the beard as well as for the cutting of nails, two cowries had to be paid. For the cutting of the nails of women and for the decoration of the other parts, painting of lips etc., a pana and a cowrie has to be paid. For the arranging of the hair, four panas are required to be paid. For the colouring of the feet, a pana and a half is required to be paid. The same amount has to be paid for the removal of hair from the private parts. For the planting of the cereal plants, a paria has to be paid for a day as wages.

## \|\| 2.25.28-29 \|\|

*lavaṇe tu tathā deyā guvākānāṃ ca ropaṇe \|*  
*daṇḍapatrasya saṃskāre maricānāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*paṇadvayaṃ varāṭānāmadhikaṃ daśameva tu \|*  
*halehale paṇaikaṃ syātkākiṇyadhikameva ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. For the collection of salt and for the planting of the betel nuts, for initiation of Dandapatra, for the planting of black pepper, a cowrie and two panas have to be paid as the daily wages, but the maximum of it should be ten cowries. The ploughman should have die wages of a pana and a cowrie as wages for a day.

## \|\| 2.25.30 \|\|

*paṇatrayaṃ cakrapaṇe mahiṣāṇāṃ paṇādhikam \|*  
*narāṇāṃ vāhane caiva paṇaikaṃ daśa kākiṇī \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. For Cakrapana, three panas are to be paid. For the carrying of palanquins for four people, a pana and ten cowries have been prescribed as the wages.

## \|\| 2.25.31-32 \|\|

*dāsīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca adhikaṃ kākiṇīdvayāt \|*  
*kṣālane cāpi vastrasya tailakṣāravivarjite \|\| 31 \|\|*

*vastre pratipaṇaṃ dadyāddīrghe prasthe'pi vardhayet \|*  
*sadyaḥ prakṣālane'pyardhaṃ dinādāvadhikaṃ bhaved \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Those who work with a slave girl and a donkey, they should be paid two cowries in excess. The washer-man who washes the clothes without soap or soap nut, should be paid a paw for a cloth. For a more lengthy cloth, the wages have to be suitably increased. In case a cloth has to be got washed quickly, half of the prescribed wages should be paid in excess.

## \|\| 2.25.33-34 \|\|

*śvetavastre bhavennyūnaṃ pade sūkṣme ca varddhayet \|*  
*mṛttikānāṃ samuddhāraṃ kuddāle cekṣupīḍane \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vetanaṃ puṣpasaṃskāre sahasraṃ daśakākiṇī \|*  
*kākiṇī sraṅnibaddhe ca dviguṇaṃ kaṇṭhamālikā \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. For the washing of the white cloth, the wages would be less, while for the silken cloth more wages have to be paid. Digging of the earth by the potter, crushing of sugarcane and for decoration with a thousand flowers, ten cowries are to be paid. For the making of a garland, one cowrie is payable and for the making of a garland for wearing, double the amount is payable.

## \|\| 2.25.35-36 \|\|

*abaddhe dvyaṃgulaṃ yāvanmuṇḍamālā prakīrtitā \|*  
*hastatraye kaṇṭhamālā ānābhi kamalāvadhi \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kākiṇīkatrayaṃ caiva nirmāṇe dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*mālatyāśca tulasyāśca jātiyūthyośca sattamāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. When a garland of skulls falling upto the navel is made, three cowries are payable as the wages for the same. Same amount of wages are payable for the making of the garland of Malati tulasi (holy basil) as well as jasmine.

## \|\| 2.25.37 \|\|

*tadardhārdhaṃ mārutena damane bakulasya ca \|*  
*vetanaṃ dīpataile ca ājyasya parivardhayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. For the garland of Bakula flowers which fall with the wind, half the amount is given for the same purpose. For the burning of the oil lamps, there should be increase in the ghi.

## \|\| 2.25.38 \|\|

*yāmeyāme raupyamāṣaṃ snehe caiva tu kākiṇī \|*  
*sārdhāṃgulapramāṇena vastravartiṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. For the burning of the lamps for a prahara, a masa of silver; a cowrie for the oil should be paid. The learned people have desired to put a wick of cloth measuring an angula and a half.

## \|\| 2.25.39 \|\|

*ṣaḍaṃgulena dairghyaṃ ca na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ bhavet \|*  
*pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ saṃkhyā taṃtubhirdvijasattamāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О best of Brahmanas, the wicks of six angulas, which should be neither less nor more, is to be made of twenty five cotton threads

## \|\| 2.25.40-43 \|\|

*pañcāṅgulena mānena kartavyaḥ susamāhitaḥ \|*  
*hastocchrāye pradadyāttu muṣṭihaste tu madhyamam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*trihaste caturhaste vā uttamaṃ mānamīritam \|*  
*svarṇadhāre hato rājā rajate sarvakāmadaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tāmre cāyuḥkṣayakaramāyase durgatipradaḥ \|*  
*śastasya karamardasya praśastottara ucyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

*dīpādhāraṃ kāṃsyamayaṃ tathārītimayasya ca \|*  
*abhāve mṛnmayasyaiva mṛnmaye mānavarjitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

40-43. With the standard of five angulas, it should be carefully made. With the height of a cubit, the one of the size of a fist is the medium, while the one of three or four cubits is said to be the best. With the burning of a vase of gold, the king gets destroyed. By using the silver for the purpose, all the desires are fulfilled. The use of copper for the purpose reduces the age; when the iron is used for the purpose, one has to face grave misfortunes. The tree Karmarda or Caressa Carandes tree is considered to be the best for the lamp. The lamp of bronze or brass is considered to be the best for the lamp. The lamp of bronze or brass is considered to be excellent for being used as a lamp. In the absence of the metal, the earthen lamp can be used.

## \|\| 2.25.44-45 \|\|

*daśāṅgadhūpake mūlyaṃ viṃśake tu paṇatrayam \|*  
*dvādaśakāṃgule'pyardhavartiṃ dhūpāya vartayet \|\| 44 \|\|*

*haste paṃcapramāṇaṃ ca vastraiḥ kuryācca vartikām \|*  
*pañcaviṃśatibhirvā yaḥ sa mahāvartirucyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. For the incense of ten or twenty angulas, one has to pay three panas. In the lamp for twelve angulas, half a wick is used. The wick that is made of five or twenty five cubits length of cloth is known as the great wick.

## Chapter 26

## \|\| 2.26.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kalaśānāṃ vinirṇayam \|*  
*yasyārpite ca māṃgalye yātrāsiddhiśca jāyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said - Thereafter, I shall speak about the pitchers which are used in welfare ceremonies and by which the journey is made successful.

## \|\| 2.26.2 \|\|

*saptāṅgaṃ kalaśe jñeyaṃ pañcāṅgamatha vā punaḥ \|*  
*vārimātreṇa saṃpūrṇe na sā siddhiḥ prajāyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The pitcher or a kalasa has five or seven parts. When the pitcher is simply filled with water, one does not meet with success.

## \|\| 2.26.3 \|\|

*atha vākṣatapuṣpeṣu devamāvāhya pūjayet \|*  
*na cānyatra yajeddevānviphalaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In the absence of a pitcher, the gods should be invoked with the pouring of unbroken rice or the flowers, otherwise the worship of the gods becomes unsuccessful. This has been ordained.

## \|\| 2.26.4 \|\|

*vaṭasyāśvatthavṛkṣasya dhātakībilvakasya ca \|*  
*pañcapallavamuddiṣṭaṃ vinyasetkalaśopari \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The leaves of the banyan, myrobalan, pipala and the wood apple trees should be used for decorating the kalasa.

## \|\| 2.26.5 \|\|

*sauvarṇā rājatā vāpi tāmrādyā mṛnmayāstathā \|*  
*kalaśāḥ kramaśaḥ proktā yathāvittānusārataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. According to one’s financial position, the pitchers made of gold, silver, copper or other metals or earthen should be consecrated.

## \|\| 2.26.6-8 \|\|

*abhedyāḥ suṣamāḥ plakṣāḥ sarve ādyāḥ supūritāḥ \|*  
*niśchidrā ṛjavaścaiva secanānyekakarṣakaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*eka triṃśāṅgulaṃ kuryātkālāhe dviguṇaṃ śatam \|*  
*mukhaṃ cāṣṭāṃgulaṃ tasya dvyaṃgule ca varārthite \|\| 7 \|\|*

*taijasaiḥ kārayenmānaṃ mṛnmaye mānamucyate \|*  
*kalaśodakanirmāṇe amānaṃ naiva yojayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. A pitcher without cracks, which should be complete and beautiful, straight and made of a single lump of clay, should be kept filled with water, without hand. The pitchers of the size of twenty one angulas, which are also of double or a hundred angulas in size, should have the neck of eighty angulas and the tejas of two angulas. For a house built in mud, this is the prescribed standard and also for the water pitcher. The pitcher without a standard is not considered to be auspicious.

## \|\| 2.26.9 \|\|

*kalaśasthāpanaṃ vakṣye yatra sannihitāḥ surāḥ \|*  
*vyutkrameṇa pravinyāse yātudhāno haretkila \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. I am now speaking about the consecration of the pitcher, which serves as the abode of ail the gods. In case they are not lodged in a proper order, the puja of the same is usurped by the demons.

## \|\| 2.26.10 \|\|

*yajñe sādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye yadvidhānaṃ yathāmatam \|*  
*svastikopari vinyāse saṃpūrṇasyārdhamānake \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. I am also speaking out its yajnika process which has been prescribed unanimously. Half a standard of the kalasa should be consecrated over Svastika.

## \|\| 2.26.11 \|\|

*caturasrottaraṃ bhittvā cordhvādhomānataḥ samam \|*  
*turyasūtrāṇi matimānpañca pūrvāyatanāni ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Piercing through the square space, with upper and the lower portions being equal, it should be marked with four sutras. Then with the five sutras, it should be marked towards the west.

## \|\| 2.26.12 \|\|

*mārjayetsvastikākāraṃ turyamātraṃ yathā bhavet \|*  
*svastikaṃ jāyate tatra kalaśānāṃ tathāsanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The water should be sprinkled over the Svastika which is only a fourth of it. The same Svastika serves as the seat of the kalasa

## \|\| 2.26.13 \|\|

*syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa kuryādbhūbhiparigraham \|*  
*madhyamānānikābhyāṃ ca nyasyetpātālasaṃmukham \|*  
*ṛṣirnārāyaṇo'sya syādgāyatrī devatā raviḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Reciting the mantra Syona Prithivi, the earth is measured. Nyasa should then be performed with middle and the ring fingers. Narayana is the Rsi of this mantra, Gayatri is the meter, while Sun is the god.

## \|\| 2.26.14-15 \|\|

*viniyogaḥ sthāpane ca tathā bhūmiparigrahaḥ \|*  
*dhānyamasīti mantreṇa dhānyasūktaṃ paristavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*asya mantrasya ca ṛṣirgautamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|*  
*anuṣṭupca bhavecchando devatāsya guruḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The same Viniyoga is used for consecrating the pitcher. Reciting the mantra-Dhanyamasiti, the paddy is spread over the same. Gautama is the Rsi for this mantra, its chanda or meter is Anustupa, while Brhaspati is the Devata for the purpose of Viniyoga.

## \|\| 2.26.16-18 \|\|

*ājighraṃ kalaśaṃ mahyāṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakaṃ tyaktvā kumbhāgre udare'pi ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vinyāsaścaiva kartavyastryaṃgule brahmamudrayā \|*  
*1 ājighrasya ca mantrasya ṛṣirbharga udāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*paṃktiśchandaśca uddiṣṭo devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kalaśasthāpane caiva somayāge ca yojayet \|*  
*paṃcanadyetimantreṇa kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ tataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Using the mantra- “Ajighram kalasam, the kalasa should be established over the earth, in which leaving aside the thumb and the little finger, Brahmamudra should be displayed with the rest of the three fingers using these fingers, the nyasa should be performed over the forepart and upper part of the pitcher. Bharga is the Rsi for tins mantra; Pankti is the meter; the eternal Visnu is the god, who is mentioned in the Viniyoga This mantra is usually used in the consecration of the kalasa as well as the performing of the Somayaga. Thereafter, reciting the mantra-“Panca-nadyeti" the water of Ganga should be poured in the pitcher.

## \|\| 2.26.19 \|\|

*devatā paramā triṣṭubdevatā somabhāvitaḥ \|*  
*viniyogaḥ pallave ca vinyasetparikīrtitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Parama is the god for this mantra; Tristupa is the meter, while Soma is the god and have been mentioned in the Viniyoga.

## \|\| 2.26.20 \|\|

*yāḥ phalinīti maṃtreṇa pradadyātsaphalākṣatam \|*  
*yāḥ phalinīti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ kamalasaṃjñakaḥ \|*  
*triṣṭupchando gaṇapatirdevatā parikīrtitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Reciting the mantra- “Ya phaliniti,” the unbroken rice with fruits are required to be offered. Kamala is the Rsi of the mantra; Tristupa is the meter; while Ganapati is the god.

## \|\| 2.26.21 \|\|

*badaraṃ nāgaraṃ caiva dhātrī ca picumardakam \|*  
*jīvaṃtī pīvaraṃ caiva phalānyetāni varjayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The jujube, orange, lemon, myrobaloan, black myrobalan, nima and long pepper should not be used in this puja.

## \|\| 2.26.22 \|\|

*hiraṇyagarbheti ṛcā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet \|*  
*ṛṣirhiraṇyagarbhosya chandastriṣṭubudāhṛtam \|*  
*savitā devatā cāsya ratnanyāseti yoja yet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Reciting the verse- “Hiranyagarbha," the Pancaratna should be sprinkled in the house. Hiranyagarbha is the Risi of this mantra; Tristupa is the meter and Surya is the god, who are mentioned in the related nyasa.

## \|\| 2.26.23 \|\|

*amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāddaivaśulbanameva ca \|*  
*varuṇasya tveti ṛṣirvaruṇāṃtare yojayet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The rites of amrtikarana as well as Devacara should also be performed. Then uttering the mantra- “Varunasya tveti", Varuna is made to enter the pitcher. Varuna is the Rsi of this mantra.

## \|\| 2.26.24-26 \|\|

*śrīśca te iti mantreṇa dadyātpuṣpaṃ sacandanam \|*  
*gandhadvāreti maṃtreṇa dadyādgandhaṃ viloḍitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ punaḥ \|*  
*vrīhayaśceti mantreṇa pañca vrīhīṃśca nikṣipet \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tilāśca māṣā mudgāśca śyāmākāḥ śālayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*pañca dhānyagaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvāriṣṭaniṣūdanaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Uttering this mantra, the flowers with the sandalpaste should be offered. Then uttering the verse "Gandhadvareti,” the sandalpaste should be offered. The durva (green grass) mixed with unbroken rice should be offered. Thereafter, uttering the mantra - "Kandadi", durva and unbroken rice should be offered. Then uttering the mantra- “Vrihayasceti", five cereals, sesamum, black wheat, black gram, millet and the Sali rice should be consecrated over the kalasa.

## Chapter 27. The Months

## \|\| 2.27.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha māsāśrayaṃ karma kartuṃ māsanirūpaṇam \|*  
*kriyate tadvidhaṃ saṃkhye bhavenmāsa ścaturvidhaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*cāndraḥ sauraḥ sāvanaśca nākṣatraśca tathāparaḥ \|*  
*śuklapratipadaṃ prāpya yāvaddarśa ca aindavaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said - Now I am speaking about the months, over which the karmas or activities are based. They are of four types viz., Candra (relating to moon), Saura (relating to sun), Savana and Nakstras (based on the constellations). These are the four divisions of the months. They start on the first bright moon day and end at the moonless day These are known as the months of the moon

## \|\| 2.27.3-6 \|\|

*ekarāśau raviryāvatsa māsaḥ saura ucyate \|*  
*triṃśatā divasairmāsaḥ sāvanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nākṣatramāso'śvinyādirevatyanto hi viśrutaḥ \|*  
*udayādudayaṃ yastu sāvano divaso raveḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*taṃtreṇaikatitherbhāgakālo divasa aindavaḥ \|*  
*rāśestriṃśadbhāgakālaḥ kālastvekasya bhāsvataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ahorātraṃ tu tannaivaṃ saure'pi bhāgamānataḥ \|*  
*ahorātraṃ sādhanasya mukhyavṛttvaiva labhyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. When the Sun remains with a particular zodiac symbol for a number of days, it is known as the solar months. This starts from Asvini constellation and lasts upto the last day of Revati constellation and is known as the month of constellation. The day of Savana month starts from the sunrise to the sunrise of the next day. The lunar month’s one day is based on the tantrika calculation. The thirtieth part of a zodiac happens to be a day of the solar month, which is calculated on the standard of a day and night. For the performing of the meditation by the Sadhakas (devotees), the day comprises of a day and night.

## \|\| 2.27.7 \|\|

*saure cāndre tūpagaṇau triṃśadbhāge tvadarśanāt \|*  
*sāvanā divasā grāhyā ṛṣīṇāṃ samaye gṛhe \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The thirtieth part of the solar month and the lunar month, being invisible, the day of Savana months are acceptable for the performing of the tapas by the Rsis as well as for the entering in the house.

## \|\| 2.27.8-9 \|\|

*atibhāgavyavasthāyāṃ prāyaścittakriyāsu ca \|*  
*mantropāsanakārye ca annasya prāśane śiśoḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*karasya grahaṇe rājño vyavahāreṣu māḥsu ca \|*  
*yajñeṣu dinasaṃ khyāyāṃ grāhyo māsastu sāvanaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. In the arrangements for atibhaga, rites of repentance, penance of the mantras, meditation rites, tasting of food by the children, collecting of the taxes from the people, the monthly activities and for the counting of the days for the yajnas, the Savana month has to be patronised.

## \|\| 2.27.10 \|\|

*sauramāso vivāhādau yadādyaiḥ supragṛhyate \|*  
*yajñeṣvapi vrate vāpi vihite snānakarmaṇi \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the activities for the performing of the marriage, yajfia, the vrata rites and for bathing rites, the solar month is patronised.

## \|\| 2.27.11 \|\|

*cāndrastu pārvaṇe grāhyo vārṣikeṣvaṣṭakāsu ca \|*  
*śrāddheṣu tithikāryeṣu tithyukteṣu vrateṣu ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. During the Parvana, Astaka-sraddha, in the activities of tithis or the vratas etc., performed on the particular tithis or days, the lunar month is adopted.

## \|\| 2.27.12 \|\|

*nākṣatraḥ somapādīnāmāryabhāgavicāraṇe \|*  
*karagrahavidhau rājñāṃ nāyaṃ sarvajanākṛtiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The constellation months are adopted during the thoughts about gods etc., collection of the taxes by the king. Therefore, this particular type of month is not made use of by the ordinary people.

## \|\| 2.27.13-14 \|\|

*tadvaccaitrādimāsoktaṃ tithyuktaṃ karma dṛśyate \|*  
*tattu cāndreṇa kartavyaṃ sā hi caitrādinocyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*rājoktau sāvanaḥ prokte tithisaṃbhāgakarmaṇi \|*  
*tatra sauro bhavedvācyaḥ sauraśabdapravartanāt \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Similarly, the activities which have been prescribed in the month of Caitra are concluded according to the lunar months. It is because such activities have to be performed in the month of Caitra alone. The Savana month has been prescribed for the use of the king. But in the arrangement for the distribution of the tithis, because of inclusion of the solar system, only the solar month is acceptable.

## \|\| 2.27.15 \|\|

*citrānakṣatrayogena caitrī sā pūrṇimā smṛtā \|*  
*tayopalakṣito māsaścaitra ityabhidhīyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. After the Citra constellation’s combination, the full moon day is called as Caitri-Purnima. Because of that, the month has been given the name of Caitra.

## \|\| 2.27.16 \|\|

*sa ca tithyātmako māsaścāndraḥ śravaṇabhāskaraḥ \|*  
*cāndraścaitryaṃtiko māso mukhyaścaitrādisaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The month in which the tithis or moon days are counted, is known as the lunar month in which the sun is said to rise. The last month of the lunar month is known as the Caitra month, which has become quite prominent.

## \|\| 2.27.17-18 \|\|

*gauṇo'pyasau yugādyāderanurodhena vardhanāt \|*  
*mukhyaḥ śuklādidarśāṃto māso lākṣaṇiko mataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*caitrādyāścāndramāsā ye dvādaśāpi tu yogataḥ \|*  
*paurṇamāsīyutābhistu na carkṣatvaṃ na rebhire \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Because of the influence of Satya-yuga and other yugas, it becomes insignificant as well. In this month, starting from the first day of the bright fortnight, the month is recovered upto the last day of dark fortnight known as the moonless night. This month is unanimously accepted as the symbolic and also the foremost one. All the solar months including the Caitra one, with the combination of the full moon day or Purnima are totally separate from the constellations.

## \|\| 2.27.19 \|\|

*viśākhayādyeṣu yā vā tathā bhādrapadena vā \|*  
*yatra na pūrṇimāyogo māsaḥ sa syādvināśakaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The months starting from the Visakha constellation and upto the month of Bhadrapada, without the combination of Purnima are said to be causing destruction

## \|\| 2.27.20 \|\|

*yo'sau yadyapi caitrādau naiṣṭhiko'pi pralabhyate \|*  
*yathā saure'pi yāto'sau yogo'yamatidurghaṭaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Though like the solar months, during Caitra and other months, religious activities are carried out, but such a combination is rarely found.

## \|\| 2.27.21-24 \|\|

*tathā ca māsasāmānye yogenāyaṃ bhavetkvacit \|*  
*yadi varṣasahasrānte tadakṣeṇaiva pūrṇimā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*saṃyuktā labhyate yatra bhavedrājyavināśanam \|*  
*sūryācandramasau nityaṃ kurvāte tithibhojanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*daṇḍadvaye bhuktaśeṣe na bhuñjīta kadācana \|*  
*atikramyāparāṃ bhoktuṃ tithiṃ yatra ubhāvapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yatra viṃśattithistasmātsañcitaikā bhavediti \|*  
*triṃśatā cāndramāsau tu candreṇaiko hi varddhate \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. Such a combination is rarely found in the ordinary months. After the lapse of thousands of months in case this yoga is found on a full moon day, then it causes enormous notional destruction. Both the sun and the moon, always make use of the tithis. During the period of such utilization, one should not take food upto two dandas (forty eight minutes). This should not be repeated when both the sun and the moon are likely to attack the other tithi at the same time. A month in which the moon has only twenty tithis, these then exert a cumulative tithi. There are thirty such tithis in the lunar months alone and there is the expansion of it by moon.

## \|\| 2.27.25-26 \|\|

*sa cādhiko yato māsastataḥ syādadhimāsakaḥ \|*  
*samarātriṃ divaṃ kṛtvā vaivasvatapurīgatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

*gaśe rāśyaṃtare sūryo yāvadgacchati bhānumān \|*  
*gacchanvardhayati pūrvaṃ tithayastāstu saṃcitāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. This happens also in the excess month, which is called intercalary month (which falls once in three years). It is also called as an extra month. When the sun moves from one zodiac to another, the earlier tithis get increased and are known as the cumulative tithis.

## \|\| 2.27.27 \|\|

*vardhate tithayo yāvattulāṃ yāti divā karaḥ \|*  
*tulādirāśiṣaṭke tu na varddhate kadācana \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. By the time the sun reaches Libra zodiac, only upto that time the tithis get increased and from sixth zodiac (Virgo) when it reaches Libra, the increase stops.

## \|\| 2.27.28 \|\|

*svabhāvātsamagatyā tu yataḥ saṃkramate raviḥ \|*  
*saṃcayamānātvekaikā pratimāsaṃ vivarddhate \|*  
*niśāsvapi tu saure tā ekasmiṃstisra ityapi \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Ordinarily, the sun according to its own nature moves from one zodiac to the other, in which the cumulative tithis keep on growing even during the night, because of which a solar month is completed. Thus, three tithis get expanded.

## \|\| 2.27.29 \|\|

*saṃpūrṇatriṃśattithibhirmāsyekasminyadā bhavet \|*  
*sa cāndro malino māsaḥ koṇapādyaiḥ samīhitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The month in which all the thirty tithis are spent as per the standard, the experts in the related field describe the month as the malina or insipid month.

## \|\| 2.27.30 \|\|

*bhuktocchiṣṭā tu tanmāsādasaṃspṛṣṭadivākaraḥ \|*  
*yadā saṃkramate laṃghya tadā jñeyo malimlucaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The month in which the sun making use of the tithis discards them, the said month is then not touched by the sun. The sun then crossing the said month, moves over to the next month. The same month is known as Adhi-masa or Mala-masa.

## \|\| 2.27.31 \|\|

*sārdhavarṣadvaye pūrṇe patatyevaṃ niśākaraḥ \|*  
*parityaktāśca yāvaṃtyo vyutkramiṇyaśca yāḥ punaḥ \|*  
*tithayaste niyoktavyā naro na syātsa pūraṇaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. After two and a half months, the moon falls similarly. Several of the tithis stand discarded, while some of them remain unconnected. At that point of time, those tithis are not made use of and the performance remains unfinished.

## \|\| 2.27.32 \|\|

*nairṛtyāṃtaṃ hitārthāya jalaketurnigacchati \|*  
*nirmamaṃ malinaṃ māsaṃ pretānāṃ ca hitāya ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. For the benefit of the Raksasas, the Jalaketu is taken out. Therefore, the Malamasa is meant for the goblins and for their benefit and not for others.

## \|\| 2.27.33 \|\|

*ataḥ pretakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryā malimluce'pi ca \|*  
*yatkartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ malamāse dvijottamāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Therefore, all the preta rites are performed in the Malamasa and the auspicious rites and those relating to the gods are not performed during this month.

## \|\| 2.27.34 \|\|

*tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi kathitaṃ ca prasaṃgataḥ \|*  
*yacchrāddhaṃ pretasaṃbaṃdhi sarpiḍīkaraṇāvadhi \|*  
*malamāse'pi tatkāryaṃ viśi naṣṭi sapiṃḍanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In the same context, I am going to speak out as to what should be done in the Malamasa and what should not be done. All the pindas relating to the pretas are performed in the Malamasa.

## \|\| 2.27.35-36 \|\|

*yadā tu dvādaśo māso daivānmalimluco bhavet \|*  
*tatraiva yatnātkartavyā kriyā pretasya vārṣikī \|\| 35 \|\|*

*māsāṃtare tu patite tasminneva malimluce \|*  
*tadā trayodaśe māsi kartavyaṃ tatsapiṃḍanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. As a move of the destiny, in case the twelfth annual month becomes the Malamdsa, then one should make an effort to perform annual Srdddha ofpreta in the same month. In case the Malamdsa appears in the month itself, then the sapinda rites should be completed in the thirteenth month.

## \|\| 2.27.37 \|\|

*varjyaṃ māsikayā śrāddhamekaṃ tasmiṃstrayodaśe \|*  
*triṃśatā ghaṭikaiḥ śrāddhaṃ vardhate'dyāpi saṃmitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The monthly Sraddha should not be performed in the thirteenth month. According to the thirty ghadis, the increase of Sraddha is admitted even today.

## \|\| 2.27.38 \|\|

*kuryātpatyābdikaṃ karma prayatnena malimluce \|*  
*naimittikaṃ ca kurvīta nādhikārastayorbhavet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The husband’s annual as well as the occasional rites should be performed during the Malamasa making all the efforts. But the essential rites in both the cases cannot be performed.

## \|\| 2.27.39-40 \|\|

*tīrthasnānamalabhyaṃ tattadādyaṃ devadarśanam \|*  
*upavāsādikaṃ karma sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ārtavarjaṃ puṃsavanaṃ putrādimukhadarśanam \|*  
*malamāsepi kurvīta śukre cāstamupāgate \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. The rare type of holy places, audience with the gods, performing of fasts, rite performed at the sixth month of pregnancy, the conception ceremony, pacification of the harsh planets or constellation, looking at the face of the new borne, can be performed during Malamasa or when the Jupiter has set.

## \|\| 2.27.41-44 \|\|

*malamāsepi kurvīta nṛpāṇāmabhiṣecanam \|*  
*vratāraṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca cūḍākarma ca mekhalām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*maṃtropāsāṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahādānaṃ sumaṅgalam \|*  
*vivāhaṃ ca gṛhāraṃbhaṃ praveśaṃ navaveśmanaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*upagrahaṃ gavādīnāmāśramāṃtarasaṃkramam \|*  
*dīrghamātrāsu nejyaṃ vai tīrthayātrāvasecanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*varṣavṛddhivṛṣotsargakanyā dvirnayanādi ca \|*  
*yajñaṃ ca kāmikaṃ vidvānmalamāse vivarjayet \|\| 44 \|\|*

41-44. On the occasion of the abhiseka of the kings, start of the vratas, consecration of the gods, removal of hair, tying of the waistband, siddhi of the mantras or knowing about secret, giving of huge amount of charities, the extremely welfare ceremonies, the marriage, start of house building, entry in the new house, the sale of cows and the change of place, the huge yajnas, starting on pilgrimage and abhiseka for the same, annual sraddha for upliftment, setting free of a bull, arrival of girls at the gate and discarding of the kamya yajna should not be performed during the Malamasa month.

## \|\| 2.27.45 \|\|

*evamastaṃ gate śukre vṛddhabālye ca saṃtyajet \|*  
*pādāstaṃ ca mahāstaṃ ca dvividhaṃ cāstamasya tu \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Similarly, the setting of the Venus (padasta and mahasta) is of two types.

## \|\| 2.27.46 \|\|

*dvisaptatirdinānyasya mahāstaṃ pūrvato bhavet \|*  
*pṛthivyāmeva pādāstaṃ bhaveddvādaśa vatsarān \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The planet Jupiter sets in the east for seventy two days and his padasta on earth is for twelve days.

## \|\| 2.27.47 \|\|

*ūnapañcāśadadhikaṃ divasānāṃ śatadvayam \|*  
*pratīcyāmuditaḥ kāvyo dṛśyo bhavati sarvadā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thus the Jupiter is visible in the southern direction for two hundred and forty nine days.

## \|\| 2.27.48 \|\|

*ekarkṣe guruṇā yukto yāvattiṣṭhati bhārgavaḥ \|*  
*malamāsavatkarmāṇi prāhustyājyāni sarvaśaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Thus upto the number of days Sukra (Venus) remains in the same constellation with Jupiter (Brhaspati), the aforesaid activities should also be discarded for the same period.

## \|\| 2.27.49 \|\|

*ṛkṣabhede tvekarāśau saṃparke yadi vānayoḥ \|*  
*guro rāhorapi tathā tyajedvidvānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Inspite of the difference in the constellations when both of them are in the same zodiac and in case Rahu comes in contact with either of them, even then the learned people should stop the aforesaid activities. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 2.27.50 \|\|

*siṃhe rāśau sthite sūrye jīve cāstamupāgate \|*  
*heyāni yāni karmāṇi niṣiddhāni malimluce \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When the sun is in the Leo zodiac and at the time of the setting of the planet Brhaspati, the activities which arc prohibited in Malamasa, should also then be discarded.

## \|\| 2.27.51 \|\|

*mithunasthe yadā bhānau malamāsaḥ patatyasau \|*  
*dvirāṣāḍha iti khyāto gauṇe śabdavivartanāt \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. When sun is in the Gemini zodiac dunng Malamasa, then there are two months of Asadha. Thus there has been a metaphorical exchange of words.

## \|\| 2.27.52 \|\|

*phalaṃ cātra mṛtasyaurdhvadehikaṃ karma kurvatā \|*  
*āṣāḍhakīrtanaṃ kāryamevaṃ varṣāṃtare'pi ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. During this period, while performing the last rites of a person, Asadha kirtana should be done. The same provision about this is found in Varsantera.

## \|\| 2.27.53 \|\|

*āṣāḍhadvayasaṃyuktapūrṇamāsīdvayaṃ tathā \|*  
*yugmakarkaṭayo rāśyo dvirāṣāḍhastadā bhavet \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. During the two months of Asadha, there are two full moon days. At the same time in the Gemini and Cancer signs of zodiac, there is the yoga of two Asadhas.

## \|\| 2.27.54-55 \|\|

*bhavedgauṇo dvirāṣāḍho rāśistatraiva saṃyute \|*  
*pūrvatrike tu patite tadeva bhagavānhariḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*karkaṭe śayanaṃ kuryādāgamiṣyaṃ paratrake \|*  
*karkiṇyarke suptaharau śakrapūjāśvine bhavet \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. The zodiac which combines the two zodiacs, is considered to be of subsidiary nature. Thus in the above three zodiacs, in a single threefold when Malamasa appears, then lord Visnu in his coming threefold sleeps in the Cancer zodiac. When the sun is in the Cancer zodiac, lord Visnu sleeps and the Asvinapuja is performed during the month of Asvina besides the awakening of Durga.

## \|\| 2.27.56 \|\|

*durgotthānaṃ tulāyāṃ tu viṣṇurnidrāṃ jahātyasau \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. When the sun reaches the Libra zodiac, lord Visnu frees himself of his sleep.

## Chapter 28. The arrangement of tithis (moon days)

## \|\| 2.28.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ karma kālamāśritya vartate \|*  
*kāle tānyeva karmāṇi phalaṃ yacchaṃti kurvatām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said- The period of Devas as well as the pitrs remain dependent upon the time. The deeds so performed bestow reward to the performers in due course of time.

## \|\| 2.28.2 \|\|

*muhurbālye karmaphalaṃ trikāle'pi na vidyate \|*  
*vyayo vā mukhyabhāvena phaladaḥ karmaśālinām \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The reward which the moments of childhood bestow cannot be achieved during the present, past and future or the morning, noon and the evening.

## \|\| 2.28.3 \|\|

*kālastu guṇabhāvena sarvakālāśritā kriyā \|*  
*na kālena vinā kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu jāyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. All the activities, by nature are dependent on the time. Nothing is possible in the three worlds without the time.

## \|\| 2.28.4 \|\|

*ataḥ kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi nimittaṃ karmaṇāmiha \|*  
*kāle hyamūrtirbhagavāneka eva tu yadyapi \|*  
*tathāpyupādhibhedena bhidyate kālabhedibhiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Therefore, I am arranging for the time for the sake of the deeds or the karmas. Though the formless or the spiritual is one, but due to the difference in time, also appears a concrete form as well.

## \|\| 2.28.5 \|\|

*tithinakṣatravārādau rātriyogādayopi ye \|*  
*te'pi kālāḥ pakṣamāsarāśivarṣāṃtare'pi ca \|*  
*sādhanāni bhavantyete svātantryeṇa na kasyacit \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The tithis, constellations and days, besides the nights are believed to be the form of time. Similarly, the fortnights, months, the zodiacs and the years are all said to be the form of Kola or time. In this way, the fortnights, months, zodiacs are not the independent means of time.

## \|\| 2.28.6 \|\|

*dharmasya vāpyadharmasya mukhyo vyāpāra eva saḥ \|*  
*tithyādikālabhāveṣu niṣiddhaṃ nihitaṃ hi tat \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Dharma and Adharma are lodged in the same, which is accepted.

## \|\| 2.28.7 \|\|

*pālayansvargamāpnoti hitvā prāpnotyadhogatim \|*  
*sādhayaṃtyapi karmāṇi parasparamavekṣyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. By following them, one achieves heaven and by discarding them, one falls in the hell. Thus observing the karma, they look at each other.

## \|\| 2.28.8-9 \|\|

*kālabhāgo niḥsahāyo ye'pi syuḥ karmasādhanāḥ \|*  
*tithau pūrvāhṇavyāpinyāṃ kurvīta karma vaidikam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ hi samācaret \|*  
*parāhṇavyāpinīṃ prāpya tithiṃ kuryāttu pārvaṇam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Thus Kala-раrt is helpless, while the karma is the performer. The tithis which lasts upto forenoon, the Vedic activities should be continued. The tithi lasts upto the noon, Ekodista Sraddha can be performed, while during the tithi which remains in vogue in the afternoon, the Parvana Sraddha should be performed.

## \|\| 2.28.10 \|\|

*na tu pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnaparāhṇeṣu yathocitam \|*  
*apradhāne tu kurvīta karma daivādikaṃ ca yat \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. For performing of the divine functions, no definite time has been prescribed. Therefore, one should make efforts to perform such auspicious deeds, because there is no indication (about the performing of the deeds) during the forenoon, noon or the afternoon.

## \|\| 2.28.11 \|\|

*eko hi kālaḥ prātastu vṛddhiśrāddhādisādhane \|*  
*nāpekṣate sāhāyyaṃ tattithyādiviṣuvādiṣu \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. During the morning alone, the Sraddha for the benefit should be performed. The time (or morning) without accepting any kind of help from the tithi or visava or equinox, remams indifferent

## \|\| 2.28.12 \|\|

*devebhyo brahmaṇā dattaḥ pūrvāhṇastithibhiḥ saha \|*  
*pitṛbhyo hyaparāhṇastu pārvaṇaṃ tu paraṃ vinā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Brahma gave away to the gods, all the tithis besides the forenoon. To the manes, at the same time for the performing of the Parvana Sraddha (and all other Sraddhas) afternoon was given.

## \|\| 2.28.13 \|\|

*pūrvāhṇamātrasaṃprāptau tato devānprapūjayet \|*  
*pūrvāhṇasparśamātre'pi tithikhaṇḍena cārpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Therefore, with the mere receiving of the forenoon time, the gods should be worshipped during that time. Witli the fragmentation of the tithis, but with the mere touch of the forenoon, the gods are given away the presents during that period alone.

## \|\| 2.28.14 \|\|

*kharvā darpā tathā hiṃsrā tithiśca trividhā bhavet \|*  
*kharvādi laṃghayettulyā darpā bhavati varddhitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The tithis are said to be of three types viz., Kharva, Darpa and Himsra. The declining tithi is known as Kharva and Darpa. The vanishing tithis are known as Himsra.

## \|\| 2.28.15-18 \|\|

*hiṃsrā tu kṣayajā jñeyā kālabhedena gṛhyate \|*  
*kharvā darpā pare grāhyā hiṃsrā grāhyā tu pūrvataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śuklapakṣe parā grāhyā kṛṣṇe pūrvā praśasyate \|*  
*snānadānavrate caiva viṣayogo nidarśitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tithau codeti savitā kālamātraṃ ca vā yadi \|*  
*anyāpi saiva vijñeyā tithistasminnaharniśam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yathāvāste ravirbhāti ghaṭikā daśa vāpi vā \|*  
*sā tithistadahorātraṃ vyapadeśyā na cetarā \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. The tithis known as Kharva and Darpa function in the afternoon, while the Himsrd tithi functions in the forenoon. For the taking of bath or the performing of charities, vratas and for visa-yoga, the Para-tithi of the bright fortnight and the one of the black fortnight are said to be praiseworthy. The tithi in which the sun rises in a moment and in the same moment another tithi enters, but the tithi which thus enters is made use of by the name of the earlier tithi.

## \|\| 2.28.19 \|\|

*śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe kharvā darpā tithiśca yā \|*  
*yayāstaṃ savitā yāti pitṛkārye ca sā tithiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. As the sun remains present, similarly in case a particular tithi remains present even for a ghadt (twenty two minutes), then during the whole night, the same tithi would be considered to be in vogue.

## \|\| 2.28.20-21 \|\|

*dinadvaye'pi kutape astagāṃ tithimāśrayet \|*  
*śrāddhakālādikaṃ yatra tatra śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate \|*  
*vrate ca vṛddhigāminyāṃ yatrodayo raverbhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*amāvāsyapārvaṇe ca sā tithiḥ pitṛpūjane \|*  
*amāvasyāmṛtasyaiva pārvaṇaṃ yatra kutracit \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. When the sun sets during tithis named Kharva or Darpa of the bright or black fortnights, it becomes acceptable for the pitr-rites. At the time of Sraddha on both the days, the tithi of the sunset should be recorded, because the tithi in which the time of Sraddha falls, it has to be processed accordingly. For the purpose of vrata, the extended tithi in which the sun rises should be followed.

## \|\| 2.28.22 \|\|

*astagāmitithiryatra sā tithiḥ pitṛmaṃdiram \|*  
*ekoddiṣṭaṃ carettatra nodaye ca kadācana \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. During the Parvana Sraddha as well as at the time of the adoration of the manes, the moonless tithi is acceptable. A person who meets with his end on the moonless day, for him the performing of the Parvana Sraddha would not be necessary.

## \|\| 2.28.23-24 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe ca kṛṣṇe ca yo yogaḥ parapūrvayoḥ \|*  
*pūrvedyurvā paredyurvā trisaṃdhyavyāpinī tithiḥ \|*  
*sā pūjyā ca svakṛtyeṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pūjyā hi vyastaṃ saṃtyajya pūrvaṃ caikādaśīyugam \|*  
*dvitīyā vahninā yuktā caturthī paṃcamīyutā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The tithi which exists at the time of the sunset, equates with the temple of the pitrs. The Ekodista Sraddha should be performed during the same tithi, but never in the udaya (rising) tithi. During the bright or the dark fortnight, on the festive occasions, whenever this yoga is found, when the same tithi prevails in the three Sandhyas, irrespective of its being in the first or the second day, it is considered to be auspicious for the performing of the holy rites.

## \|\| 2.28.25 \|\|

*etā upoṣyāstithayaḥ puṇyāḥ syurdharmavedibhiḥ \|*  
*etadvyastāstu puṇyāni ghnaṃti pūrvakṛtānyapi \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The opposite tithis should be discarded. Then, Ekadasi and other tithis or Dvitiya combined with Agni besides Caturthi and Pancami are the auspicious tithis during which the religious minded people should perform fast etc. In case a person does not conduct himself properly during these tithis, his earlier earned merits also get lost.

## \|\| 2.28.26-28 \|\|

*bāṇena viddhā yā ṣaṣṭhī munividdhā tathāṣṭamī \|*  
*daśamyekādaśīviddhā trayodaśyā caturdaśī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*amāvāsyā bhūtaviddhā nopoṣyā munināpi ca \|*  
*haṃti putrakalatrāṇi dhanāni samupoṣitā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*viddhā ye nābhinindyāḥ syuryuktāstenābhinanditāḥ \|*  
*vyastasya saṃbhave yugmaṃ viddhā bhavati sarvaśaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. During the bana-viddha sasthi (viddha means combined) or the sixth moon day, or Muni-viddha astami (or eighth moon day) or Dasami-viddha Ekadasi (eleventh moon day), Trayodasi viddha Caturdasi (or the fourteenth day of moon), Bhuta-viddha (moonless night), even the sages should not undertake a fast, failing which one has to face enormous loss of son, wife and wealth.

## \|\| 2.28.29 \|\|

*tāmastāṃ tu tithiṃ prāpya yugmānyapūjyatāmiyuḥ \|*  
*yugmāni ca divāyoge grāhyāṇi vyastaniṃdanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Such of the viddha or injured tithis have not been denounced, when such tithis are combined, they are treated to be auspicious. But on the contrary, they get blemished.

## \|\| 2.28.30 \|\|

*naktādivratayoge tu divāsaṃvarddhamarkarān \|*  
*rātriyogaścaturthyostu viśiṣya parigṛhyate \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The viddha or combined tithis at the time of setting are not considered adorable. They should be accepted only with the combination of the days. The adverse tithis are denounced as well.

## \|\| 2.28.31 \|\|

*rātriyogaṃ vināpi syādekādaśyādikaṃ vratam \|*  
*naktaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ caiva vināyoge'pi śasyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. During the combination of the nakta-vrata (vrata performed during the night), the tithis related with the day are accepted and with the combination of nights of the tithis, Caturthi tithi is particularly accepted.

## \|\| 2.28.32 \|\|

*ekādaśyupavāsaṃ tu dvādaśīyogataścaret \|*  
*divāyoge tu saṃpūrṇāṃ tyajedubhayapūrvataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. When the vrata yoga of Ekadasi is not possible during the night, it can still be performed, because the waking up is quite praiseworthy for the purpose of Viniyoga.

## \|\| 2.28.33 \|\|

*rātriyoge tu saṃpūrṇā sopāsyaikādaśī sadā \|*  
*saptamī śukla pakṣe'pi pūjyā ṣaṣṭhyā samanvitā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. With the combination of Dvadasi, the Ekadasi vrata should be performed. But in case Dvadasi is found during the day itself, then the Ekadasi of the earlier day has to be discarded.

## \|\| 2.28.34 \|\|

*niśi tu syādyadā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī navamī divā \|*  
*upoṣya kevalāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ toṣayedbhāskaraṃ naraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Similarly, when Dvadasi exists during the night, the vrata of complete Ekadasi should be performed. When Sasthi-Saptami of bright fortnight are combined, they are adorable.

## \|\| 2.28.35 \|\|

*evaṃ trayodaśīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vidhiprāptāṃ vinā dvijāḥ \|*  
*upoṣya pārvatīnāthaṃ toṣayedyaśca kevalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. When Sasthi falls during the night and Saptami and Navami fall during the day, then a person should perform vrata. The fasting should be performed to please the Sun-god.

## \|\| 2.28.36-37 \|\|

*divā trayodaśīyuktā kṛṣṇopoṣyā caturdaśī \|*  
*pareṇāpi caturdaśyā na tu kuryādamātithau \|\| 36 \|\|*

*trisaṃdhyavyāpinī prāpya yadi kuryādupauṣaṇam \|*  
*pāraṇaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ caturdaśyāmupoṣayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. О Brahmanas, similarly, during the combined Trayodasi of the dark fortnight, Bhutanatha Siva could be pleased by fasting. When the day has the Trayodasi combined with Caturdasi during the dark fortnight, fasting should be done on Caturdasi. But when the Caturdasi is combined with moonless day or Amavasya, the fasting in that case is prohibited.

## \|\| 2.28.38 \|\|

*caturdaśīmatikramya sinīvālyāṃ tu pāraṇāt \|*  
*vratāni tasya naśyaṃti prākṛtāni caturdaśīm \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. When the Caturdasi falls on the three Sandhyas, one can observe fast but the breaking of the fast should be done on the day of Amavasya. Overlapping the fast less Caturdasi, during Sini, Amavasya (during which the moon is sighted), when one breaks the fast, the vratas performed earlier to Caturdasi get destroyed.

## \|\| 2.28.39 \|\|

*saptamī lalitā bhādre śaktotthānaṃ ca vāruṇī \|*  
*pūjyāścaitāḥ parāḥ kuryāttrisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. On the bright Saptami of Bhadrapada known as Lalita, besides the powerful Varuni-tithis when remain present during the three sandhyas, the next day is also considered as auspicious.

## \|\| 2.28.40-41 \|\|

*trisaṃdhyāvyāpinī pūrve parato varddhate yadi \|*  
*saṛkṣā ṛkṣayoge tu ṛkṣābhāve parā yutā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ṛkṣābhāve parā grāhyā trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi \|*  
*śrāvaṇe cādyapāde tu praśastā śakrapūjane \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. When a tithi prevails during the three Sandhyas and with the combination of the constellation in case the extending becomes possible on the next day, then the tithi of the day of festivities becomes acceptable. During the first part of Sravana constellation, the time is considered to be auspicious for the adoration of Sukra or Venus.

## \|\| 2.28.42-43 \|\|

*abhāve cottarāṣāḍhā dhaniṣṭhā ca viśiṣyate \|*  
*daṇḍārdhaṃ daṇḍamekaṃ vā tadardhaṃ palameva vā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*udaye saṃyutā grāhyā sā tithiścottamā bhavet \|*  
*trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṃ hitvā pūjyā śuklāṣṭamī parā \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. In the absence of the same, during the Uttarasadha Dhanistha is particularly accepted. When a danda (twenty four minutes) or half of it or still half of the same of a tithi is found at the time of sunrise, such a type of rising tithi is considered to be auspicious. During the three sandhyas of the bright fortnight, the prevailing tithi should be discarded and astami of the next day should be accepted.

## \|\| 2.28.44 \|\|

*ravicakravatā grāhyā rathe tithyāderapi ca \|*  
*trisaṃdhyavyāpinī yā tu palamekaṃ pare dine \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. During the car festival or other festivities, the tithi prevailing at the time of the sunrise, which remains present on all the three sandhyas and remains in vogue for a moment on the next day, should be accepted.

## \|\| 2.28.45-46 \|\|

*apare'pi ca sarvatra halānāṃ vāhanaṃ tyajet \|*  
*śuklaikādaśyamāvāsyāsaṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhavāsare \|\| 45 \|\|*

*narāśvagogajādīnāṃ vāhanātpātakī bhavet \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. On the next day, the ploughing of the fields should be discontinued. Similarly, on the bright Ekadasi, the moonless day, first day of the month and on the days of performing of Sraddha, a person shall earn sin by making use of a vehicle, a palanquin, the horse, bullockcart, and elephants etc. are forbidden.

## \|\| 2.28.47 \|\|

*karturgomahiṣādīnāṃ gardabhoṣṭrakharasya ca \|*  
*na vāhayeddāsa dāsī vāhanenāsti dūṣaṇam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. During those days, the bullock, buffalo, the donkey, the camel or mules can be used as vehicles by the householders. There is no restriction for the use of vehicles for the slaves or the slave girls.

## \|\| 2.28.48 \|\|

*bahukālikayajñe ca yajñaśrāddhe tathaiva ca \|*  
*grāmāṃtare na doṣaḥ syāddivi nadyaṃtare'pi ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. There is no harm in going to other villages for attending yajnas, sraddha and other religious activities, or for going to the river bank.

## \|\| 2.28.49 \|\|

*nityaśrāddhe'pyambughaṭe yacchrāddhaṃ māsikaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tatra gomahiṣādīnāṃ vāhane nāsti dūṣaṇam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. For the filling of water in the pitcher, for the performing of sraddha or on the occasion of the performing of monthly sraddha, there is no harm in moving by means of a bullock or the buffalo-carts.

## \|\| 2.28.50 \|\|

*kuryādaṃbughaṭaśrāddhaṃ na kālaniyamaṃ kvacit \|*  
*na cānnaniyamaṃ kuryādaśmapātraṃ ca varjayet \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. At the time of performing kumbha-sraddha there is no time limit, but the vases of stone should not be used.

## \|\| 2.28.51 \|\|

*taijasairnirmitaṃ kumbhamatha vā vṛkṣapatrajam \|*  
*na yojayenmṛnmayaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ mṛnmaye vidhiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. In the kumbha-sraddha, the vases made of gold or trees should be used. The earthen vases should not be used. This is because the earthen vases are required to be used by the Sudras.

## \|\| 2.28.52 \|\|

*nivedayecca māsāṃte mṛnmayaṃ vṛkṣamūlake \|*  
*āsphālayetpareṇaiva na vastraṃ tu kathañcana \|*  
*parvaśrāddhe daivalakaṃ tathā raṇḍāśramaṃ tyajet \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. At the end of the month, the earthen pitches should be got placed by someone else at the root of a tree and then get it removed by someone else but not the costumes. During the Parvana-sraddha, the temple priests as well as the whores should be discarded.

## \|\| 2.28.53-57 \|\|

*mātāpitṛparityāgī tailahavyādivikrayī \|*  
*catvāriṃśadutsavānāṃ sāṣṭānāṃ ca caredyadi \|\| 53 \|\|*

*striyā vimucyate kaścitsa tu raṇḍāśramī mataḥ \|*  
*aṣṭacatvāriṃśadabdaṃ vayo yāvanna pūryate \|\| 54 \|\|*

*putrabhāryāviyuktasya nāsti yajñādhikāritā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya samudeti divākaraḥ \|*  
*snānādhyayanadāneṣu sā tithiḥ sakalā smṛtā \|\| 56 \|\|*

*yayāstaṃ savitā yāti kṛṣṇapakṣe tu sā tithiḥ \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ sakalā jñeyā snānadānādikarmasu \|\| 57 \|\|*

53-57. The person having discarded his parents, the one who is engaged in the sale of oil, havya etc. or the performer of forty eight festivities, one who has been disowned by his own wife, one who lives with whores upto the age of forty eighty years, though his living there is desirable or the one who has been separated from his wife as well the son, have no right to perform the yajnas. During the time and the day on which the Sun-god rises, the same time is patronized for the sake of taking bath and giving of charities. The tithis during which the Sun-god reaches the Astacala or starts setting, the same time is said to be appropriate for taking bath and giving away the charities for the manes.

## \|\| 2.28.58-59 \|\|

*saptamī śuklapakṣe yā yāvadicchecca khaṇḍitā \|*  
*ādyabhāge raveḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parādau yāṣṭamīyutā \|*  
*yadyakhaṇḍā bhavetsaiva tadā jñeyā bhavātmikā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*māghamāsena sāpyevaṃ pūrveṇa ravitoṣiṇī \|*  
*manvaṃtarā pareṇaiva snānapānādikarmasu \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Even when the Saptami of the bright fortnight is not much shattered, in its first part linked with Sasthi. and when Astami is combined with it on the next day, the Sun-god should be adored in its forepart. In ease Saptami is not shattered, it should be treated as immensely praiseworthy and emotional. The same Saptami is also believed to please the Sun-god during the month of Magha. In the rites for taking bath etc. during the Manvantras, the tithi of the second day is considered to be praiseworthy.

## Chapter 29. The excellent tithis (moon days)

## \|\| 2.29.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmādbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtā \|*  
*pratipāditā pare pūrve pratipādya navodyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kārtikāśvayujoścaitre māghe cāpi viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ dānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ śivaviṣṇvośca pūjanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said - The reason for which Brahma had declared some of the tithis as the best, I am going to talk about their sanctity. You please listen. If in the months of Kartika, Asvina, Caitra and Magha, one takes bath or performes charity for the sake of Siva or Visnu, then he achieves ten times more merits than on the ordinary days.

## \|\| 2.29.3 \|\|

*agnimiṣṭvā ca kṛtvā ca pratipadyāmiti smṛtam \|*  
*haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ dhanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Agnihotra (homa) should he performed on the first moon day. The performing of homa on that date has also been said to be praiseworthy. By so doing, one earns wealth to his satisfaction as well as the cereals.

## \|\| 2.29.4 \|\|

*bṛhaspatau dvitīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vidhipūjanam \|*  
*kṛtvā naktaṃ samaśnīyāllabhate bhūtimīpsitām \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. During the bright fortnight on the days of Brhaspati (Jupiter) on the second moon day if the Brahma is worshipped observing the fast at night, one earns the riches as per his desires.

## \|\| 2.29.5 \|\|

*mithune karkaṭe caiva govipradamanāṃtaram \|*  
*dvitīyā yā tu vipreṃdāstāmupoṣya hariṃ yajet \|*  
*yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prayāti strī na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. During the Gemini and Cancer zodiacs, when the sun is lodged in them and in case the cows and Brahmanas are served on the second day of the moon, one should observe fast and then should worship Visnu. In case a woman observes fast during that period, she can never become a widow. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 2.29.6 \|\|

*amūlyaśayanaṃ māsaṃ daṃpatī pratipūjayet \|*  
*vāsobhirgandhapuṣpaiśca nānābhakṣyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The precious sleep of lord Visnu lasts for four months. Both the husband and wife should together give away in charity clothes, fragrance, flowers and several types of eatables and then worship him.

## \|\| 2.29.7 \|\|

*vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*gaṃgātoye naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On the same third moon day of the mouth of Vaisakha, one should take bath with the sacred water of Ganga which relieves him of all the sins.

## \|\| 2.29.8-9 \|\|

*svātiyuktatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe tu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*māghe tu rohiṇīyuktā vṛṣe cāśvayuje tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiñcittadakṣayamudāhṛtam \|*  
*viśeṣato haviṣyānnaṃ modakādisamāyutam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Particularly in the Svati constellation, when it joins the third moon day it gains special significance. Similarly, the Rohini constellation is of special importance and whatever is given during the time of Rohini, it becomes everlasting. The payasam as well as the sweet balls should be given together.

## \|\| 2.29.10 \|\|

*toyadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*guḍakarpūrasaṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The learned people have particularly praised the performing of offering of water (Toyaddna) during the period. The sugarcane balls should be given with camphor and by so doing, the donor is honoured in Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 2.29.11 \|\|

*budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā tṛtīyā yadi labhyate \|*  
*tasyāṃ snānopavāsādyamakṣayaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. On Wednesday, during the Sravana (the twenty seventh) constellation, when there is the third moon day, if a person fasts and takes bath on that day, he becomes eternal.

## \|\| 2.29.12 \|\|

*caturthībharaṇīyoge bhaveccaradinaṃ yadā \|*  
*tadābhyarcya yamaṃ devaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. When Caturthi falls during the Bharani or second constellation on Saturday, Yama is to be worshipped and a person who does so is relieved of all the grave sins.

## \|\| 2.29.13 \|\|

*śivā śāṃtā sukhā caiva caturthī trividhā smṛtā \|*  
*sāpi bhādrapade śuklā śivaloke supūjitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Caturthi tithi is known to he of three types viz., £iva, Santa and Sukha. The same during the bright fortnight of Bhadrapada, on the fourth moon day, is adored in the Sivaloka appropriately.

## \|\| 2.29.14 \|\|

*kārttike tu bhavecchāyā tathā māghe tu kīrtyate \|*  
*tasyāṃ snānaṃ tapo dānamupavāso japastathā \|*  
*bhavetsahasraguṇitaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The Caturthi of the Karttika and Magha months is known by the name of Chaya as well. In case one resorts to bathing, performing of tapas, charities, fasting as well as japam, one gets a thousand times more reward. In case a sraddha is performed on that particular day, it bestows everlasting reward.

## \|\| 2.29.15 \|\|

*gaṇeśe kārayetpūjāṃ modakādibhirādarāt \|*  
*caturthyāṃ vighnanāśāya sarvakāmaprasiddhaye \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. For the fulfilment of one’s all the desires without obstructions, Ganesa should be worshipped on the bright fourth moon day of the month.

## \|\| 2.29.16-17 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*snāpayennavanāgāṃśca gaṃdhatoyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. During the bright fortnight of the month of Sravana, nine serpents should be worshipped with fragrant water and other scented articles. By so doing, the serpents bestow protection to the entire race.

## \|\| 2.29.18 \|\|

*dvādaśyobhayalekhe ca gomayena viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūjayeddadhidugdhādyaiḥ siṃdūrairapi bhaktitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On the Dvadasi day, the image of cowdung of both the deities should be made and should be worshipped with curd, milk and other stuff, with devotion offering vermilion.

## \|\| 2.29.19 \|\|

*supte janārdane kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ bhavanāṃgaṇe \|*  
*pūjayenmanasādevīṃ vāmāṃ snuhīti saṃśrayām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. During the time of going to sleep of Janardana on the dark fifth day of the moon, the worship of the goddess should be performed in the courtyard of the house, quite beautifully.

## \|\| 2.29.20 \|\|

*picumaṃdasya patrāṇi sthāpayedbhavanodare \|*  
*pūjayitvā naro devīṃ na sarpabhayamāpnu yāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In the courtyard of the house, the goddess should be worshipped seated over the nima leaves and by so doing, one is freed from the danger of serpents.

## \|\| 2.29.21-22 \|\|

*yeyaṃ bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭhī ca dvijasattama \|*  
*snānadānādikaṃ tasyāṃ sarvamakṣayamucyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano viprā viśeṣānmāghakārtike \|*  
*iha cāmutra mukhyāṃ ca labhate khyātimuttamām \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. О best of the Brahmanas, on the sixth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, only fruits should be consumed after taking bath, and by which one earns enormous glory in this as well as in the future world.

## \|\| 2.29.23 \|\|

*śuddhe pakṣe ca saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ \|*  
*mahājayā tadā syādvai saptamī bhāskarapriyā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. On the day of Saptami of the bright fortnight of the month and on the first day, it is known as Maha-Jaya Saptami, which is the favourite of the Sun-god

## \|\| 2.29.24 \|\|

*aparājitā tu bhādrasya mahāpātakanāśinī \|*  
*lalitā kevalā jñeyā putrapautra vivarddhinī \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The Aparajita tithi of the month of Bhadrapada removes the grave impurities. Besides the tithi named Lalita causes the increase in the sons and the grandsons.

## \|\| 2.29.25 \|\|

*śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī tu vā \|*  
*ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tithiḥ puṇyatamā smṛtā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The sixth or seventh moon day of bright or dark fortnight falling on Sunday, is said to be extremely auspicious.

## \|\| 2.29.26 \|\|

*āśvinasya sitāṣṭamyāmaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ yajet \|*  
*kārttike śuklapakṣe vā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. On the eighth moon day of the bright fortnight for the accumulation of enormous riches, the eight-armed goddess should be worshipped. Similarly, in the month of Kartika during the bright seventh day of the fortnight, the same goddess should be worshipped.

## \|\| 2.29.27 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca caṃḍikām \|*  
*prātaḥ snātvārcayedbhaktyā rātrau saṃsnāpayeddvijāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О Brahmanas, on the eighth moon day of Asadha and Havana months, the goddess Candika should be bathed and offered puja in the early morning after taking the bath, with devotion.

## \|\| 2.29.28-29 \|\|

*caitramāsi sitāṣṭamyāmaśokakusumairdvijāḥ \|*  
*arcayenmṛnmayīṃ devīmaśokārthaṃ ca sarvadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*satyaṣṭamamuhūrte vā rohiṇīsahitāṣṭamī \|*  
*śrāvaṇe māsi siṃhārke kvacitsāpi ca śasyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. О Brahmanas, on the eighth moon day of the bright fortnight of the month of Caitra, the image of clay of the goddess should be adored with Asoka flowers which makes a person free of all the worries. During the Robin! constellation of the month of Sravana, in the eighth muhurta when the sun is in the Leo zodiac, then even the eighth moon is considered to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 2.29.30 \|\|

*ekādaśīnāṃ koṭīnāṃ vrataiśca labhate phalam \|*  
*ato daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛtvaitatphalamāpnuyāta \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The number of merits one achieves for performing of crores of Ekadasi vratas, ten times more than those merits one achieves with the performing of these rites.

## \|\| 2.29.31 \|\|

*aśakto'nyakriyāṃ kartumupavāsaṃ tu kevalam \|*  
*kṛtvā vimucyate pāpātsaptakṛtyakṛtāṃ varaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. When a person becomes weaker with the performing of other rites, he is free from all the sins with the observing of this fast alone. He becomes foremost of the people who perform the seven noble deeds.

## \|\| 2.29.32 \|\|

*na kālaniyamastatra na vāraniyamaḥ kvacit \|*  
*nāpi nakṣatradoṣo'sti vāradoṣo na gaṇyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. No definite time is prescribed for the said puja or the day. There is also no necessity for the following of a particular constellation.

## \|\| 2.29.33 \|\|

*trikālaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ divā rātrau viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*ardharātre viśeṣeṇa puṣpairnānāvidhairapi \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. During all the three periods, the time of day, night or the mid of night has been said to be praiseworthy for the performing of the puja. The adoration should be completed using the relevant types of flowers.

## \|\| 2.29.34-35 \|\|

*divā titheralābhe tu na kuryādvidhivadvratam \|*  
*rātrisparśe yadi paraṃ rajanyāmapi cāṣṭamī \|\| 34 \|\|*

*saptamī sārdhayāmaṃ ca rohiṇī vā na saṃspṛśet \|*  
*vratī saṃkalpayettatra na ca rātrau kadācana \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. When running in loss, the vrata should not be performed in the same tithi. Starting from the evening upto the last hour of the night in case the Astami tithi exists and the RohinI constellation does not touch during a prahara and a half, then the related samkalpa should be undertaken on the Saptami itself, but not during the night.

## \|\| 2.29.36 \|\|

*prāgāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta adhimātrādhike vratī \|*  
*viśvanāthādidevānāṃ darśanaṃ prāgvivarjayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. When it is therefore short duration, the fasting person should start the process of vrata ahead. But one should not have an audience with gods like Visvantha and others.

## \|\| 2.29.37 \|\|

*yatra tatropavāsī syādyāmāṣṭakavrataṃ caret \|*  
*yāmārdhaṃ tatparaṃ yāme pāraṇaṃ vicaredvratī \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The fasting can be started at any point of time, but the vrata should be performed during the eight praharas alone. With the passing of half a prahara, the breaking of the fast should be done during the next prahara.

## \|\| 2.29.38-39 \|\|

*tatpare cā'nnajanyaṃ vā na kuryātpāraṇaṃ gṛhī \|\| 38 \|\|*

*nakṣatrayoge grahaṇe pūjayetparameśvaram \|*  
*japahomādikaṃ kuryādgṛhī nopavasetkvacit \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. During that period, the householders are prohibited from breaking the fast. With the combination of the constellation, when there appears an eclipse, the worship of Paramesvara should be performed besides the japam and homa. But a householder is prohibited from observing fast at that time.

## \|\| 2.29.40 \|\|

*divāṣṭamyāṃ muhūrte vā prājāpatyena saṃyutam \|*  
*tathāpi ca divākṛtyaṃ samāpya ca vrataṃ caret \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. During the eighth muhurta of a day, with the combination of Prajapatya, completing the rites to be performed during the day, the vrata should be performed.

## \|\| 2.29.41-42 \|\|

*muhūrtāṃte ca māsāṃte aṣṭamyāmapi rohiṇī \|*  
*upavāse ca yo doṣaḥ pūjāhomaḥ praśasyate \|\| 41 \|\|*

*navamyāṃ ca sadā pūjyāḥ pratimāse'yutaṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ caiva yathā karma phalapradam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. At the end of a muhurta and a month, when the Rohini constellation appears with eighth moon day, the blemishes which appear in the fasting is subsided with worship and homa. О Brahmanas, on the ninth moon day of every month, puja should be performed with japam of ten thousand mantras, observing all the rules, because they also yield merits like the karmas.

## \|\| 2.29.43 \|\|

*kārtikasya tu māsasya daśamī śuklapakṣikā \|*  
*tasyāṃ yuktāśanā viprā brahmalokamavāpnuyuḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О Brahmanas on the tenth moon day of the bright fortnight of the month of Kartika, by taking food one achieves Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 2.29.44 \|\|

*daśamī jyeṣṭhamāsasya sā ceddaśaharā smṛtā \|*  
*āśvinasya mahāpuṇyā kārtike vijayā smṛtā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Dasahara is observed on the tenth moon day of the month of Asvina. which is also known as Mahapunya Dadarni. It is known as Vijaya during the month of Kartika.

## \|\| 2.29.45-48 \|\|

*ekādaśī vrataparā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktā yathā kurvaṃti mānavāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*daśamyāmekabhaktastu saṃyataḥ syājjitendriyaḥ \|*  
*ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ caret \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dvādaśa dvādaśīrhanti tasmāttathācaredbudhaḥ \|*  
*pūrvedyurekādaśī pūrṇā parehani ca vardhate \|\| 47 \|\|*

*na vardhate dvādaśī tu tadā tvevaṃ vyavasthitiḥ \|*  
*vanavāsī parāṃ kuryātpūrvāṃ kuryādgṛhāśramī \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. The moon day known as Ekadasi is known to be destroyer of all the sins. By performing vrata during that Ekadasi, the way a person is relieved of all the sins is being told by me. Getting disciplined, controlling all his senses, one should take food only once a day. Then observing fast on the day of Ekadasi, the breaking of the fast should be observed on the day of Dvadasi. because it removes twelve blemishes. Therefore, an intelligent person should do accordingly. On the early day, Ekadasi prevails for the whole day and increase on the second day. In case there be no increase in the Dvadasi, the arrangement has been made accordingly. The ascetics and the forest dwellers should observe the Ekadasi of the second day, while the householders should observe vrata for the Ekadasi of the first day.

## \|\| 2.29.49 \|\|

*pūrvevaikādaśī tyājyā vardhate cettithidvayam \|*  
*ekādaśī dvādaśī tu tadopoṣyā parā tithiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In case both the Ekadasi and Dvadasi get increased, then discarding Ekadasi of the earlier day, vrata should be observed on the Ekadasi of the following day.

## \|\| 2.29.50 \|\|

*yadā tu pāraṇā yogyā dvādaśī nopatiṣṭhate \|*  
*tadā pūrvaiva saṃgrāhyā tyājyā vṛddhā pare'hani \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. In case Dvadasi is not available for the ending of the fast, then in that case the fast could be concluded in the Ekadasi of the earlier day and not the extended one of the following day.

## \|\| 2.29.51 \|\|

*ekādaśī kalāyuktā sakalā dvādaśī yadi \|*  
*tatra kratusamaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. On a day when only a digit of Ekadasi exists, that vrata yields the merit comparable with a yajna. In that case, the vrata should be concluded on the day of Trayodasi.

## \|\| 2.29.52 \|\|

*ekādaśī dvādaśī ca pare'hani na labhyate \|*  
*nopoṣyā sā mahādoṣā putrapautradhanakṣayāt \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. In case no increase of Ekadasi or Dvadasi seen on the following day, then the vrata should not be performed, because it becomes a blemished one and causes loss of sons, grandsons as well as the wealth.

## \|\| 2.29.52-54 \|\|

*ekādaśī dvādaśī ca pare'hani na labhyate \|*  
*nopoṣyā sā mahādoṣā putrapautradhanakṣayāt \|\| 52 \|\|*

*ekādaśī daśāviddhā dvādaśyāṃ liptikā yadā \|*  
*dvādaśī pāraṇāyogyā vardhate cāpare'hani \|*  
*tadā dinadvaye tyājyā pāraṇaṃ ca niyogataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvādaśī luptapāraṇā \|*  
*caṇḍātithau vrataṃ caiva haṃti puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. Ekadasi getting combined with Dvadasi and getting absorbed in the latter, becomes fit for the breaking of the fast. Still when the increase in Dvadasi is possible on the next day, then discarding both of them, the conclusion of the fast should be made by an alternative method. When an eclipse is visible with all the sixteen digits, the Dvadasi in which the vrata is concluded and when the vrata is concluded during vanishing Dvadasi or Canda tithi, they get instrumental in the destruction of the merits gained earlier.

## \|\| 2.29.55 \|\|

*trayodaśyāṃ yadvihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ na tu puṇyadam \|*  
*gṛhāśramī na kuryādvā daśamīdvādaśīkṣayāt \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The conclusion made during the Trayodasi tithi is not said to be meritorious. At the time of the decline of Dasami and Dvadasi, the conclusion of vrata should not be performed.

## \|\| 2.29.56 \|\|

*yadi rudrā daśamitrā pare'hniravisaṃkramaḥ \|*  
*tathāpi saṃparityajya dvādaśyāṃ samupāvaset \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. On the day of Dasami combined with Ekadasi, in case it happens to be the first day of the month, the conclusion of the vrata should be performed on the day of Dvadasi.

## \|\| 2.29.57 \|\|

*vajrālokanamātraṃ tu daśamī saṃviśedyadi \|*  
*ekādaśī na bhoktavyā parā hyekādaśī tadā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Even when a portion of Dasami equivalent to the fraction of a lightning is combined with Ekadasi, then discarding Ekadasi on that day, the vrata should be concluded of the next day in which both Ekadasi and Dvadasi get combined.

## \|\| 2.29.58 \|\|

*tadā ceddaśamīviddhā samupoṣyā na dūṣaṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. In case Dasami is combined with Ekadasi and ends on the next day, then there is no harm in the conclusion of the vrata in Ekadasi.

## \|\| 2.29.59 \|\|

*dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra viṣṇuranāmayaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The person who performs vrata on the day of Dvadasi achieves the highest position, besides the highest place in the abode of Visnu, which is eternal.

## \|\| 2.29.60 \|\|

*upoṣya daśamīmitrāṃ mohādekādaśīṃ naraḥ \|*  
*nirayaṃ yāti sa pretya dharmasaṃtatisaṃkṣayāt \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Out of concision, in case a person performs vrata during the combination of Dasami and Ekadasi, then he achieves the hell after his death and his Dharma gets destroyed.

## \|\| 2.29.61 \|\|

*ravivāre śukravāre saṃkrāntyāṃ tu dinakṣaye \|*  
*upavāsaṃ prakurvīta pāraṇaṃ tu vivarjayet \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. During Sunday and Friday falling on the first day of the month, when the days are on decline, only fasting has been pi escribed and not the eating of food.

## \|\| 2.29.62 \|\|

*śuklāṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇāṃ pūrvasaṃkalpitāmapi \|*  
*ekādaśīṃ sadā kuryānna vai kṛṣṇettarāṃ kvacit \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. For the performing of the rites on the dark or bright fortnights, even when the Samkalpa has been made earlier, inspite of that vrata should be performed in the dark Ekadasi and not in the bright on.

## \|\| 2.29.63 \|\|

*naktena vartayetkṛṣṇāmiti śāstraviniścayaḥ \|*  
*māse caikādaśī yatra labhyate śuklapakṣake \|*  
*tatra kuryātkṛṣṇapakṣe parā tithirna gṛhyate \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Because it has been ordained in the scriptures that vrata should be performed in the dark Ekadasi alone. This is certain. During certain months, when in preference to the bright Ekadasi the dark one is patronised and no tithi of any other day has to be patronised. The other tithi should not be accepted.

## \|\| 2.29.64 \|\|

*śrāvaṇī dvādaśī śuklā cāṃdrabhadre yadā harau \|*  
*tatropoṣya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. On the bright Dvadasi of the month of Sravana when the moon is sighted with Bhadra, the adoration of lord Hrsikesa should be performed even when lord Visnu be asleep.

## \|\| 2.29.65 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe cāśvine caiva labhyate dvādaśīdine \|*  
*śravaṇena samāyuktā mahatī sā prakīrtitā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. On the Dvadasi of the months of Sravana and Asvina, in case there arrives the Sravana constellation, it is considered to be most important.

## \|\| 2.29.66 \|\|

*puṣyeṇa drādaśīyuktā phālgune vijayā smṛtā \|*  
*kārtike cetparityājyā māghe tu nārakī bhavet \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. On the Dvadasi of the month of Phalguna when its combination with Pusya constellation is found, then the same tithi is called Vijaya.

## \|\| 2.29.67 \|\|

*yā bhādre vijayā proktā śravaṇena samāyutā \|*  
*viśeṣaḥ kathyate tatra yathāvadvratamācaret \|\| 67 \|\|*
