*acchevatena mantreṇa gāyatryā tadanantaram \|*  
*rocanābhistriratnena tathā kuṃbhodakena ca \|\| 224 \|\|*

*parvatāgramṛdā toyanāgavalmīkajātayā \|*  
*gajadaṃtamṛdā caiva kūlamūlatamṛdā tathāta \|\| 225 \|\|*

*puṣpodakena śaṃkhena tathā ratnodakena ca \|*  
*dadhyakṣatena dugdhena ghaṭena śatadhārayā \|\| 226 \|\|*

*sugaṃdhena triśītena vilipya ca samāhitaḥ \|*  
*dāpayetkāṃsyamūlaṃ ca dadyāllohamayaṃ ca vā \|\| 227 \|\|*

*mālyavastrairalaṃkṛtya pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ \|*  
*īśāvā iti maṃtreṇa dadyātpuṣpāñjalitrayam \|\| 228 \|\|*

222-228. Thereafter, during the pleasant time of the early morning, performing the descending of water, a pure milking cow without a fly whisk and the bell and of white colour, together with the daksina should be given over to the singer of Samaveda. Then establishing the yuра-stamba of the yajna over the ground, Varuna mantra together with the Gayatri mantra should be recited. A kalasa decorated with three gems and filled with water should be used for the bathing purpose. In this kalasa, the neck represents the mountains. The water of the confluence of rivers, the dust from the place of elephants, the sand from the anthill, the earth dug with the elephant tusk, the sand from the river bank, the essence of flowers, the conch, the water of gems, curd, unbroken rice and milk should be kept in that pitcher. The continued stream of water should be poured from the pitcher for the purpose of bathing, Thereafter, the fragrant paste should be applied over the body. Then the base of the same should be touched with iron or the copper. Thereafter, the same should be decorated with costumes and the garlands. Then, the deity should be worshipped with fragrance and the sandal paste. Then reciting the mantra Isava-iti, the three hand cups fill of flowers should be offered to the image.

## \|\| 2.40.229-234 \|\|

*punastvāditi maṃtreṇa punaḥ puṣpaṃ samutsṛjet \|*  
*prādeśamātravistāraṃ madhye vṛttaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulam \|\| 229 \|\|*

*kāṃsyacakrasya mānaṃ tu ūrdhvaṃ yaddvādaśāṃgulam \|*  
*tadūrdhve vilikhecchūlaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ \|\| 230 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhahīne lohasya tatra śūlaṃ na kārayet \|*  
*tato maṃgalapūrve tu dvijātīnāṃ matena ca \|\| 231 \|\|*

*samutsṛjecca prāsādaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*caturdarbhaṃ gṛhītvā tu īśānābhimukhena tu \|*  
*samutsṛjettataḥ paścādvākyametadurīyet \|\| 232 \|\|*

*omityādiśrīkṛṣṇadvaipāyanābhidhāna vedavyāsapraṇīta bhaviṣyapurāṇokta phalapraptikāmaścatuṣkoṇādyavacchinnamatkāritapuṣkariṇījalametadūrjitaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādyarcitaṃ varuṇadaivataṃ sarvasattvebhyaḥ snānāvagāhanārthamahamutsṛje \|\| 233 \|\|*

*tato varuṇasūktena varuṇaṃ nāgasaṃyutam \|*  
*makaraṃ kacchapaṃ caiva toyeṣu parinikṣipet \|\| 234 \|\|*

229-234. Thereafter, reciting the mantra punastvaditi, flowers should be offered. This has been prescribed. The yuра stambha should be of territory size and there should be an orb of the size of six angulas in the middle of it. In the upper part of the bronze cakra, there should be a space of twelve angulas. In the top portion, there should be a space of four angulas in which a trident is to be carved. In case it is without the thumb, then the trident should not be carved. Thereafter, reciting the welfare suktas, in consultation with the twice boms, extracting kusa from a tank, it should be placed in the north-east direction uttering the words, "For the achieving of the reward as prescribed in the Bhavisya Parana, composed by Sri Krsna Dvaipayiana Vyasa, the square step well built by me, in which the fragrance and flowers have been dropped by me, whose god is Vanina, is being gifted by me for the bathing of all the living beings.” Thereafter, reciting the Varuna sukta, the serpents with Vanina crocodiles and tortoises should be released in the water of the step well.

## \|\| 2.40.235-240 \|\|

*pūjayedvaruṇaṃ devamarghyaṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tenodakena saṃsnāpya gajadaṃtotthamṛtsnayā \|\| 235 \|\|*

*śvetāśvasurasaṃbhūtaṃ śrīśca teti ca saṃjapan \|*  
*āpyāyasveti maṃtreṇa mṛdaṃ catuṣpathodbhavām \|\| 236 \|\|*

*tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa kuśamūlena sthāpayet \|*  
*tīrthatoyena gaṃdhena tathā pañcāmṛtena ca \|\| 237 \|\|*

*gāyatryā snāpayeddevaṃ ratnatoyena sādhakaḥ \|*  
*āpyāyasveti maṃtreṇa kṣīreṇa tadanaṃtaram \|\| 238 \|\|*

*dadhikrāvṇeti dadhnā ca madhuvāteti vai madhu \|*  
*sarasvatyāṃteti jātīpuṣpatoyena snāpayet \|\| 239 \|\|*

*( varuṇottamiti maṃtrasya nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chaṃdo varuṇo devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ \|*  
*śrīśca te iti maṃtrasya kardama ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ sariddevatā aśvakhuramṛdā snāne viniyogaḥ \|*  
*āpyāyasveti maṃtrasya parvata ṛṣiḥ uṣṇikchandaḥ sarasvatī devatā varuṇaprītaye catuṣpathamṛdā snāne viniyogaḥ \|*  
*tadviṣṇoriti maṃtrasya maināka ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ sarasvatī devatā varuṇaprītaye kuśamṛdā snāne viniyogaḥ \|*  
*kayā na iti maṃtrasya vasiṣṭha ṛṣiranuṣṭupchandaḥ somo devatā varuṇaprītaye nāgagaṃdhasnāne viniyogaḥ \|*  
*tejosīti maṃtrasya garga ṛṣistriṣṭupchanda vāsavo devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ \|*  
*sarasvatyai bhaiṣajyeneti maṃtrasya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchaṃdo viṣṇurdevatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ \|*  
*puṣpodakasnāne \|*  
*agna āyāhīti maṃtrasya janārdana ṛṣiḥ jagatīchanda aindrī devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ \|)*  
*prakṣipetpañca vrīhīṃśca iyañceti ca saṃpaṭhan \|*  
*paścānnīrājanaṃ kuryātpañcaghoṣapuraḥsaram \|\| 240 \|\|*

235-240. After the adoration of the god Varuna, the arghya should be particularly offered to him. H e should be bathed with the water of the pitcher in which the sand dug with elephant tusk is poured. Then reciting the mantras “Sri Srlsceti and Apyayasveti” the collected sand from the road crossing should be dropped in the same. Then reciting the mantra Tadvisnoriti, kusa should be placed at the base, the water-mixed with water of holy places, pancamrta (cow’s milk, curd, ghee, honey and sugar) should be used for bathing. Thereafter, the Gayatri mantra should be recited, the bathing should be done with this water of gems. Thereafter, reciting the mantra Apyayasveti, the payasam and butter m ilk and uttering Dadhikrdvyati the curd should be offered. Then reciting the mantra Madhuvateti, the bathing should be done with the water of jasmine flowers. Thereafter, reciting the mantra Varunottamiti, which has Narayana as the Rsi, Gayatri as the meter, Varuna as the Devata and the Viniyoga is performed for the pleasure of Varuna. Kardama is the Rsi for the mantra Srisceti, Pankti is the meter, Santa is the Devata, the sand with the hoofs of the horse, when used for the purpose of bathing, this Viniyoga is made use of. Parvata is the Rsi for the hymn Apyasyaveti, Usnika is the meter and Sarasvati is the Devata. This mantra is made use of while taking bath with the dust collected from the road crossing. Mainaka is the Rsi for the mantra Tadvisnoriti, Tristupa is the meter, Sarasvati is the Devata and for the pleasure of lord Varuna, the Viniyoga is made use of for bathing with sand of kusa grass. Vasistha is the Rsi for the mantra Kaya-na-iti, Anustupa is the meter, Soma is the god and in the bath with fragrance, the Viniyoga is made use of for the pleasure of lord Varuna. Then Bharga is the Rsi for the hymn Tejositi, Tristupa is the meter, Vasava is the god and this mantra should be recited for the pleasure of the god Varuna. Vamadeva is the Rsi for the hymn Sarasvatyai bhaisajyaneti, Pankti is the meter, Visnu is the Devata and the Viniyoga is performed for the pleasure of Varuna. During the bath with water of flowers, the hymn Agni-ayahiti is recited, Janardana is the Rsi for this mantra, Jagati is the meter, Aindri is the Devata and the Viniyoga is performed for the pleasure of Varuna. Thus uttering all the hymns, the arati should thereafter be performed with the playing of five musical instruments.

## \|\| 2.40.241-245 \|\|

*śirīṣapuṣpasaṃbhūtaṃ darpaṇaṃ kāsyasaṃbhavam \|*  
*gopīcandanasaṃbhūtaṃ gaṃgāmṛttikayātha vā \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ gomayaṃ vāpi svastikaṃ śaṃkhameva ca \|\| 241 \|\|*

*kārayetpadakaṃ vāpi yavagodhūmakasya vā \|*  
*utpannasvargasaṃbhūtaṃ kalaśaṃ māṣasaṃbhavam \|*  
*śrīrasaṃ puṣpasaṃbhūtaṃ darpaṇaṃ kāṃsyasaṃbhavam \|\| 242 \|\|*

*nandyāvarte malayaje tato nirmalayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*ekaikaṃ pratimaṃtreṇa pratyekaṃ tu jalopari \|\| 243 \|\|*

*dhruvapratikṛtairmaṃtrairaṣṭabhiśca yathākramam \|*  
*pūrvākṣataṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ dadyādvidhānataḥ \|\| 244 \|\|*

*tato nārāyaṇasūktena devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vrajet \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ pradadyāttriṃśataṃ balim \|\| 245 \|\|*

241-245. A medal should be made of acacia flowers, the mirror, the bronze, white sandal paste, the sand extracted from the river Ganga and the cowdung of the cow of black colour, the conch, barley or wheat, should be used and a pitcher should be arranged in the month of Magha. Then the essence of the flowers and the mirror should be used. The bronze vase should be purified with sandal paste and kept in spotless Nandyavarta. The same should be given over to the learned people there, while reciting the hymns. Then the offering of the rice boiled with black gram should be made in the fire. Thereafter, reciting the Narayana sukta, the offering should be made to Narayana as well as to the other gods.

## \|\| 2.40.246-250 \|\|

*tata ācamanīyaṃ ca vastrayugmaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa krameṇāpi vidhānataḥ \|\| 246 \|\|*

*pṛthakpṛthaktato dadyāttāvaṃtyenāpi bho dvijāḥ \|*  
*vedasūktasamāyukte yajñasūtrasamanvite \|*  
*sarvavarṇaprade deva vāsasī te vinirmite \|\| 247 \|\|*

*śarīraṃ te na jānāmi ceṣṭāṃ naiva ca naiva ca \|*  
*mayā niveditāngandhānpragṛhya ca vilipyatām \|\| 248 \|\|*

*aṣṭottaraśatāndīpānparitaḥ sthāpayetkramāt \|*  
*tadardhaṃ vā pañcaviṃśaṃ maṃtreṇa prayajetsudhīḥ \|\| 249 \|\|*

*tvaṃ sūryyacandrajyotīṃṣi viṣādastvaṃ tathaiva ca\|*  
*tvameva sarvajyotīṃṣi dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 250 \|\|*

246-250. Thereafter, two clothes together with the water for sipping should be given over to the Brahmanas appropriately. О twice born ones, for each individual god, all the things should be given over separately, saying- “O Deva, the Devasukta together with Yajnasukta and a cloth with all the colours, is being given over by me to you. I am not aware of your body, nor do I at all try to know about the same. Therefore, you kindly accept the fragrance presented by me and apply it over your body.” Thereafter, a hundred and eight lamps should be lighted around the same. In the absence of that number (108), only fifty or even twenty five lamps should be given over by a learned person reciting the mantras and saying- “You are the spotless light of the sun and the moon. Therefore, you accept this lamp.”

## \|\| 2.40.251-253 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryātpañcadhā saptadhātha vā \|*  
*vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa dadyāddhūpaṃ daśāṃgakam \|\| 251 \|\|*

*vanaspatiraso divyo gaṃdhāḍhyaḥ surabhiḥ śuciḥ \|।*  
*mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 252 \|\|*

*alaṃkāraiśca gaṃdhaiśca pītavastraistathaiva ca \|*  
*dūrvākṣatena mālyena yuktaṃ puṣpeṇa pūjayet \|*  
*dadyātpañcāñjaliṃ paścādviṣṇusūktaṃ punarjapet \|\| 253 \|\|*

251-253. He should go round five or seven times, Dasanga incense should be offered according to one’s own knowledge, saying- “I am offering this divine, fragrant, aromatic and auspicious incense with utmost devotion. You kindly accept it. Thereafter, the adoration should be completed offering the ornaments, scent, yellow cloth, durva grass, unbroken rice, flower garlands and then five hand cups of flowers should be offered to him. Thereafter, Visnu-sukta should be recited.

## \|\| 2.40.254-260 \|\|

*tataḥ suśobhane sthāne vedīṃ nirmāya deśikaḥ \|*  
*varuṇaṃ vinyasettatra tathā puṣkariṇīmapi \|\| 254 \|\|*

*vivāhoktena vidhinā kuryānnirmaṃchanādikam \|*  
*gaṃdhapuṣpaṃ tato dadyādgāṃ ca dadyātsadakṣiṇām \|\| 255 \|\|*

*cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ kāṃsyaṃ lohaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*kuryātpuṣkariṇīṃ ramyāṃ rājatīṃ ca tripādikām \|\| 256 \|\|*

*catuṣkoṇāṃ ca suṣamāṃ dvyaṃguṣṭhaparimaṃḍalām \|*  
*suvarṇapratimāṃ kuryādbhālenaikena bho drijāḥ \|\| 257 \|\|*

*atha vā svarṇapatre ca kuṃkumena tale likhet \|*  
*bāṇaśaktipramāṇena svarṇapatraṃ tu dvyaṃgulam \|\| 258 \|\|*

*kārayeccaturasraṃ ca pīṭhopari nyasedbudhaḥ \|*  
*nīrājanāṃte vipreṃdrāḥ saṃsmaredamṛtaṃ taret \|\| 259 \|\|*

*aśaktena tathaivaikakāṣṭhe vā pippalacchade \|*  
*tāmrapaṭṭe likhedvāpi alaktena yathāvidhi \|\| 260 \|\|*

254-260. Thereafter, a beautiful pedestal should be erected, over which Varuna and Puskarini (lake) should be consecrated over it. Thereafter, the nirmanchhanadika should be performed offering the scent, flower and daksina besides the cow or alternatively a tank of silver should be made, which should be square in shape, quite pleasant in appearance, with a mandala on all the four sides resembling a thumb and a beautiful garland around the same or alternatively over a gold leaf a figure of the size of two angulas should be drawn with the tip of an arrow or a sakti. It should be square in shape and a learned person should be made to take his seat over it. О Indra among the kings, after performing the arati with lamps, one should meditate upon the figure of Varuna as well as the water. In case these metals are not available, then the image of Varuna should be drawn over the pedestal by the learned person. О best among the kings, at the end of the performing of the arati one should think of the water (god). In case these metals could not be found, then the wood or the leaf of a pipala tree or the copper leaf should be used and the figure of Varuna should be made over the leaf of the pipala tree in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 2.40.261-270 \|\|

*prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāttu varuṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*mahaṃ tu vatsaraṃ kuryādvedaghoṣapuraḥsaram \|\| 261 \|\|*

*aśokaḥ khadiraḥ śālo hyaśvattho bilvakastathā \|*  
*dhātrī kurubakaścaiva bakulo nāgakeśaraḥ \|\| 262 \|\|*

*eṣāmeva kāṣṭhayūpaṃ yajamānapramāṇakam \|*  
*samādāya ca saṃsthāpya vastrādyaiḥ pratigṛhya ca \|\| 263 \|\|*

*yūpa rakṣeti maṃtreṇa khanitvā ca pradāpayet \|*  
*sthiro bhaveti mantreṇa hastaṃ dattvā paṭhettataḥ \|\| 264 \|\|*

*taḍāgasya tathaiśānyāṃ tathā prāsādakasya ca \|*  
*prāpayeddakṣiṇe bhāge āvāsasya ca madhyake \|\| 265 \|\|*

*naukā gatvā tataḥ paścādyūpamādāya vāgyataḥ \|*  
*madhyadeśe taḍāgasya samulaṃghya tathottaram \|\| 266 \|\|*

*gaṃtavyaṃ prakalpya tatraiva āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā \|*  
*śilāyāṃ homayettatra hunennaukāhutitrayam \|\| 267 \|\|*

*aṃgadāya svāheti bhaumāya nama ityataḥ \|*  
*lājāśaktau dadhimadhau vāsane pratihomayet \|\| 268 \|\|*

*kūrmāya nama ityuktvā pṛthivyai nama ityuta \|*  
*svāhetyanaṃtamaṃtreṇa dadyādarghyamanaṃtaram\|\| 269 \|\|*

*pañcaratnena gandhena śaṃkhenārghyaṃ pradāpayet \|*  
*caturasraṃ samākīrṇaṃ caturdikṣvadhṛtairjanaiḥ \|\| 270 \|\|*

261-270. After consecrating the figure, it should be presented to Varunadeva with respect. Thereafter, the yearly function should be celebrated for the same. The sacrificial pillar should be made of the wood of Asoka tree, Catechu, Sala tree, Pipala wood, apple tree, myrobalan tree with red flowers, Mimusops elengi and Messyaferrea. The yupa should be covered with a cloth reciting the hymn “уupаt raksai.” Then the yupa should be consecrated digging the earth. Then touching it with the hand, one should utter- “sthirobhaveti.” The yupa stambha should be lodged on the north eastern side of a tank, to the south of the palace, and the centre of the dwelling place should always remain firm. Thereafter, keeping silent, the yupa pillar should be carried in a boat and crossing the northern side, it should be established over a rock or a stone slab reciting the mantra - “Apyayasveti.” The homa should be performed thereafter. Three offerings should be made for the boat uttering- “Angadaya svaha” besides “Bhaumaya svaha.” The offerings should be made accordingly. In the absence of fried paddy, the scented curd and honey should be used for the performing of the homa uttering-“Kurmaya namah, Prthivyai namah, Svahet" and the offering should be made. Then five gems (panca-ratnas), scent, together with arghya should be offered turning it into a square, which should not be touched by a human being.

## \|\| 2.40.271-276 \|\|

*kalpayedropayettatra hastaṃ dattvā paṭhedidam \|*  
*sthiro bhaveti maṃtreṇa gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet \|\| 271 \|\|*

*cakraṃ sadarpaṇaṃ dadyānnāgadaṃḍaśiro gataḥ \|*  
*vidyudatra ca kartāraṃ gra(gna?)haduḥkhaharipriyam \|\| 272 \|\|*

*evaṃ cakraṃ pūjayitvā śūlaṃ nāgāṃśca pūjayet \|*  
*uccairdhvajaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā na nāgeti ca saṃpaṭhet \|\| 273 \|\|*

*gāyatrasveti maṃtreṇa paṭheddvāradvayaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*dikpālebhyo baliṃ dadyānmāṣabhaktaṃ guḍaudanam \|\| 274 \|\|*

*raktapuṣpānvitaṃ kṛtvā praṇipatya prasādayet \|*  
*sahasraṃ vā dhanaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine\|\| 275 \|\|*

*tato bhojyaṃ sasarpiśca sahiraṇyaṃ yathāvidhi \|*  
*ikṣusvastītikāṃ dadyājjale mātṝśca pūjayet \|\| 276 \|\|*

271-276. Thus by imagination and establishing it, one should place his hand over it and then speak out “Sthirobhaveti.” Thereafter, its adoration should be completed by offering fragrant flowers etc. Thereafter, a cakra should be offered to it with a mirror, which is lodged over the end of the Nagadanda, having a lustre like the lightning, the performer, the form of misery, besides being the favourite of Hari. Thus completing the adoration of cakra, the Nagas or the serpents should be worshipped. Then unfurling the flag above, the hymn- “Na nageti” and “Gayatrasveti” should be repeated twice, the food for the Dikpalas comprising of sugarcane balls mixed with rice, besides the black grams should be respectfully offered. The wealth in thousands should then be given over to a Brahmana having a family. Then offering ghi, besides food with gold and other eatables should also be given as also the Svastika, performing the worship of mothers.

## \|\| 2.40.277-285 \|\|

*maṃtharāṃ vasutāṃ kāṃtāṃ rākṣasīṃ ca piśācikām\|*  
*nāginīrnāgaputrāṃśca madhye saṃpūjayettataḥ \|\| 277 \|\|*

*pūrṇāṃte ca pṛthagdadyāllājādyairguḍamiśritaiḥ \|*  
*indro balavatī svāhā yaśo balavatāmapi \|\| 278 \|\|*

*bṛhatpakṣāviśaṣo'yaṃ madhyame ca kanīyake \|*  
*bṛhaspate ca indrāya tava devalatāmiti \|\| 279 \|\|*

*svāheti juhuyātpaścātpraṇītāṃ cālayettataḥ\|*  
*kaniṣṭha pakṣe prāsāde tathā caiva jalāśaye \|\| 280 \|\|*

*mandare toraṇasyaiva viṣvaksenaṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*ārāme ca tathā setau viśeṣaḥ pañcamo dvijāḥ \|\| 281 \|\|*

*pūjāṃtareṇa yaḥ kasya japenmantrasahasrakam \|*  
*stutiṃ samāpya vidhivadimaṃ maṃtramudāharet \|\| 282 \|\|*

*sarvasattvebhya ucchiṣṭamapi tajjalamuddhṛtam \|*  
*iti paṭhitvā puṣkariṇījalaṃ haste gṛhītvā jale kṣipet \|\| 283 \|\|*

*tato jalamātṛbhyo nama iti jalamātṝḥ prapūjayet \|*  
*trailokye yāni sthānāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|\| 284 \|\|*

*teṣāmāpyāyanāyaitajjalamutsṛjyate mayā \|*  
*mātre tu kṛtametatte jagadānaṃdakārakam \|\| 285 \|\|*

277-285. Then the offering of fried paddy mixed with sugarcane balls to Manthara, Vasuta in the centre, Kanta, Raksasi, Pisacika, Nagini and sons of the Nagas should be separately given the offerings of sugarcane balls mixed with fried paddy. This is the special provision of Brhatpaksa. During the central and the Kaniyapaksa, the mantra- “Brhaspate ca Indraya, Tubhyam and Devalatayai Svahiti” should be recited and the offerings should be made. Thereafter, the creator should be operated upon. The Kanistha-paksa, palace, tank, the temple and the garden, and while constructing of the bridge, the image of Visnu is particularly made over the torana. After the completion of the worship, while reciting the mantras, the prayer is sung in an appropriate manner. Thereafter, reciting the hymn-“Sarvasattvebhya ucchistamapi tajjala-muddhrtam” the water of the step-well should be carried in land and then dropped in the water. Thereafter, mothers should be worshipped. “Similarly, displaying the same type of humility, all the mobile and immobile living beings in the world, for their increase I am dropping the water. Therefore, this water poured for the sake of the mothers should bestow welfare over the entire universe.”

## \|\| 2.40.286-291 \|\|

*śivāya sarvabhūtānāṃ sadā pāhi jalāśayam \|*  
*pibaṃto hyavagāhaṃtaḥ sukhinaḥ sarvajaṃtavaḥ \|\| 286 \|\|*

*jalaṃ viśvopakārāya kṛtametanmayā sadā \|*  
*kīrtistiṣṭhatu me devāścirāya dharaṇītale \|\| 287 \|\|*

*tvatprasādānmahābhāga nāgarāja namo'stu te \|*  
*ye'tra kecidvipadyaṃte svakarmaphalabhojanāḥ \|\| 288 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ doṣairna lipye'haṃ svaṃsvaṃ gamamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*nārāyaṇo jagatprāṇaḥ sarvakāmapradāyakaḥ \|\| 289 \|\|*

*āpeyā mātaraḥ saṃtu jagatāṃ vṛkṣayonayaḥ \|*  
*apāṃpate rasāyātra yādasāmīśvara prabho \|\| 290 \|\|*

*varuṇāsyāsane kīrtiṃ sanātana namostu te \|*  
*tattoyaṃ nidhivaddadyāddakṣiṇārthaṃ dvijanmane \|\| 291 \|\|*

286-291. For the welfare of all the living beings, this waters tank should be protected for all times to come. Let all the living beings be comfortable by using the water of this tank for the purpose of drinking and bathing. О all the gods, for the benefit of the entire world, I have erected this tank. Therefore, let my glory be spread in this world for all times to come. О highly fortunate king of serpents, because of your grace, I have been able to complete this work. Therefore, О king of the serpents, salutation to you. Because of the effects of the deeds of my earlier births, the one, who died at the beginning of this task, I should not be made responsible for all the same because all the living beings have to reap the reward of their own deeds. Narayana is the life of the whole world and fulfils all the desires. Such of the jivas emerging on earth as the tree, should be satisfying the mothers. О lord! You are the leader of the mobile and immobile beings, you are the seat of Varuna, you are the form of my glory, besides being eternal, salutation to you. The said water should be given over to the Brahmanasas daksina.

## \|\| 2.40.292-296 \|\|

*suvarṇaṃrajataṃ dadyādanaḍvāhaṃ payasvinīm \|*  
*dadyāddhenudvayaṃ paścātkuryādbrāhmaṇatarpaṇam \|\| 292 \|\|*

*vahnipūjāṃ puraskṛtya mantreṇa prāśayettataḥ \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ dāpayedarghyaṃ tato devaṃ prasādayet \|\| 293 \|\|*

*biṃbamudrāṃ padmamudrāṃ nāgamudrāṃ pradarśayet \|*  
*vaiśvānarā iti ṛcā pūjāṃ kṛtvā vivarjayet \|\| 294 \|\|*

*yaste prāṇāñjapanpaścātprakuryādatha candanam\|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ paścāttaḍāgasya śṛṇu dvijāḥ \|\| 295 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānpurataḥ kṛtvā vedaghoṣaṃ samuccaran \|*  
*mahāmaṅgalapūrveṇa praviśedbhavanaṃ sudhīḥ \|\| 296 \|\|*

292-296. The Brahmanas should be pleased by giving gold, silver, bullocks and milk-giving cow. After the worship of the Fire-god, the prasana ceremony should be performed. Arghya should be offered to the manes, besides the gods should be pleased. The mudras or the postures like Bimba-mudra, Padma-mudra and Naga-mudra should be displayed. Thereafter, the Vaisvanara Rca should be recited. Then the hymn - “Yaste pranana” should be recited. The sandal paste should be applied and circumambulation should be done. О Brahmanas, I am now speaking out the process of establishing a tank, you please listen to the same. The Brahmanas who are the reciters of the Vedas, whose recitation echoes in the sleep, such Brahmanas should be made to enter the house, with the reciting of the welfare mantras. Thereafter, they should be adored in the house. The food should be served to them . The destitute and the cowards should also be served with food. The arghya should be offered to the Sun-god.

## Chapter 41. Description of Middle Path

## \|\| 2.41.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*saptāgniṣṭomako nāma dyuttamaḥ kathito vidhiḥ \|*  
*madhyame madhyamaphalaṃ kaniṣṭhe tu kaniṣṭhakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*adhunā madhyamaṃ vakṣye vidhiṃ śāstrānusārataḥ \|*  
*yathāvibhavayāgena yatkartavyaṃ nareṇa vai \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sadyodhivāsakalpena yūpādīnadhivāsya ca \|*  
*pūrvasminneva divase daivajñakathite śubhe \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Suta said - I have already explained the Agnistoma-yajna of seven types in which the medium type of performance bestow the mediocre type of outcome and for the smallest type of yajna, one earns the small merit. Presently, I am speaking out according to the procedure of the scriptures, the method of the middle path, which has to be performed by the people according to his worth, being their deity. I am discussing on the same, which you please listen. During the auspicious muhurta as prescribed by the astrologers, the adhivasa rites for kalpa and yupa should be performed.

## \|\| 2.41.4-6 \|\|

*muhūrte kalaśaṃ sthāpya saṃgṛhya gaṇanāyakam \|*  
*sthāpayetprathamaṃ yūpamā pohiṣṭhetimantrakaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śanno devyāstataḥ paścādgandhadvāreti gaṃdhakam \|*  
*śrīsūktena tato dadyātpuṣpaṃ dūrvākṣataṃ tataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa tato dhūpaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*ye gṛhṇāmīti ca ṛcā pūjāyāṃ sthāpayettataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. During the auspicious time, the lord Ganapati should be worshipped, consecrating the pitcher. Initially, during the auspicious muhurta, the kalasa should be consecrated and Ganapati should be worshipped. Thereafter, the yupa pillars should be created, reciting the mantra-“Apohista iti”Thereafter, reciting the hymns- “Sannodevi and Gandhadvareti", the scent should be offered. Then reciting the Sri sukta, the flowers, durva grass and unbroken rice should be offered. Thereafter, uttering the hymn- “Kanda it," incense should be offered and reciting the Red grhndm^ the adoration should be completed.

## \|\| 2.41.7-11 \|\|

*vivāhavidhinā sarvaṃ kāryaṃ caivādhivāsanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sarvameva prayuṃjīta taḍāgādiṣu paṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*adhivāsya taḍāgādīnācāryādīṃśca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saṃgṛhya gaṃdhapuṣpādyairdhūpairdīpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prabhātasamaye nityaṃ nirvartya śāstrataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tataḥ kuryānmātṛpūjāpuraḥsaram \|*  
*alaṃkṛtya yathāśakti ācāryādīṃścaredbudhaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śṛṇuyātpaścime bhāge maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ \|*  
*madhyadeśe samudbhūtaṃ yajñapātraṃ praśasyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. Following the procedure for the performing of the marriage, the adhivasa rites are required to be performed completely. Therefore, by all the groups of Brahmanas, that while consecrating a lake, the adhivasana of Acarya should also be completed, offering the scented material, incense and lamp in an appropriate manner. At the time of getting a son, the daily routine should be completed first and the adoration of Mothers should be made. Thereafter, the Vrddhisraddha should be performed. A learned person should decorate the Acarya and other Brahmanas as per his means, and should be lodged in the western side of the mandapa because he is considered to be quite praiseworthy, having been bom in the Madhyadesa.

## \|\| 2.41.12-13 \|\|

*atha vā tatra deśīyaṃ guruṃ vā śrotriyodbhavam \|*  
*yajñe pradhānadvitīyamṛtvigācāryameva hi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vaitānakalpe saṃpannaṃ śaktikalpaparāyaṇam \|*  
*nigamajñānasaṃpannaṃ yajñe pātraṃ praśasyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Or otherwise, the dweller of the same country having been bom in the high race or being a preceptor, should be engaged as the performer of the yajna as the second Acarya. Because the learned people well-versed in the performing of yajna or the one who could perform the Sakti-kalpa successfully or the one who is well-versed in the performing of the yajna, is said to be quite praiseworthy for the performing of the yajna.

## \|\| 2.41.14-15 \|\|

*patnīhīnamaputraṃ ca śyāvadaṃtamadaṃtakam \|*  
*gaṇānāṃ yājakaṃ ṣaṃḍhaṃ svagotraṃ parivarjayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*apradhāneṣu yajñeṣu dānayajñeṣu sattamāḥ \|*  
*niyojayetsvagotraṃ ca home nasti vicāraṇā \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. A person having no wife, no son or having black teeth, who performs the yajnas of ganas or a eunuch, belonging to the same gotra should not be engaged for the said task and should be discarded. О excellent Brahmanas, for the small yajnas or homas, there is no need for considering the engaging of the Brahmanas of one’s own gotra as the performers of yajna.

## \|\| 2.41.16 \|\|

*kuśapratikṛtau cāpi tataḥ svargaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*dhanamādau ca saṃśodhya tato yajñaṃ samācaret \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In case none is available, then the figure of kusa grass should be made, which leads one to the heaven. Therefore, the yajna should be started after carefully taking into account one's financial position

## \|\| 2.41.17-19 \|\|

*ayājyayājanodbhūtaṃ pallavaṃ vyavahārake \|*  
*kūṭasākṣyeṇa pallave sthāpyahārakameva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*devasvaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca lohavikrayaṇaṃ dhanam \|*  
*havirvikrayaṇaṃ kṛtvā putrabhāryā divikrayī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*niṃditāni purāṇeṣu yatkṛtaṃ tatra tatphalam \|*  
*yajñasadmani viprāṃśca na śrāddhānbhojayetkvacit \|*  
*na dadyāttasya dānaṃ ca yāvannaiva samāpayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. The performing of the improper yajna, the one who indulges in misconduct, who appears as a false witness, stubborn, one who tells a lie, one who sells the Vedas, gods and Brahmanas, the iron, havi, the son and the wife, have been denounced in the Puranas. Therefore, all such types of people are unfit for the performing of the yajnas. The Brahmana should not be served food for sraddha in the yajna-mandapa. Till such time the yajna is completed, the Brahmanas should not be given the charities or daksina.

## \|\| 2.41.20-23 \|\|

*brahmannācāryamukhyosi saṃsārāttrāhi māṃ vibho \|*  
*tvatprasādādguro yajñe prāpnuyāṃ mānasepsitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ciraṃ me śāśvatī kīrtiryāvallokāścarācarāḥ \|*  
*prasīda tvaṃ maheśāna pratiṣṭhākarmasiddhaye \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraka \|*  
*jñānāmṛtapradācārya viṣṇu rūpa namo'stu te \|\| 22 \|\|*

*brahmāsanasamudbhūtaṃ prakāśitadigaṃtaram \|*  
*tvaṃ ca jāṃbūnadaprakhya yajurveda namostu te \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. One should say- “O Brahmanas, you are my prominent Acarya, besides being a preceptor. By your grace, I shall surely meet with success. Till such time all the mobile and immobile beings last in this world, upto that time my grace and glory should continue. О Mahesa! For the success of the task, your pleasure is essential. You are the most respectable of all the living beings, you rescue the people from the ocean of the universe. You bestow the nectar of the knowledge. Therefore, О Acaryal You represent the form of Visnu. Salutation to you. You emerged out of the seat of Brahma, salutation to you. You illuminate the entire universe. You possess the glory of the Jambunada gold. You represent Yajurveda, salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.41.24-26 \|\|

*praphullakamalodbhāsi bhāsvarāṃbarabhūṣita \|*  
*prakīrṇaśāstrasaṃbhāra vidhijña praṇatosmi te \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jvaladvaiśvānaraprakhya dhūmaśyāmālitānana \|*  
*ṣaḍaṃgavedatattvajña ṛtviṅ mokṣaṃ samācara \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tatastūryādighoṣeṇa puraskṛtya dvijottamān \|*  
*yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ praviśedyāgamaṇḍapam \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Like the blossoming flower you feel delighted. You are adorned with clothes, with lustre, you are well-versed in all the scriptures and with the smoke of the yajna fire, you are shining. You bestow moksa to the person whose face has been clouded with the smoke of the yajna fire. You are well-versed in all the six angas of the Vedas and bestow moksa to the performer of the yajna.” Thereafter, with the sounding of the musical instruments, together with the wife of the yajamana, one should enter the yajna-mandapa following the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.41.27 \|\|

*svasthāne sthāpayedviprānmakhe dharmairyathākramam \|*  
*pūjayedgandhamālyādyairgaṃdhādyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. All should be seated at the proper place in the yajna mandapa. Then they should be adored with beautiful fragrance, flowers, garlands and other costly things.

## \|\| 2.41.27-32 \|\|

*svasthāne sthāpayedviprānmakhe dharmairyathākramam \|*  
*pūjayedgandhamālyādyairgaṃdhādyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yajñe suvitate yosau pūjyate puruṣaḥ sadā \|*  
*nārāyaṇasvarūposau yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ kuru \|\| 28 \|\|*

*makhaśreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu yena maṃtrāḥ suvistṛtāḥ \|*  
*yajurvedārthatattvajña brahmarūpa namostu te \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yajñeṣu sākṣī sarveṣu vedavedārthatattvavit \|*  
*ṛgvedajña mahāprājña viśvarūpa namostu te \|\| 30 \|\|*

*māṃgalyaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ brahmarūpiṇam \|*  
*siddhaye mama yajñasya namāmi śivarūpiṇam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*pālayaṃti diśaḥ sarvā vidiśaśca tathā imāḥ \|*  
*dikpālarūpiṇaṃ vipraṃ yajñasiddhyai namāmyaham \|*  
*pātayeddakṣiṇaṃ jānu vikirānvikirettataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

27-32. A person, who is always respected in the vast yajna, such a person who is the form of Narayana should bestow success to me in this yajna. Salutation to the Brahmana, who has been vastly eulogised in the mantras of Yajurveda and is well-versed in the interpretation of the relevant hymns. He is the witness to all the yajnas, who knows well the meanings of the Vedas, master of the Rgveda, such a learned person is the great yajna and form of the universe. Salutation to him. He is the foremost of the welfare deeds, you are eternal, everlasting, you are the form of Siva the lord of welfare for my yajna. I offer my salutation to you. The Dikpalas, the gods or directions who maintain all the directions as well as the sub-directions, who are represented in the form of a Brahmana, I offer my salutation to them for the success of my yajna.

## \|\| 2.41.33-40 \|\|

*trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivāḥ sarve rakṣāṃ kurvaṃtu tāni vai \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vedyāvedīti maṃtreṇa paṭhedvediṃ praṇamya ca \|*  
*saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairimaṃ maṃtramudā haret \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yājanaṃ yajamānaśca śreyasā tatra yājakaḥ \|*  
*idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpoyaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 35 \|\|*

*aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ saṃpūjya gaṇa nāyakam \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca dvitīyakalaśe yajet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*maṃḍalaṃ caiva viṣṇurvai dvārakārūpamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*tena tvāṃ pūjayāmyadya svargaprāptiṃ kuruṣva me \|\| 37 \|\|*

*pūrvādidikṣu kalaśānsaṃsthāpya ca trayaṃtrayam \|*  
*ardhapādasavarṇena nirmitaṃ tāraṇaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*gaṃgāmṛttikayā yukte pallave saṃnivedayet \|*  
*maṃdaraṃ kalpayitvā tu gopīnāṃ ca kulena vā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kalaśopari saṃsthāpya maṃdaraṃ saṃprapūjayet \|*  
*syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ pṛthigvidhaiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

33-40. Thereafter, seating himself, kneeling the right leg and after making the charities, he should thus speak - “All the mobiles and immobiles of the three Iokas, besides the jivas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara should kindly provide protection to me. Thereafter, reciting the hymn- “Vedyavediti”, he should offer his salutation to the Vedika on the pedestal and then adore it offering the scents, flowers and other things. Thereafter, reciting the hymn viz., “Yajamana Yajaka”, the dividing activities should be completed. Besides the incense, arghya, padya etc. should be offered. In the north-east direction, the Gananayaka in the form of a kalasa or a pitcher should be adored appropriately. With the other kalasas, Brahma and Vasudeva should be adored. This mandala exists with lord Visnu and the city of Dvaraka, because of which I am adoring you. I must achieve the heaven. There torana of three each should be made in the eastern and other direction. Its arghyapada should be of a single varna. This has been prescribed by the learned people. The tender leaves with the sand from Ganga should be poured into it. Then one should imagine the building of mountain over it. Then the kalasa should be placed over the same. In this adoration, reciting the the hymn- “Syonaprthivi,” the scent and the flowers should also be offered.

## \|\| 2.41.41-43 \|\|

*evaṃ dakṣiṇadigbhāge navatolakanirmitam \|*  
*prādeśamātralohaṃ tu raupyeṇa gaṃdhamādanam \|*  
*mṛdā saṃghaṭanaiḥ paścātkadācana ṛcā yajet \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kadācaneti maṃtrasya sūrya ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ sūryo devatā gaṃdhamādanaprītaye viniyogaḥ \|*  
*uttare toraṇatodreraṃguṣṭhadvayamānake \|*  
*tolakadvayamānena yavānāṃ piṣṭakopari \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pūjayetpārśvakalaśe dhātrādīnpūrvadikkramāt \|*  
*śrīsūktenaiva mantreṇa yajedvijayasaptakam \|*  
*pūjayetparayā bhaktyā gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādinā \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Sumanta is the Rsi for Syonaprthvi iti, Jagati is the meter and Нага is the god. The Viniyoga is offered for the pleasure of Mandara. Similarly, on the southern direction, the Gandhamadana mountain is erected in iron or silver. This is finally plastered with clay and the Red Kadacana should be recited. Surya is the Rsi for Kadacana hymn, Tristupa is the meter, Surya is the god and the Viniyoga is performed for the pleasure of Gandhamadana. Towards the north of torana etc., an image of two tolas should be consecrated over the barley flour. Then reciting the hymn- “Apyayasveti", the kalasa at the back should be adored with ghi etc. Kardama is the Rsi for this hymn, Jagati is the chanda or meter, $acl is the god and for the pleasure of Suparsva, the Viniyoga is performed. Then reciting the SrlsUkta with utmost devotion and offering the scent, flowers, unbroken rice etc., Vijayasapta should be adored.

## \|\| 2.41.44-46 \|\|

*aṃbāaṃbiketi maṃtrasya nalina ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śaṃbhurdevatā jaya prītaye viniyogaḥ \|*  
*gāyatryā pūjayeddakṣe paścimaṃ kalaśadvayam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*bhadraṃ caiva subhadraṃ ca prayataḥ saṃyajedbudhaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*vidhāyārghyādikaṃ caiva dharmādimaṃḍale yajet \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. Nalina is the Rsi for Amba-ambiketi, Gayatri is the meter, Sambhu is the god and the Viniyoga is offered for the sake of japam. The pitchers which are both established in the south and the west, should be adored reciting the Gayatri mantra. Visvamitra is the Rsi for the Gayatri hymn, Savita is the god for the same. The Viniyoga is performed for the sake of Vinaya or humility. A learned person should worship bhadra and abhadra, making all the efforts. Antaka is the Rsi for Manonna Brhati is the meter, besides Nirriti is the god. The Viniyoga is performed for the sake of the goblins. Then the rite of the purification from the goblins and the nyasa should be performed in an appropriate manner. Then under the process of ardhavidhdna together with the dharma-mandala, the gods should be adored.

## \|\| 2.41.47-50 \|\|

*madhye ādhāraśaktyādīnvaruṇaṃ madhyato yajet \|*  
*pūrvādikramataścaiva indrādīnkuladevatāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*pārśvadvaye karṇikāyā brahmāṇaṃ cāpyanantakam \|*  
*svaiḥsvairmaṃtrairyathoktaiśca balibhirgandhapuṣpakaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*indrābhiṣekamaṃtrasya vādyaṃ gāṃdhārarāgakam \|*  
*agnestejosīti vādyaṃ rāgaṃ caiva varāṭakam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*ghanakaṃṭakamasyāpi vācyaṃ rāgaṃ tu gurjaram \|*  
*rakṣodhipasya saṃgrāmaṃ vaitālaṃ vādyamucyate \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. The basic Sakti and others are to be lodged in the middle, Varuna is to be placed in the east. Thereafter, the gods like Indra and the family deities are to be placed, respectively, who should be adored in a chronological order. In both the hind parts of the pericarp, Brahma and Ananta should be adored with their respective mantras, offering the ball, scent, flowers etc. while making use of the abhiseka-mantra of Indra, the tune of Gandhara raga with music, using the hymn agnestejositi. In the battle with the Raksasas the use of Vaitala raga with musical instruments has been prescribed.

## \|\| 2.41.51-67 \|\|

*nāṭakākhyaṃ tathā rāgaṃ varuṇasyāpi me śṛṇu \|*  
*vādyaṃ rājyābhiṣekākhyaṃ rāgo vasaṃtasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*īśasya naṃdighoṣākhyaṃ vādyaṃ rāgotha kāmadaḥ \|*  
*suvarṇaṃ duṃdubhirvādyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kathito budhaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*rāgo devī vasaṃtaśca anaṃtasya nibodha me \|*  
*vādyaṃ gāṃdhāratārākhyaṃ rāgaścāṅgāravātakaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*some ghoṣe bhavedvādyaṃ jaleśasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*mālavākhyo bhavedrāgaḥ patrāgreṣu mahānapi \|\| 54 \|\|*

*svaiḥ svairdharmaiśca saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇe pṛthivīṃ yajet \|*  
*syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*maṇḍapasyottare bhāge mahādevaṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*namo vṛkṣebhya ityādi naivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*gaṃdhapuṣpādibhirbhaktyā bhūtāni parito yajet \|\| 57 \|\|*

*vetālāśca piśācāśca rākṣasāśca sarī sṛpāḥ \|*  
*asmātprayāṃtu me sthānādye cānye vighnakārakāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*madhuyuktaṃ pāyasānnaṃ varuṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*pītaṃ cālohitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śuddhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhūmrakam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*pītaṃ śuklaṃ tathā citraṃ śvetamannaṃ yathākramam \|*  
*balayastu digīśānāṃ grahāṇāmapi tāñchṛṇu \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kṣīraudanaṃ graheśāya śuklānnaṃ śaśine smṛtam \|*  
*lohitānnaṃ ca bhaumāya budhāya kṣīraṣāṣṭikam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*pītamannaṃ devaguroḥ śukrasya sitataṃdulam \|*  
*māṃsaudanaṃ śanerjñeyaṃ rāhośca kṛṣṇa bhaktakam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*dhūmravarṇaṃ tu tāmraṃ tu bhaumasya kṣīraṣāṣṭikam \|*  
*piṣṭakānnaṃ śivasyoktaṃ bhūtānāṃ māṣabhaktakam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*evaṃ baliṃ vidhāyātha agre kuṃbhaṃ niveśayet \|*  
*pradeśadvyaṅgulaṃ nāma aṣṭottarasahasrakam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*bahvaṃgulakaṃ vinyasya vinyasya kalaśopari \|*  
*niśāvāṃchtisūtraiśca saṃveṣṭya pihitaṃ tathā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*śarāvaṃ ca punardadyādvardhanīṃ pratipūjayet \|*  
*astrāya phaḍiti maṃtreṇa dhyātvā devaṃ jaleśvaram \|\| 66 \|\|*

*sūktaṃ yajedyathāśakti śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet \|*  
*kuṃḍeṣu vinyasennāgānaṣṭau pūrvādiṣu kramāt \|\| 67 \|\|*

51-67. I am going to speak out the play of Varuna and the related raga. You please listen. Their raga is known as Rajyabhiseka and the Vasanta-raga is related to them. Similarly, the Vadya of Siva is known as Nandighosa and the connected tune is Malava-raga. Collecting according to one’s own dharma reciting the hymn syonaprthiviti, the adoration should be completed using different materials. In the northern part of the mandapa where lord Mahadeva is consecrated, he should be worshipped. Then reciting the mantra- “Namo Vrksebhya iti, the eatables should be offered. He has two arms carrying the mountain Sumeru and a trident. Concentrating one’s mind on Uma and Mahesvara he should be offered fragrant flowers etc. reciting the mantra- Namo vrksebhyah, which has Brahma as the god, Gayatri as the meter, besides the moon as the god. The Viniyoga is to be performed for the pleasure of the moon. Thereafter, one should say that the Vetalas, Pisacas, Raksasas, snakes or crawling insects, besides other creatures who cause obstructions should be kind enough to leave the place and go somewhere else. Thereafter, the payasam with honey should be offered to Varunadeva and the cereals of yellow, red, black, white and of smoke colours, besides the things of yellow, white, mixed colours or white food should be given over to the Dikpalas as the offerings. Thereafter, I am speaking about the planets. You please listen. The sun should be offered the white payasam , the white food for the moon, the eatables of red colours for Mars, payasam for Budha, besides the Sali boiled rice. For Brhaspati, the yellow food is to be offered, white rice for Sukra (Venus), cooked rice for Saturn and the cereals of black colour for Rahu. For Mars particularly, especially the food of smoke and copper colour should be offered, besides the Sail rice. The pudding should be given over to lord Siva. For the goblins, the cooked black grams should be given. Thus making the offerings in an appropriate manner, one should enter his house. The entry is of two angulas, which could be a thousand and eight angulas or of many angulas. Keeping it over the kalasa , its neck should be covered with nisa-sutra. Then it should be adored appropriately. Reciting the hymn - Astrayaphat, one should meditate upon the god Jalesvara and worship. Thereafter, the recitation of sukta should be carried out as per one’s means and all the eight Nigas should be established starting from the eastern one.

## \|\| 2.41.68-77 \|\|

*anaṃtaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ mānenāṃgulamātrakam \|*  
*nirmitaṃ kāṃcanenaiva saptavartikayā sudhīḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*rājataṃ vāsukiṃ nāgaṃ yajetpatrāṃtare punaḥ \|*  
*pādamātrepi cāṃguṣṭhamātraṃ tāmrasya bhakṣyakam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*paṃcāṃgulaṃ tolikayā lohaṃ karkoṭakaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*vartikābhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbṛhatparvapramāṇakam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*śaṃkhapālaṃ kuśamayamardhapādena nirmitam \|*  
*aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ raktena nāgaṃ tālakamātrakam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhe tolakaṃ paścātpadmanāgaṃ punaryajet \|*  
*tolakārdhapramāṇena aṃgulaṃ parimāṇataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*kuryācchailamayaṃ samyagyathāvallakṣaṇānvitam \|*  
*mahāpadmasya vai tasya pūrvamānena nirmitam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*dhyātvānaṃtaṃ caturbāhuṃ śuklasaptaphaṇānvitam \|*  
*dakṣiṇordhvakare śaṃkhamadhicakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*vāmordhve tu gadāpadmaṃ madhyasthāne vyavasthitam \|*  
*sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktamevaṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhi \|\| 75 \|\|*

*sahasraśīrṣeti maṃtreṇa pūjayitvā baliṃ haret \|*  
*lājaiśca tilasaṃmiśraiḥ kṣīrayuktaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*caturvidhaṃ tathā śvetaṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutam \|*  
*svakīyaṃ prajapettatra āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā \|\| 77 \|\|*

68-77. Towards the east, the figure of Ananta of the size of an angula should be made by a learned person with the seven wicks of gold The worship should be concluded with the same. Thereafter, the Naga Vasuki is to be worshipped. The figure of Vivasvan should be made of copper of the size of a foot or a big toe. The figure of Karkotaka, the serpent should be made in iron which should have wicks of the length in the knuckle of a finger numbering sixteen. He should then be worshipped. Then the figure of Kusamaya Naga known as Sankhapala of red complexion should be made of the size of a thumb, who are of the leaf of tala tree. Then the figure of the serpent Padma should be made weighing a tola in weight of the size of an angula. Then the figure of mountain weighing half a tola with all the usual symptoms should be made. It should have four hands, white complexion, having seven hoods. The two upper hands should hold a sankha and a cakra. In both the left hands, he should hold a gada and a lotus. He should be seated in a central place and should be adorned with all the ornaments. Such a lord Ananta should be meditated upon appropriately. The hymn- Sahasrasirsapurusa should be worshipped offering the fired paddy and payasam mixed with sesamum seeds. Then four types of offerings should be made for him of white stuff reciting the mantra Apyayasveti.

## \|\| 2.41.78-80 \|\|

*piṇyākaṃ nāgajihvāṃ ca tathā sarjarasaṃ dadhi \|*  
*balayastasya nirdiṣṭāstakṣakaṃ lohitaṃ yajet \|\| 78 \|\|*

*padmaṃ ṭaṃkaṃ dadhānaṃ ca bhujābhyāṃ nāgasattamam \|*  
*manonnā iti maṃtreṇa ājyaṃ somo baliṃ haret \|\| 79 \|\|*

*karkoṭakaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ pītavastradharaṃ yajet \|*  
*pañca nadya iti ṛcā viṣṇukrāṃtā balirbhavet \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. The offering of solid linseed drugs, Naga-jihva, juice of Sarja tree and curd are required to be used as the offerings. After adoring the figure of serpent Taksaka of red colour, lotus and a miserly person, the best of the Naga should be adored reciting the mantra-“Manonna iti” the offering of the ghi should be made. Thereafter, the serpent Karkotaka having two arms, clad in yellow garments should be adored reciting the hymn- “Panca-nadya iti, holding red lotuses in both the hands. Then the offering of Visnukranta should be made.

## \|\| 2.41.81-88 \|\|

*pītavastraṃ ca kuliśaṃ yājayettu caturbhujam \|*  
*bhujābhyāmūrdhvabhāge tu raktapadmadharaṃ harim \|\| 81 \|\|*

*śarkarā kuṣṭhakaṃ caiva balistasya prakī rtitaḥ \|*  
*dvibhujaṃ śaṃkhapālaṃ ca śaṃkhābhaṃ śaṃkhadhāriṇam \|\| 82 \|\|*

*padmāsanasthaṃ padmābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ ca varaṃ vibhum \|*  
*dhruvakṣitidhruvosīti maṃtrābhyāṃ pūjayetpṛthak \|\| 83 \|\|*

*ghaṭaudanaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ padmaṃ ca valayastayoḥ \|*  
*svagṛhyoktena vidhinā saṃsthāpyāgniṃ kuśaṃḍikām \|\| 84 \|\|*

*kṛtvā ājyasya saṃskāraṃ vāruṇaṃ śrapayeccarum \|*  
*juhuyādaṣṭa bilvāni digīśānāṃ ghṛtena vai \|\| 85 \|\|*

*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādgrahāṇāṃ ca trayaṃtrayam \|*  
*susamidbhirghṛtamadhu payobhirmiśritaiḥ pṛthak \|\| 86 \|\|*

*palāśasamidhaṃ paścātpratiṣṭhāmāhutitrayam \|*  
*śivasya paramānnena juhuyādaṣṭasaṃkhyayā \|\| 87 \|\|*

*madhvājyaguḍamiśrābhirlājābhirjuhuyātpṛthak \|*  
*lājānyathoktaṃ vitaredekaikāmāhutiṃ kramāt \|\| 88 \|\|*

81-88. Narayana clad in yellow garments holds the red lotus flowers in the both the upper hands. The four-armed Hari Narayana should be worshipped after which the offering of sugar and medicinal plant castus specious should be made with reverence. The twoarmed lord Sankhpala carrying a conch in his hand besides the lotus, is seated over a lotus seat. He should be adored reciting the hymns-“Dhruvaksiti dhruvositi” separately. Then a pitcher with cooked rice and medicinal shrub should be given to him in offering with reverence. Thereafter, with the Grhayoga process, the fire should be consecrated and the offerings with ghi, panca-varuni and eight of wood apple fruits should be made. Similarly, for the Dikpdlas, the offering of ghi should be made for each one of them. For the planets, three offerings should be made for each one of them in the fire ignited with sacrificial sticks. The ghi, honey and payasam mixed with other things should be poured in the fire separately for each one of the gods. Thereafter, the offerings of plasa sticks should also be made thrice. For lord Siva, the excellent eight offerings should be made in the burning fire Besides honey, fried paddy mixed with sugarcane balls should also be poured in the fire as offering for each one of the gods.

## \|\| 2.41.89-100 \|\|

*sthālīpākasya juhuyādekaikāmāhutiṃ punaḥ \|*  
*varuṇaṃ ca samuddiśya rudraṃ sarvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 89 \|\|*

*vāstoṣpataya iti maṃtreṇa pañcagavyo bhavettataḥ \|*  
*syonāpṛthivīti maṃtreṇa vrīhimṛttikayā punaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*vṛṣānna iti maṃtreṇa kayā na iti vai punaḥ \|*  
*kuśamūlamṛdā caiva catuṣpathamṛdā tathā \|\| 91 \|\|*

*imā rudreti maṃtreṇa śrīśceti ṛcā punaḥ \|*  
*padmakhaṇḍasya ca mṛdā snāpayetsusamāhitaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa tathā puṣpodakena ca \|*  
*tīrthodakena kṛṣṇena triraktena triśītakaiḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*pañcaraktena raktānāṃ mṛdā kaiśca kuśodakaiḥ \|*  
*svarṇatoyaiśca kalaśairaṣṭottaraśatena tu \|\| 94 \|\|*

*taijasairmārttikaiścāpi aṣṭāviṃśatibhistathā \|*  
*yathāśakti tu saṃsthāpya kuṃkumaiścandanairapi \|\| 95 \|\|*

*annaṃ lipya tato mṛdbhirdadyāccaiva yathākramam \|*  
*surāsureti ca ṛcā vastrayugmena veṣṭayet \|\| 96 \|\|*

*dhvajaṃ ca dhanunāgeti gaṃdhadvāreti gomayam \|*  
*dhūrasīti tato dhūpaṃ hotre cāhutidīpakam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*siṃdhosīti ca siṃdūraṃ svabhāve raktakaṃ tathā \|*  
*mālatīkusumaiḥ kṛtyairnāgānsaṃsthāpayettataḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*dhārābhiḥ śatapuṣpābhirgandhatoyādibhistathā \|*  
*athavāśvatthapatreṣu vaṭapatreṣu vā sudhīḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*rocanā kuṃkumairvāpi saṃlikhya tatra pūjayet \|*  
*prakṣipettatra muktā hi kalaśeṣu vinikṣipet \|\| 100 \|\|*

89-100. Thereafter, out of the boiled eatables made for Rudra and Varuna, an offering should be made for each one of them reciting hymn- “Vastospataya iti” and pancagavya should be offered. Then reciting the hymn- “Syona-prthiviti”, the earth from paddy and reciting- “Vrsanna-iti” the earth from the roots of kusa grass of the crossings, besides reciting the hymn-“Ima Rudreti” and “Srisceti” one should take bath with the dust of padma-khanda. Again reciting the hymn- “Tadvisnoriti”, the water of flowers, the water of holy places, three red and three cold, sand of red colour, water of kusa grass and water of gold should be collected in a hundred and eight kalasa or pitchers and the deity should be bathed with the water of these pitchers. Thereafter, the saffron and the sandal paste should be offered as per one’s means, besides the paste. Thereafter, the food should be offered. Then, reciting the hymn-“Surdsureti”, the clothes should be made to cover the deity. Thereafter, uttering the mantra- “Dhanu-nageti”, the flag should be offered. Reciting the hymn- “Gandha-dvareti” the cowdung should be offered. Reciting the hymn- “Dhurasiti the incense should be offered. The offering for the hotel should be made with the lamp. Uttering the hymn- “Sindhoriti” the saffron should be offered. Then according to one’s own liking, the flowers of red colour or jasmine flowers should be offered. Consecrating the Nagas, they should be worshipped with seven flowers, fragrant water, leaves of pipala or banyan tree making the figures of serpents over them with saffron. Then they should be adored appropriately. Thereafter, they should be placed in a pitcher.

## \|\| 2.41.101-111 \|\|

*maṃḍapasyottaredeśe śayyāṃ nirmāya śobhanām \|*  
*rājataṃ vāruṇaṃ tasyāṃ pādamātreṇa nirmitām \|\| 101 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ saṃsthāpya tataḥ puṣkariṇīmapi \|*  
*svarṇapādena ghaṭitāṃ caturasrāṃ suśobhanām \|\| 102 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ sampūjya varuṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*yathāśakti tato gāṃ ca saṃbhave pañcaviṃśatiḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*suvarṇaṃ rājataṃ caiva dhānyaṃ vāso varāṭakam \|\| 104 \|\|*

*nāgayaṣṭiṃ samādāya kiṃciduttaragāṃ tathā \|\| 105 \|\|*

*tatokṣatāya bhaumāya kṛtvā cājyāhutitrayam \|*  
*lājāndadhisamāyuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu guḍaṃ tathā \|\| 106 \|\|*

*kṣīraṃ ca piṣṭakaṃ caiva śaṣkulīgandhapuṣpakam \|*  
*paṃcāmṛtaṃ pañcaratnaṃ garbhe dadyātsamāhitaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*ācāryo yajamānena susannaddhaiśca bhṛtyakaiḥ \|*  
*gaṃgājaleśayormadhye paṃcaghoṣapuraḥsaram \|\| 108 \|\|*

*avāpya ca tato yaṣṭiṃ sthiro bhavati vairivā \|*  
*dhruvaṃ dhruveti maṃtreṇa yaṣṭimā maṃtrayettataḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

*yajñapriyāsi devi tvaṃ sarvavighnavināśinī \|*  
*pāhi māṃ sarvapāpebhya ātmanā tvaṃ sthirībhava \|\| 110 \|\|*

*ityāmaṃtrya yajeccaiva gāyatrīṃ ca paṭhettataḥ \|*  
*vanaspateti viḍavāmiti maṃtraṃ japetpunaḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

101-111. Towards the north of the mandapa, a beautiful bed should be arranged. Its legs should be made of silver. The figure of Varuna and the thumb like figure of a tank which should be square in shape studded with gold, should be placed over the bed and worshipped Thereafter, the figure of Puskarini should be given over to Varuna. Thereafter, according to one’s means, twenty five or one cow only should be given over in charity. Then gold, silver, paddy, clothes, small shells etc. should also be given in charity. Then accepting the pillar erected in a tank besides an uttaraga, three offerings should be made for Mars. Then the fried paddy, curd with ghli honey, ghi, mudra, pudding, fried cake, scent, flowers, pancamrta and panca-ratna should be offered The Acarya with his associates besides the Yajamana should enter the Gariga as well as the ocean sounding the five types of tunes, the yasti should be consecrated reciting the hymn- “Dhruvam dhruveti,” inviting her at the same time. Then with folded hands, he should pray to her- “O goddess, you are the favourite of the yajna and remove all the obstructions. Therefore, because of your firm position here, you save me from all the sins.” Thus inviting her, he should worship her at the same time. Then he should adore her reciting the Gayatri hymn.

## \|\| 2.41.112-119 \|\|

*punarāgatya tāṃ vediṃ nirmathya varuṇaṃ prabhum \|*  
*tathā puṣkariṇīṃ caiva vardhanīṃ kalaśodaraiḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

*aniṣṭaṃ mārjayennāgānuddhṛtya kalaśaṃ tathā \|*  
*pāṣāṇābhyaṃtaraṃ kṛtvā gomayaiḥ parilipya ca \|\| 113 \|\|*

*varuṇaṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ ca jalamadhye vinikṣipet \|*  
*namostviti ca mantreṇa baliṃ dadyācca pāyasam \|\| 114 \|\|*

*nirmanthettatra yo nāgaḥ sthāpayettu yathāvidhi \|*  
*śrāvayettamimaṃ maṃtramatra saṃnihito bhava \|\| 115 \|\|*

*atra svāmī bhavānnāga rakṣaṇīyastvayā janaḥ \|*  
*gāyatreṇa tvā chaṃdasāmīmantraṃ saṃśrāvayetpunaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ purato nikṣipeddiśi \|*  
*pidhāya nāgarājānamṛcābhyāṃ parisūtrakaiḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*sanniruddhyāśu saṃsthāpya baliṃ dadyā dvidhānataḥ \|*  
*lājaudanaṃ manastasya yajjāgrata ṛcā japet \|\| 118 \|\|*

*evaṃ bhūriti maṃtrai svaiḥ svaireva tu pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|*  
*svāsu dikṣu ca saṃsthāpya pūja yecca prayatnataḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

112-119. Thereafter, reaching the pedestal, churning Varuna and Puskarini for the subjugation of the evil, the kalasa which is for the rescue of the Nagas, should be established in the stones. Then it should be plastered with cowdung from all the sides. Thereafter, the water of Varuna and Puskarini should be dropped in it Thereafter, uttering the mantra — “Namostviti the offering of payasam should be made for the same. Then the churned Naga should be properly established and he should utter- “Matrasamnnihito bhavati” Then he should say- “O Naga, you happen to be here. Therefore, you protect all of them.” Thus, offering the meek prayer, he should utter the hymn- “Gayatrena tva chhandasami.” Thereafter, the adoration should be performed offering the fragrance, flowers and the Nagaraja should be covered by the Reds and should be bound with the thread from all the sides. Then the offerings of fried paddy and j rice should be made appropriately, reciting the hymn- “Yajjagrata iti.” Thus the earth goddess should be adored separately in all the directions and consecrated.

## \|\| 2.41.120-139 \|\|

*pūrvabhāge puṣkariṇyāṃ haritābhaṃ savajrakam \|*  
*halagrahīta maṃtreṇa nyasya lājāhutiṃ kule \|\| 120 \|\|*

*trātāramiti maṃtreṇa agnau vinyasya mauktikam \|*  
*manaḥśilāṃ pravālaṃ ca agnimīḍeti saṃpaṭhet \|\| 121 \|\|*

*vaiśvānareṇa mantreṇa paṭhallāṃjāhutiṃ punaḥ \|*  
*dadyādye te śatamantreṇa paścime kāṭikaṃ nyaset \|\| 122 \|\|*

*śālibījena sahitaṃ kayā na iti maṃtrakam \|*  
*varuṇasyo iti maṃtreṇa dadyādaṣṭādaśāhutīḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*uttare rocanāṃ kanyāṃ tathaiva gaurasarṣapam \|*  
*kuṃkumena samāyuktaṃ kuvidaṃḍamṛcā paṭhan \|\| 124 \|\|*

*vinyasya tena maṃtreṇa pradadyādāhutiṃ punaḥ \|*  
*aiśānyāṃ maṃdrakaṃ raṃgamī śāvā iti saṃpaṭhan \|\| 125 \|\|*

*saṃsthāpyājyāhutiṃ dadyāttamīśāna ṛcā punaḥ \|*  
*āsadyairmaṃtrasaṃyuktairdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yajet \|\| 126 \|\|*

*varuṇātmakaṃ tato dhyātvā tato nīrājanaṃ paṭhet \|*  
*jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā paṭhejjñānāmṛtaṃ stavam \|\| 127 \|\|*

*dharmo vaṃśaṃ tataḥ kuryādutsargāṃte vidhīyate \|*  
*tato devīṃ punaḥ kṛtvā dattvā puṣpāñjalitrayam \|\| 128 \|\|*

*sarvasattvopakārāya samutsṛjettu vai janam \|*  
*utsṛṣṭaṃ sarvasattvebhyo dṛśyate jalamūrjitam \|\| 129 \|\|*

*ramaṃtīṃ sarvabhūtāni snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ \|*  
*varuṇaṃ ca tato devaṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ ca nikṣipet \|\| 130 \|\|*

*jale varuṇamantreṇa matsyādīnprakṣipettataḥ \|*  
*pakṣiṇaśca śubhāṃstatra bhekaṃ kūrmaṃ ca kardamam \|\| 131 \|\|*

*śaivālaṃ prakṣipeccaiva dakṣiṇāṃ tadanaṃtaram \|*  
*suvarṇaṃ dhānyaratnaṃ ca ācāryāya pṛthagdadet \|\| 132 \|\|*

*ṛtvigbhyaśca pṛthagdadyādyathāvittānusārataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyo gāyanebhyo vasubhyaśca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 133 \|\|*

*nityaṃ samāpya vidhivaddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥ \|*  
*dadyādarghyaṃ ca sūryāya hastāsa iti saṃjapan \|\| 134 \|\|*

*tataḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaṃ saṃveṣṭya kṣīradhārayā \|*  
*prāsādapakṣe prāsādamārāme atha maṃḍapam \|\| 135 \|\|*

*śatādhidhārayā śaktyā trivāraṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*vikīrya lājakusumaṃ vrīhīścaiva kapardakān \|\| 136 \|\|*

*tūryaghoṣeṇa mahatā tato viprapuraḥsaram \|*  
*yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ praviśetsvagṛhaṃ punaḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

*tato gṛhārcanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānatha bhojayet \|*  
*kumārīśca kumārāṃśca dīnāndhakṛpaṇānapi \|\| 138 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇaṃ tato dadyādvipramuddiśya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

120-139. Towards the eastern side of Puskarini, an offering of green colour should be made together with vajra, fried paddy should be made and the “Halagrahita” hymn should be recited. Thereafter, placing a pearl in fire together with cord and bitumen, reciting the hymn - “Agnimideti", the offering of fried paddy should be poured in the fire once again. Thereafter, uttering the hymn- “Те satam,” the kativastra (lion cloth) should be offered in the west and the seeds of sali rice should be offered reciting the hymns- “Kaya na ti,” “Varunasyo” and eighteen offerings should be poured in the fire. Thereafter, gorocana, a girl, white mustard and saffron reciting the hymn-“Kuvidandamiti” should be established. The pouring of the offerings should then be started. In the north-east direction, while reciting the hymn- “Rangamisava iti,” mandala should be established. Then reciting the mantra-“Tamisara iti” the offerings of ghi should be poured in the fire. Thereafter, pouring the offering of ghi, reciting the hymn-“Asadyariti” and concluding the worship of lord Narayana, meditate on Varuna and then the arati should be offered to him. Thereafter, one should worship him reciting a stotra. At the end of the performance, with a desire of increase in the dynasty, three hand cups full of flowers should be offered to the goddess, saying- “You kindly protect a person like me for the welfare of all the living beings of the world. With this in view, I have offered the oblation of water for the welfare of the entire people of the world. Salutation to the goddess who will drink or bath in this water.” Thus offering the prayer to the goddess, Varunadeva should be dropped in the Puskarini. Thereafter, in the water of Puskarini (tank) reciting the Varuna-mantra, the fish should be released in that water. The birds which are beneficial for the fish should also be set free besides frogs, tortoises, mud and aquatic plants. Thereafter, offering the daksina in the water, the Acarya should also be given gold, paddy, gems as daksina separately. To those who are instrumental in getting the yajna performed or the Brahmanas should also be given daksina separately and individually. In addition to them, the singers and Vasus should also be given the daksina individually. After the concluding of the daily routine, the purnahuti or the final offerings should be made. Then reciting the mantra- “Hastasa iti, the oblation should be offered to the Sungod. Then in the sequence of the circumambulation, the milk should be poured in hundred of streams and one should go round the palace, the orchard and the Brahmanas thrice. Thereafter, one should spread fried paddy, flowers, vrihi rice, shells, with the sound of musical instruments play at that time. Then making the Brahmanas to lead, yajamana should enter his house with his wife. The Brahmanas should then be served with food at the time of entry in the house. The young girls and the boys, the poor, blind and destitutes should also be served with the food to their satisfaction. The image of Narayana should be offered to a Brahmana.

## Madhyaparva Part 3

## Chapter 42. Description of establishing of a grove

## \|\| 2.42.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ārāmādau viśeṣo yo vakṣyate'tra mayādhunā \|*  
*maṃḍalaṃ kārayitvā tu caturasraṃ samaṃ śubham \|\| 1 \|\|*

*aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ tatra nāthaṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*madhyame kalaśe pūjā grahāṇāṃ ca tataḥ param \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said - I am going to speak out the special features of establishing a grave. An auspicious and square mandala should be made. A. pitcher for the main deity should be consecrated in the north-east direction. Thereafter, the other planets should be worshipped by placing a kalasa in the middle.

## \|\| 2.42.3 \|\|

*svadikṣu dvāradeśe tu paścimadvāradeśayoḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ cāpyanantaṃ ca madhyato varuṇaṃ yajet \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Thereafter, in the doors of the other directions, towards its back and the western side, Dikpala, Brahma and Ananta should be lodged with Varunadeva, who should be worshipped.

## \|\| 2.42.4 \|\|

*varuṇaṃ codakumbhasthaṃ bhūtaśākhāsu śobhanam \|*  
*tena cāvāhayāmi tvāṃ vibho svargāya vai bhava \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Then one should say- “Varuna who is lodged in the water of the pitcher, who is well decorated with the branches of the bhutas, is invoked by me for attaining of the heaven.”

## \|\| 2.42.5-9 \|\|

*pūrvagaṃ mandaraṃ sthāpya toraṇopari sattamāḥ \|*  
*viṣvaksenaṃ samabhyarcya arcanaṃ svargasaṃyutam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*karṇikāyāṃ vāsudevaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham \|*  
*caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmavibhūṣitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*dakṣiṇe kamalā tasya vāme puṣṭivyavasthitiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*siddhakinnarayakṣādyaiḥ stūyamānaṃ surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā viṣṇorarāṭa ityṛcā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dale saṃkarṣaṇādīṃśca vimalādyāśca nāyikāḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya dhūpadīpādyairupahārairanuttamaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. О excellent people of assembly, the temple should be consecrated towards the east. Then in order to gain the benefit of the adoration, Visvakasena should be worshipped. Like the pure crystal gem in the pericarp, Vasudeva should have four arms, holding sahkha, cakra, a club and a lotus. He should be adorned with Srivatsa mark and a Kaustubha gem at the chest. His head should be decorated with a crown. Such a Vasudeva should be worshipped with devotion and reverence. Towards his right side, Kamala should appear, while on the left side should appear the goddess Pusti. Besides Siddhas, Kinnaras, the gods and the asuras should be shown and engaged in offering prayer to him. The hymn of “Visnorarata-iti” should be recited, while adoring him. Thereafter, Samkarsana Balarama, Vimala and other damsels should also be adored offering the incense, lamp and the best of presents.

## \|\| 2.42.10-15 \|\|

*ghṛtapradīpo devasya gugguluḥ saralastathā \|*  
*dhūpo devabaliḥ kṣīraṃ paramānnaṃ ghṛtaplutam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dhyāyetsomaṃ karṇikāyāṃ dakṣiṇe padmasaṃsthitam \|*  
*śuklābhaṃ dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ keyūrādyupaśobhitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*praśasyaṃ devayakṣāṇāṃ varadābhayahastakam \|*  
*imaṃ devā iti ṛcā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pūjayecca niśānāthaṃ ghṛtabhaktaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*indraṃ jayantamākāśaṃ varuṇaṃ cāgnimeva ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*īśānaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ caiva vāyuṃ pūrvādidikṣvapi \|*  
*karṇikāyā vāmabhāge varadābhayahastakam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ ca mahādevaṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*tryaṃbakeṇa ca maṃtreṇa dadyācca ghṛtapiṣṭakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

10-15. A lamp of ghi, guggulu, incense, Devabali, payasam and the best of food cooked in ghi should be offered to the god. In the southern side of the pericarp, Somadeva should be lodged over lotus seat. He is to be of white complexion, having two arms and should be adorned with two armlets. The god is best among the Yaksas and bestows the boons. Reciting the hymn- "Imam Deva iti", the adoration should be carried out by different means and materials. Similarly, completing the worship of Moon - the lord of the night, ghi and butter milk should be offered to him. Thereafter, Indra, Jayanta, the sky, Varuna, Agni, Isana, Tatpurusa and the Wind-god should be adored in the eastern direction. Towards the left of the pericarp, lord Mahadeva with white complexion should be adored appropriately, reciting the hynm- "Tryambakam iti” The pudding fried in ghi should be offered to him.

## \|\| 2.42.16-21 \|\|

*vāsudevāya devāya juhuyādaṣṭa āhutīḥ \|*  
*paramānnena saumyasya juhuyādaṣṭaviṃśatim \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śivāya paramānnena juhuyādāhutidvayam \|*  
*gaṇeśasya tathājyena dadedekāhutiṃ budhaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*brahmaṇo varuṇasyātha ekaikāmāhutiṃ tathā \|*  
*grahāṇāṃ svoktasamidhā digīśānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 18 \|\|*

*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādājyena ca yathākram \|*  
*karālī dhūmalī śvetā lohitā kanakaprabhā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*atiraktā padmarāgā vahnijihvā prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ maṃtrāḥ krameṇaiva sādivāsāṃta bindavaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*yakārasthāśca vijñeyā aṣṭasvaravibhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*ghṛtamadhvājyasiktābhirhomayecca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 21 \|\|*

16-21. For the excellent lord Vasudeva, eight offerings of the best of food should be offered. For Budha, twenty eight offerings should be poured in the fire and two for Siva. For Ganesa, a single offering of ghi should be poured in the fire. Similarly, a single offering should also be poured in the fire for Vanina as well as Brahma. A single offering should be dropped in the fire for each one of the nine planets separately. Karali, Dhumali, Sveta, Lohita, Kanakaprabha and Padmaraga are the tongues of the Fire-god. Their respective mantras have already been spelt out. All of them are decorated with yakara. They should be individually offered ghi, honey and the fried items.

## \|\| 2.42.22-26 \|\|

*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāddattvā caiva samāhitaḥ \|*  
*agnīṣomaṃ tathendraṃ ca pṛthivīmantarikṣakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sthālīpākena juhuyānmadhukṣīrayavānvitam \|*  
*ekaikāmāhutiṃ teṣāṃ samuddiśya pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yāvakairgaṃdhapuṣpādyairarcitvā saparāvakam \|*  
*japasva tvaṃ mahābhāga śraddhayā caiva vāgyataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jāpako vidhinānena prajapettatra ruddhakam \|*  
*maṅgalaṃ paramānnaṃ ca saurasūktaṃ tathā japet \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tataḥ saṃmṛjya vidhinā snāpayitvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*yūpaṃ garbhe vinikṣipya tatra kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

22-26. Thus making a single offering to each one of them with the eatables already prepared for Agni, Vyoma, Indra, Prthivi and the space, a single offering should be made for each one of them individually, mixed with honey, payasam and barley. They should also be adored offering pudding, fragrance etc. Then observing silence, the performer should perform Japam with devotion. Again the one who performs the japam following the same process, should recite the sukta, which is essential. Thereafter, sprinkling water and bathing appropriately, the intelligent one should establish a yuра-stambha in the womb.

## \|\| 2.42.27-34 \|\|

*dhvajānāropya prāṃteṣu dadyātsomaṃ vanaspatim \|*  
*ko'dāditi paṭhitvā ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ karṇavedhanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sūcyā sutīkṣṇayā kāryaṃ dvipātre vāmadakṣiṇe \|*  
*navagrahāṇāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ yāvakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*piṣṭakaṃ ca pṛthagdadyātkumārībālakeṣu ca \|*  
*niśāraṃjitasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya ca sacūrṇakam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pradadyāddohakaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*prāśayeccaiva tānvṛkṣānimaṃ mantramudāharet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vṛkṣāgrātpatitasyāpi ārohātpatitasya ca \|*  
*maraṇe vāsthibhaṅge vā kartā pāpairna lipyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dhenuṃ suvarṇaṃ dhānyaṃ ca ācāryāya pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*dattvā ca ṛtvije dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dhānyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadyādghṛtabhojyaṃ saśarkaram \|*  
*iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsadasyāya tathaiva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*adhikalaśaṃ samānīya snānaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā caivāniśaṃ kuryāddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

27-34. After raising the flags in the various provinces and offering the Soma-vanaspati, uttering the words, Kodaditi should perform the rite of Karnavedha in two tree leaves with a sharp needle. Thereafter, the pudding or sweet ball should be distributed for the pleasure of the nine planets to the little girls or the children. With the threads coloured in the turmeric colour, they should be coiled round the trees performing the dohaka and prasana rites, offering the prayer, while climbing over the forepart of the tree in case one breaks a bone or meets with the death, then the person who planted the tree should not be made to face the related sin. Thereafter, for paying daksina to the Acarya a cow, gold and cereals should be offered. For the performer of yajna gold, silver, cereals for Brahma, besides ghi with sugar should be given in food. His other associates should also be rewarded appropriately. Then the main pitcher should be brought, one should take bath appropriately and the final offerings should then be made.

## \|\| 2.42.35-50 \|\|

*sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ prokṣya trivāraṃ kṣīradhārayā \|*  
*saṃveṣṭya triścaturvāraṃ brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

*gṛhaṃ vrajettato vipraiḥ kuryāccaiva gṛhārcanam \|*  
*taṃtau viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi varā evedamityṛcā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*balaṃ kāmaṃ hayagrīvaṃ mādhavaṃ puruṣottamam \|*  
*vāsudevaṃ dhanādhyakṣaṃ tato nārāyaṇaṃ yajet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*dadhibhaktaṃ baliṃ dadyātpañcagavyasamudbhavam \|*  
*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā dakṣiṇe pṛthivīṃ yajet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*śuddhakāṃñcanavarṇābhāṃ varābhayakarāṃ śubhām \|*  
*maṃḍūkasthāṃ ca dvibhujāṃ sarvālaṅkārasundarīm \|\| 39 \|\|*

*syonā pṛthivīti mantreṇa pūjayitvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyātsaśarkaram \|\| 40 \|\|*

*vāmato viśvakarmāṇaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham \|*  
*śūlaṭaṃkadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ saṃyajedupacārakaiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*viśvanniti ṛcā taṃ ca baliṃ ca madhu piṣṭakam \|*  
*dadyājjapecca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*madhupāyasayuktena homānaṣṭau vidhāya ca \|*  
*ekaikaṃ homayetpaścā tpṛthivīhomakarmaṇi \|\| 43 \|\|*

*samutsṛjya tataḥ setumimaṃ mantraṃ paṭhettataḥ \|*  
*picchile patitānāṃ ca ucchritenāṃgasaṃgataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*pratiṣṭhite dharmasetau dharmo me syānna pātakam \|*  
*setorasya prabandhasya śraddhayā parayā tathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ye cātra prāṇinaḥ saṃti rakṣāṃ kurvati setavaḥ \|*  
*vedāgamena yatpuṇyaṃ yathaiva hi samarpitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*gartaṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnaṃ saṃsthāpyaṃ tadanantaram \|*  
*saṃsthāpya ca tato yūpaṃ saṃpūjya ca yathāvidhi \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ācāryāya tato dadyādiṣṭāṃ ca varadakṣiṇām \|*  
*pūjayeddvijadāṃpatyaṃ lājābhiḥ paripūjitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*poṭikāṃ ca tataḥ śayyāṃ dadyādiṣṭārthasiddhaye \|*  
*setau vṛkṣa sthitā ye syū ropayetkadalīṃ śubhām \|\| 49 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ pārśvadvayepyevamārāme ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 50 \|\|*

35-50. Washing the gate with the water mixed with herbs, then making three or four mandalas with the stream of milk, the worship of the house should be carried out. Some points of special attention are being spoken by me. The adoration of Bala, Kama, Hayagriva, Madhava, Purusottama, Vasudeva, Kubera and Narayana should be made reciting the mantra- “Vara evedamiti" and the offering of pancagavya should be made. Thus performing their worship in an appropriate manner, then the image of twoarmed goddess earth, mounted over a frog, adorned with all the ornaments and extremely beautiful and reciting the mantra-“Syonaprthiviti", the rite should be concluded. Thereafter, the offering of the milk, honey and sugar should be made to her. Then Visvakarma standing to the left, having the complexion of pure crystal, holding a chisel and a trident and who looks peaceful, should be adored with suitable offerings. Then reciting the hymn- “Visvanniti", the honey and pudding should be offered. Then Кusmanda and Purusa-suktas should be recited. Thereafter, the payasam mixed with honey should be poured in the fire eight times. Thereafter, an offering should be made for all the deities at the end. Then discarding the setu (bridge), he should pray- “By slipping or falling from the height, I should gain dharma because of erecting the bridge and not of a sin. I have built up the bridge with devotion. A living being who is lodged here in the form of the bridge should earn merit by safety and Vedagama”. Thereafter, digging a pit, a уuра-stambha should be fixed with five gems in an appropriate manner. It should be worshipped thereafter. And the appropriate daksina should be given over to the Acarya. The Вrhmana couple should then be worshipped with devotion. A bed with a bundle should also be given to the couple for achieving success in one’s own desires. Thereafter, the banana trees should be planted on both the sides of the bridge as well the orchard.

## Chapter 43. Special features of the cow’s pastures

## \|\| 2.43.1-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*gopracāraṃ punarvakṣye viśeṣaṃ tatra me śṛṇu \|*  
*yajedviṣṇuṃ sala kṣmīkamupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*upacāraiśca brahmāṇaṃ rudraṃ caiva karālikām \|*  
*varāhaṃ somasūrye ca mahādevaṃ yathākramam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*homaṃ caiva yathā viṣṇoḥ kamalāyāstrayaṃtrayam \|*  
*ājyena kṣetrapālānāmanyeṣāṃ madhumiśritaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāllājādiṣu pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*samutsṛjya vidhānena yūpaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Suta said- I am repeating about Go pracara and you should know about its special features. Visnu with Laksmi should be adored by various means. Thereafter, using various means, the adoration of Brahma, Rudra, Karalika, Varsha, the moon, the sun and Mahadeva should also be carried out. Then as prescribed for Visnu and Laksmi, three offerings of payasam should be given. For Ksetrapalas, the fried paddy mixed with honey should be given individually. Thereafter, the уuра pillar should be fixed and then worshipped.

## \|\| 2.43.5-7 \|\|

*trihastamāttraṃ racitaṃ kuryānnāgaphaṇānvitam \|*  
*ropayedekahastena garbhe homaṃ prayojayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*lājāsaṃyuktavidhinā viśveṣāmiti sañjapan \|*  
*nāgādhipataye tadvadacyutāya tṛtīyakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*bhaumāyeti caturthaṃ ca tato yūpaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*mayi gṛbhṇāmīti sampūjya yūpaṃ ca rudradaivatama \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. It should be made of three cubits in size resembling a Naga. A hand should be inserted in the womb and the process of homa should be started uttering the verse- “Vitvesamiti" and the offering of the fried paddy should be made. Reciting the verse - “Mayi grbhnamiti", the adoration should be made. The offering should then be made for god Rudra.

## \|\| 2.43.8-16 \|\|

*saṃpūjya rudraṃ pañcāṃgaṃ dhānyaṃ vastraṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*ācāryāya tathā hotre anyeṣāmiṣṭadakṣiṇām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*gopracāre ca śaileyaṃ yūpaṃ hastadvayānvitam \|*  
*pañcaśīrṣānvitaṃ kuryāddhastamātraṃ praropayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yūpaṃ ca caitravṛkṣaṃ ca kuṇḍalīmaṭhapīṭhikām \|*  
*saṃspṛśyācamya vai viprāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati \|\| 10 \|\|*

*caturhastapramāṇena śatakuṇḍena saṃmitam \|*  
*tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhena aṣṭakāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhūmau ratnaṃ ca saṃsthāpya imaṃ mantramudāharet \|*  
*śivalokastathā gāvaḥ sarvadevasupūjitāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gobhya eṣā mayā bhūmiḥ sampradattā śubhārthinā \|*  
*evaṃ nivedayedyastu gopracāraṃ samāhitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|*  
*yāvaṃti tṛṇagulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate \|*  
*pūrve sīmāṃ nibadhnīyātkṛtvā vṛkṣasya ropaṇam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*setuṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ paścimeṃgāraropaṇam \|*  
*uttare khānayetkūpaṃ tasya sīmāṃ na laṃghayeta \|\| 16 \|\|*

8-16. Worshipping Rudra with Pancanga, the Acarya should be given the appropriate cereals, clothes and the desired daksina. Besides the due amount of daksina should also be given to the performer of Нота. In the Go-pracara karma, yupastambha has to be made of stone block, which should be two cubits in height with five peaks. Inserting a hand in the womb, it should be consecrated and worshipped. О group of Brahmanas, with the touching of the kundali-matha-pithika, one gets purified with the sipping of water and performing of the pranayama. It should be of the size of four cubits in Satakunda. Establishing the gems in the earth, a mantra should be recited. £ivaloka and the cows are adorable by all. Therefore, I have donated this land for the benefit of the cows. In this way, a person who donates land to be used for the grazing of the cows or as the pasture land, he getting relieved of all the sins is honoured in Vi$nuloka. Till such time the grass remain on earth, the person who donates (the land for the use of cows and for the number of days upto which the grass grows on earth), the donator enjoys bliss in the heaven for thousands of years. Demarcating the limit on the eastern side, the trees should be planted. The bridge should be erected in the south. The fire altar should be built in the west and the well should be dug in the northern side. The limits should not be crossed.

## \|\| 2.43.17-21 \|\|

*tataḥ sahasradhārāṃ ca śasyena paripūritām \|*  
*pradadyādvā tato viprāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nagaragrāmapūrve vā uttare paścimepi vā \|*  
*na kuryādagnidigbhāge dakṣiṇāṃ vā tataḥ śubhām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*gopracāraṃ khanedyastu vāhayedvā kathaṃcana \|*  
*kulāni pātayatyāśu brahmahatyāśca viṃdati \|\| 19 \|\|*

*svargaṃ nayati gocarma samyagdattaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|*  
*yāvattṛṇāni tadbhūmau saptasaṃkhyāni saṃkhyayā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge viṣṇulokānna taccyutiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. О Brahmanas, thereafter, the one who donates the grassy land with a thousand streams, he is relieved of all the sins. Towards the east of the city or a village, in the southern or the south-east direction, the pasture land should not be located. The digging or excavation of the cow’s pasture land should not be done.
