A person who digs up the cow’s grazing land, his entire family gets destroyed, besides earning the sin of Brahmahatya. A person who donates land for the grazing of the cows with daksina, he achieves the heaven. The line upto which the land remains green, he earns heaven for the period multiplied by seven. Thereafter, he never falls from Visnuloka.

## \|\| 2.43.22-38 \|\|

*mahāyāgāvasāne ca yo na tarpayati dvijān \|*  
*nirarthakaṃ tasya karma prayāsaphalamātrakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vṛṣotsargā vasāne tu pradadyādyo mahīṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*na yāti viprāḥ pretatvaṃ tasmādviprādamatsarāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tatra mānaṃ pṛthakcaiva śṛṇutātra samāgatāḥ \|*  
*amānena dadedyastu narakaṃ yāti rauravama \|\| 24 \|\|*

*gavāṃ śataṃ vṛṣaścaiko yatra tiṣṭhatyayaṃtritaḥ \|*  
*tadgocarmeti vikhyātaṃ dattaṃ sarvāghanāśanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*gopracārasya devasya brāhmaṇasya ca bho dvijāḥ \|*  
*yāvatkālāvadhe sīmā atīte nāsti pātakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*maṇḍapaṃ pūjayetsūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam \|*  
*homastila guḍābhyāṃ ca aṣṭāvaṣṭau pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dehi meti ca mantreṇa vinyasenmaṃḍapopari \|*  
*yatnasiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śulkaghaṭacatuṣṭayam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*samutsṛjejjapetpaścātsauraṃ sūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam \|*  
*vaṭapatre tu saṃlikhya citraṃ nirmāya vā punaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dikpālānsaṃnyasetsvāsu svāsu dikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhenmaṃtrāniṃdrādīnāṃ yathākramam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya ātmano vibhavāya ca \|*  
*vajrahasto mahendra tvaṃ dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 31 \|\|*

*bho vahne meṣavāhastvaṃ catuḥśṛṃgavirājita \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yama tvaṃ dakṣiṇāśeśa mahāmahiṣavāhana \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 33 \|\|*

*mañcastho rākṣasendrastvaṃ khaḍgapāṇirmahābalaḥ \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 34 \|\|*

*vārirāṭ dhvajahasto'si pavano mṛgavāhanaḥ \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 35 \|\|*

*dhanādhyakṣo gadāhastaḥ piṃgākṣo naravāhanaḥ \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ādidevosi devānāṃ kartā hartā maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*anaṃto nāgarājo yo dharāmuddhṛtya tiṣṭhati \|*  
*anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatasrātumarhasi \|\| 38 \|\|*

22-38. A person who does not please a Brahmana at the conclusion of the great yajna, his entire performance becomes infructous. О Brahmanas, at the conclusion of Vrsotsarga, when a person donates land, he does not have to fall in the preta-yoni. For this purpose, separate procedure for honour has been prescribed, which is going to be revealed by me, you please listen. Because in case the said performance is ended without the honour, one has to fall in the Raurava hell. A country in which a bull wanders with a hundred cows freely, it is called Gocarma which destroys all the sins. О Brahmanas, a Brahmana who speaks in favour of the cows, when crosses the limits in the prescribed time, he does not earn any sin. After adoring Vasudeva with the Sun-god, eight offerings of sesamum seeds and sugarcane balls should be poured in the fire. Then reciting the hymn-“Dehi meti” vinyasa should be done over the mandapa and four pitchers of white colour should be donated. Besides the Saura and Vaisnava saktas should be recited. Thereafter, the figures of Dikpalas should be drawn over the banyan. Dikpalas should be established in their respective directions. Thereafter, prayers with the folded hands should be offered to Indra and the other gods saying- “O Mahendra, for the establishment of Dharma and for the increase of my own fortunes, you have been declared to be the protector of Dharma with vajra held in your hand. О fire god, you have a sheep as your vehicle and are decorated with four peaks. Therefore, you protect the protectionless mandapa. О Yama, you are the lord of the southern direction. You have a he-buffalo as a vehicle. You kindly protect the otherwise protectionless mandapa. О valorous lord of Raksasas, you are lodged over the stage holding a sword in your hand, you also protect this shelterless mandapa with dharma. О lord Vayu, holding a flag in your hand, you are the lord of water and have a stag as your vehicle. You also protect this protectionless mandapa. О lord Kubera, you have the yellow eyes and hold a gada in your hand. You have a human as your vehicle. You are the lord of riches. You also protect this protectionless mandapa with dharma. О lord Mahesvara, you are the creator as well as the destroyer of the universe besides being the eternal lord, you protect this protectionless mandapa with dharma. O Ananta! The king of serpents, who carries the burden of the earth, should protect this protectionless mandapa.

## \|\| 2.43.39-42 \|\|

*caturṇāmeva varṇānāṃ sthityarthaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām \|*  
*prītaye vāsudevasya evaṃ maṇḍapamutsṛjet \|\| 39 \|\|*

*bhagne stambhe tṛṇe jīrṇe punastṛṇapradāpane \|*  
*sthāpane ca tathaivāsya pratiṣṭhā syādyathākṣayā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ghātāpāyādidoṣeṇa mriyaṃte yadi jantavaḥ \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tu dharmo me syānna pātakam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*mānuṣāḥ paśavo ye ca nivasantīha maṇḍape \|*  
*svasti cāstu sadā teṣāṃ tvatprasādātkila prabho \|\| 42 \|\|*

39-42. For maintaining of all the animals and birds and for the pleasure of lord Vasudeva, the mandapa should be gifted. At the breaking of a pillar or its getting shattered, for the restoration of the same its consecration remains unaffected. This should be stated. With any type of injury or with obstruction or at the death of the blemished features, the dharma is regained with the performing of the consecrating rites. I should earn the merit and not the blemish. All the animals and human living in this mandapa, let them all meet with welfare always.”

## \|\| 2.43.43-60 \|\|

*tatastriguṇasūtreṇa sutrāmāṇeti vai ṛcā \|*  
*saptadhā veṣṭayitvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ saṃprakāśya ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*upānahau tathā chatramācāryāya nivedayet \|*  
*maṇḍape bhojayedviprāṃsteṣāṃ dadyādyathepsitān \|\| 44 \|\|*

*dīnebhyaśca pṛthagdadyādgṛhaṃ viprapuraḥsaram \|*  
*praviśettūryaghoṣeṇa prakuryācca gṛhārcanam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*evaṃ prapāyāṃ vijñeyo viśeṣo varuṇaṃ vrajet \|*  
*vāsudevena sahitaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sthālīpākavidhānena prakuryāddeśikottamaḥ \|*  
*ācāryāya gṛhaṃ dadyātparicchedasamanvitam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ṛtvije tāmrapātraṃ ca jalapūrṇaṃ ca dhānyakam \|*  
*dikpālāndvāradeśe tu kūpayāge viśeṣataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ nāgarājānaṃ dvārapālau ca paścime \|*  
*yajenmantraiḥ pṛthagdevānmantrairebhiryathākramam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*balidānaṃ vidhānena kṛtvā dadyādyathāvidhi \|*  
*patākānāmatastattvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vajrī ca dhūmalī kṛṣṇā pītā caivātha vāruṇī \|*

*kuṃbheṣu pūjayeddevānmaheśaṃ prathamaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*grahāṃśca madhyakalaśe brahmāṇaṃ ca tataḥ param \|\| 52 \|\|*

*vedikāpūrvabhāge tu uttare kalaśe śivam \|*  
*dakṣiṇe kalaśe viṣṇuṃ karṇikāyāṃ jaleśvaram \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kalaśe vidhivadbhaktyā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya vaṭapatre ca nāgānsaṃlikhya nāgajaiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yo nāgāstānpravakṣyāmi anaṃto vāsukistathā \|*  
*tathā karkoṭakaścaiva padmaśca kulikastathā \|*  
*padmaścaiva mahāpadmo mantrairebhiḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 55 \|\|*

*puṃḍarīkadalābhāsa śubhakarṇāṃtalocana \|*  
*phaṇāsahasrasaṃyukta śaṃkhābjakṛtalocana \|\| 56 \|\|*

*anaṃta nāgarājendra ihāgaccha namo'stu te \|*  
*sita kuṃdenduvarṇābha visphuradbhogamaṃḍala \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sarvanāgasya śūrasya kṛtasvastikalāṃchana \|*  
*nāgendratakṣaka śrīmannihāgaccha namostu te \|\| 58 \|\|*

*navīnajaladaśyāma śrīmankamalalocana \|*  
*viṣadarpabalonmatta grīvāyāmekaśekhara \|\| 59 \|\|*

*śaṃkhapāla iti khyāta jalādhārapratīkṣaka \|*  
*adhyakṣe nāgalokānāmihāgaccha namo'stu te \|\| 60 \|\|*

43-60. Thereafter, stretching the cord three times, reciting the mantra- “Sutramaneti”, the cord should be wrapped round the pillar. Then an umbrella, shoes along with daksina should be given to the Acarya. The Brahmanas should be thereafter served with the food of their liking. Then making the Brahmanas to lead offering of the things of their liking, the musical instruments should be played upon and creating huge sound, one should enter his own house, performing the puja as well. Similarly, the place for the free supply of water has to be established in which Varuna should be particularly worshipped. During the worship of Vasudeva, the dakina should be given, with the worship of the place in an appropriate manner. After the concluding of the relevant rites, the Acarya should be given a house and the Brahmanas should be given the vases filled with water, besides the cereals. At the time of digging of a well particularly, the Dikpalas should be made to stand at the gate, while Brahma should be made to stand to the west. Besides the adoration of Nagaraja as well as the other gods should be earned out reciting the individual mantras. They should also be given the prescribed offerings, besides the flags. I am going to speak about the same, which are known by the names of Vajra, Dhumali, Krsna, Pita, Varuni, Sighra, Gauri and Sukla. The gods should be worshipped consecrating the pitcher. Initially, the learned people should worship Mahesvara. The planets should then be worshipped in a kalasa. In the eastern part of the pedestal, towards the north, Siva is to the worshipped in the kalasa. In the kalasa lodged in the pericarp, Jaladhisvara should be worshipped with reverence and with separate means. Then the figures of serpents should be drawn over the banyan leaves including those of Ananta, Vasuki, Karkotaka, Kulika and Mahapadma. Then reciting the mantras, the worship should be concluded. They have the lustre of the lotus leaf, the auspicious eyes extending upto the ears, possessing the thousand hoods, Ananta - the lord of the Nagas, salutation to you. You grace us with your presence here. Your complexion resembles the while lotus flowers or the moon. The mark of Svastika is embossed over the hood. Such a Naga known as Taksaka, salutation to you. You grace us with your presence here. The Naga known is Samkhapala, who has the dark complexion like the fresh cloud, who possesses the grace, has the eyes resembling the lotus flower, in whose throat the venom is lodged, who always waits for the clouds, is the leader of Nagaloka, salutation to you. You kindly grace us with your presence here.

61-74. Salutation to you. О Rajendra Kulira, you are of yellow complexion, having lustre of gold, having the hoods decorated with the crescent moon, possessing all the auspicious symptoms, you bestow welfare to all the living beings. You can take to any form at will. Salutation to you. You grace the place for the success of the yajna. Salutation to Padmanagendra, who has the complexion of gold, whose vast eyes resemble the lotus leaves, whose hood is marked with five spots, having the neck like the peak, having sharp features. Let the female serpents, the N£ga girls and N5ga children feeling delighted should always accept my adoration with delight Then according to the family tradition, consecrating the fire, they should accept my adoration. Then making the offerings of ghi according to the traditions, the offering should be made for the Dikpalas. The offerings of pudding and ghi should then be made to Varuna, Siva, Surya, other planets, besides Brahma and Krsna. Thereafter, the Yupa-stambha, which is in square with a trident, should be worshipped after invoking the gams. Thereafter, the figures of the Nagas should be dropped in a well with five gems. Then reciting the mantra- “Sutra-maneti", the thread should be bound around thrice. Then the flower of the banana should be offered to Varuna. Then reciting the hymn-“Trataramiti", the costume and the rosary should be offered to the same. Then the rite of piercing the ear should be performed and while concluding the ceremony, one should thus speak- “Om adyeti” and then performing the samkalpa, one should seek fruits for all the living beings, besides flowers, leaves, several shady trees and orchards, the god of which is Vanaspati as worshipped by all appropriately. For the achieving of the fruits according to the words of the Rsis like Vedavyasa and others, for a particular Rsi of a particular gotra, I being a Sarman, discard this. Thereafter, performing celebrations, one should offer prayers with folded hands.” In case anyone falls and dies after climbing the tree, then the person who planted the tree should not earn the sin or blemish. Such a type of consecration should be made. After consecrating the yupastambha at the middle, it should be worshipped and honey, fried paddy, unbroken rice, collyrium and garland should be offered. Thereafter, the banana tree with a thread of turmeric colour should be bound around it, which should be planted there. Then the stream of ghi, together with the stream of water, should be poured. It should be decorated with the bunches of flowers and one should move towards his house.

## Chapter 44. Consecrating of small orchard

## \|\| 2.44.1-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye vai dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*amaṃḍale śubhe sthāne dvihaste'pyatha sthaṃḍile \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tatra viṣṇuṃ somaṃ samarcayet \|*  
*ācāryamātraṃ varayenniśāsūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vṛkṣānmālyairalaṃkṛtya bhūṣayedbhūṣaṇādinā \|*  
*dohadaṃ ca tato dadyātsthāpayecchatadhārayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhojayetpañcaviprānhi puratastaṃ viśeṣayet \|*  
*karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utsṛjedvākyapūrvakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Suta said - О Brahmanas, I arn now speaking about the consecrating of the small orchards. One should select an auspicious place without drawing a mandala there. Then a pedestal of the size of two cubits should be made over that land, over which a kalaka should be placed. Thereafter, lord Visnu and the Moon-god should be adored. Thereafter, the Acarya should be selected and the thread of the colour of turmeric (yellow) should be rolled around the trees, which should be decorated with the garland and ornaments. Then dohada should be offered, the trees should be planted with a hundred streams. Then the five Brahmanas should be served with the desired food and the Karnavedha rites should be performed. At the time of their uprooting, the prayer should be offered with folded hands.

*aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādanyeṣāṃ ca ghṛtena tu \|*

5-10. Then уuра-stambha should be installed in the middle region. The banana trees should be planted in all the directions. Then eight offerings should be poured in the fire. For others, a single offering of ghi should be made for each one of the other people. Finally, the purnahuti should be dropped. Then giving away the daksina, purnahuti should be dropped in the fire. О Brahmanas, I am speaking out the planting of a single or many trees. After consecrating the tree appropriately, the Brahmanas well-versed in Dharma, the gods like Dharma, Prthivi, Dikpalas, Yaksas and the Acarya should be pleased at the root of the tree. Making contribution towards the daksina, adoring the tree appropriately, oblation should be offered to the Sungod.

## Chapter 45. Description of small grove’s making

## \|\| 2.45.1-7 \|\|

*gaṃdhadvāreti tailena śrīśca teti ca candanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ kalpe brāhmaṇatrayabhojanama \|*  
*kārayetsitasūtraiśca veṣṭayeccandanokṣitaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kuṃbhe vināyakaṃ pūjya brahmāṇaṃ ca pare ghaṭam \|*  
*svadikṣu dikpatīṃścaiva vṛkṣamūle navagrahān \|\| 5 \|\|*

*maṃḍale śivamabhyarcya pīṭhapūjāpuraḥsaram \|*

1-7. Suta said- In the consecration of the Asvatha or a pipala tree, a pedestal should be erected at its base. Then it should be irrigated with the sandal paste. Thereafter, a beautiful lotus should be created. Ordinary arghya should be offered appropriately to it. On the first day and night, the hymn- “Tadvisyoriti” should be recited. After the consecration, “Kayaneti" hymn should be recited offering the fragrance. The oil should be offered reciting the verse- “Sriscteti” mixed with sandal paste and durva grass with unbroken rice. In the first kalpa, three Brahmanas should be served with food. Then the threads soaked in the sandal paste should be coiled around the pitcher and Vinayaka should be in that pitcher. Brahma should be worshipped in the other pitcher. The lords of directions should be adored in the respective directions. The nine planets should be lodged at the root of the tree. In the mandala, Siva should be adored over the seat over the pedestal. Thereafter, the dhyanam is being defined. Lord Siva is seated over a white bull having two arms, carrying a trident and adorned with all the ornaments. Such an image should be seated over the bull as according to one’s own means and he should perform the rite of bhuta-suddhi.

8-22. Then decorating the arghya vase, the seat over the pedestal should be adored and all the deities like Ganesa, Gurupada, Bhadra, Sakti in the middle, the tortoise with lotus, the serpent Ananta, Sun, Moon, Agni and other gods should be worshipped. Besides all the gods lodged in the masala should be worshipped. Again in another vase, holding a flower and making a form of a tortoise with the hand, one should meditate upon Vanina, following, the procedure detailed earlier and one should offer three vases. The madhuparka as well asana should be offered and the deity should be welcomed. After the display of the mudra or the posture, the limbs are to be adored. On the patras to the east Indra should be lodged, Brahma in the middle and Ananta in the front. On the outer parts their weapons, in the central part Rudra, Santa, Prasanta, Bhustattva, Bhuvastattva and Svastattvadi-tattva, kama, dharmadharma, Narayana in the directions, Siva and Durga in the south-west, Indra on to the rear sides besides Vinayaka, Visnu, Ganga and the sixty gods of Prthivi should be adored together with the process of Sodasapacara should be carried out. Particularly, over the mandala, the figure of Naga Ananta with five black tufts with long knots should be made. Thereafter, the white sandal paste and unbroken rice besides the flowers should be offered in worship. The performing of homa should then be started. First of all, the offerings of honey and payasam should be made for Varuna. Thereafter, a hundred and eight offerings of sesamum seeds, unbroken rice or ghi or honey, mixed with sugar should be made. Then an ahuti in ghi should also be offered to the each one of the Dikpalas. During the night, eight offerings of flowers, sesamum seeds and ghi should be made for Narayana, Siva, Durga, Ganesa and the nine planets. Besides a single offering of ghi should also be made to all of them. Again reciting the mantra - “Brahmayudhvanmiti” an offering of payasam should be made for Brahma. Then reciting the mantra- “Apohistheti”, three offerings should be made and an offering of ghi should be made for Varuna

*puṣkariṇyāsamaṃ tena nāgayaṣṭyaṃtare kṣipet \|\| 31 \|\|*

23-31. Then reciting the five hymns- “Imam varunam iti va, tadvaroma iti”, “ Varunasyottambhanamasiti, “ Yenapavaka iti” and “Vatsyayamiti” the offerings should be poured which should comprise of ghi and sugarcane balls in favour of Varuna. Then performing the offering for Varuna as per one’s own liking, the offering should be made to him. For Varuna particularly, the offerings of honey, ghi and payasam should be made. Thereafter, for the gods of the directions payasam of barley and others should be offered the ordinary payasam. For the Nagas, pudding should be offered in the form of eight ahutis. On the northern bank of Ananta, the leaves of lotus should be spread and the figure of Varuna adorned with the ornaments of eight metals should be lodged. On the eastern side, a square figure of Puskarini should be made. Then both Varuna and Puskarini should be lodged over the seat. After consecrating them, they should be worshipped. Then they should be consigned with tank appropriately and thus speaking-“Om (then uttering sankalpa) (one should speak out) according to Sruti and Smrti for the gaining of Agnistoma fruit as prescribed by Vedavyasa, in the process of consecration of this Puskarini, according to my family tradition, I am giving over this Puskarini, decorated with all the ornaments for Visnu in the form of Varuna. I belong to gotra, am SarmA and am offering the same with respect.” Thereafter, the same should be consigned in the water. Again reciting “Adyetyadi” for the achieving of many fruits of Agnistoma, I adore the god Varuna with four faces. Then I give over this tank to the excellent Brahmanas and the people of the four varnas for drinking water and having a bath with it. I belong to this gotra and my name is Sarma. I present this tank with respect to the people.” Then reaching through from middle to the northern region, the homa should be performed in the middle of it through the sacrificial priest. Then he should establish the danda or a rod, which should have been kept there already in an appropriate manner. Then reciting the Varuna sukta, the image of Varuna in silver should be tied with Nagayasta and should be put inside it.

32-36. At the same time, he should offer the prayer to the serpent Ananta at the same place, who has the lustre of lotus flower and has the eyes of blood red complexion. He should have a thousand hoods. О serpent Ananta, salutation to you. Then taking the final offering, he should give the daksina and crocodiles, fish, tortoises and other aquatic animals should be released in the tank water. Besides lotus, blue lotus and watery grass should also be planted reciting the hymns. Then three pits should be dug in the Puskarini after circumambulation. Reciting the Aditya-adhyaya the fried paddy and shells should be dropped in the water. Thereafter, hundreds and thousands of streams of milk should be poured in it. Then it should be covered with the thread of red colour. Then pleasing the destitute on the way, one should process towards his home.

## Chapter 46

## \|\| 2.46.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*nalinyāśca tathā vāpyā hradasya dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*vidhiṃ vakṣye sahāṅgena vidhānaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said- О best of the Brahmanas, I am speaking out the consecrating of a lotus pond, a step well as well as a lake. You please listen.

## \|\| 2.46.2 \|\|

*svarṇapādena mānena pūrvedyuradhivāsa yet \|*  
*āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa tathā astraiḥ śatairapi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. On the first day, an image of gold should be made and hundreds of lotus flowers should be offered to it reciting the mantra-“Apohtoheti" the adhivasa rite should be performed.

## \|\| 2.46.3 \|\|

*svamaṇḍale śubhe sthāne viśetpūrvamukhena tu \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ varuṇaṃ caiva ghaṭe saṃpūjayecchivam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Thereafter, at the auspicious place in the mandala and facing east, the kalasa should be consecrated after which Ganesa, Varuna and Siva should be worshipped appropriately.

## \|\| 2.46.4-5 \|\|

*vāgīśaṃ ca tathā viṣṇuṃ sūrye kuṃbhe samarcayet \|*  
*pāyasenāhutiṃ dadyādvaruṇāya ghṛtena ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādanyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇa ca \|*  
*balidānaṃ pāyasena utsṛjettadanaṃtaram \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Thereafter, in the Surya-kumbha, Vagisvara and Visnu should again be worshipped. For the sake of both the gods, the offering of payasam should be poured in the fire altar. Varuna should also be offered havya of ghi. Making the offering with ladle, another offering with payasam should be made.

## \|\| 2.46.6-15 \|\|

*yūpaṃ niveśayetpaścāddadyāddhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*pūrṇaṃ dadyātsavitre'rghyaṃ dattvā tu svagṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ārāmasya vidhiṃ vakṣye pratiṣṭhāvidhivistaram \|*  
*hīnārāmasya ca tathā eka vṛkṣasya ca dvijāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*araṇyamadhye pāścātye uttare vā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*maṃḍapaṃ vartulaṃ kuryādarghyahastapramāṇakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*taddakṣiṇe bhavetkuṃḍaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃ śubham \|*  
*caturmukhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ toraṇādyairalaṃkṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*maṃdarādikamāvāhya tataḥ saṃpūjayetkramāt \|*  
*viṣvaksenaṃ ca tatraiva pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bhṛguṃ karṇasamārūḍhaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*viṣvaksenasya maṃtroyaṃ pūjāyāṃ caiva sarvataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dvārapālaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ gauryādīnkalaśeṣu ca \|*  
*svāsu dikṣu digīśānāṃ balipuṣpākṣatādi nā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nairṛtyavaruṇayormadhye anaṃtaṃ pratipūjayet \|*  
*indreśānayośca madhye brahmāṇaṃ ca prakalpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vedipārśve tato gatvā vedimāvāhya pūjayet \|*  
*āsanaṃ kalpayitvā tu sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*aiśāne kalaśe vidyudbrahmāṇaṃ ca tathā grahān \|*  
*svaiḥsvairmaṃtrairgaṃdhapuṣpairnaivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

6-15. After the entry of the уuра-stambha, daksina should be given with a cow. Then the final offering should be made. The arghya should also be offered to the Sungod. Now I am speaking out the establishment of an orchard in detail in which a tree is also appropriately planted. I am going to speak out the same. In the middle of the forest, or in a part in the northern region, a circular mandapa should be created along with a fire altar of half a cubit, square in shape, with same length and the breadth. The torana around the mandapa should be decorated with the arches. Thereafter, invoking the gods therein, the adoration should be made and Visvakasena should be worshipped there with fragrance and sandal paste, and a hymn should be recited-“Salutation to Bhrgu lodged in a boat.” Thereafter, Dvarapalas should be lodged in the pitchers, besides Gauri and other deities. The lords of the directions should be adored with all the directions presenting the flowers, offerings and unbroken rice etc. Vanina should be lodged in the west, Ananta in the centre and Indra in the middle of the north-east should be worshipped. Then at the back of the pedestal, vedi should be invoked and worshipped. After offering the arghya in the kalasa of the northeast. lightning, Brahma and the nine planets should be adored, reciting the hymns. Thereafter, fragrance, flowers, eatables and other things should be presented to each one of them.

## \|\| 2.46.16-33 \|\|

*maḍaleśaṃ vāsudevaṃ sāsanaṃ ca bṛhaspatim \|*  
*pūjayetparayā bhaktyā pāyasānnaṃ baliṃ haret \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca śaṃkha cakradharaṃ vibhum \|*  
*padmāsanagataṃ dhyāyetpītavastraṃ suśobhanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nīlotpaladalābhāsaṃ haricaṃdanacarcitam \|*  
*devarṣisiddhasahitaṃ kalatradvaya saṃyutam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*dhyātvā āropayedevaṃ bālādīnatha nāyakān \|*  
*vimalādyā nāyikāśca digīśāṃśca yathāvidhi \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśoccaiḥ pṛthagrūpaiḥ pratipuṣpāṃjalikramāt \|*  
*paritaḥ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 20 \|\|*

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ dhyāyetsomaṃ caturmukham \|*  
*aśvārūḍhaṃ divya rūpaṃ padmākṣaṃ dhṛtapuṣpakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*varadaṃ devagaṃdharvaiḥ sevitaṃ munibhiḥ stutam \|*  
*śvetaṃ vanaspatiṃ dhyāyeddvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*svarathasthaṃ mahābāhuṃ śaṃkhāṃkuśasakheṭakam \|*  
*vidyāṃ ca vāmato dhyāyetsvamantreṇa ca sthāpayet \|\| 23 \|\|*

*daśasvarānvitaṃ toyaṃ svabhāvaṃ tamasānvitam \|*  
*maṃtro'yaṃ devadevasya pūjāyāṃ viniyojayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*nīlaṃ jayaṃ bhṛṃgiṇaṃ ca paritaśca yathākramāt \|*  
*tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā sthālīpākaṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva somāya dvādaśāhutīḥ \|*  
*vānaspatestathāṣṭau ca ājye'nyeṣāṃ vidhīyatām \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsaptajihvāmanaṃtaram \|*  
*vāstoṣpataya iti maṃtreṇa sthālīpākadvayaṃ nayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*vanaspatiṃ samuddiśya tatoyamīrayedṛcam \|*  
*vṛkṣādīnsthāpayetpūrve gāyatryā prathamaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*abjairagraṃ kāṃsyavastraṃ ratnaṃ dikṣu yathākramam \|*  
*brīhayaśceti maṃtreṇa tathā ca saritaśca me \|\| 29 \|\|*

*mitratrayaśceti tathā pūṣā ca ma ṛcā tathā \|*  
*saṃsthāpya vrīhīnsaṃvāpya tatraiva vidhipūrvakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ toye sarvauṣadhyudakena ca \|*  
*saṃsthāpya yajamānaṃ ca surāstvāmiti mantrakaiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ācāryamātmane tatra saṃsthitaṃ dvijapuṃgavaiḥ \|*  
*samāpya nityavidhinācāryāyātha ca dakṣiṇām \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dhenuṃ ca lohapātraṃ ca dattvā iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśakti dadyātpūrṇāṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 33 \|\|*

16-33. After concluding the worship of Mandalesa lord Vasudeva with his seat, Brhaspati (Jupiter) should be worshipped with devotion, offering payasam to him. The twoarmed lord Vasudeva, having the lustre of the blue lotus, with yellow sandal paste applied over his body, is served by two spouses, Rsis and the Siddhas. Thus meditating upon him, besides the leaders, Vimala and other damsels, besides the lords of the directions should be properly adored using the sixteen methods of worship and hand cups full of flowers, individually. Thereafter, Visnu, Durga, Siva, Sarasvati and Soma with four faces should be meditated upon whose complexion resembles the pure crystal gem, is mounting over a horse has divine lotus like eyes, is adorned with ornaments, bestower of the boons, is served by the gods and the Gandharvas and is being praised by the ascetics. Then white complexion Vanaspati, who is clad in yellow garment, mounted over his chariot, having long arms, holding the conch, goads and khetaka should be adored. The goddess Vidya is lodged to his left. She is recited while adoring the god of gods. Together with ten tunes, she has the nature of water. After thus speaking, Nila, Jaya and Bhrngi who surroundes him, should be adored. Then concluding the kusa vase or kusa-kundika and other rites appropriately, a hundred and eight offerings should be made. Then the deity Somadeva should be given twelve offerings, and eight offerings should be made for the Jupiter. For other gods, a single offering of ghi should be poured for each one of them reciting the hymns - “Saptajihvamanantaramiti” and “Vastospataya iti" and both the vases should be carried. The hymns should be recited for the sake of Vanaspati. First of all, reciting the Gayatri mantra, the tree should be planted by a learned person. Then its foreparts should be decorated with lotus flowers, besides red robes and the gems should be lodged in all the directions, reciting the hymns- “ Vrihayasceti saritasca me iti,” “Mitratrayasceti and “Pusa ca meti.” Reciting these hymns, Vrihi should be established and the seeds should be sown appropriately. After concluding this, abhieseka of the seated yajamana should be performed reciting the mantra- “Surastvamiti.” After concluding the process o f daily routine, the Acarya, together with the best of the Brahmanas should be given the cows, iron vases. For them as well as the other Brahmanas, the required daksina should be given as per one’s means. After pouring the final offering, one should depart towards his home.

## Chapter 47. Setting up of a small grove

## \|\| 2.47.1-7 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye ca dvijasattama \|*  
*amaṃḍale śubhe sthāne dvihastama yasthaṃḍile \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tatra somaṃ viṣṇuṃ samarcayet \|*  
*ācāryamātraṃ varayenniśāsūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vṛkṣānmālyairalaṃkṛtya bhūṣayedbhūṣaṇādinā \|*  
*dohadaṃ ca tato dadyātsthāpayecchitadhārayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhojayetpaṃcaviprāṃśca puratoṃ'te viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utsṛjedvāsyapūrvakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dadyādyūpaṃ madhyadeśe ropayetkadalīṃ tataḥ \|*  
*raṃbhāṃ ca ropayeddikṣu sthālīpākavidhānataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādanyeṣāṃ ca ghṛtena tu \|*  
*ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsviṣṭakṛttadanaṃtaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyātpūrṇāṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Suta said- О best of Brahmanas, I am now going to speak out you about the setting up of a small grove. At a selected auspicious place, a pedestal of two cubits should be made without a mandala. A kalasa should be consecrated there, after which Visnu and Soma should be adored. Only the Acarya should be selected. Then the threads of yellow colour should be coiled around the trees. They should be decorated with ornaments and garlands. Thereafter, dohada of a hundred streams should be consecrated. At the start of the process of consecration, five Brahmanas should be served with food. The karmavedha rite should then be performed as advised earlier. Yupa-stambha should be set-up in the middle and the banana trees should be planted on all the sides adding to the grace. Thereafter, eight offering should be poured into the fire for each one of them. For others, an offering for each one of the others should be made. After given daksina as per one’s means to all of them, the purnahuti or the final offering should be made. All should then proceed to their abodes.

## Chapter 48

## \|\| 2.48.1-5 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ekādivaravṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*vṛkṣasya paścime bhāge sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vṛkṣaṃ saṃsthāpayetpūrvaṃ sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ kalaśebhyaśca somaṃ viṣṇuṃ vanaspatim \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tatastilayavairhomānaṣṭāṣṭau vidhivaccaret \|*  
*samutsṛjya tato yūpaṃ kadalyā saha dharmavit \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vṛkṣamūle yajeddharmaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca viśaṃ tathā \|*  
*digīśāṃśca tathā yakṣānnācāryaṃ toṣayettataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddohadaṃ vṛkṣapūjanam \|*  
*kṛtvā samyagvidhānena savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Suta said- О best of Brahmapas, there is a provision for the planting of a single tree as well, which I am going to speak out to you. Towards the west of the tree, a kalasa binding a thread over its neck should be placed there. Then the tree should be adored from the east. By means of that kalada, Brahma, Soma, Visnu as well as Vanaspati should be adored, making the eight offerings of sesamum seeds, for each one of them in an appropriate manner. Thereafter, the уuра-stambha with a banana tree should be gifted away. Then at the root of the tree, Dharma, Prthivi, Vida, the lord of the directions, Yaksa and Acarya should be worshiped and pleased. Then worshipping, the rite of dohada should be performed. Thereafter, the oblation should be offered to the Sungod appropriately.

## Chapter 49. Setting up of a Pipala tree

## \|\| 2.49.1-13 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*athāśvatthapratiṣṭhāyāṃ mūle bāhupramāṇakam \|*  
*sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettatra caṃdanenāṅkitaṃ yathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*padmaṃ prakalpayettatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*pūrvedyu rātrisamaye tadviṣṇoriti vai ṛcā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sthāpayedvāriṇā pūrṇaṃ kayā neti ca gaṃdhakam \|*  
*gaṃdhadvāreti tailena śrīśca teti ca caṃdanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ kalye brāhmaṇatrayabhojanam \|*  
*kārayetsitasūtraiśca veṣṭayeccaṃdanasya ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kumbhe vināyakaṃ pūjya brahmāṇaṃ ca pare ghaṭe \|*  
*svadikṣu dikpatīṃścāpi vṛkṣamūle navagrahān \|\| 5 \|\|*

*maṃḍale śivamabhyarcyaṃ pīṭhapūjā puraḥsaram \|*  
*pūrve caṃḍaṃ pracaṃḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇe naṃdibhṛṃgiṇau \|\| 6 \|\|*

*anaṃtaṃ paścime kāmamuttare gaṇanāyakam \|*  
*kārtikeyaṃ madhyadeśa ādhāraśaktipūrvakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*anaṃtaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva trivṛttaṃ ca trimaṃḍalam \|*  
*atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śvetaṃ vṛṣabhameva ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam \|*  
*āropayetsvataṃtreṇa mūle viṣṇuṃ samarcayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā madhye agre brahmāṇakaṃ yajet \|*  
*baliṃ ca piṣṭakānnaṃ ca dattvā ca śrapayeccarum \|\| 10 \|\|*

*juhuyādrudramuddiśya rudrasaṃkhyāhutiṃ kramāt \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇaiva homaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ropayetkadalīvṛkṣamācāryaṃ paritoṣayet \|*  
*kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ paṃcadhārāṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kṣīradhārāṃ ca saṃpādya arghyaṃ dattvā gṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 13 \|\|*

1-13. Suta said- Hereafter, I am going to speak about the planting of a pipala (or a holy fig tree). A pedestal of multipurpose should be made under the tree and a lotus should be drawn over the same. Then the arghya should be offered in an ordinary manner. Thereafter, on the first night, reciting the mantra - “Tadvisnoriti” it should be consecrated with the pouring of water, reciting the hymn-“Karayeti," oil with the hymn - “Gandhadvaretii” and sandal paste should be offered reciting the hymn “Srisceteti” The durbha grass and unbroken rice should also be offered with respect. Food should be served to the three Brahmanas in the morning. Then Viniyaka should be lodged in a pitcher applying the sandal paste over the image and coiling the thread round him. In the second pitcher, Brahma as well as the gods of directions should be lodged in their respective directions. The nine planets should be lodged at the roots of the tree. They should then be worshipped. Siva should be adored in the m asala. Towards the east, Canda and Pracanda should be lodged, while Nandi and Bhrngi should be placed towards the south. Kama and Ananta should be placed towards the west while Ganega, Karttikeya should be placed towards the north. In the middle part, the basic Sakti with Ananta, Prthivi, three circular mandalas should be established and worshipped. Now I am speaking about the method of meditation. He is two-armed, holding a trident in one hand. He is adorned with all the ornaments and the bull of white colour should be established there. Visnu should be lodged at the root, Siva in the middle and Brahma in the forefront. They should then be worshipped and the eleven offerings of pudding and payasam should be made for lord Siva. For other deities, homa with ladle is required to be performed. Then the banana tree should be planted and the Acarya should be pleased pouring the five streams of ghi and finally the purnahuti (or the final offering). One should circumambulate, the stream of milk should be poured and the arghya should be offered. Thereafter, one should proceed towards his abode.

## Chapter 50

## \|\| 2.50.1-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*vaṭasthānamatho vakṣye tasya mūle tu dakṣiṇe \|*  
*trihastavedimupari sthāpayetkalaśatrayam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayitvā huneccarum \|*  
*raktasūtraistriguṇitaiḥ svarṇameva puraḥsaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yavakṣīrabaliṃ dadyādutsṛjedvākyamuccaran \|*  
*yūpamāropayetpaścādvaṭamūlaiḥ samarpayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yakṣānnāgāṃśca gaṃdharvānsiddhāṃścaiva marudgaṇān \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Suta said- I am now speaking about the consecration of a banyan tree. At its base towards the south, a pedestal of three cubits should be erected. Then three pitchers or kalasas should be consecrated over the same. Thereafter, Ganesa, Siva and Visnu should be lodged over the pedestal. They should all be consecrated and worshipped. Then the homa of payasam should be performed. The string of three threads should be coiled around the same and should be offered to the god. Then the offering of the payasam of barley should be made. The yupastambha should be established at the root of the tree. Then pleasing the Yaksas, Nagas, Gandharvas, Siddhas and Marudganas, the function should be concluded.

## Chapter 51. Consecration of the wood apple tree

## \|\| 2.51.1-7 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*vakṣye bilvapratiṣṭhāṃ ca pūrvedyuradhivāsayet \|*  
*tryaṃbakaṃ ceti maṃtreṇa sthāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sunābheti ca maṃtreṇa me gṛhṇāmīti cākṣatam \|*  
*kayāneti tato dhūpaṃ vastraṃ mālyaṃ nivedayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yajedrudraṃ tato devaṃ madhye durgāṃ dhaneśvaram \|*  
*tataḥ kalye samutthāya nityaṃ nirvartya śāstrataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*svagṛhe sapta viprāṃśca bhojayeddvijadaṃpatī \|*  
*mūle hastadvayaṃ dattvā vartulā vedikā bhavet \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tatra gairikayuktena kusuṃbhacūrṇakena vā \|*  
*niśāraktena vā kuryādaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*niveṣṭanaṃ tataḥ kuryādvṛkṣasya dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*rakta sūtrairveṣṭayecca paṃcasaptanavabhistu \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vrīhīṃśca vāpayettatra uttarābhimukhastathā \|*  
*śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ pūjayedbhūtimicchatā \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Suta said- I am speaking about the consecration of the wood apple tree, in which, first of all adhivasa rite has to be performed Then reciting the mantra- “Tryambakamiti, the kalasa with fragrant water has to be established. Then reciting the mantras-“Sunabheti” and “Grhnamiti”, the unbroken rice has to be offered. Then uttering the hymn- “Kayaneti” the incense, costumes and the garlands have to be offered. Thereafter, lord Rudra, Durga in the middle and Kubera have to be worshipped. Then in the early morning, the daily routine as prescribed in the scriptures should be completed. Thereafter, pure Brahmanas as well as the Brahmana couples should be served with the food of their liking. Then at the root of the tree, a circle, two cubits in diameter should be drawn. The powder of gold, silver and of the flowers, besides turmeric should be used in decorating the eight-petalled lotus. Then the tree should be covered with the five, seven or nine threads and the seeds should be sown. Then facing north, for the increase of one’s own fortunes, Brahma, Visnu and Siva should be worshipped.

## \|\| 2.51.8-11 \|\|

*śivaṃ ca nāyakaṃ kuryādādityānpatramūlake \|*  
*śeṣaṃ ca tarumūle tu madhye'naṃtaṃ śatakratum \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vanapālaṃ ca somaṃ ca sūryaṃ pṛdhvīmanukramāt \|*  
*homastilākṣataiḥ kāryo baliṃ dadyādghṛtaudanaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yakṣebhyo māṣabhaktaṃ ca vāyanāni ca dvādaśa \|*  
*prahāṇāṃ prītaye dadyātkṣīreṇāveṣṭya dakṣiṇām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kāṃcanaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ tāmrapātrakam \|*  
*yūpāropaṃ karṇavedhaṃ savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. At the base of the leaf, Siva, Nayaka and other gods should be worshipped. Then at the root of the tree Sesa, Ananta in the middle besides Indra, Vanapala, Soma, Surya and the earth goddess should be worshipped. Then the homa with sesame seeds, unbroken rice and ghi should be performed. The offering of the boiled rice should also be given. For Yaksas, the offering of boiled black grams should be offered. The offerings should also be made to the planets with the sacred food for their pleasure, besides the payasam. Then daksina, gold, copper vases, betel and vases of bronze should be given over to the Brahmanas with devotion. The уuра should be fixed and the Karnavedha-samskara should also be performed. The arghya or oblation should also be offered in favour of the Sun-god before the conclusion of the function.

## \|\| 2.51.12-20 \|\|

*atha rātripratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye śāstrānusārataḥ \|*  
*yakṣaikavṛkṣasaṃskāre na punarjāyate bhuvi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pūrvedyurupavāhe tu vṛkṣamūle ghaṭaṃ nyaset \|*  
*viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca pūjayitvā tu sthāpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kalaśānpañca vā sapta gaṃdhatailairalaṃkṛtān \|*  
*dugdhena paṃcagavyena śaṃkhatoyena yatnataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā vastramālyairanaṃtaram \|*  
*kāṃḍāditi ca maṃtreṇa dadyāddūrvā kṣataṃ tataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*viṣṇusūktena ca punaḥ siṃdūrāṃjanacaṃdanam \|*  
*dadyātphalaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca svayaṃ tatra svapettataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhāti vile brāhmaṇāna pojayet \|*  
*ūrvavatkalaśaṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ viṣṇaṃ gaṇādhipam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sopa vanaspati caiva ekakuṣme saparyayat \|*  
*hunetpaṃcāhutīstatra yūpaṃ dadyātsamutsṛjet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*baliṃ ca pāyasenaiva prakuryātkarṇavedhanam \|*  
*veṣṭayetkṣīratoyena dhānyaṃ dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dadyādarghyaṃ hunetpūrṇaṃ bhojayeddvijadaṃpatī \|\| 20 \|\|*

12-20. Thereafter, I am speaking about Ratri-pratistha Vidhana (rite of consecrating during the night). By performing the rite over a tree, one does not have to be reborn on earth. On the first day at the root of a tree, a pitcher has to be placed. Then Visnu, Siva and Ganesa have to be worshipped. Thereafter, five or seven kalasas or pitchers have to be consecrated, which should be filled with fragrant oil, milk, pancagavya and the water of conches. Then these pitchers should be covered with threads and decorated with garlands and costumes. Then reciting the mantra- “Kandaditi", durva grass and unbroken rice should be offered. Then reciting the Visnu-sukta, the vermillion, collyrium, sandal paste, besides fruits and lamps should be offered. Then one should sleep there alone. After rising in the morning, one should be free from the daily routine and seven Brahmanas should be served with food and as per the earlier practice, worship the kalasas. Then Siva, Visnu, Ganesa, Soma and Vanaspati should be worshiped in a kalasa and five offerings should be made. Thus performing, the уuра-stambha should be fixed and the charities should be given, at the end of which the offerings of payasam, the rite of karnavedha should be performed with the streams of water, mixed with milk. Thereafter, the cereals, cow and daksina should be given. The oblation should be offered again. Then the homa should be performed, after which food should be served to a Brahmana couple.

## Chapter 52. Consecration of an auspicious tree

## \|\| 2.52.1-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śatahastamitāṃ muṣṭiṃ nānātaruvibhūṣitām \|*  
*pūgāmrādiphalairyuktaṃ vāstuṃ kṛtvā yajettu yaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke vasecciram \|*  
*tadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāśāstrānusārataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nityaṃ nirvartya vidhivatpaṃca viprānsamarcayet \|*  
*bhojayetpūjayedviṣṇuṃ prajāpatisamanvitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Suta said- A person who plants various types of trees like those of mangoes, betel nuts and other fruit yielding trees in the land a hundred cubits in measure and then builds a house there and then performs the yajna there, he enjoys his stay in the heaven for sixty thousand years. I am speaking out the relevant process as prescribed in the sacred scriptures. After performing the daily routine, five Brahmanas should be adored and then served with the food. Then Prajapati and Visnu should be worshipped. Then after performing homa, daksina should be given to Brahmanas.

## Chapter 53

## \|\| 2.53.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāṃ maṃḍapasyaiva śailadārumayasya ca \|*  
*tṛṇakāṣṭhasya ca vibho tṛṇavattasya ca dvijāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*adhivāsasya pūrvedyuḥ śubhe lagne ghaṭaṃ nyaset \|*  
*sūryaṃ somaṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ kalaśe tu samarcayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said- I am speaking out the method of erecting a mandapa with straw, wood etc. On the first day, choosing an auspicious moment, the kalasa should be consecrated, adoring the Sungod, Soma and lord Visnu in the same.

## \|\| 2.53.3-5 \|\|

*prokṣayetkuśatoyena āpohiṣṭheti vai ṛcā \|*  
*āpyāyasveti gaṃdhena gaṃdhadvāreti gaṃdhakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ākṛṣṇeneti tailena śrīśca te iti caṃdanam \|*  
*siṃdūrālaktakaṃ dadyādaṃjanaṃ pūrvayā saha \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhāte vimale śrāddhaṃ vṛddhyātmakaṃ caret \|*  
*dikpālāṃścaiva vinyasya maṃḍape śubhalakṣaṇe \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Then reciting the hymn- “Apohistheti", sprinkling of water with the kusa grass be resorted to. Thereafter, reciting the mantra-“Apydyasveti'' and “Gandhadvareti" the fragrance should be offered. Then reciting the mantra- “Akrsneneti” the oil should be offered and reciting the mantra- “Srisceti ” the sandal paste should be offered, besides Vermillion, sandal paste, red colour for use over the feet and collyrium should be offered. On the next day at dawn, at the spotless time, the Vrddhi-sraddha should be performed. In the auspicious mandapa, the gods of the directions should be consecrated and then worshipped.

## \|\| 2.53.6-15 \|\|

*madhye vedyaṃtare caiva rājabhirmaḍalaṃ likhet \|*  
*sūryamāvāhayettatra somaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca pārśvayoḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gaṇeśaṃ ca grahāṃścaiva dikpālāṃśca ghaṭe'rcayet \|*  
*pāyasaṃ juhuyādagnāvaṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ādityasya tathā viṣṇoḥ somasya dvādaśāhutīḥ \|*  
*baliṃ ca pāyasaṃ dadyāttailaṃ kṣīramathāpi vā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tata utsṛjya vidhivadvākyametadudīrayet \|*  
*jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā śanairoṣṭhaṃ na cālayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vāstoṣpatiṃ ca tatraiva pūjayedgandhacandanaiḥ \|*  
*arghyaṃ dadyācca vidhivadbhūnaivāhutiṃ hunet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tataḥ śvetaghaṭaṃ dadyānmaṇḍapopari sattamāḥ \|*  
*triguṇena niśāktairvā veṣṭayedvāridhārayā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddadyātsūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*tṛṇaveśmani vai sūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ghaṭe gaṇeśaṃ varadaṃ varaṃ kṛtvā samutsṛjet \|*  
*aiśānyāṃ dāpayedyūpaṃ dhvajāndikṣu prakalpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*maṇḍapopari kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya mantramuccaret \|*  
*prapāyāṃ varuṇaḥ pūjyo viśvakarmā prayatnataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pṛthivīṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ ca pūjayitvā hunedghṛtam \|*  
*sarvavarjyamidaṃ vākyaṃ dhvajamātraṃ vidhīyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

6-15. Again in the middle, another pedestal should be erected and with same colour, a circular mandala should be made, where the Sungod should be invoked and worshipped. At the back of it, Soma and Visnu, Ganesa, the nine planets and the gods of directions should be invoked and worshipped. Thereafter, a hundred and eight offerings of payasam, ten for the Sungod, Visnu and the moon, twelve offerings should be made for each one of them. Then the offering of payasam, oil or milk should be given. Thereafter, the rite of the giving away of gift should be performed. One should kneel down and perform in such a way that the lips do not flutter even slightly. Then offering the fragrant sandal paste, arghya should be given appropriately with the performing of homa. Then performing the Sankalpa adyetyadi for the pleasure of the lord Visnu, the mandapa, which is respected, whose prime god is the Sun and was constructed with the cooperation of all with stone and bricks, for achieving the reward as prescribed in the Srutis as well as in Smrtis, the one belonging to gotra of Rsi should be Devasarma. О best of the Brahmanas, thereafter, a white kalasa should be consecrated in the front which should be covered with threads of turmeric colour. Then the appropriate daksina should be given for the sake of the Sungod, after which the function should be concluded. In the mandapa made of grass, adoration of Ganesa who bestow boon should be done. The incense should be burnt in the north-east direction, the flags should be hoisted in the other directions and a kalasa should be consecrated over the mandapa. As Varuna is worshipped reciting the mantras in the place of free supply of water, similarly, Visvakarma should be worshipped there. Thus speaking, the worship of Ganesa and homa should be performed. The flag ceremony must also be performed.

## Chapter 54. Erection of Maha Yupa-stambha

## \|\| 2.54.1-12 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*caturhastaṃ mahāyūpaṃ hastaṣoḍaśanirmitam \|*  
*vakṣye taṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca rātrau trairātrikaṃ yajet \|\| 1 \|\|*

*varuṇaṃ sitakuṃbhe ca prapākūpasya paścime \|*  
*gāyatryā snāpayetpūrva māpohiṣṭheti vai kramāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

*gaṃdhadvāreti gandhaṃ ca aṃśunā ceti tailakam \|*  
*manonnā iti kusumaṃ dhūrasīti ca dhūpakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kayāneti dadedvastraṃ naivedyaṃ dīpacandanam \|*  
*ādau śrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃte vidhīyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

*daṃpatībhojanaṃ kuryādvarayedekabrāhmaṇam \|*  
*maṃḍape cāṣṭahaste ca kalaśaṃ tatra vinyaset \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pūjayedvaruṇaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇasamanvitam \|*  
*śivaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ caiva svaiḥ svairmantrairyathākramāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā sthālīpākavidhānataḥ \|*  
*varuṇaṃ ca samabhyarcya juhuyādāhutīrdaśa \|\| 7 \|\|*

*anyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇaiva dadyādekāhutiṃ kramāt \|*  
*varuṇasyoktavaruṇaṃ tattvā yāmi tataḥ param \|\| 8 \|\|*

*varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasīti ca ābhyāṃ devāṃstathaiva ca \|*  
*yenāpāvakacakṣasā paṃcamaṃ samudāhṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*rātrasya yūpamityādi paraṃ ca daśamastakam \|*  
*tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ kṛtvā saptajihvaṃ caruṃ nayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*iha vetyādikaṃ paṃca tataḥ paṃcāhutiṃ hunet \|*  
*śaṃbhave ca pṛthivyai ca mahā rājāya ca kramāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

*carupāketi naivedyaṃ baliṃ caivāgurūdanam \|*  
*śaṃkarāya ca rudrāya śarvāya paśupataye iti ca \|*  
*ugrāya asanāyeti bhavāya tada naṃtaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

1-12. Suta said- I am speaking out the consecration of the great уuра of four cubits or sixteen cubits and the method of its erection. Its method of consecration lasts for three nights, during which the relevant rites are performed. The god Varuna has to be invoked in a white kalasa, in connection with the consecrating of a well or the place for the free supply of water. It has also been prescribed therein that the Gayatri hymn has to be recited. Thereafter, reciting “Apohistheti", the bath is to be provided; reciting “Gandhadvareti", the scent is to be offered; reciting “Amsuna ceti”, the oil is to be offered; reciting “Manonna”, the flowers are to the given; uttering “Dhurasiti”, the incense is to be offered; reciting “Kayaneti", the costumes are to be given, besides the eatables, lamp and the sandal paste should be offered. At the start of the consecration ceremony, sraddha should not be performed, but should be performed at the end. After taking food and selecting a Brahmana, a kalasa should be placed in a mandapa of eight cubits. The minister should then establish Varuna, Narayanadeva, Siva and the earth goddess. Then following the process of kusakandika and paka-vidhana, Varuna should be worshipped making ten offerings in his favour. Then using the ladle, a single offering should be made for each one of the remaining deities. A prayer should be then offered to Varuna, starting with “Varunasyottambhanamasiti”, “Yenapavaka caksasiti” and “Ratrasya yupamityadi", the Svistakrta rite should be performed. Thereafter, for the satisfaction of the Fire-god having seven tongues, five offerings should be made reciting the five mantras- “Vaityadikam iti.” Thereafter, the offerings should also be made to Sambhu, the mother earth and for the Maharaja.

## \|\| 2.54.12-15 \|\|

*carupāketi naivedyaṃ baliṃ caivāgurūdanam \|*  
*śaṃkarāya ca rudrāya śarvāya paśupataye iti ca \|*  
*ugrāya asanāyeti bhavāya tada naṃtaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

*mahādevāya ca punarīśānāyeti ca kramāt \|*  
*carupāketi naivevaṃ baliṃ caivāgurūdanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vākyapūrvaṃ sṛjettoyaṃ tatra vākkaraṇaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivad dadyādgāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. Reciting the mantra- “Carupaketi", the eatables should be offered and the offerings should also be made to Sankara, Rudra, Siva, Pasupati, Ugra, Asana, Bhava, Mahadeva and Tsana uttering their respective names. Then reciting the passage- “Carupaketi the water should be poured, the passage is linked with “Om Adyetyadi” and the sankalpa should be read for the sake of all the Brahmanas belonging to \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ gotra known as \_\_\_\_\_\_ deva Sarman, son of \_\_\_\_ deva Sarman, consecrating the well and expecting the reward as prescribed in the Srutis and Smrtis, which is very well covered. This is to be inaugurated by lord Varuna through \_\_\_\_\_ Sarman of \_\_\_\_\_\_ gotra. Ultimately, offering the daksina as per the prescribed procedure, a milk giving cow should be given in charity.

## \|\| 2.54.16-17 \|\|

*maṃḍape kṣudrakūpe ca pratiṣṭhāṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśaṃ varuṇaṃ kuṃbhe vidhivatpūjayetsudhīḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*veṣṭayedraktasūtraiśca dadyāyūpaṃ samutsṛjet \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivad dadyādviprānsaṃ pūjayettataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. О best of the Brahmanas, I am now speaking about the mandapa or a small well and their erection. You please listen. A learned person should first establish a kalasa and consecrate Ganesa and Varuna, worshipping them at the same time. The red thread should be covered around them. The incense should then be offered. Then the daksina should be given appropriately.

## Chapter 55. Setting up of a flower orchard

## \|\| 2.55.1-6 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*puṣpārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ tu vakṣye śṛṇvaṃtu vai dvijāḥ \|*  
*madhye vediṃ trihastāṃ ca kṛtvā saṃsthāpayedghaṭam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*adhivāsasya pūrvedyuryathāvadviprabhojanam \|*  
*kṛtvā ghaṭe gaṇeśaṃ ca sūryaṃ somaṃ hutāśanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇaṃ sthaṃḍile ca juhuyānmadhupāyasam \|*  
*vidhivadyūpamāropya godhūmānsecayedgurau \|\| 3 \|\|*

*veṣṭayedraktasūtraiśca pradadyācceti dakṣiṇām \|*  
*etaddhārājalenaiva yavānnaṃ saguḍaṃ payaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aiśānyāṃ yūpamāropya vidhivaddvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*karṇavedhaṃ samāropya snāpayetkuśavāriṇā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dhānyaṃ yavaṃ ca godhūmaṃ dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*śatadhārajalenaiva veṣṭayetparito dvijāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Suta said- О Brahmanas, I am speaking about the setting up of a flower orchard. You please listen. A pedestal of three cubits should be erected. In the middle of the same, a banyan tree should be planted. On the first day, adhivasa should be performed followed by the feeding of the Brahmanas. Then Ganesa, Surya, Soma, Fire-god and Narayanadeva should be worshipped. Then honey mixed with payasam should be placed over the pedestal. The yupa-stambha should be erected in an appropriate manner. That should be taken on Thursday and the pedestal should be covered with red thread and the daksina should be given. Thereafter, mixing up barley, sugarcane balls, milk should be mixed in water. The уuра-stambha should then be erected in the northeast direction. The karnavedha rite should then be performed. Taking bath with the water of kusa, the cereals, barley, wheat, together with daksina should be given to the Brahmaoas. Thereafter, a hundred streams of water should be poured over the уuра-stambha.

## Chapter 56. Consecration of Tulasi plant (Holy basil)

## \|\| 2.56.1-7 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhe tulasyāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret \|*  
*yajamānaḥ śuddhadine ekādaśyāmathāpi vā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tato rātrau ghaṭaṃ sthāpya pūjayetparameśvaram \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ śivaṃ somaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ceṃdrameva ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

*gāyatryā snapanaṃ kuryāttathoktairmaṃtrakairapi \|*  
*kayāneti ca gaṃdhena aśruneti ca tailakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tvāṃ gaṃdharveti ca punaḥ puṣpaṃ maṃḍaṃśaneti ca \|*  
*mānastoketi kusumaṃ śrīścateti ca caṃdanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vaiśvadevīti ca punarmaṃtreṇānena caṃdanam \|*  
*dūrvāmaṃtreṇa dūrvāśca rūpeṇeti ca darppaṇam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*phalamaṃtreṇa ca phalaṃ samedheti ca aṃjanam \|*  
*sakuśaiḥ pītasūtrādyairveṣṭayetkṣīradhārayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śatadhārājalenaiva veṣṭayetsvagṛhaṃ vrajet \|*  
*vastreṇāvṛtya vidhivadbudhaḥ kāle ghaṭaṃ nyaset \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Suta said- During the month of Jyestha or Asadha, Tulasi or Holy Basil should be planted in an appropriate manner. On an auspicious day like Ekadass, the householder should consecrate the каlasа during the night. Then worship of lord Narayana, Siva, Soma, Brahma and Indra should be carried out. Then reciting the hymn of Gayatri or those mentioned above, bath should be offered. Then reciting the mantra “Kayaneti", the fragrance should be offered; reciting the hymn “Amsuneti,” the oil is to be offered; reciting the hymns “Tvam gandharveti’ and “Mandasaneti” the flower should be offered; then reciting the hymn “Manastoketi kusuma" flowers have to be offered; with the hymns “Sriscteti” and "Vaisvadeviti", sandal paste should be offered; with the reciting the durva-mantra, durva grass should be offered; with the hymn “Rupeneti”, a mirror is to be offered. With the “Phala-mantra,” the fruit has to be offered and with the hymn “Samedheti", the collyrium should be offered. Then the yellow thread with kusa grass should be drawn round them. Thereafter, the streams of milk in hundred should be poured around them. After performing all these activities, one should return to his home. Thereafter, the learned person should cover a pitcher with a cloth and then consecrate the same.

## \|\| 2.56.8-18 \|\|

*saptapaṃcatribhirvātha tadviṣṇoriti vai ṛcā \|*  
*snāpayedatha sādhvībhiḥ kṛtamaṃgalapūrvakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tataḥ śrāddhaṃ samāpyaiva mātṛpūjāpuraḥsaram \|*  
*ācāryaṃ varayetpūrvaṃ gaṃdhādyaiḥ kusumairapi \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ācārya eva hotā syādbrahmāṇaṃ ca sadasyakam \|*  
*maṃḍape daśahaste'pi vartule sthaṃḍileṣu ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sahasraṃ maṃḍalaṃ kuryāttatra nārāyaṇaṃ yajet \|*  
*grahāṃllokeśvarānmadhye ādityāṃśca marudgaṇān \|\| 11 \|\|*

*rudrānvasūṃśca kalaśe paritaśca samarcayet \|*  
*tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā homaṃ tilayavena tu \|\| 12 \|\|*

*aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryādanyeṣāṃ śaktito hunet \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ samuddiśya dadyādutsṛjya sattamāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*madhye yūpaṃ samuddiśya carupākaṃ baliṃ dadet \|*  
*kadalīṃ dikṣu saṃnyasya dhvajāndikṣu praropayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ kāṃcanaṃ dadyāttilaṃ dhānyaṃ sapuṣpakam \|*  
*dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ dayādveṣṭayetkṣīradhārayā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*jayaṃtyāḥ somavṛkṣasya tathā somavaṭasya ca \|*  
*panasasya kadaṃbasya niṃbasya dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*pāṭalā kanakasyaiva śālmalīniṃbakasya ca \|*  
*biṃbāśokavaṭasyaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhadrakasya śamīkoṇacaṃḍātakabakasya ca \|*  
*khadirasyaiva kartavyaṃ karṇavedhaṃ na kārayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

8-18. Then reciting the hymn “Tadvisnoriti” the welfare rites should be performed. Then seven, five or three chaste ladies should bathe the deity and then perform the worship of the mother goddess. The sraddha should then be concluded. The Acarya should then be selected offering the fragrant flowers. In the mandapa of the size of ten cubits, in the triangle of the circular pedestal, the Acarya is lodged as performer, besides Brahma and others. Creating a thousand mandalas, Narayana should be adored besides Lokapala. Aditya should be in the middle. Then Marudganas, Rudra and Vasu should be adored on all the sides. The kalasa should be consecrated with reverence. Thereafter, kusa kundika should be placed and a hundred and eight offerings of sesamum and barley should be poured in the fire for others. Offerings should be offered as per one’s means. Charities should be given for the sake of Narayana and other deities, The уuрa-stambha should be erected in the middle, offerings should be made in havi, the directions should be decorated with trunks of banana trees as well as the banners. Thereafter, the daksina should be given with the sesamum, cereals, flowers and gold, besides the cows. Then the stream of milk should be poured. О Brahmanas, Jayanti, Somavrksa, jack fruit, Kadamba, Nima tree, Patala, Kanaka (thorn apple), silk cotton tree, Patala (rose coloured tree) and Asokavati should be established. Besides Bhadraka, Sami, Kona, Candataka, Baka-vrksa and trees like Catechu should also be planted. The Karnavedha rite, however, is not performed in this case.

## Chapter 57. Rules for special types of consecration

## \|\| 2.57.1-8 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*

*madhyemadhye kaniṣṭhā tu kaniṣṭhaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vartulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ kuryāttattu śīrṣe tathāntyake \|*  
*madhye vā vedikāṃ kuryāttanmadhye kuṃḍamaṃḍalam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pūrvedyū rātrisamaye ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet \|*  
*śeṣaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatpṛthivīṃ ca śivaṃ tathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*gaṃdhatoyena gāyatryā setuṃ saṃpūjya mokṣayet \|*  
*kayāneti ca mantreṇa āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dadyādgandhādikaṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīriti candanam \|*  
*dūrvāmantreṇa dūrvāśca phalamantreṇa vai phalam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śannodevīti mantreṇa dadyātkuśapavitrakam \|*

1-8. Suta said- In so far as the consecration of the trees is concerned, the process for the best of the trees is the best, for the medium types of trees it is known as moderate one, and for the lowest types, it is the lowest. At the height of each one of them, a circular mandala should be made The pedestal should be seated in the centre The altar should be made in the middle of it. On the first day during the night, the serpent Sesa, the earth goddess and Siva are required to be worshipped. Then reciting the Gayatri hymn, the Setu should be worshipped with the fragrant water. The sandal paste should be offered reciting the hymn “Srisca te”, durva grass should be offered reciting the “Durva mantra" and the fruit should be offered reciting the “Phala” mantra. Then reciting the hymn “Sannodeviti", the ring of kusa grass should be presented. Then reciting the hymn “Surasureti”, two costumes should be given. Reciting the mantra - “Manonna iti, the collyrium is to be given. Thereafter, the deity should be decorated with red colour. Again on the next day, together with Vasudhara, sraddha should be performed. Then the performer of sacrifice and hotara should be selected. For other members, two vases should be conceived.

The deities like Brahma, the planets and the Lokapalas who bestow all the success, should be invoked and worshipped. During the rest of the time, lord Visnu should be worshipped. ## Chapter 59. Consecration rite to be completed in a day

*uttaraṃ tu gate haṃse atīte cottarāyaṇe \|*  
*śaratkāle vyatīte tu vasaṃte yajñamārabhet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇādimūrtīnāṃ dvātriṃśadbheda eva tu \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāṃ pratimānāṃ ca gajāsyādīṃśca sattamāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nityaṃ nirvartya matimānkuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*viprānsaṃbhojayedvātha tato yāgagṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 4 \|\|*

*gaṇeśa grahadikpālānpratikuṃbheṣu pūjayet \|*  
*sthaṃḍile pūjayedviṣṇuṃ parivāragaṇaṃ yajet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*snāpayetprathamaṃ devaṃ toyaiḥ pañcavidhairapi \|*  
*pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ paṃcamṛtpiṇḍakairapi \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tilatailaiśca snehaiśca kaṣāyairapi sattamāḥ \|*  
*pañcapuṣpodakairvātha tripadairapi sattamāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tulasīkusumāpuṣpapatrāṇyāhustripatrakam \|*  
*pañcakāmraśamīpadmakaravīraṃ ca paṃcakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*mṛttikā karidaṃtasya tathāśvakhuramṛttikā \|*  
*gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistu paṃcamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kuryātprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ca homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddadyātpūrṇāṃ tu tadanaṃtaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

1-10. Suta said - During the time of a grave misfortune or distress, there is a provision for the performing of the rites in a single day for the rich people, which I am going to reveal. The concerned person should conclude the adhivasa rites expeditiously. During the Uttarayana (or summer solstice) when the winter season is over and on the arrival of the spring season, the yajna is required to be started. О excellent Brahmanas, in the said yajna, thirty two figures of Narayana and other gods, including those of the goddesses and Ganapati should be worshipped. Then completing the daily routine, the welfare sraddha should be performed, serving food to a Brahmana. Then the intelligent person should enter the place of the yajna. All the deities like Ganesa, besides gods of directions and others should be worshipped at one and the same time and place. Thereafter, the figures of lord Visnu with his family should be lodged over the pedestal. Initially, five types of water, pancamrta, pancagavya and dust of five places should be collected. The gods should be made to take their bath with the same. Then the sesamum oil, fragrant material and essence of five types of flowers should be offered. They should be worshipped with Tripatra-Tulasi (holy basil), Kusuma (yellow flower) and the flower petal are called Tripatra. The fruits like pancaka, mango, Acacia, lotus and oleander are known as Pancakas. The elephant tooth (tusk), dust of the hoof of a horse, cow’s urine, cowdung, milk, curd and ghi are known as Pancagavya. Thus completing the consecration in an appropriate manner, the homa should be performed. Thereafter, the final offering should be poured and the daksina should be given.

## Chapter 60. Consecration of the Goddesses

## \|\| 2.60.1-8 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*

*prathame jalajaiḥ snānaṃ pañcagavyairanaṃtaram \|*  
*pūrvavacca vidhānena kuṃbhe durgāṃ samarcayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ karīṣaśatadhārayā \|*  
*śrībilve pūjayeddevīṃ dadyātprāṇamanaṃtaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bilvapatraiḥ phalairvāpi dadyāccāpi śatāhutīḥ \|*  
*ekaikaśastu sarveṣāṃ dadyātkāñcana dakṣiṇām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pratimāṃ kālikāyāśca tārāyāśca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*grāhyaṃ vinārcayedviprāḥ pañcapañcaśatairapi \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhojayetsnāpayeddevo gaṃdhatoyairdinatrayam \|*  
*tāmrakuṃbhe'rcayeddevīṃ tridinaṃ prātareva hi \|\| 6 \|\|*

*samīraṇaṃ tato dadyātpeṭikāyāṃ niveśayet \|*  
*tato'pi gandhatoyaiśca snāpayetkanyakādibhiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tato vai cāṣṭamadine rātrāvapi prapūjayet \|*  
*paśudānaṃ prakartavyamagnikāryaṃ ca pāyasaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

1-8. Suta said- О best of the Brahmanas, hereafter, I am speaking about Kali and other deities. The process of the consecration is exactly similar and the rite of adhivasa has to be observed in the same initially. Thereafter, the welfare sraddha has to be performed. After bathing with water mixed with pancagavya, the kalasa should be established as prescribed earlier. Thereafter, the goddess Durga should be worshipped. With the hundred streams of pancagavya and pancamrta, the goddess should be worshipped with the wood apple tree. The consecration ceremony should then be performed. A hundred offerings should then be made with wood apple leaves, besides the daksina at the end. О Brahmanas, the images of Kalika as well as Tara should be adored individually. Two thousand five hundred offerings should be poured for each one of them. For three days, the goddesses should be bathed with the fragrant water. Then for three days, she should be adored in a copper vase and the girls should be made to offer oil to her. On the eighth day, she should be worshipped during the night. Then an animal should be given away in charity and the offering of the payasam should be made.

## \|\| 2.60.9-18 \|\|

*śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye taṃtramataṃ yathā \|*  
*trivipraṃ bhojayedviprā adhivāsyaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nityaṃ samāpya ca punaḥ kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*ācāryaṃ varayetprātaḥ snāpayetpūrvavartmanā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*parivāragaṇaiḥ sārddhamarcayettadanaṃtaram \|*  
*dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścādagnikāryaṃ samācaret \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tilahemamayīṃ gāṃ ca dadyādgāṃ ca vidhānataḥ \|*  
*na nāma na ca gotraṃ ca homakarmaṇi sarvadā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pūrṇimāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa nānyeṣāṃ ca kathaṃcana \|*  
*homāṃte vasudhārāṃ ca kuṃbhe dattvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*trihastacarakāyaṃ ca hastaikaṃ caturhastake \|*  
*śālaśamaśilāyāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sadyodhivāsayeddevaṃ dvādaśyāṃ snāpayedatha \|*  
*ratnatoyaiḥ parimalaistrigaṃdhaiḥ paṃcapallavaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kuṃbhe prajāpatiṃ sthāpya śvetābjaṃ navanābhake \|*  
*navadurgoktamārgeṇa pūjayetparameśvaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

*cakrasvarūpato jñeyaṃ pradadyācca samīraṇam \|*  
*ānīya tāmrabhāṃḍe ca trikālaṃ pratipūjayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pāyasānnairutpalairvā paṅkajairvāpi homayet \|*  
*sakāñcanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ prada dyādbhūridakṣiṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

9-18. According to the Tantrika belief, I am speaking out to you the method of Sivalinga. In the process, three Brahmanas are to be served with food and the adhivasa rite is to be completed. Then performing the daily routine, the welfare sraddha should be performed. The Acarya should then be selected. Again in the early morning, the deity should be bathed as before and the worship should be performed with the whole family. Then offering the wind, the homa should be performed. Then the cow of sesamum seeds and of gold should be made and the same should be given away in charity. The name and gotra of the performer should never be neglected while performing the homa. Particularly on the full moon day, this process has to be followed by all. Thereafter, Vasudhara should be offered in the kalasa in an appropriate manner. For the purpose of consecration, the image of Saligrama should be made over a pedestal of one, three or four cubits or alternatively, over the pedestal of a single cubit, the consecration should be done. For this purpose, the adhivasa rite should be performed initially. On the twelfth day of the moon, the chief deity should be bathed with water of gem mixed with dust of flowers, three scents and five tender shoots should decorate him. Then the Prajapati in the kalasa and the white lotus should be placed in Navanabhaka. Then the path having been led by Nava-Durga, Paramesvara should be worshipped. Thereafter, stamping with the sign of cakra (discus), giving away the Acacia fruit, he should be worshipped in the copper vase, thrice in a day. Then, the offerings of payasam, blue lotus or red lotus should be made. Then the Brahmana should be offered the daksina comprising of gold, a couple of costumes and the riches to the maximum possible extent.

## \|\| 2.60.19-29 \|\|

*śrīsūryasya gaṇeśasya viriñceścāpi sattamāḥ \|*

*raktābje pūjayetsūryaṃ parivārasamanvitam \|*

*vārāhyāstripurāyāśca nārikelodakairapi \|\| 22 \|\|*

*paśujñānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaiḥ pañcamodakaiḥ \|*

*pratimāṃ bhuvaneśīṃ ca mahāmāyāmbikāmapi \|*
