*paratra ca bhuvarloke piṇḍadehakṛtaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*manaḥkāyena saṃbhūtaṃ para janmani rājyadam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*manovākkāyasaṃbhūtamiha janmani siddhidam \|*  
*paratra paramāṃ siddhiṃ tatkarma pradadāti hi \|\| 17 \|\|*

12-17. Being his disciple, he stayed among the five fires and again started reciting the same mantra. He could not still get the yogini there. Then he got worried. Thus speaking, the Vaitala said to the learned king- “why could he get the yogini as a beloved?” On hearing this, the king said- “For a performer desirous of achieving the success, three ways of performance have been prescribed which are known as the mind, speech and the actions. The actions taken by means of the mind and speech provide comforts in the life after the death. The deeds which are performed by the speech and the body improve the beauty of the body, besides achieving the worldly success. The deeds which are done by the mind and the body make one achieve Bhuvarloka after the death. They even make one achieve the position of a ruler in the next birth. The deeds which are performed by the mind, speech and actions make one achieve success in this birth itself, while in Paraloka, they make one achieve extreme success.

## \|\| 2.85.18 \|\|

*tasmātkartavyameveha trividhaṃ karma sādhakaiḥ \|*

*ato'nyajanmani prāpto yakṣatvaṃ tatparo dvijaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Therefore, a performer should perform the three types of the deeds. The Brahmana had performed the japam using the riches of others, therefore, he would become a Yaksa in the next birth.

19\. Suta said- While thus speaking, Vaitala felt delighted and uttered- “Well done, well done.” Then he honoured the king Vikrama immensely. Thereafter, in order to further test the king, the Vaitala started narrating another story.

1-6. Suta said- О Saunaka, О intelligent one, the Vaitala said to the king again. In the town of Kambala, once a king named Sudaksa ruled the country. He was quite judicious in approach, religious-minded, valorous, charitable, besides being devoted to lord Siva. A vaisya named Dhanadhyaksa lived in his capital city. DhanavatT was his beautiful daughter. The beautiful girl was given over by him to a trader named Gauridatta. After sometime, she gave birth to a daughter named Mohini. On her reaching the age of twelve years, her father died. At that point of time, due to poverty, Dhanavati was going back to her parents home with her daughter for living there. In the dark night, on the way she met with Brahmana named Nyayasarma, who because of stealing all the belongings of a Brahmana was awarded the capital punishment, but somehow he escaped death and (the booty remained with him).

## \|\| 2.86.7-12 \|\|

*akasmādvaiśyajā prāptā tatkaraṃ sā tadāspṛśat \|*  
*tena duḥkhena mahatā rurodo ccairdvijaśca saḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*hā rāmakṛṣṇa pradyumnāniruddheti punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*śrutvā dhanavatī dīnā ko bhavāniti sābravīt \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dvija āha ca vipro'haṃ tryahaṃ śūlyāṃ nirūpitaḥ \|*  
*yadi dāsyasi me kanyāṃ koṭisvarṇaṃ dadāmi te \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śrutvā dhanavatī tasmā udvāhya mohinīṃ sutām \|*

*mohinyapi patiṃ prāha bhavānmṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*kuto jāyeta tanayastanme brūhi dayānidhe \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dvijaḥ prāha śṛṇu vyaṃge yadā te hṛcchayo bhavet \|*

7-12. Suddenly, the daughter went to him and touched his feet and he suddenly started crying in grief uttering the names of Krsna, Pradyumna and Aniruddha. Reciting these names, he started crying again and again. Hearing these words, the destitute and miserable Dhanavati went to the Brahmana and asked him- “Who are you?” The Brahmana said- “I am a Brahmana, but I am feeling painful at heart for three days. In case you give this girl to me, then I shall give you a crore of gold coins.” On hearing this, Dhanavati married his daughter Mohini to the Brahmana. Thereafter, she kept the wealth in a pit under a banyan tree and returned to her home. Mohini then said to her husband- “You seem to be nearing death, then how shall I get a son?” Brahmana said- “O dear, when you become lustful, then go to a Brahmana and get yourself impregnated from him and get your son from him.”

## \|\| 2.86.13-18 \|\|

*ityuktvā maraṇaṃ prāpya yamalokaṃ gato dvijaḥ \|*  
*nārakīṃ yātanāṃ nityaṃ bubhuje niṃdyakarmajām \|\| 13 \|\|*

*māturgṛhe tu sā nārī mohinī yauvanānvitā \|*  
*samayaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā tiṣṭhaṃtī ca punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ke bhogāśca kimāścaryaṃ ko jāgarti śayīta kaḥ \|*  
*pāpo vyādhiśca duḥkhaṃ ca kuto jātaṃ hṛdi sthitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*iti ślokaṃ dvijānāha nottaraṃ ca dadurdvijāḥ \|*  
*medhāvī nāma kāśmīre sthito vipraḥ samāgataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tāmuvāca prasannātmā śṛṇu mohini suṃdari \|*  
*sugaṃdhi vanitā vastraṃ gītaṃ pānaṃ ca bhojanam \|*  
*śayyā ca bhūṣaṇaṃ jñeyo bhogo hyaṣṭavidho budhaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ahanyahani bhūtāni mriyante janayanti ca \|*  
*mamatāṃ yaḥ karotyeṣāṃ tadāścaryaṃ smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

13-18. After thus speaking, the Brahmana met with his end and reached the Yamaloka, where he had to face the torture of the hell because of the misdeeds performed by him on earth. On the other hand, while living in her mother’s home, Mohini attained the youthful age. She was reminded of the words of her husband and could not travel on the evil path. She used to ask the meaning of the verse:- “What are the pleasures, what is the surprise, who is awake and who sleeps? How the sins, ailments and sufferings are re-born living in the heart?” She used to ask the meaning of this verse from every Brahmana, but no one could give her the correct answer. After sometime, a Brahmana known by the name of Medhavi arrived there from Kasmira. Feeling pleased, he said to Mohini- “0 beautiful one, I shall explain the meaning of the verse. You please listen. Fragrance, woman, costume, knowledge, liquid stuff, food, bed and ornaments are the eight types of pleasures described by the learned people. The jivas are daily born and meet with death, therefore a person who gets confused at this is described by the learned people as the surprise or wonder.

## \|\| 2.86.19-20 \|\|

*yo vivekaṃ samāsādya kurute karmasaṃgraham \|*  
*saṃsāre ghoratamasi sa jāgarti vivekavān \|\| 19 \|\|*

*saṃsārājagaraṃ jñātvā vairāgyaṃ yo'karodbhuvi \|*  
*audāsīnyaṃ samādhiṃ ca sukhaṃ śete hi mānavaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. A person who engaged himself in activities with prudence, he is known as a prudent and remains awake in the universe which is otherwise filled with darkness. Considering the world as the python, a person who becomes a detached person, remains unconcerned and meditates, the same person sleeps with comfort.

## \|\| 2.86.21-24 \|\|

*saṃkalpājjāyate kāmastato lobhaḥ prajāyate \|*

*jalaprakṛtyāṃ yo jāto raso rasavikāravān \|*  
*rasājātasya dehe'sminvyādhiḥ karmamayo'śubhaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*rudrātkālyāṃ samudbhūto moho hṛdi ca lokahā \|*  
*sa tuṣṭāva mahādevīṃ patnyarthe surapūjitām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tasmātsnehaśca tatpatnyāṃ jātaśca mamatāpriyaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. With the resolution there emerges the desire, from the desire emerges the greed and from the greed emerges the lust. A person who owns them all, he is known as the sinner and achieves the hell. The juice that emerges from the water, the same juice causes deterioration. The evil deeds are caused by the same evil juice and the danger, which is called the ailment. From Rudra, in the age of kali, Moha was born who usurped the Iokas. He adored Mahadevi for achieving a wife and false vision emerged out of it, who is termed as his beloved, who gave birth to affection and love.

25-35. With the confluence o f both of them, the sufferings with grief were bom. Hearing this,the damsel Mohini with beautiful limbs was attracted towards him. Because a person possessing pride, shrewdness, commanding nature, virtuous and the one who can protect the woman, attracts the women. Therefore, the BrShmapa, after impregnating her, also received his riches and departed from the place. The woman also started feeling comfortable with the conception. At the start of the tenth month, lord Siva said to MohinI- “O lord, all the happenings of dream were established as they were. The infant was placed in a palanquin with enough of riches, she went to the king’s place and placed the palanquin with her son at the door of the royal palace and slept there. At the same time, the king who was the devotee of Siva and was desirous of a son, reached there and owned the infant. The infant who had been bom of the womb of MohinI was adopted by him as his son and he p erformed the name giving ceremony for him in which he spent huge wealth. He was given the name of Haradatta. He became proficient in all types of knowledge. After the death of his (foster) father, he ascended the throne and he propagated the dharma. At the bank of the river phalgu at Gaya, he performed srdddha for his father in an appropriate manner. At that point of time, three hands emerged (for receiving the pindas) which immensely surprised the king. Thus speaking, the Vaitala said to the king Vikrama- “O king, who was entitled to receive the pintfa? Hearing this, the king Vikrama said-Both the pandits were desirous of the wealth and the king is like the preceptor, therefore the pirida would be received by the thief, who had actually married MohinI.

## \|\| 2.86.36 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tena piṃḍaprabhāvena sa cauro brahmadravyahā \|*  
*nirayānniḥsṛto vipra svargalokaṃ samāgataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Suta said- О BrShmanas, because of the influence of the pinda, the Brahmana who had stolen the riches and was actually a thief, got rescued from the hell and achieved the heaven.

## Chapter 87. Collateral history of the age of Kali

1-2. At Citrakuta, there lived a king known by the name of Rupadatta. While hunting, he reached from one forest to another. At noon time, he found the daughter of a sage collecting the lotus flowers from a pool. She was quite beautiful and youthful and looked intoxicated.

3-15. When the king and the girl were both busy in the exchange of glances, then the sage suddenly reached there and he spotted them both. At this sight, the king got enlightened. Then with all the humility, at his command, the king enquired from the sage about dharma. The Muni who was well-versed in the divine knowledge, started speaking on the subject of compassion or mercy as dharma. He said-“There could be no charity better than protection, nor could there be in future. By awarding punishment to culprit, one gets the reward for the performing of adoration of the adorable. One should always be friendly with the cow and the Brahmana, equality in punishment, truthfulness in the worship of the gods, service to the preceptor, control of the sense organs, softness while giving away the chanty and patience should be adopted in doing the deplorable deeds. Thus speaking, giving away his daughter to the king, he retired to his place. Thereafter, the king slept with the girl at the roots of a banyan tree. At the same time, a Raksasa with the intention of eating up the wife of the king, said to him- “I require a sacrifice. After the seventh day from today, I shall give you a Brahmana son of seven years age, as a charity.” With this truthful resolve, the king returned to his place and reaching there, he consulted with his courtier and gave a lakh gold coins and he got his middle son. Then he gave the sacrifice to the Raksasa. At the time of sacrifice, the boy first laughed and then wept. “You tell me, why did he laugh first and then wept?” On hearing this, the king said to Vaitala- “O Brahmana, the eldest son is liked by the father, while the youngest son is the favourite of the mother.” When he thus came to know about this, he took refuge with the king. But finding the sword held in the hand of the king Rupasena, the boy laughed for his welfare and that he was going to fill the belly of the Raksasa, he cried.

## Chapter 88. Collateral history of the age of Kali

*kamalākaranāmāsau kṛtyayogātsamāgataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-7. Suta said- Listening to this much, the Vaitala again started telling a story to the king Vikrama. In a vast and the pleasant city of Visala, a king named Vipulesa used to rule the country. In the same city, there also lived a competent trader known by the name of Arthadatta, who had a most beautiful girl known by the name of Anangamanjari. Her father married the girl with a Vaisya named Suvarna. Once Suvarna started on a journey towards an island of Kamala city. Out of greed, the said person stayed there for long. As a move of destiny, an excellent Brahmana known by the name of Kamalakara arrived in her house for the performing of a ceremony. After performing the homa, the beautiful damsel arrived there for the sprinkling of water. Being a passionate bud, she attracted the Brahmana boy when he looked at her. She also getting attracted towards him with passionate eyes, gave him some time to meet her. She said- “In the dark dead of night, you will enjoy the best of pleasure, by meeting me.” On hearing this, the Brahmana was deeply absorbed in her thought. Having been suffered from the fire of passion, he fell asleep over the excellent bed.

## \|\| 2.88.8-12 \|\|

*arddharātre tu sā nārī dvijāgamanatatparā \|*  
*mārgamanveṣamāṇā sā priyasya smarapīḍitā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nāgataḥ sa dvijo daivāttadā sā maraṇaṃ gatā \|*  
*kamalākara evāśu samayānte samāyayau \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuvaśāṃ subhrūṃ svayaṃ maraṇamāgataḥ \|*  
*prabhāte cārthadatto vai dāhayāmāsa tāṃ śucā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*suvarṇaśca tadāgatya vilalāpa priyāṃ prati \|*  
*citāyāṃ bhasmasādbhūtvā svargaloke tu sā yayau \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ityuktvā sa tu vaitālo nṛpatiṃ prāha vikramam \|*  
*kasya sneho'dhikasteṣāṃ kutaḥ svargapuraṃ yayau \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. The beautiful damsel waited for the arrival of the Brahmana boy suffering from the pangs of lust, fixing her gaze on the route of his coming there. As luck would have it, the Brahmana could not arrive there and she ended her life. Thereafter, Kamalakara also reached there and finding her dead, he also ended his life. Tn the early morning, Arthadatta cremated the damsel. In the mean time, Suvarna also reached there and started crying for his beloved. But she getting reduced to ashes in fire, reached the heaven. After thus narrating the story, the Vaitala said to Vikrama-“Whose love was excessive of the two and how could they achieve the heaven?”

## \|\| 2.88.13-16 \|\|

*rājovāca \|*  
*pati snehodhikasteṣāṃ madhyamau nāriviprakau \|*

*vaiśyavarṇaiḥ sadā pūjyo brāhmaṇo brahmamūrtimān \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dvijo'pi nāptavānnārīṃ tadā svargagatiṃ harim \|*

*suvarṇo hṛdi saṃjñāya matpriyā brahmavatsalā \|*

13-16. The king said- The love of her husband is quite excessive. Besides the love for the damsel and the Brahmana is of mediocre type. Because of her love for the Brahmana, she achieved the heaven. Because the Vaisyas should always adore the Brahmanas. The Brahmana could not avail of the love of the damsel, but he ended his life getting devoted to lord Visnu, which led him to the heaven. Suvarna on the other hand also thought in his mind that his wife always served the Brahmanas, therefore she discarding me embraced the fire.

## Chapter 89. Collateral history of the age of Kali

## \|\| 2.89.1-7 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*

*jayasthalapure ramye vardhamāno nṛpobhavat \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tasya grāmevasadvipro vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ \|*

*catvāraścātmajāstasya caturbhāgaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*dyūtakarmā ca kulaṭo viṣayī nāstikaḥ śrutaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kadāciddaivayogena nirddhanatvaṃ ca te gatāḥ \|*  
*pitaraṃ viṣṇuśarmāṇaṃ nemuste vinayānvitāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dyūto dhanavyayakaraḥ pāpamūlo mahākhalaḥ \|*  
*vyabhicārastathā cauryaṃ nirdayatvamato bhavet \|*  
*dyūtakarmaprabhāveṇa tvadīyadravyasaṃkṣayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dhanopāyena bhoḥ pitrorvākyaṃ kuru matiṃ prati \|*  
*tīrthavrataprabhāveṇa tvatpāpaṃ saṃkṣayaṃ vrajet \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Suta said- After thus narrating the story, Vaitala spoke to the king with humility- “In the city of Jayasthala, a king named Vardhamana once ruled there. A Brahmana named Vispusvami lived in his capital city, who was well-versed in the Vedas and the related literature besides being devoted to lord Krsna. The Brahmana had four sons who were engaged in four types of activities. One of them was a gambler, destroyer of the family traditions, an adulterer and an atheist. All of them became paupers by the move of destiny. Then they reached their father Visnusarma and said to him with humility- “O dear father, how have we lost our riches?” Their father said-“The money is lost by gambling. The habit of gambling is the destroyer of the wealth, besides being root of all the sins and evils. Because of that, the gambler becomes cruel and a thief. You have lost your wealth by gambling. Therefore, you accept my words for gaining the wealth. You will be relieved of all your sins by performing the pilgrimage and the vratas.

## \|\| 2.89.8-13 \|\|

*he putra kulaṭa tvaṃ vai veśyāsaṃgaṃ mahāśubham \|*  
*tyaktvā brahmaparo bhūtvā brahmacarye matiṃ kuru \|\| 8 \|\|*

*viṣayinmāṃsamadire nityapāpavivardhike \|*  
*ataḥ prāpsyati cauryatvamato vai nirayastathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tasmāttvaṃ prabhumīśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ jagatpatim \|*  
*nivedya sarvathā dravyaṃ bhuñjīthā vāgyataḥ svayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nāstikatvaṃ devaniṃdā parityajya matiṃ kuru \|*  
*ātmā sarvābhayo nityamātmaśaktiśca caṃḍikā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ātmanoṃgāni devāśca sarvajīvaguhāśayāḥ \|*  
*tāñjñātvā pūjanaṃ teṣāṃ kuru tvaṃ pāpaśāntaye \|\| 12 \|\|*

*iti te vacanaṃ śrutvā gatāstīrthāntaraṃ prati \|*  
*śivamārādhayāmāsurvidyārthe sarvarūpiṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

8-13. O son, it is of no use wasting the family traditions by keeping the company of the evil women. Discarding the said practice, you accept to be a Brahmacan. These words were spoken by him of the one who followed the evil path- “By daily consuming the wine and eating meat, a person moves towards the hell Therefore, you shall have to use the wealth in the service of lord Siva as well as Visnu, who are all adorable. After first offering the same to them with devotion, you should then make use of the wealth keeping yourself silent.” Then he addressed to the atheist son “You at once discard the denouncing of the gods. The soul is fearless, besides being eternal. Besides Candika is the strength of the soul. The soul resides in all the creatures in the form of gods. Therefore, with the said faith, you should worship all the gods with devotion.” Listening to these words of their father, all of them proceeded on to the pilgrimage. Thus moving, they started earning knowledge worshipping lord Siva.

## \|\| 2.89.14-18 \|\|

*varṣāṃte ca mahādevo vidyāṃ saṃjīvanīṃ dadau \|*  
*te prāpya vanamāgatya parīkṣārthe samudyatāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*mṛtavyāghrāsthini śreṣṭhaṃ maṃtrapūtāṃbu cākṣipat \|*  
*tena maṃtraprabhāveṇa paṃjaratvamupāgatam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tasyoparyyeva kulaṭo maṃtrapūtaṃ payo'kṣipat \|*  
*ghanamāṃsaṃ ca rudhiraṃ tena maṃtreṇa cābhavat \|\| 16 \|\|*

*viṣayī cākṣipaccaiva tasyopari jalaṃ śubham \|*  
*tena mantraprabhāveṇa tvakprāṇatvamupāgatam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*suptaṃ vyāghraṃ ca saṃjñāya nāstikastu jalaṃ dadau \|*  
*maṃtreṇa bodhito vyāghrastāṃśca viprānakhādayat \|\| 18 \|\|*

14-18. After a year, lord Siva bestowed the knowledge of Sanjivani to them. In order to test the knowledge, they collected the bones of a tiger and sprinkled the sanctified water over it, reciting a mantra. With the use of that mantra, all the bones of the tiger united. The other one again sprinkled the sanctified water over it and as a result of which, the flesh was grown over the caricature of the tiger and the blood started moving in the body of the tiger Then the third one sprinkled the sanctified water over the body and the skin was grown over the body and the wind started passing through its body, but the tiger kept on sleeping still. The fourth one then finding that the tiger was still asleep, sprinkled the water over the body of the tiger. As a result of this and the mantra used on the tiger, he regained his life and got up. Then he ate up all the four Brahmanas.

In the same village, a Brahmana named Sambhudatta also lived there. He was well-versed in the Vedic and the related literature and was devoted to lord Rudra. He had two sons who were well-versed in all the lores and arts. The elder one was known by the name of Liladhara, who worshipped Bali as well as Visnu. The younger one was known by the name of Mohana, who was devoted to Sakti. Once the king K$atrasimha invited the Brahmana Sambhudatta to his place with his son. He organised a yajna for the sacrificing of a goat.

5-12. The old Sambhudatta delightfully created a cakra and consecrated the kalasas there for the success of the task. Then offering the pleasant and qualified havya, he completed the homa. The king summoned the goat and worshipped it appropriately. The compassionate Liladhara, who was devoted to Visnu, besides being immensely intelligent, finding the goat at the death’s door, spoke with an angry voice- “The killing of the creatures leads one to the terrific hell, because lord Visnu never gets pleased with a yajna in which some animal is killed.” Listening to the words of the elder brother, Mohana initially smiled serenely and then spoke in humble but loud voice- “O brother, earlier in the Satyayuga, the Brahmanas performed yajna offering the sacrifice of a goat only. This is what has been heard and understanding this as the best, one should accept the importance of the goat and the sesamum, performing the sacrifice accordingly. The sacrifice was performed accordingly. At the same time, Indra and other gods became present at the fire altar and said—"Your ideology is of no use, because the goat has been mentioned in the Vedas".

At the same time, Amavasu who was bom in the Pitryoni, spoke to the sages in excellent voice-“For the satisfaction of the gods, the yajna should be performed by killing of a goat.” On hearing this, all of them acted accordingly and by so doing, they achieved merit. О intelligent one, you also perform the yajna accordingly. Hearing the harsh speech, the large-hearted and the religious-minded Liladhara said to Mohana- “The yajna mentioned by you was performed in the Tretayuga, during which Rajoguna remains predominant but in the Satyayuga, all the four feet of the dharma remain present and as such no killing should be made. The gods never get satisfied with wealth nor the flesh nor the blood.” Listening to this speech, Ksatrasimha feeling panicky, discarded the goat and performed the yajna with the offering of fruits etc. О monarch, at the same time, getting enraged, the violent goddess reduced the city to ashes with its men and women. With the influence of Mahamaya, like an immensely violent person, Sambhudatta met with his end and went to the heaven. Then the Brahmana Liladhara started living in a village known by the name of Padmaputra with his ten sons. Reaching the place of Mohana, the king Ksatrasimha achieved the grace of the divine goddess, pleasing her at the same time.

25-38. The mother having Prapava as her son and who herself is the beloved of the TurTya Puru$a, salutation to such a mother again and again. Salutation to the form of Prapava. The goddess by whose grace the entire world becomes visible, besides being maintained, and in whose body the universe is lodged, salutation to the same goddess. The goddesses known as IndraijI, Siddhi, Mrtyu, Prabha, besides Svaha, Nirrti,, Ratri, Rddhi and Bhukti were all bom out of you. You are the beloved of Lokapala. Therefore, salutation to the mother of the universe. You have the forms of Lajja, therefore salutation to the mother of the universe. You are the form of Тrsnа, Trpti, Rati, Niti, Himsa, Ksanti, Mati, Gati, Ninda, Stuti, Irsya and Lajja, salutation to you again and again. With the influence of this astaka-stuti, the king Ksatrasimha achieved the place of Siva. I also appeared there in the form of Vaitala to serve you. Therefore, О king Vikramaditya, the fortunes which always remain present, have arrived here to serve you. Therefore, the same goddess Durga should be adored by you. О lord of earth, I have reached under the command of lord Siva. О Monarch, with the questions and answers I have listed you, I shall dwell in both of your arms. Therefore, you destroy your enemies on the earth. О king, all the robbers have been destroyed. Therefore, you establish and rule the entire earth according to the provision of the sastras. A ruler who shall be rebuilder of the decaying holy places, he shall perform the task contrary to the established era. The Vikrama era shall be established once again. Twelve hundred years of Dvapara are still left. At the end of the same, the time of valorous Krsna would start by which Kali would be redeemed and the race of Mlecchas would be on the increase. О great king, Suta and other Rsi residents of Naimisarapya shall reach the city of Visala and live in Cakratirtha. They shall spend their time in listening to the Puranas. Thus speaking, the Vaitala suddenly disappeared from that place, while the king Vikrama achieved the supreme bliss. Therefore, О excellent group of Rsis, taking it to be evening time, all of you should worship lord Siva.

In this way, they were seated in meditation for a year. The king Vikramaditya then arrived there and addressed those Rsis with excellent speech. The Rsis then went to Suta and said to him- “The king about whom you had mentioned earlier, has arrived here. In case you so permit, then we may initiate the Asvamedha-yajna started from him. But you reaching Cakratirtha, start meditation there itself.” Accepting their words, Suta reached the same place with them and got the Asvamedha sacrifice performed appropriately.

7-18. The sacrificial horse went first to the place of Kapila in the east, from there it went to Setubandha - Ramesvaram in the south, then it reached the river Sindhu in the west and then it reached in the forest of Badarikasrama and then it reached the bank of the river Ksipra where it burnt its body in the fire and reached the heaven. In the function of the yajna performed by the king, all the gods arrived there with their spouses, only moon could not arrive there. Therefore, all the rulers, with disturbed minds, went to Candraloka with Vaitala. The moon felt delighted with the arrival of this people there. He said- “O great King, I cannot discard on earth, because of the arrival of Kali. Therefore, I cannot accompany you. Thereafter, the nectar like water disappeared from that place. This incident came to the knowledge of Indra. Indra then taking to the form of a Brahmana, begged from him. The king gave away the nectar to the Brahmana (Indra). Thereafter, Indra himself arrived there. Because of the king’s handing over the nectar to Indra, the age of the king was increased to a lakh of years. At that point of time, a Brahmana named Jayanta performed tapas and receiving the same, proceeded on to the heaven. The king Bhartrhari received a lakh of gold coins from the king and narrated the event to him. Making use of the same, Bhartrhari made preparation for yoga and went to the forests. Thereafter, the king Vikramaditya ruled the country without any obstruction for a hundred years and then proceeded to the heaven. Knowing about the demise of the king, Sаunака and others went to the sage and offering their salutation to him, said to him- “Presently you discuss about the human dharma. Thereafter, Suta again narrated all the puranas to them. With a delightful mind, he narrated five lakhs of verses to them for a hundred years. Thereafter, all the Rsis with delightful hearts, retired to their respective abodes.

О Brahman, you kindly speak out the glorious method, which should be truthful and beneficial.”

## \|\| 2.92.4-6 \|\|

4-6. Suta said- I always adore the lord Satyanarayana, having the eyes resembling the fresh lotus flowers, is the sport for the goddess Laksmi, has four arms, has the body with the reflection of gold like beauty, who is the main cause for the protection of the universe besides being a comet for the destruction of enemies. I offer my salutation to lord Rama along with Laksmana, who is compassionate accompanied with Sita, who is the greedy black wasp of the face of JanakI, the destroyer of Ravana and the race of Pulastya, who is adorable, the best of the deities, who showers his grace on his devotees, who is served by Satrughna, Hanuman and Bharata and was bom in the race of Raghu. You better listen to the glorious story of the great monarch. He is the remover of all the blemishes of the age of Kali, who fulfils all desires, is the grace of the faces of all the gods, who is illuminated by the Brahmanas and is the support of the learned people. He achieved the great glory from ascetics. Please listen to his great history.

## \|\| 2.92.7-11 \|\|

7-11. Once the sage Narada, in order to shower his grace on others, while wandering in all the lokas, arrived on the earth, inhabited by humans. He observed that the people had been suffering from various types of ailments. They were suffering mentally and physically from ailments, overpowered with poverty and were getting seasoned because of their deeds. He thought- “By which way, they should be relieved of their continued sufferings.” Thus thinking in his mind, he reached the abode of lord Visnu. He found Narayanadeva there with bright complexion, four arms, holding sankha, cakra, gada and lotus in his four arms as his attributes. He was decorated with long garland of flowers, a smiling face and was being praised by Sanaka and other Rsis. Narada also started eulogising lord Visnu there.

## \|\| 2.92.12-13 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*namo vāṅmanasātītarūpāyānaṃtaśaktaye \|*  
*nādi madhyāntadevāya nirguṇāya mahātmane \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sarveṣāmādibhūtāya lokānāmupakāriṇe \|*  
*apāraparimāṇāya tapodhāmne namonamaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Narada said- Salutation to the lord, who is beyond the description by the mind and speech and possesses the strength beyond measure. He is the one without beginning, middle or the end, besides being absolute and the supreme soul. He was present ahead of all, besides being eternal. He is beneficial for the universe, the ocean of tapas, salutation to him again and again.

## \|\| 2.92.14-20 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā stutiṃ viṣṇurnāradaṃ pratyabhāṣata \|*  
*kimarthamāgato'si tvaṃ ki te manasi vartate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kathayasva mahābhāga tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi te \|*

*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sādhusādhvityapūjayat \|*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi vratamekaṃ sanātanam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kṛte tretāyuge viṣṇurdvāpare'nekarūpadhṛk \|*  
*kalau pratyakṣaphaladaḥ satyanārāyaṇo vibhuḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*catuṣpādo hi dharmaśca tasya satyaṃ prasādhanam \|*

*satyanārāyaṇavratamataḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ smṛtam \|*

*kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca satyanārāyaṇārcane \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā deva kathayasva kṛpānidhe \|\| 20 \|\|*

14-20. Suta said- Listening to this type of the prayer of the lord, lord Visnu spoke to Narada-"O virtuous one, how have you arrived here? What do you want? You apprise me of the factual position. I shall reveal everything before you.” On hearing this, Narada spoke to lord Visnu about all the causes which had brought him to the abode of lord Visnu. Listening to the words of Narada, lord Visnu said to Narada-“Well done, well done.” Thus saying, he honoured him further immensely and said- “O Narada, I shall reveal before you an eternal and everlasting vrata which in the Satyayuga, Treta and Dvapara made Visnu to take to many forms and its main source is the truth, because it is by truth that the world is maintained. Beside Brahmana remains established in the same truth. Therefore, the vrata of the same Satyanarayana is indeed the best.” On hearing the speech of lord Visnu, Narada spoke again-“O lord —the treasure of compassion, you kindly reveal before me the method of the warship of Satyanarayana and the reward one achieved for so doing. You kindly tell me in detail.”

21-26. The lord said- Even Brahma with four faces would not be able to speak out the glory of worship of lord Narayana. Therefore, I am going to reveal the same in brief before you, which you please listen. By performing the worship of Vi$nu, the pauper becomes rich, the childless person gets a son, the usurped kingdom is restored to the king, the blind gets the beautiful eyes, a person in bondage is freed from the same, a terrorised person is freed from the terror, besides all the mental desires are fulfilled. When a Brahmana performs the vrata of Satyanarayana in an appropriate manner, his desire is fulfilled. There is no need to further think about it. One should get up early in the morning and brushing the teeth with the toothstick, one should purify himself by performing Sandhya-vandana. Then holding a shoot of the holy basil plant, one should meditate upon the lord, who is lodged in truth. Then he should conceive- “I am adoring lord Narayana, who is spotless like the thick clouds, possesses four arms, is clad in excellent pitambara, has the delightful face, has the eyes resembling the fresh lotus flowers and is served by the sages like Sanaka and others.

27-36. О lord, I am performing a vrata for you. Worshipping you in the evening time, I shall listen to your katha or a recital and ultimately I shall consume your prasada” With this mental resolve, the lord should be worshipped in the evening in an appropriate manner. Five pitchers should be decorated and arches of banana tree should be made. The Saligrama should be adored with atmasukta and gold. It should be bathed with pancamrta. Then meditating upon lord Satyadeva, I offer my salutation to him. “The one who bestows all the four padarthas, salutation to him again and again.” This mantra should be repeated a hundred and eight times, and the homa should be performed by one tenth part of it. Thereafter, the sprinkling and oblation with water should be done. Then, the narration of the katha of lord Narayana in six chapters should be divided and distributed to all the listeners. The first part should go the Acarya, the second part should go to the relatives, the third part should go to the listeners, the fourth part should be kept for self. Thereafter, the Brahmanas should be served with food, satisfying them completely. Thereafter, the devotee should himself take food. Observing silence, О Devarsi, in case the puja of lord Satyanarayana is performed appropriately, then the desires of even those who do not perform the vrata are also fulfilled and their lives become successful. The deeds performed in this birth are rewarded in the next birth. The rewards of the deeds performed by a person in other births have to be faced always.

## \|\| 2.92.37-38 \|\|

*satyanārāyaṇa vratamiha sarvānkāmāndadāti hi \|*

*ityuktṃvā'tardadhe devo nāradaḥ svargatiṃ yayau \|*

37-38. But the reward of the Satyanarayana vrata is achieved by a person during this birth alone and all the desires get fulfilled. Therefore, I am performing this vrata in the middle of the universe today itself.” Thus speaking, Visnudeva disappeared. Then, Narada also departed from that place, towards the heaven. Thereafter, lord Satyanarayana reached Kasi.

## Chapter 93. Glory of Satya-narayana Vrata

## \|\| 2.93.1-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*

*itihāsamimaṃ vakṣye saṃvādaṃ hariviprayoḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1-4. Suta said- I am discussing about a dialogue between lord Visnu and a Brahmana, which was revealed by the lord by his own grace through the Brahmana. In the famous city of Каsi, there once lived a Brahmana known by the name of Satananda, who was a recluse. He was quite a poor person having a wife, a son. He lived in poverty, but still performed the vrata of lord Visnu regularly. Once, when the Brahmana was going for begging, lord Visnu met the poor, humble and peaceful Brahmana on the way in the form of an old Brahmana and asked the Brahmana- “O best of the Brahmanas, where are you going to earn your livelihood?”

## \|\| 2.93.5 \|\|

*śatānanda uvāca \|*  
*bhikṣāvṛttirahaṃ saumya kalatrāpatyahetave \|*  
*yācituṃ dhanināṃ dvāri vrajāmi dhanamuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Satanada said- “I live by begging, therefore for the up-keep of my family, I am going to beg from the abodes of the rich people.”

## \|\| 2.93.6-8 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhikṣāvṛttistvayā dīrghakālaṃ dvija sadā dhṛtā \|*  
*tadvāraka upāyoyaṃ viśeṣeṇa kalau kila \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mamopadeśato vipra satyanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja \|*  
*dāridryaśokaśamanaṃ saṃtāpaharaṇaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*caraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāhi mokṣadaṃ padmalocanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃbodhito vipro hariṇā karuṇātmanā \|*  
*punaḥ papraccha viprosau satyanārāyaṇo hi kaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Narayana said- “Because of your being a poor person, you have been begging for a long time. Therefore, in order to get you relieved of the begging, I am going to reveal to you a definite method. О Brahmana, at my advice, you better adore lord Satyanarayana. The feet of lord Narayana relieves one of misery and grief, besides all the sufferings. Therefore, in order to serve him, you must take refuge with the lotus-eyed lord who bestows salvation.” Thus at the advice of lord Visnu - the ocean of mercy, the Brahmana asked him repeatedly-“Who is lord Satyanarayana? You please tell me.”

## \|\| 2.93.9-16 \|\|

*vṛddhabrāhmaṇa uvāca \|*

*duḥkhodadhinimagnānāṃ taraṇiścaraṇau hareḥ \|*

*āhṛtya pūjāsaṃbhārānhitāya jagatāṃ dvija \|*  
*arcayaṃstamanudhyāyaṃstvametatprakaṭī kuru \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pītāṃbaraṃ navāṃbhojalocanaṃ smitapūrvakam \|*  
*vanamālāmadhuvrāta cuṃbitāṃgrisaroruham \|\| 13 \|\|*

*niśamya pulakāṃgosau premapūrṇasulocanaḥ \|*  
*stuvangadgadayā vācā daṃḍavatpatito bhuvi \|\| 14 \|\|*

*praṇamāmi jagannātha jagatkāraṇakārakam \|*

9-16. The old Brahmana said- “Lord Satyanarayana has many forms, truthful, omnipresent and is devoid of the three gunas. He is presently standing before you in the form of an old Brahmana. The feet of the said lord serve as the boat for the rescue of the people drowning in the ocean of the universe. Therefore, the intelligent people alone take refuge with him and not the sinful people. So, O Brahmana, for the welfare of the world, you collect the material for worship and using the same, adore him. You please him by meditating on him and adoring him.” Then the Brahmana had a look at the old person, who had the dark complexion like the fresh clouds, who held in his four hands club and other attributes, clad in lower yellow silken garment, the eyes resembling the fresh lotus flowers, who was having a serene smile over his face, wearing the long garland of lotus flowers and whose lotus like feet were kissed by the black wasps. Finding him in such a condition, the poor Brahmana was overwhelmed with delight. With his eyes filled with love, the Brahmana spoke in his choked voice and offered his salutation to him, falling on the ground like a rod. He said- “I offer my salutation to lord Jagannatha, who is the cause of the universe, who is the lord of the destitutes, who provides refuge to the people, is sinless, auspicious, who reveals the invisible one and who removes all the three types of sufferings.

## \|\| 2.93.17-30 \|\|

*karālāya kālāya viśvasya hartre namaste jaganmaṅgalāyātmamūrte \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dhanyosmyadya kṛtī dhanyo bhavodya saphalo mama \|*

17-30. I offer my salutation to lord Satyanarayana. Salutation to the creator, who happens to be the spotless tattva and maintains the universe, who taking to the terrific form destroys the universe. Besides, he is the form of the welfare of the world. Inspite of your being description by the mind and speech, you have appeared before me. Therefore, I feel myself to be quite graceful and successful. My life has met with success. What could I speak of my destiny today? I know not of what type of speech, I have been rewarded today that the body of useless person like me has also met with success. О lord of the universe and lord of RamA, by which method should you be worshipped? You tell me, О excellent one. Then lord Visnu, who could confuse the universe, said to the Brahmana with a smile on his face- “O best of the BrAhmanas, you need not spend much of riches in my puja. Whatever you can get without making much efforts, my devotee should worship me with the same. By so doing, you can be relieved of the misery like the Gajendra who was caught by a crocodile and Ajamila. О foremost of the Brahmanas, I am highlighting the procedure for the same. You please listen the method in which the material for adoration is collected and the worship is performed in an appropriate manner. According to the weight of a sera (930 grams), a half or one-fourth of wheat or wheat flour should be taken and similar quantity of ghi, milk and sugar should be added to it. (These things should be mixed up) and then the same should be offered to the lord. Cow’s milk, curd, ghi, water of the holy river Gangs, besides the honey should be mixed preparing pancamrta with the same. This should be used for the washing of the image of Saligrama. Thereafter, the fragrance, flowers, eatables, incense, lamp and the betel shall be offered to the same, reciting the Vedic mantras. Thereafter, the sweets, the fruits of the season and the flowers should be offered. Then, my story should be heard with all the relatives and friends and the Brahmanas, in which the history of wood cutter Bhilla and Vaisya is narrated. At the end of the narration, the prasada should be distributed with devotion.

## \|\| 2.93.31-33 \|\|

*labdhaṃ prasādaṃ bhuṃjīta mānayanna vicārayet \|*

*vidhinānena viprendra pūjayaṃti ca ye narāḥ \|*

31-33. Respecting the prasada, it should be consumed without any thought. I do not feel so pleased with the offering of riches as compared to the high devotion. О best of Brahmanas, following this process those who worship me, they achieve the sons, grandsons and excellent pleasures, while living on earth. After their death, they enjoy bliss while living with me. Those who perform this vrata, all their desires are fulfilled.

34-41. Thus speaking, lord Visnu disappeared from the scene and the Brahmana also achieved enormous pleasure. Then the Brahmana. overwhelmed with that performance, proceeded towards the direction he had desired in his mind. At the same time, he resolved in his mind- “Whatever I shall get in alms today, I shall worship lord Visnu with the same.” With this resolve in his mind, the Brahmana proceeded towards the city for getting alms. He received enormous riches even without asking for it. With his mind having been filled with anxiety, he got back to his home and narrated the entire episode to his wife. The lady got delighted on hearing the same and she received the burden of the wealth at the command of her husband. Then she informed all her relatives, friends and neighbours that she was organising the katha of Satyanarayana at her house, inviting them at the same time to join the same. With their devotion, lord Narayana got pleased (and appearing at the time of the function), he fulfilled all the desires of the Brahmana. At the command of the lord who is the favourite of his devotees, the Brahmana begged from the lord- “O lord, first of all, you kindly bestow on me your supreme devotion, besides the vrata to achieve the same. In addition to the above, you kindly get me chariots, elephants, gold, beautiful palaces, riches, slaves and slave girls, cows, land, milk giving buffalo and an opportunity to serve you.”

## \|\| 2.93.42-44 \|\|

*tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tataścāṃtardadhe prabhuḥ \|*  
*vipro'pikṛta kṛtyo'bhūtsarve lokā visismire \|\| 42 \|\|*

*praṇamya bhuvi kāyena prasādaṃ prāpurādarāt \|*
