71-84. He exercised his control over the Arya kings. Humiliating the gods and the pitrs, he then propagated the preta-puja, In this way, the Kalamali king, disturbing the people, ruled over the country for thirty two years. Thereafter, his sixty descendants, who were the resident of Naisdha country ruled for a hundred years one after the other. Thereafter, for a thousand years, the kingdom was divided into a hundred principalities of small size. During the period, the worship of the gods and the following of the Vedas was for the namesake only. After the lapse of three thousand and one hundred years subsequent to the rule of Pusyamitra at the end of the thirty second country, the gods expressing their grief, went to Krsnacaitanya and offering their salutation to him, spoke in sweet voice- “O lord, all the four varnas on earth have been completely desecrated, but you remain alive leading the life like the pretas. The people on earth leaving aside good activites, are following the denounced practices and because of this practice, they are suffering as well. This situation has been very well witnessed by us. The goblins, pretas, pisacas, dakinis and sakinis are getting intoxicated with their worship and are continuously denouncing the gods and the manes. Therefore, О master, you patronize those who take refuge with you. Kindly save us from the ugly situation, because they are all powerful and we are quite weak.” On hearing these words, Yajnamsa, who had been lodged in the orchard of Nadilha, spoke to the humble gods thus- “In the Magadha country, the king Puranjaya and his wife Puranjani are mediating for achieving Brahman. At my command, by their union, a strong and valorous son would be bom to them, He would be known by the name of Visvasphurji, He would follow the Brahma-marga, besides being virtuous.” Thereafter, Puranjani conceived. During the tenth month of conception, the prince named Visvasphurji was bom to her.

85-98. At the time of the birth of the prince, a divine voice from the sky declared- ‘‘Like the king Pusyamitra, who was the founder of Varyadharma, this valorous boy would also propagate the same dharma and would follow the Brahmamarga, Among the people of the Yadu race as well as the people of Bhadra country, he would establish the varya arrangement and would subjugate Kali, Besides this, he would also divert the minds of the people with wicked wisdom to the Vedic faith. He would also build a city named Padmavatipura for the destruction of the wicked rulers.” Accordingly, listening to the words of Akasavani, the king Puranjaya distributed the clothes to the poor as well as to the guests. О sage, at that point of time, eight thousand and eight hundred years had been spent after the arrival of Kali on earth. Then the immensely strong king named Visvasphurji exercised his control over the small principalities and included therein, the people of all the varyas. They included, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, Sudras, people of mixed breed, Pisacas, Gurundas, besides the Mlecchas. The people consuming the balanced diet, performed sandhya, tarpana and the worship of the gods as per the prescription in the Vedas and led an extremely comfortable life. Thus by ruling the country for sixty years, a thousand rulers of his dynasty, who ruled one after the other, gained immense popularity. They ruled for ten thousand years. The yajnas performed by the kings of the followers of Brahmamarga were equally shared by the gods as well as the daityas. Observing the same, the gods were immensely surprised. Thereafter, the godd went to take refuge with Yajnamsadeva and apprised him of the factual position. Learning about the factual position, Yajnamsadeva - the son of Sukra said- “The Vedas are the form of Narayana himself. Taking to the form of a prudent swan, he established the classification among the humans based on the castes, according to their merits. Those possessing the sattvaguna were called as Brahmanas; those with rajoguna were known as Ksatriyas; those with tamoguna were known as Vaisyas; and those who were of equal gunas were known as the Sudras. Out of these, the Brahmanas and Ksatriyas adore the manes as well as the gods, while the Vaisyas adore the Yaksas and Sudras adore the Raksasas.

*iti śrutvā ca sa kalirdetyapakṣavivarddhanaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

*svāṃśājjanma kalau prāpya gurjare deśadāruṇe \|*  
*ābhīrī siṃhikā nāma sihamāṃsāśanā khalā \|\| 111 \|\|*

*tasyā yonau samāgamya rāhurnāma sa cābhavat \|*  
*yathā rāhurnabhomārge dāruṇo hi vidhuntudaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

99-112. The daityas and danavas are pleased at the hands of the Sudras. In case, a caste is equated with all other castes, such people are known as Kayasthas, who can satisfy the goblins, pretas as well as the pisacas. Therefore, there are four varnas in Brahman. All these Brahmans are of mixed breed. With the giving of the part of yajna, the danavas feel half satisfied followed by the gods of the heaven. Therefore, О gods, during the time of the horrible age of Kali, I am going to incarnate in Saurastra region on the earth, out of my own amsa." Thus speaking, Yajhamsa incarnated in the house of the lord of Saurastra and came to be known as Somanatha. He defeated all the contemporary rulers and became popular by the name of Somanatha. Defeating all the contemporary rulers, he established his capital city over the seashore. By performing several of the yajnas, Somanatha always pleased the gods. Accordingly, by the grace of gods, he occupied the royal throne for a period of hundred years. During the period of his rule, samvad (era) started after his name. Subsequently, a hundred and fifty kings ruled from his race, one after another in quick succession for a thousand years, enjoying all the comforts. With the passing of thirty thousand years in the land of Bharatavarsa, the daitya feeling grieved, said to Kali - “In earlier times, we had adored Mahesvara for a hundred years, as a result of which, he getting pleased, gave all of us to you. Thereafter, half of your body was made hard like vajra, while the half was made as soft as a lotus. Therefore, О lord Kali, you kindly save as. We are suffering badly.” On hearing these words, Kali - the supporter of daityas, took out an amsa from his body, placed the same in the womb of a milkmaid named Simhika, who consumed the meat of a lion and took the birth. He came to be known as Rahu who troubles the moon staying in the sky and is called Vidhuntuda.

## \|\| 2.158.113-119 \|\|

*tathā rāhuḥ kaleraṃśo bhuvi jātaḥ surantudaḥ \|*  
*jātamātre sute tasminbhūmikampo mahānabhūt \|\| 113 \|\|*

*viparītā grahāḥ sarve janayanti mahadbhayam \|*  
*tadbhayātsakalā devāstyaktvā mūrtīḥ samantataḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

*mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sumerugirimūrddhani \|*  
*tadarthe bhagavāñchakrastuṣṭāva jagadambikām \|\| 115 \|\|*

*kanyāmūrtimayī devī surānprāha śivaṅkarī \|*  
*mamāṅgadarśanāddevāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca vinā sadā \|\| 116 \|\|*

*bhavadhvaṃ ca tato yūyaṃ madvilokanatatparāḥ \|*  
*iti śrutvā tu te devā harṣitāḥ sambamūvire \|\| 117 \|\|*

*ābhīrītanayo rāhuḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ \|*  
*tyaktvā prāṇānkalau līno babhūva munisattama \|\| 118 \|\|*

*tadanvaye sārddhaśatamayutābdāntarebhavat \|*  
*mahāmadamataṃ ghoraṃ cirakālādvināśitam \|\| 119 \|\|*

113-119. Similarly, Rahu as the amsa of Kali, having been born on earth, was called as Surantuda (one who troubles the gods). At the time of his birth, there occurred a terrible earthquake. All the gods becoming adverse, indicated danger. At that point of time, all the gods disowning their own images, went to the peak of Sumeru mountain and took refuge with Mahendra. On hearing about the same, Indra adored and worshipped the goddess Jagadamba. Subsequently, the goddess appeared in the form of a girl. The auspicious goddess Bhagavati said- “O Devendra, by having a look at my body, your hunger and thirst cannot subside. Therefore, you should remain here always and have audience with me.” These words of the goddess were delightfully accepted by the gods. О excellent sages, Rahu - the son of the milkmaid, putting an end to his life, ruled for a hundred years and was absorbed into the body of Kali. Subsequently, in the same dynasty, a hundred and fifty rulers, the relatives of Mahamada who had been destroyed since long time, owned their kingdom and ruled over the same.

## \|\| 2.158.120-124 \|\|

*taiḥ punaścoddhṛtaṃ bhūmau sarve mlecchā babhūvire \|*  
*na vedāśca na devāśca na varṇāśca kalau yuge \|\| 120 \|\|*

*dṛśyante na ca maryādā kalikāle tadanvaye \|*  
*dvijaśeṣāḥ sahasrāśca punararbudamūrddhani \|\| 121 \|\|*

*dvādaśāhaṃ prayatnena devānārādhituṃ kṣamā \|*  
*arbudācca samudbhūto rājanyaḥ khaḍgacarmadhṛk \|\| 122 \|\|*

*jitvā mlecchāndurādharṣānnāmnā cārvabalī hyabhūt \|*  
*pañcayojanamānā sa bhūmirātmavivṛddhaye \|\| 123 \|\|*

*nirmitā tena śuddhena nāmnā cārvapurī smṛtā \|*  
*śanaiḥ śanairāryakulaṃ punastatra vavarddha ha \|\| 124 \|\|*

120-124. They further propagated their own ideology in an extensive way as a result of which all the people of the earth started embracing the religion of Mlecchas. During the terrific time of Kali and during the period of rule of these kings, the Vedas, the gods and the caste system almost vanished. The ancient traditions were almost wiped out. At that point of time, the remaining hundred Brahmanas reached the peak of the Arbuda mountain and adored the gods, making all the efforts. As a result of which, there emerged a group of kings from Arbuda mountain, who held swords and shields and who became victorious over the Mlecchas and came to be known as the valorous Carvas. For the expansion of their race, they built a city over the plane land spread in an area of five yojanas, which came to be known by the name of Suddha. The race of Aryans started spreading at that place slowly and slowly.

## \|\| 2.158.125-132 \|\|

*śatārddhābdaṃ prayatnena tena rājyaṃ mahatkṛtam \|*  
*tadanvaye sārddhaśataṃ nṛpāścāsaṃstadā mune \|\| 125 \|\|*

*ayutābdāntare vīrā mlecchamitrāśca saṅkarāḥ \|*  
*mlecchakanyodvahā ghorā nāmamātrāryyamārgagāḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

*tadā malayadeśasthairmlecchairlakṣapramāṇakaiḥ \|*  
*ārvudāryaiḥ samaṃ yuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam \|\| 127 \|\|*

*varṣamātrāntare jitvā mālavasthā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*maṇḍalīkapadātaiśca muktamāryaiḥ samantataḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

*catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi varṣāṇi jagatītale \|*  
*mlecchabhūpāśca śataśo babhūvuḥ svalpajīvinaḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

*paṃcaviṃśatsahasrāṇi teṣāṃ saṃkhyā ca bhūbhujām \|*  
*ye tu puṇyā mahīpālāḥ pūrvajanmatapodbhavāḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ līlā ca munibhiḥ purāṇeṣu prakīrtitā \|*  
*nānāsaṃvatkarāḥ sarve paiśācā dharmadūṣakāḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

*navatyabdasahasrāṇi vyatītāni kalau yuge \|*  
*jātā mlecchamayī bhūmiralakṣmīstu janejane \|\| 132 \|\|*

125-132. While staying there, they ruled the country for fifty years. О sage, thereafter, a hundred and fifty rulers ruled the country for ten thousand years. After ten thousand years, those rulers established friendship with the Mlecchas and started marrying the Mleccha girls, who produced the Aryans for name sake only. The followers of the Arya paths had only the symbolic following. In the meantime, the Mlecchas of the Malaya country were collected, whose number was one lakh. They invaded the Aryans over the Arbuda mountain in a war which continued for a year. In that terrific war, the Mlecchas of the Malava country, who happened to be the foot soldiers of the king, defeated the king and drove out the Aryans from their country. In this way, the Mlecchas ruled over this country for forty thousand years. The number of these Mleccha rulers was twenty five thousand. Those of the rulers who were noble-minded and had performed tapas in the earlier birth, they rose to the position of the kings. Their life stories have been narrated by the sages in the puranas. They were the starters of samvats, besides being the destroyers of pisacas dharma. After the lapse of ninety thousand years, the Mlecchas were spread all over the earth in the age of Kali and the entire land had the population of the Mlecchas in which everybody suffered from poverty.

## Chapter 159. Collateral history of the Age of Kali

## \|\| 2.159.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tataste sakalā daityāḥ kalinā ca puraskṛtāḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā ca jalayānāni harikhaṇḍamupāyayuḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*manujā harikhaṇḍe ca devatulyā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*ayudhyaṃstānmahāśastrairayutābdaprajīvinaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*daśavarṣāntare sarve māyāyuddhaiḥ parājitāḥ \|*  
*mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurharikhaṇḍanivāsinaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Suta said- Soon thereafter, all the daityas, making Kali to lead them, proceeded on to Harikhanda by the boat. On their reaching there, the people of that place, who were valorous like god and each one of them enjoyed the life of ten thousand years, fought with the daityas with their own weapons. After the lapse of ten years of war, the people of Harikhanda were defeated and they took refuge with the lord Mahendra.

## \|\| 2.159.4-13 \|\|

*tadā tu bhagavāñchakro viśvakarmāṇamabravīt \|*  
*bhramiśca nāmayantro'yaṃ saṃsthitaḥ saptasindhuṣu \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tvayā viracitastāta tatprabhāvānnarā bhuvi \|*  
*anyakhaṇḍe na gacchanti sa ca yantrastu māyinā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mayena bhraṃśito bhrātrā mlecchaiḥ sārddhaṃ samantataḥ \|*  
*saptadvīpeṣu yāsyanti manujā mama vairiṇaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ato naḥ pāhi maryādāṃ bhūmadhye bhavatā kṛtām \|*  
*iti śrutvā viśvakarmā divyayantramacīkarat \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tena yantraprabhāvena bhramitāste babhūvire \|*  
*bhramiyantrānmahāvāyurjjāto mlecchavināśakaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tadvāyorabhavatputro vātyo vātyāsamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*daityayakṣāṃśca paiśācāñjitvā jñānamayo balī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstrivarṇāstena satkṛtāḥ \|*  
*balānmlecchānvarṇamayānkṛtvā vātyo mahābalaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śatārddhābdaṃ maṇḍalīkaṃ padaṃ bhuvi gṛhītavān \|*  
*tadanvaye sahasrāśca nṛpāścāsankalau yuge \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vāyupakṣāstrivarṇāḍhyāḥ ṣoḍaśābdasahasrake \|*  
*vāyorjātaḥ svayaṃ brahmā vāyorjātaḥ sa vai hariḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vāyorjāto mahādevaḥ sarvaṃ vāyumayaṃ jagat \|*  
*vinā vāyuṃ mṛtāḥ sarve vāyunā bhuvi jīvinaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

4-13. At that point of time, Mahendra said to Visvakarma - “O excellent one, in all the seven oceans, the yantras made by you have been established and by the danger of which a person cannot travel from one region to another. But the illusory maуa of the daitya has destroyed the yantra, as a result of which my enemies together with the Mlecchas can travel freely in all the seven islands. Therefore, the traditions which had been prescribed by you have now to be protected by you." On hearing these words, Vilvakarma created a divine yantra, with influence of which all the travellers started rotating themselves. Again with the same yantra, the dust storm emerged from the earth, for the destruction of the Mlecchas, Subsequently, a son named Vatya was bom out of the storm. The powerful son, who was quite learned as well, defeated Daityas, Yaksas and PUdcas and established the three varnas of Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas, providing them a special position. The immensely valorous Vatya also created castes among the Mlecchas. Thus, while decorating the position of a Mandalika ruler on earth, he ruled the country for a period of fifty years. During the time of the age of Kali, a thousand rulers of his dynasty who were the supporters of the Windgod and the three varnas, continued to rule the country for sixteen thousand years, because Brahma himself had his origin from Vayu. Similarly, the entire universe, Visnu and Mahadeva originated from the wind. When a person on earth is deprived of the wind, he dies and when gains the wind, he becomes alive.

## \|\| 2.159.14-16 \|\|

*iti matvā tu te lokā vāyuṃ ca samatarpayan \|*  
*punastadā kalirghoro daityarājaṃ baliṃ prabhum \|\| 14 \|\|*

*natvā nivedayāmāsa duḥkhito'bhūttadā baliḥ \|*  
*vāmanāntikamāgamya kalimitreṇa saṃyutaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*natvovāca sa vai rājā devadevaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*tvayā kaliḥ kṛto mahyaṃ prasannena surottama \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Thus realizing, the dwellers of earth variously tried to please the Windgod. Thereafter, in the terrific age of Kali, he went to Bali - the king of daityas and apprised him of the factual position. On hearing these words, expressing his displeasure, Bali with Kalimitra went to lord Vamana and offering salutation to him, said to Janardana - the god of gods- “O best of gods, you had delightfully created Kali in earlier times for my sake.

## \|\| 2.159.17-26 \|\|

*tataḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrābdaṃ devairbhuktaṃ surasthalam \|*  
*tataḥ paṃcaśataṃ varṣaṃ kiñcidadhikameva ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*mayā bhuktā karmabhūmiḥ sarvalokasya kāraṇāt \|*  
*tataḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrābdaṃ devairbhukteyamuttamā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tataḥ sārddhasahasrābdaṃ kiñcidūnaṃ mayā dhṛtā \|*  
*sārddhatriṃśatsahasrābdaṃ devairdetyaistathā mahī \|\| 21 \|\|*

*bhuktā daityaiḥ punardevaiḥ tathā devaiśca dānavaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tvayā datto hi me deva kaliḥ kalivināśana \|*  
*nādhikāraṃ kṛtaṃ nātha satyaṃ satyapriyakṣama \|\| 23 \|\|*

*iti śrutvā balervākyaṃ bhagavānvāmano hariḥ \|*  
*svāṃśānmahītale prāpto daityapakṣavivardhanaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kāmaśarmā tadā vipro yamunātaṭasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*hariṃ tuṣṭāva manasā dvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tadā tu vāmanaḥ śrīmānvacaḥ prāha dvijottamam \|*  
*varaṃ brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha yatte manasi saṃsthitam \|*  
*iti śrutvā kāmaśarmā tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā \|\| 26 \|\|*

17-26. But in Bharata - the land of activity, after the departure of Kali, the followers of the Windgod turned him out after humiliating him. Only a small period of the lapse of the foot of the Kali has been left out. I had enjoyed the rule of the earth with authority like Indra. During the age of Kali as well, have ruled the earth for a thousand years, Subsequently, the gods ruled the Devabhumi for fifteen hundred years. Thereafter, I have also ruled the Devabhumi for fifteen hundred years, which had been the best of all. For little lesser period, I established my control over it. After that, the Daityas and the Devas ruled over the universe. Thus after the Daityas, the gods ruled the earth and after the gods, the Daityas did so. О Deva - the destroyer of Kali, though you have endowed me with Kali, but I enjoy no truthful authority." On hearing these words, lord Vamana - Vissu, for the increase in the family of the daityas, thought of incarnating on earth out of his amsa. At that point of time, a Brahmana named Kamasarma had been performing tapas over the bank of the river Yamuna for over twelve years, making all the efforts. Getting pleased with his devotion, lord Vamana said to the Brahmana - “O best of the Brahmasas, you ask for a boon you desire.” On hearing these words, Kamasarma humbly spoke to Vamana, offering prayer to him.

## \|\| 2.159.27-32 \|\|

*kāmaśarmovāca \|*  
*namo devāya mahate sarvapūjyāya te namaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dharmapriyāya dharmāya devadaityakarāya ca \|*  
*daivādhīnanṛṇāṃ bhartre karmakartre namo namaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*daivādhīnāśca te devā daivollaṅghāśca dānavāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ bharttā kramāddhartā tasmai devāya te namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*putro bhava hare svāminsaphalaṃ vāñchitaṃ kuru \|*  
*iti śrutvā hariḥ sākṣādvāmano balirakṣakaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*svapūrvārddhāddevahūtyāṃ tatpatnyāṃ ca samudbhavaḥ \|*  
*dvidhā bhūtvā mahī jātau divyāṅgau divyavigrahau \|\| 31 \|\|*

*bhogasihaḥ kelisiṃha devapo daityapo hariḥ \|*  
*jitvā vātyodbhavānbhūpātkalpakṣetramupasthitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

27-32. Kamasarma said- “O greatest of the gods and adorable by all, salutation to you. You are Dharmpriya, Dharmamurti, creator of the gods and the daityas. Because of your being under the control of the destiny, you are the preserver of the humans, Kramaddharta, salutation to you again and again. Your gods are under the control of Destiny, while the danavas violate the destiny. You feed as well as destroy them all. O master, I have a great desire to get you as my son. You kindly fulfil my desires.” On hearing these words, Visnu -the protector of Bali, out of his upper half incarnated with Devahuti and then in the womb of the wife of the Brahmana, divided his body into two parts. Both the parts were known by the names of Bhogasimha and Kelisimha, who were the protectors of gods as well as the daityas, Becoming victorious over the rulers of the race of the Windgod, they built their abodes in the Kalpaksetra.

## \|\| 2.159.33-45 \|\|

*pūrvajātāstrivarṇāśca bhakṣayitvā dinedine \|*  
*karmabhūmyāṃ vavṛdhire pakṣiṇaśca yathā drume \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tadā kaleśca caraṇo dvitīyo bhuvi cāgamat \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yathā khagāḥ karmahīnāścatvāriṃśābdajīvinaḥ \|*  
*bhūmigāśca tathā te vai bhedaṃ teṣveṣu naiva bhoḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dṛśyante cādya yuṣmābhirbhūtale kinnarā narāḥ \|*

*na vivāho na bhūpaśca nodyamo na hi karmakṛt \|*  
*bhavitā ca tadā teṣāṃ dvitīyacaraṇāntike \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sapādalakṣābdamitamadyaprabhṛti bho dvijāḥ \|*  
*bhogakelyanvayodbhūtā bhaviṣyanti mahītale \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ato mayā ca sahitā bhavanto munisattamāḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya gamiṣyāmastadājñayā \|\| 45 \|\|*

33-45. Maya daitya had built there a city named Kridavati. Both the powerful warriors established this capital city there and made it as their abode. By living there, both of them expanded Kali immensely. She is basically Sanatani and wife of all the Dharmas, but the Aryans, who united with them, all of them earning blemish, became the followers of the dharma of the people of mixed breed. Thus realizing, the lord taking to the form of Kamamaya body, started uniting with damsels in a day. All the damsels then getting pleased, started producing the children. All those women produced twins (a son and a daughter), who attaining the marriageable age, added to the population of the age of Kali. In this way, several types of creations were made in the age of Kali. All of them started consuming daily the people of three varnas and destroyed them, but they expanded their own race like the birds living in the trees. At that point of time, the second foot of Bali had appeared on earth. After the lapse of two thousand years, the sons who produced progeny with huge bodies, the descendants of the same were reduced to the size of a fish, but they conducted themselves as the daityas. Such types of discussions were quite common with Kinnaras - the demigods of the contemporary period. As the birds, having been deprived of the activity, can live for forty years only, similarly, there is no difference on earth among them. Presently, you come across Kinnaras or demigods on earth, but at the time of the end of the second foot (part) of Kali age, things would appear in the reverse side. At that point of time, the people would never perform a marriage; nor would there be kings; nor would anyone make any effort; nor would anyone be engaged in any activity. О Brahmanas, this would happen by the end of the second phase of Kali. Upto a lakh and a quarter of the years, the descendants of Bhogasimha and Kalisimha would hold the royal positions. Therefore, О excellent sages, let us go to the Krsnacaitanya and move to the place which is suggested by him.

## \|\| 2.159.46-49 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*iti śrutvā tu munayo viśālāpūrnivāsinaḥ \|*  
*bho namaste gamiṣyanti yajñāṃśaṃ prati harṣitāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*natvā sarve muniśreṣṭhā yajñāṃśaṃ yajñarūpiṇam \|*  
*vacanaṃ ca vadiṣyanti dehyājñāṃ bhagavanprabho \|\| 47 \|\|*

*indraloke gamiṣyāmo nākamadhyaṃ manoharam \|*  
*iti śrutvā tu yajñāṃśaḥ sarvaśiṣyasamanvitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha svarlokaṃ gamiṣyati surapriyaḥ \|*  
*tadā kaliḥ samaṃ daityairbhajiṣyati mahītalam \|*  
*kimanyacchrotumicchā te hṛṣīkottama tadvada \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. Vyasa said- On hearing these words, the saints of the city of Visala delightfully went to have an audience with Yajnamsadeva. Reaching there, they offered their salutation to him and then spoke to Yajnamsadeva. They said- “In case you so permit then we could go to Indraloka, which is quite pleasing and is located in the middle of the heaven.” Hearing these words, Yajnamsadeva with all the sages shall travel to the heaven. After this, Kali would dominate everywhere in the world. Next, which one of the episode would you like to listen from me?”

## \|\| 2.159.50 \|\|

*manuruvāca \|*  
*bhagavanvistarādbrūhi bhogakelicaritrakam \|*  
*kalau yathā bhaviṣyanti manujāstattathā prabho \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Manu said- Kindly narrate the story of the Bhoga and Kali in detail. What type of people would be there in Kali? How would they lead their lives? You enlighten us on this aspect as well.

51-64. Vyasa said- Bhogasimha and Kalisimha, who were born of the amsa of Vamana, defeated the descendants of the Windgod or Vatya and conducted themselves as the daityas and delightfully occupied the throne. Their followers, who were the descendants of Vamana, felt greatly delighted with their lord, becoming the ruler. At that point of time, the gods painfully discarding their images, went to Krsnacaitanya and offering their salutation to him, spoke quite humbly to him- “O lord, by your grace, during the first phase of Kali, we had defeated the leaders of the daityas and enjoyed all the comforts on earth. But О lord of compassion, О lord Yajnamsadeva, what should we do presently? You kindly tell us. All of us offer our salutation to you.' On hearing these words, lord Visnu said- “0 best of the gods, you listen to what is being told by me. I am prepared to come along with you to the heaven. Therefore, О sage, you together with all the sages, should proceed on to the heaven.” О Manu, when Suta will thus address the sages, the gods will bring the plane and carry the great Rsis with them. They would also reach Krsnacaitanya in the Nadiha orchard. Meeting him, they would proceed on to the heaven. They would be accompanied with Ahlada yogi, Gorakhanatha, Sankaracarya, Rudramsa, Bhartrhari as well as the monarchs. All the yogins would proceed on to the heaven, together with Krsnacaitanya. At the time of the second phase of Kali, both the yogis bom of the amsa of Vamana, sitting in meditation like a yogi, shall live in Kalpaksetra. At that point of time, the daityas shall delightfully widen the paths for visiting patala with the humans. During the third phase of Kali, the Kinnaras would slowly perish from the earth. After the lapse of twenty six thousand years, at the command of Rudra, Rsi Bhrhga would be bom in the same race, supporting the ideology of the goblins.

65-81. Thereafter, he would produce terrific people from his wife named Saurabhi. These sons would resemble the kalas. They shall be eating up all the Kinnaras, destroying them completely. At that stage of Kali, the maximum age of the humans would be twenty six years. At that point of time, the Kinnaras getting freighted, would take refuge with the Bhogasimha and Kalisimha, with the result that there would be a terrific fight with the humans. Getting defeated, the Kinnaras would move to patala with the daityas. Then the vision of the sage Bhrnga would turn terrific. The humans, getting blinded with passion, would unite with mothers, sisters, the daughters as well as the animals and the sons would thus be produced. At the end of the third phase of Kali, the universe would get destroyed. They would take the form of birds during the age of Kali. During the fourth phase of Kali, the average age of the humans would be twenty years. All of them, like the people of cities and the people living in water, would live on roots and fruits, like the forest people. During those times, the Tamisra and other hells shall be filled with the followers of the Vedas. In the first phase, the people of Bharata shall reach Satyaloka; in the second phase they shall reach the Tapoloka; in the third phase, they would reach Janaloka; and during the fourth phase, they would reach the heaven. In the first phase of Tretayuga, they (humans) reach Dhumraloka, Bhuvarloka and the heaven. In the second phase, they reach Rsiloka, heaven in the third phase; and Bhuvarloka in the fourth phase. In the first phase of Dvapara, the people reach Puskara-dvipa; in the second phase, they reach Salmala-dvipa. In the third phase, they reach Kraunca-dvipa and in the fourth phase, they reach Jambu-dvipa. All these Iokas are filled with the ascetics. Similarly, in the first phase of Kali, the entire universe, both up and down was filled (with the people of Bharata). During the second phase, all the seven Iokas with patala; and in third phase, Bhuloka was filled by people of Bharata. All the altar of the hell were also filled by these people. Thus, I have provided answer to all your questions.”

## Chapter 160. Collateral history of the Age of Kali

## \|\| 2.160.1-8 \|\|

*indriyaprakṛtīnāṃ ca daśānāṃ grāmataddaśa \|\| 1 \|\|*

*namaste dharmarājāya naśca tṛptikarāya ca \|*

*iti śrutvā dharmarājaścitraguptena saṃyutaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ ca gamiṣyanti sandhyāyāṃ ca kalau yuge \|*  
*caturaśca yamāndṛṣṭvā parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tadīritaṃ svayaṃ jñātvā kṣīrābdhiṃ prati yāsyati \|*  
*pūjayityā jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ vṛṣākapim \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sāṅkhyaśāstramayaiḥ stotraiḥ saṃstoṣyati param prabhum \|\| 6 \|\|*

*jaya jaya jaya nirguṇa guṇadhārinragajagajīvatattvaśubhakārin \|*

*tasmai namo namo guṇarāśe devavṛndahṛdi kṛṣṇavikāśe \|\| 7 \|\|*

*rajobhūtatattvebhya utāśu viracati bhuvi ca narānsvayamāśu \|*

*pāhi nātha no daityavināśinkālajanitalīlāguṇabhāsin \|\| 8 \|\|*

1-8. Vyasa said- With the start of the fourth phase of the age of Kali, twenty one hells, having been overcrowded, went to Yamaraja and offering their salutation to him, said to him- “Salutation to Dharmaraja, who has overfed us. But О omniscient one, you kindly listen to my prayer. О best of the gods, we have now been overfed. You kindly tell us the way out to get ourself relieved of this ailment.” On hearing these words, Dharmaraja together with Citragupta, went to Brahma during the evening time of the age of Kali. The Paramesthi Brahma with all the four ganas when found Yamaraja there, he learnt about the purpose of their arrival and proceeded on to lord Visnu in the ocean of milk. Reaching there, they reciting the stotras from Samkhya philosophy, adored lord Visnu, who is the supreme Brahman - the lord of the universe, besides being the god of gods. “You are the one who takes to visible or invisible forms, besides being Brahman. Victory to you again and again. You are the auspicious creator of the mobile and immobile living beings. You created the gods with the essence of the tattvas of Satvaguna and also protects them. You are the treasure of virtues who is lodged in the hearts of the gods as Sri Krsna again and again. Salutation to you. You creates the humans of the earth in no time, feeds them and also finally destroys them as well. You are a large-hearted lord, because you carry the entire load of the universe over your head. Therefore, О lord, the destroyer of the daityas, you kindly protect us, because you emerged out of the sports of Kali.”

## \|\| 2.160.9-18 \|\|

*teṣāmiti vacanaṃ prabhuḥ śrutvā hyavanimivāśu \|*

*taṃ dvijaṃ viṣṇuyaśasaṃ gṛhītvā nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ \|*  
*baddhvā sarve sapatnīkaṃ kārāgāre dṛḍhāyase \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kariṣyanti mahādhūrtā nārakā iva dāruṇāḥ \|*

*janiṣyati mahāviṣṇuḥ sarvalokaśivaṅkaraḥ \|*

*guruḥ śukraḥ śaniḥ rāhuḥ ketustatra gamiṣyati \|*  
*padyaikaikena te devāḥ stoṣyanti parameśvaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

9-18. Listening to the words of the gods, when the all competent lord would incarnate on earth or the manner in which he would do so, is being related by me. You please listen. At that point of time, the gods who had been filled with humility, were looked at by lord Visnu, who said- “O Devas, Kasyapa would be bom in the village named Sambhala and would be known by the name of Visnuyasa. His wife would be known as Visnukirti. To whomsoever, he would recite the treatise on the sports of Krsna, the people of the village getting united, would bind him with strong iron chains. He would be imprisoned with his wife. While so doing, the sinful people would have terrific forms and they would feel delighted by their performance. In the prison, from the womb of the wife of a Brahmana, the complete Brahman would be born, who is also known as Hari, Mahavisnu besides being the welfare of all. On the dark eighth day, at dead of night, by incarnating with all the gods, for the welfare of all the human beings, Brahma, Visnu, Mahesa, Ganesa, Indra, Brhaspati, Agni, Aryama, Yaksa, Vibhisana with Varuna, Citra, Vayu, Dhruva, Visvadeva, Surya, Moon, Mars, Budha, Brhaspati, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu arrived there and each one of them reciting passage, would offer prayer to the Lord.

## \|\| 2.160.19-22 \|\|

*mahattamā mūrtimayī tavājā tadāsya pūrvājjanitoha'mādau \|*  
*mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ sadaiva yato namastatpuruṣottamāya \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ajasya yāmyājjanito'hamādau viṣṇurmahākalpakaro'dhikārī \|*  
*svakīyanāmnā tu mayā tataṃ tadviśve sadaivaṃ ca namo namaste \|\| 20 \|\|*

*avyaktapāścātyamukhātsujanmā śivo'hamādau suratattvakārī \|*  
*mayā mahākalpakarastṛtīyā tvadājñayā deva namo namaste \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pradhānavaktrottarato'hamādau jāto gaṇeśaḥ kila kalpakartā \|*  
*mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ sadaiva tasmai namaḥ kāruṇikottamāya \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. From your greatest figure, which is known as Aja, I was initially born from the eastern face. Using the same body, I have expanded the entire universe. Salutation to the same Purusottama. From the southern face of Aryama, Visnu who is the creator of Mahakalpa and holds a position of authority, I was born first of all. With the same face, I have expanded the entire universe. Salutation to the same Purusottama. From the Avyakta western face, Siva had emerged. I was made as the creator of Suratattva with a position of an authority. Therefore, at your command, I built the third Mahatkalpa. Salutation to you. О Deva, from your face which is to the east, I, Ganesa - the creator of kalpa initially emerged. О Deva, together with other gods, I extensively expanded the world. Therefore, salutation to you - the form of compassion.

## \|\| 2.160.23-28 \|\|

*ajārddhavaktrājjanito'hamādau marunmahākalpakaro mahendraḥ \|*

*prathānabhālākṣisamudbhavo'haṃ vahnermahākalpakaro guhākhyaḥ \|*  
*vinirmitaṃ viśvamidaṃ mayā tadyadājñayā nātha namo namaste \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ajābhujāddakṣiṇato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakakaraḥ sadharmaḥ \|*  
*mayā sadevai racitaṃ samagraṃ liṅgākhyakalpāya namo namaste \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ajābhujātpaścimato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakaraḥ sa yajñaḥ \|*
