*pradhānabāhūttarato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakaraḥ pracetāḥ \|*  
*mayā tataṃ nātha tavājñayedaṃ karmākhyakalpāya namo namaste \|\| 28 \|\|*

23-28. I was initially bom from half the face of Aja. I created the Marut-Mahalkalpa as a result of which I came to be known as Mahendra. О Deva, during the time of my kalpa, I created the world with gods. Salutation to you, О lord, the third eye in your forehead is the form of fire. I was bom out of the same and came to be known by the name of Guha. О lord, at your command, I created the universe quite extensively. Out of the unborn Deva’s eastern ami, I emerged as Agni. During my own time, I created a great kalpa. I also contributed to the expansion of the universe. Salutation to you - the form of the universal kalpa. I was initially born from the right hand of the unborn. I created Linga-kalpa with the goddess. Therefore, salutation to you, О Linga-kalpa! I initially emerged from the western ann of Ajadeva as yajna. Then I created the Matsya-kalpa besides the universe. Salutation to you - the form of Matsya-kalpa. The main arm which appears to the north, produced me initially as Aceta. О lord, at your command, I created a great kalpa of karma which had been quite great. I have expanded it as well. Salutation to Karma-kalpa representing you.

## \|\| 2.160.29-32 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍatamaso jātastvaddāso'haṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*mayā tataṃ trilokaṃ ca namaste manurūpiṇe \|\| 29 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍasadguṇājjātaścitto'haṃ manukārakaḥ \|*  
*mayā tataṃ ca trailokyaṃ svāyambhuva namo'stu te \|\| 30 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍarajaso jāto vāyurmanvantaraṃ tatam \|*  
*mayā svārociṣaṃ svāminnamaste manurūpiṇe \|\| 31 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍamanaso jāto dhruvo'haṃ manukārakaḥ \|*  
*mayottamaṃ ca racitaṃ namaste'stu tavājñayā \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. I had been born of the tamas over darkness of the universe, as your slave. I expanded all the three Iokas. Therefore, salutation to you being the form of Manu. My mind was born from the sattvaguna of the universe. I created Manu, besides expanding the three Iokas. Therefore, salutation to you as the form of Svayambhuva or the self-born one. Out of the rajoguna of the universe, I was initially born as Vayu. At your command, I expanded the Manvantara. Therefore, I am Svarocisa Manvantara and offer my salutation to the Purusa like you. With the mental activity of the universe, I had been born as Dhruva (pole star). Obeying you command, I created Manu. Therefore, salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.160.33-37 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍaśravaṇājjāto viśvakarmāhamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*mayā tataṃ raivataṃ ca namo deva tavājñayā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍadehato jātassūryo'haṃ cākṣuṣapradaḥ \|*  
*tavājñayā tataṃ viśvaṃ manurūpāya te namaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍanetrato jātaḥ somo'haṃ tu mayā tatam \|*  
*vaivasvatāntaraṃ ramyaṃ namaste manurūpiṇe \|\| 35 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍarasanājjāto moho'haṃ manukārakaḥ \|*  
*namaste manurūpāya mayā sāvarṇikaṃ tatam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍaghrāṇato jāto budho'haṃ nātha kiṅkaraḥ \|*  
*nirmitaṃ brahmasāvarṇaṃ mayā tāta namo namaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

33-37. From the ears of the globe, I was born as Visvakarma. О Deva, I created Raivata by obeying you command. Therefore, I offer my salutation to you. I was born as the sun from the body of the globe. With use of the Caksusa lustre, I expanded this universe by creating the form of humans. Salutation to you. As Soma, I was born out of the vision of the globe. I created the Vaivasvata Manvantara. Therefore, I offer my salutation to you as a human being. As the confusion, I was born out of the juice of the universe. I expanded the Savarni Manu. Therefore, I offer my salutation to the form of Manu. О lord, out of the nose of the universe, I was born as Budha. О excellent one, I expanded the Brahmasavarni in a comprehensive manner. Therefore, salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.160.38-42 \|\|

*brahmāṇḍavaktrato jāto jīvo'haṃ manukārakaḥ \|*  
*mayā vai dakṣasāvarṇaṃ tataṃ tatte namo namaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍakarato jātaḥ śukrohaṃ tava kiṅkaraḥ \|*  
*nirmitaṃ rudrasāvarṇaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍapadato jātomando'haṃ nātha te'nugaḥ \|*  
*tataṃ vai dharmasāvarṇaṃ prabhātesmai namo namaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍaliṅgato jāto rāhuścāhaṃ tava priyaḥ \|*  
*mayā bhaumaṃ kṛtaṃ nātha namaste manurūpiṇe \|\| 41 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍaguhyato jātaḥ ketuścāhaṃ tavānugaḥ \|*  
*bhautaṃ manvataraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ tasmai devāya te namaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

38-42. As a Jiva, I was born out of the face of the universe. I built and expanded the Savarni Manu. Therefore, salutation to you. I as Sukra, had been bom out of the hand of the Brahmanda. I expanded Rudrasavarni after creating the same. Salutation to you. Since I had emerged out of the feet of the universe, therefore, I came to be known as Sani or Saturn. О lord, I have created Garbhasavarni and expanded the same. Therefore, salutation to you as the lustre. Similarly, I was bom out of the phallus of the universe and was known as loveable Rahu. I created Bhima. Therefore, salutation to you as a human being. Out of the anus of the universe, Ketu was bom, who happens to be your follower. Therefore, salutation to you in your divine form.

## \|\| 2.160.43-45 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*iti teṣāṃ stavānsvāmī śrutvā devānvadiṣyati \|*  
*varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ tataṃ prati manuḥ kramāt \|\| 43 \|\|*

*iti kṛtvā tu te devā bālarūpaṃ hariṃ svayam \|*  
*namaskṛtya vadiṣyanti vāñchitaṃ lokahetave \|\| 44 \|\|*

*keyaṃ bhavānbrūhi lokānāṃ kalpe kalpe tamudbhavam \|*  
*tathā manvantare caiva śrotumicchāmahe vayam \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Vyasa said- Listening to these types of prayers of the Devas, the lord Visnudeva would ask each one of the gods to seek a boon. On hearing these words, all the gods shall offer their salutation to the infant form of the lord and express their individual desire to the lord, for the welfare of the Iokas. Therefore, you kindly narrate the stories of all the people of all the Manvantaras.

## \|\| 2.160.46-54 \|\|

*kalkyuvāca \|*  
*aṣṭādaśa mahākalpāḥ prakṛteśca tanau sthitāḥ \|*  
*ādyo brahmamahākalpastatra brahmā paraḥ pumān \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tatpūrvārddhātsamudbhūtāstrayastriṃśacca devatāḥ \|*  
*parārddhādbhagavānbrahmā yogidhyeyo nirañjanaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*tasminkalpe tu yā līlā brahmapaurāṇikaiḥ smṛtā \|*  
*śatakoṭipravistāro brahmapaurāṇikasya vai \|\| 48 \|\|*

*purāṇapuruṣasyānte mahākalpaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇḍapralaye kalpo yugadaivasahasrakaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kalpāścāṣṭādaśa khyātāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu \|*  
*kūrmakalpo matsya kalpaḥ śvetavārāhakalpakaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*nṛsiṃhakalpaśca tathā tathā vāmanakalpakaḥ \|*  
*skandakalpo rāmakalpaḥ kalpo bhāgavatastathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tathā mārkaṇḍakalpaśca tathā bhaviṣyakalpakaḥ \|*  
*liṅgakalpastathā jñeyastathā brahmāṇḍakalpakaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*agnikalpo vāyukalpaḥ padmakalpastathaiva ca \|*  
*śivakalpo viṣṇukalpo brahmakalpastathā kramāt \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dvisahasramitāvartaireṣāṃ kalpo mahānsmṛtaḥ \|*  
*sahasrayugaparyantaṃ brahmāṇḍāyuḥ prakīrtitam \|\| 54 \|\|*

46-54. Kalki said- In the body of Parkrti-Maya, there are the eighteen kalpas enshrined therein. The first Brahmakalpa emerges out of the same. Brahma Purusa is the leader of the same. Out of the upper half body of the Brahman, thirty three gods emerged and out of the lower half, lord Brahma was born. He happens to be the spotless one, who is always meditated upon by the yogins. Whatever performance or activity is there in this kalpa, that has been extensively highlighted in the Brahma Purana. The same Purana has been expanded in crores of verses. The learned people have described the place of Mahakalpa in the centre of the Maha Purusa The globe is lodged for four thousand years in this kalpa, which is of eighteen types. Their names are being revealed by me. You please listen. They are known as- Karma-kalpa, Matsya-kalpa, Svetavaraha-kalpa, Nrsimha-kalpa, Vamana-kalpa, Skanda-kalpa, Rama-kalpa, Markandeya-kalpa, Bhavisya-kalpa, Linga-kalpa, Brahmanda-kalpa, Agni-kalpa, Vayu-kalpa, Padma-kalpa, Siva-kalpa and Brahma-kalpa. They were created one after the other. They are known as Mahakalpa because of their two thousand reflections. A thousand yugas have been stated to be the age of the universe.

## \|\| 2.160.55-57 \|\|

*yannāmnā ca smṛtaḥ kalpastasmājjāto virāḍayam \|*  
*caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca madhye kalpaḥ sa kālavān \|\| 55 \|\|*

*svāyaṃbhuvāṃtare yadvai jāṃtaṃjātaṃ caturyugam \|*  
*tasmiṃścaturyuge sarve nṛṇāmāyurhare śṛṇu \|\| 56 \|\|*

*lakṣābdaṃ vai satyayuge tretāyāmayutābdakam \|*  
*dvāpare ca sahasrābdaṃ kalau cāyuśśatābdakam \|\| 57 \|\|*

55-57. The name by which a kalpa became popular, Virat is said to have been emerged out of the same. Kalavan-kalpa is said to exist among fourteen Purusas. In whichever Svayambhuva Manvantara all the four yugas emerged and get expired, the age of the humans in those yugas is being described by me. The said age has been said to be a lakh of years in Satyayuga. During Tretayuga, it is ten thousand years; during Dvapara it is a thousand years; and in Kaliyuga it is said to be a hundred years for the humans.

## \|\| 2.160.58-59 \|\|

*svārociṣe'ntare aiva jātaṃjātaṃ caturyugam \|*  
*śṛṇu tatra nṛṇāmāyussatyeśītisahasrakam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam \|*  
*kalau dvika sahasrābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. О Deva, during the Svarocisa Manvantara, all the yugas start and also come to an end. The age of the humans during those times is being spoken by me. You please listen. During the Satyayuga it is said to be eighty thousand years During Tretayuga it is said to be forty thousand years; during Dvapara it is twenty thousand years; while in Kali age, it is said to be two thousand years for the humans.

## \|\| 2.160.60-62 \|\|

*auttamasyāntare caiva satye ṣaṣṭisahasrakam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kalau sārddhasahasrābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam \|*  
*tāmasāntarake caiva ṣaṭtriṃśābdasahasrakam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*nṛṇāmāyuḥ satyayuge tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhakam \|*  
*dvāpare ca tadarddhābdaṃ kalau varṣasahasrakam \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. During the Uttama Manvantara, the age of the humans would be sixty thousand years in Satyayuga; during Tretayuga it would be thirty thousand years; during Dvapara it would be fifteen thousand years; and in the age of Kali, it would be a thousand and five hundred years. During the Tamasa Manvantara, the human age is said to be thirty six thousand years in Satyayuga; eighteen thousand years in Tretayuga; nine thousand years in Dvapara; and a thousand years in the age of Kali.

## \|\| 2.160.63-66 \|\|

*raivatāntarake caiva satye triṃśatsahasrakam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*kalau cāṣṭaśatābdāyurnṛṇāṃ vedaiḥ prakīrtitam \|*  
*cākṣuṣāntarake caiva satye turyasahasrakam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tretāyāṃ trisahasrābdaṃ dvāpare dvisahasrakam \|*  
*kalau sahasra varṣāntaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*vaivasvatentare caiva satye turyasahasrakam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ triśatābdaṃ ca dvāpare dviśatābdakam \|\| 66 \|\|*

63-66. During the time of Raivata Manvantara, in Satyayuga the human age would be thirty thousand years; fifteen thousand years in Tretayuga; seven and a half thousand years in Dvapara; and eight hundred years in Kali age. During the Caksusa Manvantara, the human age in Satyayuga would be four thousand years; three thousand years in Tretatyuga; two thousand years in Dvapara and a thousand years in Kali. During the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the human age would be four thousand years in Satyayuga; in Tretayuga it would be three hundred years; then two hundred years in Dvapara; and a hundred years in the age of Kali.

## \|\| 2.160.67-70 \|\|

*kalau śatābdakaṃ proktamāyurvedaistathā nṛṇām \|*  
*sāvarṇike'ntare deva nṛṇāṃ viṃśatsahasrakam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*āyuḥ satye tadarddhaṃ tu tretāyāṃ ca prakīrtitam \|*  
*dvāpare ca tadarddhābdaṃ tadarddhābdaṃ tu vai kalau \|\| 68 \|\|*

*brahmasāvarṇike caiva satye daśasahasrakam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kalau caiva tadarddhābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam \|*  
*dakṣasāvarṇike caiva tathābdāyuścaturyuge \|\| 70 \|\|*

67-70. During the Saavarni Manvantara, the human age would be twenty thousand years in Satyayuga; ten thousand years in Tretayuga; five thousand years in Dvapara, and two and a half thousand years in Kali. During Brahma-Savarni Manvantara, the human age in Satyayuga would be ten thousand years; five thousand years in Tretayuga; two and a half thousand years in Dvapara and in Kali age, it would be a thousand two hundred and fifty years. During the time of Daksa-Savarni, the human age compares with four yogas.

## \|\| 2.160.71-77 \|\|

*rudrasāvarṇike caiva satye cāṣṭasahasrakam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*kalau tadarddhakaṃ jñeyaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ purātane \|*  
*dharmasāvarṇike caiva tathābdāyuścaturyuge \|\| 72 \|\|*

*bhauma manvaṃtare caiva satye turyasahasrakam \|*  
*tretāyāṃ trisahasrābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*kalau tadarddhakaṃ jñeyaṃ narāyuścārṣasammatam \|*  
*bhautamanvaṃtare caiva satye turyaśatābdakam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*tretāyāṃ triśatābdaṃ ca dvāpare tu tadarddhakam \|*  
*tadarddhakaṃ kalau ghore nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam \|\| 75 \|\|*

*manvaṃtare tu yannāmnā bhūpāścāsaṃścaturyuge \|*  
*tannāmnā ca nṛpā jātāsteṣāṃ līlāḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 76 \|\|*

*evamanyatra vai jñeyaṃ yuge turye manau manau \|*  
*yo manustasya vaṃśāśca divyaikayugasaptatau \|\| 77 \|\|*

71-77. During the period of Rudra Savarni, the human age is eight thousand years in Satyayuga; four thousand years in Treta; two thousand years in Dvapara, and a thousand years in the age of Kali. During Dharma Savarni, the human age is equal in all the yugas. During Bhauma Manvantara, the human age is four thousand years in Satyayuga; three thousand years in Tretayuga, fifteen hundred years in Dvapara as well as in Kali. Again in the Bhauta Manvantara, the human age is four hundred years in Satyayuga; three hundred years in Tretayuga; fifteen hundred years in Dvapara and seven hundred and fifty years in the age of Kali. The kings who have been described for a particular Manvantara, relate to the four yugas. The kings are born with the same names, whose performances have been described individually. Similarly, during all the four yugas of a particular Manu, he exercises control over all of them. His descendants rule for divine seventy one yugas.

## \|\| 2.160.78-81 \|\|

*yugāṃte karmabhūmeśca layaḥ kalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|*  
*manvante sarvabhūmeśca pralayaḥ sa ca kalpakaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*purāṇa puruṣasyaiva dinānte pralayo hi yaḥ \|*  
*mukhyakalpaḥ sa vai jñeyaḥ sarvalokavināśakaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*ṣaḍviṃśatkalpasāhasrairmahākalpo hi yaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo meṣarāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*tadā brahmā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ bhūpaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo makare ca samāgataḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

78-81. Thereafter, the total delusion occurs in Bharata - the land of activity, which is known as kalpa. It is the time for the end of Manu. The end of Purana Purusa is known as pralaya or the end of his time. That is the prominent event, because all the Iokas get destroyed in the delusion. Therefore, twenty six thousand kalpas make a Mahakalpa. At that point of time, the Purana-Purusa is lodged in the Aries (Mesa) symbol of zodiac.

## \|\| 2.160.82-84 \|\|

*svāyaṃbhuvamanormadhye vārāho'bhūtsa vai bhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo gataḥ siṃhe svakecchayā \|\| 82 \|\|*

*svārociṣamanorante nṛsiṃho'bhūtsa vai bhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo vṛṣarāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*tadauttamamanormadhye rudro'bhūtsagaṇo bhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo mīnarāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

82-84. At that point of time, there exist Svayambhuva Manu with the gods. Again, when the Рuranа Purusa reaches the zodiac symbol of Capricomus (Makara), Svayambhuva Mam, during the middle age, incarnate on earth in the form of Varaha. When the Purana-Purusa of his own accord is lodged in Leo (Simha) zodiac symbol, then it is the time of Svarocisa Manvantara. At the end of that period, lord Visnu incarnates as Nrsimha. When Purana Purusa is lodged in the Taurus (Vrsa) symbol of zodiac, the time of Uttama Manu starts. During the middle of that period, Rudra incarnates on earth with his ganas. When the Purana Purusa is lodged in Pisces (Mina) zodiac symbol, it is the time of the period of Manu.

## \|\| 2.160.85-96 \|\|

*tāmasānte'bhavanmatsyaḥ sa vai bhuvi sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo yugmarāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*vaivasvatamanormadhye kṛṣṇobhūdbhuvi sa prabhuḥ \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ karkarāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*raivatānte'bhavatkūrmaḥ sa vai bhuvi sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ kanyārāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*cākṣuṣānte jāmadagnyo'bhavadrāmaḥ sa vai bhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ prāpto'lau ca svakecchayā \|\| 88 \|\|*

*vaivasvatamanorādau vāmano'bhūtsa vai bhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣastulārāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*vaivasvatamanormadhye kalkī nāmnāhamāgataḥ \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ kumbharāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*sāvarṇikādau bhavitā buddho nāmnā sa vai bhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo dhanurāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*vaivasvatamanormadhye rāmo dāśarathirbhuvi \|*  
*yadā purāṇapuruṣo nakrarāśau samāsthitaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*sarvapūjyāvatāraśca na bhavedvai kadācana \|*  
*asmiṃścaturyuge devāḥ purāṇapuruṣasya hi \|\| 93 \|\|*

*trayo'vatārāḥ kathitāstathā nānyaccaturyuge \|*  
*tretāyāḥ prathame pāde rāmo dāśarathiḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*dvāparasya tathā kṛṣṇaḥ śeṣeṇa saha vai bhuvi \|*  
*kaleśśeṣe tathāhaṃ vai dvātriṃśābdasahasrake \|\| 95 \|\|*

*ataḥ khaṃḍaḥ pavitro'yaṃ nṛṇāṃ pātakanāśanaḥ \|*  
*imaṃ caturyugaṃ khaṇḍaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayecca yaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

85-96. At the end of that period, lord Visnu inincamates in the form of a fish. When the Purana Purusa is lodged in Gemini zodiac house, in the middle of the related period, lord Krsna incarnates on earth. When the Purana Purusa reaches the Cancer zodiac sign, at the end of Raivata Manu, the eternal lord incarnates as Kurma or the tortoise. When the Purana Purusa is lodged in the Virgo zodiac symbol, it is the time of Caksusa Manvantara and lord Rama incarnates on earth. When the Purana Purusa enters the Scorpion zodiac symbol, then it is the early time of Vaivasvata Manu and at that point of time, lord incarnates on earth. When the Purana Purusa enters the Libra zodiac symbol, during that period, then in the middle time of Vaivasvata Manu, lord Kalki incarnates on earth during that period. Similarly, when the Purana Purusa is lodged in the early period of Savarni Manu in the Aquarius symbol of zodiac, then lord Buddha incarnates on earth. When the Purana Purusa is placed in the Sagittarius zodiac symbol during the middle age of Vaivasvata Manu, then Rama - the son of Dasaratha incarnates on earth. When he is placed in the Capricomus zodiac, the lord incarnates in the world in the form in which he never incarnates. О Devas, in all these four yugas, in whichever form the Purana Purusa incarnates on earth, that has been described. During the first phase of the Tretayuga, lord Rama incarnates in the house of Dasaratha. At the end of Dvapara, lord Krsna incarnates on earth. Then thirty two thousand years of the incarnation of Kalki takes place. Therefore, this khanda is quite auspicious, while recited to others it relieves listeners of all their sins. Similarly, when all the four khandas are recited to the people, the sins of all the past births are vanished.

## \|\| 2.160.97-104 \|\|

*janma prabhṛti pāpāni tasya naśyaṃti nānyathā \|*  
*iti vaḥ kathitaṃ devā mahākalpacaritrakam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*dvitīyo yo mahākalpo viṣṇukalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|*  
*tatkathā paṭhitā devā viṣṇupaurāṇikairnaraiḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*śatakoṭipravistāro viṣṇupaurāṇikasya vai \|*  
*tatraiva ca mahākalpo viṣṇornābhisamudbhavaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*pūrvārddhādbhagavānbrahmā . sarvadevasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*parārddhādbhagavānviṣṇuḥ purāṇapuruṣaḥ sa vai \|\| 100 \|\|*

*tṛtīyo yo mahākalpaḥ śivakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|*  
*śivapūrvārddhato jāto viṣṇustasmādvidhiḥ svayam \|\| 101 \|\|*

*śatakoṭipravistāraḥ śivapaurāṇikaiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*caturtho yo mahākalpaḥ padma kalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*gaṇeśastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane \|*  
*gaṇeśādabhavadrudro rudrādviṣṇuḥ surottamaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*viṣṇornābhisamudbhūtaḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*kalpekalpe kramādādau devāścāsansamaṃtataḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

97-104. О Devas, I have thus narrated the auspicious story of the Mahakalpa to you, The second Mahakalpa is known as Visnukalpa, the story of which has been included in the Visnu Purana, which has been patronized by the people in their hearts. The said Purana is spread in hundreds of crores (of words). The same Purana describes the emergence of Brahma out of the navel of Visnu, He is known as lord Brahma from his upper half and Purana Purusa from his lower half. During the third Mahakalpa known as Sivakalpa, out of diva’s upper half emerged Visnu and from Visnu emerged Brahma. It is spread in the form of Siva Purana in a hundred crores (of words). The fourth Mahakalpa is known as Padmakalpa in which Ganesa has been called as Рuranа Purusa. Out of him, emerged Rudra. From Rudra appeared Visnu and from the navel of Visnu, a lotus emerged with Paramesthi seated over the same. At the start of each one of the kalpas, the gods are also spread in all the four quarters.

## \|\| 2.160.105-108 \|\|

*paṃcamo yo mahākalpo vāyukalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|*  
*maheṃdrastatra bhagavānpurāṇa puruṣāsane \|\| 105 \|\|*

*mahendrādabhavatprāpto maheṃdrādiṃdriyāṇi ca \|*  
*indriyebhyaśca taddevāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu \|\| 106 \|\|*

*śanirbudho raviḥ śukro viśva karmā bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*indro viṣṇustathā brahmā rudraḥ somaḥ kramātsmṛtāḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*sṛṣṭikartā sa vai brahmā liṅgendriyasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭipātā sa vai viṣṇuravatāripadodbhavaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

105-108. Similarly, in the fifth kalpa known as Vayukalpa, Mahendra is the Purana Purusa. From the said Mahendra emerges Mahendra (Indira) and from him emerge the sense organs. From sense organs emerge the gods, details about which had already been stated. The Saturn, Mercury, the Sun, Venus, Visvakarma, Jupiter, Indra, Visnu, Brahma, Rudra and the Moon were the gods who emerged out of him. Because of their birth with the use of the linga, Brahma is known as the creator of the universe. By his birth from the feet and by his feeding the universe, he has been known as the incarnation of Visnu.

## \|\| 2.160.109-112 \|\|

*caturviṃśatitattveṣu kalpekalpe prabhurgataḥ \|*  
*sanatkumāro haṃsaśca vārāho nāradastathā \|\| 109 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇau ca kapilātreyau yajñāśvakaṇṭakau \|*  
*vṛṣabhaśca pṛthurmatsyaḥ kūrmo dhanvantaristathā \|\| 110 \|\|*

*mohinī ca nṛsiṃhaśca vāmano bhārgavastathā \|*  
*rāmo vyāso balaḥ kṛṣṇo buddhaḥ kalkī svatattvagaḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

*guhyajanmā mahādevaḥ sṛṣṭidaityavināśakaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ jātāstrayo devā mahākalpe ca pañcame \|\| 112 \|\|*

109-112. The lord pervaded in all the twenty four tattvas of each kalpa. Sanatkumara, Harhsa, Varaha, Narada, Nara, Narayana, Kapila, Yajnasva, Kantaka, Vrsabha, Prthu, Matsya, Kurma, Dhanvantari, Mohini, Nrsimha, Vamana, Bhargava, Rama, Vyasa, Bala, Krsna, Buddha and Kalki are enshrined in the tattvas of the respective kalpas. Similarly, Mahadeva emerged out of the secret part, who is the destroyer of the universe as well as the daityas. During the fifth Mahakalpa, the birth of the three gods has been described similarly.

## \|\| 2.160.113-118 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭho yastu mahākalpo vahnikalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|*  
*skandastatraiva bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane \|\| 113 \|\|*

*puruṣāvyayataḥ skannaḥ skandastasmānmahārcimān \|*  
*sūryarūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jāto hariḥ svayam \|\| 114 \|\|*

*vahnirūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jātaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*candrarūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jātaḥ sa vai haraḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo munayo varṇā lokā jātāḥ pitāmahāt \|*  
*ādityā viśvavasavastuṣitā bhāsvarānilāḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

*mahārājikasādhyāśca devā viṣṇusamudbhavāḥ \|*  
*yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācāḥ kinnarādayaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*daityāśca dānavā bhūtāstāmasā rudrasambhavāḥ \|*  
*kalpe kalpe samudbhūtamevaṃ brahmāṇḍagocare \|\| 118 \|\|*

113-118. During the sixth kalpa of Vahnikalpa, it is Skandadeva who has been described as Purana Purusa. Because of Skanda’s becoming the Purana Purusa, during the same period, it was given the name of Maharciman or the one having abundance of light. From the same Maharci as Visnu, with the Vahni-ruра rays, emerged the moon rays as well as lord Siva. Similarly, the Grandsire Brahma also created Rs is, Munis, Varnas besides the Lokas. Vi§nu on the other hand created Aditya, Visvavasu, Tusita, Bhaskara, Anila and the goddess Maharajika Sadhya. Rudra on the other hand created Yak^as, Raksasas, Pisacas, Kinnaras, Danavas besides the Bhiitaganas. Thus in each and every kalpa, the creation in the universe was considered to be the good or auspicious.

## \|\| 2.160.119-122 \|\|

*saptamo yo mahākalpaḥ sa vai brahmāṇḍakalpakaḥ \|*  
*pāvakastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane \|\| 119 \|\|*

*acintyatejasastasmātpuruṣādvahnirudbhavaḥ \|*  
*tato jāto mahābdhiśca tasmājjātaṃ virāṇmayam \|\| 120 \|\|*

*romṇi romṇi tatastasya brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan \|*  
*brahmāṇḍādabhavadbrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

*tasmājjāto vibhurviṣṇustasmājjāto haraḥ svayam \|*  
*śatakoṭipravistāro brahmāṇḍākhyapurāṇake \|\| 122 \|\|*

119-122. The seventh kalpa was known as Brahmanda-kalpa. Lord Pavaka (or Agni) officiated as the Purana Purusa. The said Purusa is invisible, illustrious and the fire emerged out of him. The same fire produced the great ocean, Virat emerged out of the great ocean, in whose hair-pits crores of globes were lodged. Out of the said globe, Brahma - the Grandsire of the world, was born. From Brahma emerged Visnu, while stars emerged out of Visnu. Accordingly, Brahmanda Purana was expanded hundred and crores of times.

## \|\| 2.160.123-128 \|\|

*trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca daśabāhurbhavasya ca \|*  
*aṣṭādaśānāṃ kalpānāṃ vāyurvai vaidikaiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*mahākalpe'bhavansarve dvisahasrāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*aṣṭamo yo mahākalpo liṅgakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

*tatraiva bhagavāndharmaḥ purāṇapuruṣāsane \|*  
*acintyāvyaktarūpaśca jāto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

*dharmātkāmaḥ samudbhūtaḥ kāmālliṅgastridhābhavat \|*  
*puṃlliṅgaḥ klībaliṅgaśca strīliṅgaśca surottama \|\| 126 \|\|*

*puṃlliṅgādabhavadviṣṇuḥ strīliṅgācca mahendirā \|*  
*klībaliṅgātsa vai śeṣastasyopari sa ca sthitaḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

*tribhyastamomayebhyaśca jātamekārṇavaṃ jagat \|*  
*supte nārāyaṇe deve nābheḥ paṅkajamuttamam \|\| 128 \|\|*

123-128. Siva has five faces, three eyes and ten arms. He is known as Vayu in the eighteen kalpas. Since all were born during this kalpa therefore, two thousand periods of time were passed. The eighth Mahakalpa was known as Linga-kalpa. Lord Dharma happened to be the Purana Purusa. He is beyond comprehension, invisible besides being the form of eternal dharma. Out of him, Kama was generated. Out of that Dharma and Kama were produced three lingas (viz., masculine gender, feminine gender and the neutral gender). Out of the masculine gender emerged Visnu. Out of feminine gender emerged Indra or Laksmi. The serpent Sesa emerged out of the neutral gender, who serves as the bed of lord Visnu. Again out of these forms, the dark ocean was created in which Narayana had his sleep and Brahma emerged out of his navel.

## \|\| 2.160.129-133 \|\|

*jātaṃ tasmātsa vai brahmā tasmājjāto virāḍayam \|*  
*śatakoṭipravistārairliṅgapaurāṇikaiḥ kathā \|\| 129 \|\|*

*gītā caiva vidheragre tasya sāro'yamuttamaḥ \|*  
*navamo yo mahākalpo matsyakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*kuberastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane \|*  
*avyayācca samudbhūto dhūlivṛndo mahāṃstathā \|\| 131 \|\|*

*rajobhūtācca tasmācca kuberasya samudbhavaḥ \|*  
*kuberādudbhavanmatsyo vedamūrtiśca sadguṇaḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

*matsyodarātsamudbhūto viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ \|*  
*viṣṇornābheḥ samudbhūto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

129-133. Brahma is bom of the same. Virat is bom of Brahma. Therefore, the story of the Linga Purana is expanded hundred crores of time. The essence of the same emerged out of the mouth of Brahma in the form of Gita. During the ninth kalpa known as Matsyakalpa, the lord earned the status of an Epic in which Kubera is known as Purana Purusa. Thereafter, out of the indestructible one, a forceful dust storm was created and out of which emerged Kubera —the lord of riches. Again out of Kubera, Matsya - the form of the Vedas was bom. Lord Narayana emerged out of the belly of Matsya. From the navel of Visnu emerged the grandsire Brahma.

## \|\| 2.160.134-144 \|\|

*brahmaṇaścodbhavaṃ daivaṃ daivāddevā babhūvire \|*  
*caturviṃśatitattvāni tairdevairjanitāni vai \|\| 134 \|\|*

*kalpekalpe kramādevaṃ kalpanāmānyakārayat \|*  
*matsyakalpe tu matsyaśca mahāmatsyātsamudbhavaḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

*tanmatsyādbhagavānviṣṇustato brahmaṇa udbhavaḥ \|*  
*kūrmakalpe mahāmatsyātkūrmo jātaḥ sa kacchapaḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

*kūrmācca bhagavānviṣṇustato brahmā tato virāṭ \|*  
*śvetavārāhakalpe ca varāhādviṣṇurudbhavaḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

*viṣṇornābheśca sa brahmā tato jāto virāḍayam \|*  
*evaṃ sarve ca vai kalpā jñeyāḥ sarvatra vai budhaiḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

*daśamo yo mahākalpaḥ kūrmakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ \|*  
*acetāstatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane \|\| 139 \|\|*

*prakṛteśca paro yo vai turīyo'vyaya eva ca \|*  
*śūnyabhūtāttato jātaḥ pracetā bhagavānsvayam \|\| 140 \|\|*

*tasmājjāto mahānabdhistatra suṣvāpa sa prabhuḥ \|*  
*nārāyaṇa iti khyātaḥ sa vai jalapatiḥ svayam \|\| 141 \|\|*

*tadarddhācca mahākūrmastataḥ śeṣo mahānabhūt \|*  
*tridhā'bhavatsa vai śeṣo bhūmā śeṣaśca bhaumanī \|\| 142 \|\|*

*bhūmā sa vai virāḍ jñeyaḥ śeṣopari sa cāsthitaḥ \|*  
*bhaumanī ca mahālakṣmīḥ sā bhūmno hṛdi saṃsthitā \|\| 143 \|\|*

*bhūmno jātaḥ sa vai brahmā sṛṣṭisthitivināśakaḥ \|*  
*tridhāmūrtiḥ sa vai brahmā kalpekalpe kramādayam \|\| 144 \|\|*

134-144. Brahma produced the gods. Thereafter, the gods produced the twenty four tattvas. Thus in each and every kalpa, the names of the kalpas are based on the prominent gods. During the Matsyakalpa, Matsya was born out of its glory. It is the same Matsya who produced Visnu. During the Karmakalpa, tortoise was produced by Mahamatsya. From the same Kurma, lord Visnu was born. Brahma emerged out of lord Visnu and Virat was born out of Brahma. During the Svetavaraha kalpa, Visnu emerged out of Varaha. Brahma emerged out of the navel of Visnu and Virat emerged out of Brahma. Therefore, the learned people should know the importance of kalpa besides the related story. During the tenth Kurmakalpa, lord Aceta recited the Purana, who is beyond Prakrti, is Turiya (indestructible) and Sunya-bhuta. Lord Aceta himself emerged out of him. The great ocean emerged out of Aceta. When the lord sleeps in the oceanic water, he earns the title of Jalapati Narayana. From one half of his body emerges Mahakurma and from the other half emerges Mahasesa. The same Sesa is divided into three parts and appears in the form of Bhuma, Sesa and Bhaumini. The same Bhuma is also called Virat who is lodged in the heart of Sesa. The same Bhuma resorts to creation, preservation and the destruction of the universe, besides the creation of the gods. The same Brahma, in all the three kalpas, getting divided into three parts, takes to three forms at the same time.

## \|\| 2.160.145-148 \|\|

*paṭaṃ suṣuptabhūtaṃ yatpurāṇapuruṣāsanam \|*  
*yatra gatvendriyāṇyeva tṛptiṃ prāpya kṣayanti vai \|\| 145 \|\|*

*ahaṅkārastadāgatya caitanyaṃ manasi sthitam \|*  
*vañcayitvā punarlokaṃ karoti sma svalīlayā \|\| 146 \|\|*

*turīyaśaktiryā jñeyā mahākālī sanātanī \|*  
*mahākalpaśca taiḥ sarvaistadaṅgaṃ śrutibhiḥ smṛtam \|\| 147 \|\|*

*namastasyai mahākālyai mama mātre namo namaḥ \|*  
*yataḥ purāṇapuruṣā bhavanti ca liyanti ca \|\| 148 \|\|*

145-148. The Purana Purusa has the seat, which floats on water at the time of his sleep. Reaching there, all the sense organs feel satisfied and then vanish. The arrogance (ahamkara) is lodged in the mind in the form of consciousness. By depriving it with her force, one who creates the universe is called the eternal supreme goddess known as Mahakali. All the Srutis as well as the Mahakalpas have narrated the legends. I offer my salutation to the mother known as Mahakali. The Рuranа Purusa emerges from her and get absorbed in her alone.

## \|\| 2.160.149-155 \|\|

*daśaiva ca mahākalpā vyatītā iha bhoḥ surāḥ \|*  
*sāmprataṃ vartate yo vai mahākalpo bhaviṣyakaḥ \|\| 149 \|\|*

*tadutpattiṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ bho devāḥ sarpigaṇā mama \|*  
*acintyamakṣaraṃ yattu turīyaṃ ca sadā sthitam \|\| 150 \|\|*

*yadgatvā na nivartante narāstatraiva tatpadam \|*  
*anekasṛṣṭiracanāḥ santi tasyaiva līlayā \|\| 151 \|\|*

*tasyāntaṃ na vidurdevāḥ kathaṃ jānanti vai narāḥ \|*  
*bhūto bhūto mahākalpo dṛṣṭo vaidestadīritaḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

*bhāvyā ye tu mahākalpā na vai jānanti te sadā \|*  
*trayastriṃśanmahākalpāḥ kaiścidvedairudīritāḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

*aṣṭādaśa mahākalpāḥ pṛthaṅ nāmnopavarṇitāḥ \|*  
*ekādaśa mahākalpāḥ kaiścitproktāḥ purātanaiḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

*ato'haṃ niścayenādya bhāvyakalpeṣu bhoḥ surāḥ \|*  
*vedānāṃ vacanaṃ satyaṃ nānyathā ca bhavetkvacit \|\| 155 \|\|*

149-155. О Devas, ten Mahakalpas have already lapsed. Presently, there is the start of the Bhavisya Mahakala. I am going to narrate as to how I, as well as the ganas, were born. You please listen. The incomprehensible, indestructible and the form of Turiya (the divine being), are the forms in which he always exist. By reaching that position, the people do not have to return to the universe. He creates many worlds by his sports. His end is unknown even to the gods, then what could be stated about the humans? The Vedas testify about the existence of the Mahakalpa. Even they are unaware of the Mahakalpas of the future. Some of the Vedas testify to the existence of thirty three Mahakalpas, while some people believe in the existence of eighteen kalpas, which have been individually mentioned according to their respective names. Some ancient orators have described the number of the Mahakalpas. О Devas, therefore, I have arrived at the conclusion that the theory of the Veda should be taken to be correct in so far as the future Mahakalpas are concerned, which could never be otherwise in anyway.

## \|\| 2.160.156-160 \|\|

*tadavyayātsamudbhūto rādhākṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*ekībhūtaṃ dvayoraṅgaṃ rādhākṛṣṇo budhaiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

*sahasrayugaparyantaṃ yattepe paramaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*tadā sa ca dvidhā jāto rādhākṛṣṇaḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 157 \|\|*

*sahasrayugaparyantaṃ tepatustau paraṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*tayoraṅgātsamudbhūtā jyotsnā tamanāśinī \|\| 158 \|\|*

*tajyotsnābhiḥ samudbhūtaṃ divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ śubham \|*  
*ekaviṃśatprakṛtayo yojane yojane smṛtāḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

*divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ jātaṃ caturāśītisammite \|*  
*krośāyāmaṃ mahāramyaṃ talliṅgaṃ śṛṇu me prabho \|\| 160 \|\|*

156-160. The said source has further testified that the eternal Radhakrsna emerged out of the same source. With the merging of the limbs of both of them, Radhakrsna performed severe tapas for a thousand yugas. Subsequently, both of them getting divided into two parts, incarnated on earth separately. They again performed severe tapas for another yuga, as a result of which a lustre emerged out of their bodies, which could remove the darkness. The same lustre became the cause of the creation of Vrndavana, in which at a distance of a yojana each, the twenty one Prakrti-tattvas are lodged. Accordingly, the divine Vrndavana is located in eighty four krosas. I am now describing about his linga, you please listen.

## \|\| 2.160.161-165 \|\|

*gokulaṃ vārṣa nāndaṃ bhāṇḍīraṃ māthuraṃ tathā \|\| 161 \|\|*

*vrajaṃ ca yāmunaṃ mānyaṃ śreyaskaṃ gopikaṃ kramāt \|*  
*mātrābhūtadaśabhyaśca prakṛtibhyaḥ samudbhavam \|\| 162 \|\|*

*tathā daśavanaṃ ramyaṃ teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu \|*  
*vṛndāvanaṃ gopavanaṃ bahulāvanameva ca \|\| 163 \|\|*

*madhuśṛṅgaṃ kuñjavanaṃ vanaṃ dadhivanaṃ tathā \|*  
*rahaḥ krīḍāvanaṃ ramyaṃ veṇupadmavanaṃ kramāt \|\| 164 \|\|*

*manasaḥ prakṛterjāto girirgovarddhano mahān \|*  
*divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā paramānandamāpa saḥ \|\| 165 \|\|*

161-165. With the ten natural sense organs, the ten villages were formed, which were known by the names of Gokula, Varsa, Nanda, Bhandira, Mathura, Vraja, Yamuna, Manya, Sreyaska and Gopika. With the ten subtle form of the matter, the ten charming forests were created, which were known by the names of Vrndavana, Gopavana, Bahulavana, Madhuvana, Srhgavana, Kunjavana, Dadhivana, Kridavana, Ramyavana besides Padmavana. Out of the mind of Prakrti, the great Govardhana mountain was created which spotting the divine Vrndavana, expressed extreme happiness.

## \|\| 2.160.166-169 \|\|

*kṛṣṇādudabhavangopāstisraḥ koṭyo guṇātmakāḥ \|*  
*śrīdāmādyāḥ sātvikāśca rājasā arjunādayaḥ \|\| 166 \|\|*

*kaṃsādyāstāmasā jātā divyalīlāprakāriṇaḥ \|*  
*rādhāṅgādudbhavā gopyastisraḥ koṭyastathā kramāt \|\| 167 \|\|*

*lalitādyāḥ sāttvikāśca kubjādyā rājasāstathā \|*  
*tāmasāḥ pūtanādyāśca nānāhelācaritrakāḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

*sahasrayugaparyantaṃ teṣāṃ līlā babhūva ha \|*  
*tatastau tānsamāhṛtya tepatuśca punastapaḥ \|\| 169 \|\|*

166-169. Lord Krsna gave birth to three crores of virtuous cowherds. Out of these, Sridama and others emerged out of sattvaguna, Arjuna and others were bom of rajoguna, while Kamsa and others were bom of tamoguna. In connection with the divine dance and out of the divine limbs of Radha, three crores of milkmaids were bom. Out of them, the milkmaids like Lalita and others were bom of the Satvika elements, Kubja and others were bom of the Rajasi elements, while Putana and others were bom of the Tamasika elements, who have projected their lives in various ways. All of them performed their sports for a thousand yugas. Both Radha and Krsna performed severe tapas after their destruction.

## \|\| 2.160.170-176 \|\|

*dvidhā jātaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo rādhā devī tathā dvidhā \|*  
*sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt \|\| 170 \|\|*

*pūrvārddhātsa ca vai jātaḥ parārddhātkṛṣṇa eva hi \|*  
*ekaśīrṣā trinetrā ca dvipadī dvisahasrikā \|\| 171 \|\|*

*pūrvārdhātsā tu vai jātā rādhā devī parārddhataḥ \|*  
*puruṣaḥ prakṛtiścobhau tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

*sahasrayugaparyyantaṃ divye vṛndāvane śubhe \|*  
*tapasā vavṛdhāte tau nāmnānanto hyanantakaḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

*ekībhūtau tu tatpaścātsaṃsthitau maithunecchayā \|*  
*tadaṅkaromakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan \|\| 174 \|\|*

*koṭyarddhayojanāyāmāste tu sarve pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*hṛdi romasamudbhūto brahmāṇḍo'yaṃ ca bhoḥ surāḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍādudbhavo brahmā padmapuṣpe samāsthitaḥ \|*  
*sa padmo yojanāyāmo bhūmimaṇḍalasaṃsthitaḥ \|\| 176 \|\|*

170-176. Both Radha and Krsna were divided in two parts each. Krsna produced Purusa from the upper half of his body with a thousand heads, a thousand eyes and a thousand feet. The lower half of the body turned into the form of Krsna. Similarly, Radha produced two thousand figures out of the upper half of her body, having a single head but three eyes and two feet. The lower half of the body turned into the form of Radha. In the divine and auspicious Vrndavana, both Prakrti and Purusa performed hard tapas for a thousand yugas, became of which they expanded so much that it became beyond measure. Because of this, she came to be known as Ananta (having no end). Thereafter, both of them, with intention of having sexual act, were united. At that point of time, out of their hair-pits, crores of globes emerged, which stood separately but were spread into half a crore each. Subsequently, out of the globe, there emerged Brahma seated over a lotus. The said lotus flower was spread on earth in an area of a yojana.

## \|\| 2.160.177-181 \|\|

*yato jātaṃ vidheḥ padmaṃ tadvai padmasarovaram \|*  
*prasiddhaṃ puṣkarakṣetraṃ tatpadmasarasaṃ surāḥ \|\| 177 \|\|*

*vismitaḥ sa tadā brahmā nararūpaścaturmukhaḥ \|*  
*nāle nāle gatosau vai divyaṃ jātaṃ śataṃ samāḥ \|\| 178 \|\|*

*nāntaṃ jagāma padmasya punarbrahmā sa cāgataḥ \|*  
*māyayā mohitastatra ruroda bahudhā tadā \|\| 179 \|\|*

*rodanādrudra utpannaḥ sa ca tatkṣemakārakaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ rodiṣi mahābhāga tvadīśo hṛdaye tava \|\| 180 \|\|*

*iti śrutvā vacastasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*samādhibhūto hṛdaye ciraṃ tepe svakecchayā \|\| 181 \|\|*

177-181. The place from which the Brahma-lotus emerged is known as Brahmasarovara and is located at Puskara. At that point of time, the four-armed Brahma, seated in human form, felt extremely surprised by looking at the lotus. Thereafter, Brahma entered into the stalk of the lotus and tried his best to reach to its base for a hundred divine years, but he failed in his effort. Then getting confused with Мaуa (illusion), he started crying variously and out of that exercise, Rudra emerged, who became his well-wisher. He said- “O excellent one, why are you crying? Your lord is actually lodged in your heart itself.” On hearing these words of Brahma - the Grandsire of the world, of his own sweet will, he started meditating in his heart itself.

## \|\| 2.160.182-191 \|\|

*divyavarṣaśatābde tu prādurbhūto hariḥ svayam \|*  
*vacanaṃ prāha bhagavānmeghagambhīrayā girā \|\| 182 \|\|*

*karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahmañjīvāntā jīvakāriṇī \|*  
*sahasrayojanāyāṃ tu viśvasminbhūmimaṇḍale \|\| 183 \|\|*

*himādriruttare tasyāḥ pūrve'bdhiśca mahodadhiḥ \|*  
*ratnākaraḥ paścime'bdhirdakṣiṇe vaḍavābdhikaḥ \|\| 184 \|\|*

*ataḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti lokāścorddhvaṃ tathā hyadhaḥ \|*  
*karmabhūmermadhyabhūtaḥ puṣkaro'yaṃ sanātanaḥ \|\| 185 \|\|*

*matto vedānbhavānprāpya kariṣyati makhaṃ śubham \|*  
*yajñāddevā bhaviṣyanti tridhābhūtā guṇatrayāt \|\| 186 \|\|*

*siddhā vidyādharāścaiva cāraṇāḥ sāttvikāstridhā \|*  
*gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasā girisaṃsthitāḥ \|\| 187 \|\|*

*piśācaguhyakā bhūtāstāmasā gāmino hyadhaḥ \|*  
*tathā svadhāmayā yajñāstridhā pitṛgaṇā vidhe \|\| 188 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyanti surai ramyā vimānasadṛśāśca khe \|*  
*khecarā gauravarṇāśca śyāmāste sāttvikāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 189 \|\|*

*giridvīpamayā ramyāḥ sarorūpāśca rājasāḥ \|*  
*bhūcarāste bhaviṣyanti tridhā pitṛgaṇā vidhe \|\| 190 \|\|*

*biletalamayā ye tu nārakā yātanāmayāḥ \|*  
*tāmasāste bhaviṣyanti pitaro'dhomahītale \|\| 191 \|\|*

182-191. After the lapse of a hundred divine years, lord Visnu himself appeared before Brahma and spoke in his speech, thundering like the cloud- ‘This is the land of activity, from which the living beings are born and finally get absorbed. The earth in the universe is spread in an area of a thousand yojanas. Himalaya is lodged to the north of it. The ocean is on the east. The ocean of gems known as Ratnakara is lodged in the west, while the ocean with submarine fire is located to the south. Therefore, different Iokas are lodged above and below the land of activity. The eternal Puskara is lodged in the middle. The people would attain the knowledge of the Vedas from me, all of you would perform the yajnas, by which during the three yugas, out of three parts, the gods would be born. With the division of the Satvika guna in three parts, there would emerge the Siddhas, Vidyadharas and the Caranas. Out of Rajas element, the Gandharvs, Yaksas and Raksasas, besides the Pisacas and Guhyakas who live in the nether world would be born of Tamoguna. Similarly, for the pitrganas, the yajnas with the offering of the pindas, which are divided in three parts, shall board the planes which are more beautiful than those of the gods, and shall remain close to them. Subsequently, the living beings of the sky would be born of sattvaguna who have the white as well as the dark complexions. Out of Rajoguna, the mountains, islands and the lakes get created. The beings who live close to the pitrs, shall be divided into three parts. The Tamoguna form of creatures would include those living in the netherworld or those lodged in the torture cells of the hells. They are also lodged on earth below the pitrs.

## \|\| 2.160.192-198 \|\|

*vyayabhūtāśca te lokā vṛddhā madhyāḥ kṣayāḥ kramāt \|*  
*iyaṃ bhūmirmahābhāgā sarvadā ca sanātanī \|\| 192 \|\|*

*merurvai ca nameruśca dvīpāścāsaṃstathā na hi \|*  
*ilāvartādikhaṇḍāśca santi naiva kvacitkvacit \|\| 193 \|\|*

*ye tu tārāmayā lokā vimānasadṛśā vidhe \|*  
*svecchayā ca kariṣyanti rakṣitā yajñakarmaṇā \|\| 194 \|\|*

*yajño nāsti yadā bhūmau tadā te bhagaṇā vidhe \|*  
*vighnabhūtāścariṣyanti nityavakrāticāriṇaḥ \|\| 195 \|\|*

*karmabhūmiśca gaurjñeyā śrutirūpā jaganmayī \|*  
*yastāṃ pāti ca bho brahmansa gopa iti viśrutaḥ \|\| 196 \|\|*

*gopaśaktiḥ sa vai gopo gopānāmarcako hariḥ \|*  
*koṭikoṭisahasrāśca sarva gopā hareḥ kalāḥ \|\| 197 \|\|*

*tāvantaścaiva brahmāṇḍā gopanāmnā prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*karmabhūmestathordhvaṃ ca raviryojanalakṣakaḥ \|\| 198 \|\|*

192-198. Out of the lokas lodged over one another, the upper one and the middle ones get expanded, while the lowest ones have to face decline. The eternal land is quite auspicious. But the Meru mountain as well as the islands, besides the countries like Ilavarta and others, do not remain in the same form and vanish at the time of dissolution. The stars and planets which appear in the sky like the planes, are rendered safe by the yajnas. The land over which no yajnas are performed, the people there get shattered and cruel, and cause disturbances in the world. О Brahman, land which resembles the Srutis as well as the worldly type, is known as the land of activity, which resembles a cow. The one who looks after her is known as a Gopa or a cowherd. Lord Visnu is known to be the form of a cowherd от the strength of the cows. He adores the milkmaids always. A thousand crores of cowherds who emerged out of the lord are the rays of the lord. The same is the number of the cowherds on earth. The sun is lodged a lakh of yojanas above the earth.

## \|\| 2.160.199-203 \|\|

*tataśśaśī tathāmānastataścordhvaṃ bhamaṇḍalam \|*  
*dvilakṣayojanagatastato bhaumastathāvidhaḥ \|\| 199 \|\|*

*bhaumādbudhastathā jñeyo budhācca bṛhatāṃpatiḥ \|*  
*guroḥ śukrastathāmānaḥ śukrātsauristathāgataḥ \|\| 200 \|\|*

*śanerāhustathā jñeyo rāhoḥ ketustathordhvagaḥ \|*  
*saptalakṣamitaṃ jñeyaṃ ketoḥ saptarṣimaṇḍalam \|\| 201 \|\|*

*lakṣaikādaśagāḥ sarve tataścordhvaṃ dhruvāspadam \|*  
*lakṣayojanagaṃ caiva tataścordhvaṃ mahatpadam \|\| 202 \|\|*

*lakṣayojanagaṃ jñeyaṃ tataścordhvaṃ janāspadam \|*  
*lakṣayojanagaṃ jñeyaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tapasaḥ sthalam \|\| 203 \|\|*

199-203. The moon is lodged beyond the sun at the same distance. The planets are lodged still farther in the sky at the same distance. At a farther distance from the planets, Mars is lodged. From there, Budha (Mercury) is at an equidistance. Brhaspati (Jupiter) is lodged at an equidistance from Budha. Venus is at an equidistance from Brhaspati (Jupiter). Then from Venus to Saturn, from Saturn to Rahu and from Saturn to Ketu, they are lodged at equal distance. A distance beyond seven lakh yojanas are lodged the Saptarsis or seven stars. Thus all of them are lodged at a distance of eleven lakhs of yojanas and the Pole star is lodged at a further distance of a lakh of yojanas. Mahapada is lodged at a further distance of a lakh of yojanas from Pole star. Above Mahapada and beyond a lakh of yojanas from the same, Janapada is lodged. The Tapahloka is lodged at a distance of one lakh yojanas from Mahapada.

## \|\| 2.160.204-209 \|\|

*evaṃ ca karmabhūmeśca tapaḥ koṭyardhayojanam \|*  
*karmabhūmeradhaścaiva pātālāḥ sapta cāntarāḥ \|\| 204 \|\|*

*lakṣayojanagā jñeyāstataścādhogatāśca ye \|*  
*narakāśca kramājjeyā bhūmeḥ koṭyarddhayojanāḥ \|\| 205 \|\|*

*karmabhūmeruttare ca khaṇḍānyaṣṭau tataḥ param \|*  
*lavaṇābdhistato dvīpastataḥ kṣīrābdhireva hi \|*  
*tato dvīpastataḥ sindhustato dvīpastato'bdhikaḥ \|\| 206 \|\|*

*koṭyarddhalakṣavyānena yojanena vidhe svayam \|\| 207 \|\|*

*karmabhūmeḥ sa vai jñeyo lokālokā mahācalaḥ \|*  
*lokāloko dakṣiṇe ca paścime ca sa vai giriḥ \|\| 208 \|\|*

*pūrve ca karmabhūmeśca lokālokastathāvidhaḥ \|*  
*eteṣāṃ samudāyānāṃ brahmāṇḍo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 209 \|\|*

204-209. In this way, from the Karmabhumi, Tapahloka is located at a distance of a crore of yojanas. Below the Karmabhumi, upto a depth of a lakh of yojanas, the netherworld is lodged, where there is patala and other Iokas. At an equidistance from that place, there are the altars of hell, which arc lodged at an equidistance from the earth. It is said to be at a distance of half a crores of yojanas. To the north of the Karmabhumi, eight regions have been earmarked. These include the ocean of salt water and the adjoining islands. The ocean of milk is located beyond that. Similarly, there are island oceans and other islands, which are located at a distance of half a crore of yojanas. The lokaloka mountain surrounds the Karmabhumi from all the sides. The universe comprise of all these, which emerging out of you, would remain intact for a kalpa.

## \|\| 2.160.210-222 \|\|

*tvatto bhaviṣyati vidhe kalpaparyantameva hi \|*  
*omityekākṣaraṃ brahma tato viṣṇustridhābhavat \|\| 210 \|\|*

*adya viṣṇuḥ sa vai kṛṣṇa iha viṣṇuḥ sa vai virāṭ \|*  
*iti viṣṇuḥ sa vai jñeyaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ \|\| 211 \|\|*

*purāṇapuruṣo jñeya ādibrahmā cirāyugaḥ \|*  
*daive yugasahasre dve'horātraṃ tasya kīrtitam \|\| 212 \|\|*

*viṣṇostu romakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan \|*  
*adya viṣṇurahaṃ brahmanvighnahā tava bhūtale \|\| 213 \|\|*

*ityuktavāntardadhe viṣṇurbrahmā sṛṣṭimacīkarat \|*  
*tena proktaṃ yato bhāvyaṃ mahākalpo hi sa smṛtaḥ \|\| 214 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyo nāma vikhyāto dvisahasrabhavāyuṣā \|*  
*pūrvārddhaśca kūparārddhaśca purāṇapuruṣasya hiḥ \|\| 215 \|\|*

*aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi kalpāḥ pūrvārddhake gatāḥ \|*  
*parārddhaḥ sāmprataṃ jñeyo jātaṃ tasya dinadvayam \|\| 216 \|\|*

*adyāhaṃ kūrmakaścaiva vāhane matsyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyaḥ śvetavārāho divasastasya kalpavān \|\| 217 \|\|*

*tathā madhyāhnakālo hi sāmprataṃ vartate surāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyākhye mahākalpe kathā bhāviṣyakairjanaiḥ \|\| 218 \|\|*

*kathitā brahmaṇaścāgre śatakoṭipravistaraiḥ \|*  
*daśalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram \|\| 219 \|\|*

*mahāpurāṇa kathitaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam \|*  
*padyatriṃśatsahasraṃ ca kalpe kalpe prakīrtitam \|\| 220 \|\|*

*kalpanāmnā purāṇaṃ ca mahādevena nirmitam \|*  
*aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni nirmitāni śivātmanā \|\| 221 \|\|*

*dvāparānte ca bhagavānvyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ \|*  
*tānyeva janayāmāsa lokamaṅgalahetave \|\| 222 \|\|*

210-222. From the Ekaksara Brahma emerged out Om who is well known by the names of Visnu, Krsna and Virat. The same Visnu as Purana Purusa is also known by the name of Brahma, who enjoys the long life. His one day comprises of two thousand divine yugas. In the hair-pits of the body of Visnu, thousands of globes are lodged. О Brahman, Visnu is present on earth for the removal of all your misfortunes. Thus speaking, lord Visnu disappeared from the scene, after which Brahma started creation of the universe. He has made it clear that the kalpa in future would be known by the name of the Bhavisya kalpa, the age of which has been stated to be two thousand years. Out of the upper half of the Purana Purusa, eighteen thousand kalpas have already expired. In addition to the same, two days of the current second half pan have also expired. These two days comprise of Kurma, Agni, Matsya and Svetavaraha’s middle period, the story of which has been composed by the future people before Brahma. This Mahakalpa has been expanded hundred and crores of times and has been given the title of Mahapurana. Usually, the Puranas comprise of five attributes. Thirty thousand passages out of them were composed in each one of the kalpas. A kalpa is also known as a Parana, which was created by lord Mahadeva himself. Thus lord Siva composed the eighteen Puranas, which were (composed and edited) at the end of the age of Dvapara by Vyasa - the son of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 2.160.223 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*iti kalkivacaḥ śrutvā te devā vismayānvitāḥ \|*  
*namaskṛtya gamiṣyanti svaṃ svaṃ dhāma praharṣitāḥ \|\| 223 \|\|*

223\. Vyasa said- Listening to the words of lord Kalki, the gods were immensely surprised. They offered their salutation to the lord and left for their respective abodes.

## Chapter 161. Collateral history ofthe Age of Kali

## \|\| 2.161.1-7 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*tadā sa bhagavānkalkiḥ purāṇapuruṣodbhavaḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ vājinamāruhya khaḍgī varmī ca carmadhṛk \|*  
*mlecchāṃstāndaityabhūtāṃśca hatvā yogaṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśābdasahasrāṇi tadyogāgnipratāpitā \|*  
*bhasmabhūtā karmabhūmirnirjīvā bhavitā tadā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tato'nuyogaṃ janito megho bhūtvā layaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*pralayāgreṇa sā bhūmirjalamadhye gamiṣyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tadā kaliyugo ghoro balipārśvaṃ gamiṣyati \|*  
*gate kaliyuge ghore karmabhūmiṃ punarhariḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā sthalamayīṃ ramyāṃ yajñairdevānyajiṣyati \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yajñabhāgamupādāya devāste balasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*vaivasvataṃ manuṃ gatvā kathayiṣyanti kāraṇam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kalkino vadanājjāto brāhmaṇo varṇa eva hi \|*  
*bāhvoḥ kṣatraṃ viśo jānvoḥ śūdro varṇastadaṅghrayoḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gauro raktastathā pītaḥ śyāmaste brāhmaṇādayaḥ \|*  
*devyāḥ śaktiṃ samādāya janiṣyanti sutānbahūn \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Vyasa said- Kalki, bom of the Purana Purusa, riding over the divine steed, holding a sword and a shield, will kill the daityas and Mlecchas. Thereafter, entering into the yogic samadhi, he will perform tapas for sixteen thousand years. With the fire produced from his yogic exercises, the entire land of activity shall be reduced to ashes. With the becoming of inaffective of the Karma-ksetra, the earth shall be submerged in water. At that point of time, Kaliyuga would move towards the daitya Bali. After the departure of Kaliyuga, lord Visnu would again beautify the Karmabhumi and adore the goddess by means of yajnas. Receiving the share of the yajna, the gods would reach before Vaivasvata Manu and would explain to him the entire cause. Thereafter, from the face of Kalkideva, Brahmanas would be bom. Ksatriyas would emerge out of his thighs, Vaisyas out of hands and Madras would emerge out of his feet, who would respectively have white, red, yellow and black complexion. The Brahmanas and others would patronize the goddess Sakti and shall produce many sons by her grace.

## \|\| 2.161.8-9 \|\|

*ekaviṃśatkiṣkumitā manujā dharmarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*jātidharmamupādāya yajiṣyaṃti surānmudā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tadā vaivasvato dhīmānnatvā taṃ kalkinaṃ harim \|*  
*ayodhyāyāṃ rājapadaṃ kariṣyati tadājñayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. They would follow Manuja-dharma and shall have the size or height of a Kisku (or twenty four thumbs). Following the traditions of their own respective families, they shall adore the goddess. At that point of time, the people of Ayodhya offering salutation to Visnu, would occupy the throne of Ayodhya.

## \|\| 2.161.10-13 \|\|

*tacchikṣāto bhavetputro yaḥ sa ikṣvākureva hi \|*  
*pitū rājyaṃ puraskṛtya bhūmau divyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ \|*  
*divyavarṣaśatāyuśca tyaktvā dehaṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yadā tu bhagavānkalkī brahmasūtraṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*tadā vedāśca catvāro mūrtimantaśca sāṅgaḥkāḥ \|*  
*aṣṭādaśapurāṇaiśca tatrāyāsyanti harṣitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*stoṣyanti kalkinaṃ devaṃ purāṇapuruṣāṃśakam \|*  
*kārttike śuklapakṣe ca navamyāṃ guruvāsare \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yajñakuṇḍācca puruṣo bhaviṣyati mahottamaḥ \|*  
*nāmnā satyayugo jñeyaḥ satya mārgapradarśakaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. The son, who would be born with the knowledge provided by him, shall be known as Iksavaku, who carrying on the burden of the kingship of his father, would comfortably rule the earth for a hundred years. Towards the end of his life, he would shed away his body. When the lord Kalki would start the Brahmasutra yajna, at that point of time, all the four Vedas and the eighteen Puranas would arrive in their personified forms, with their paraphernalia. Subsequently, Kalkideva, who also happened to be the Purana Purusa, after his adoration, on the bright ninth day of the month of Kartika on Thursday, a great Purusa would emerge out of the yajna altar, who would be known by the name of Satyayuga and shall lead the truthful path.

## \|\| 2.161.14-19 \|\|

*dṛṣṭavā taṃ puruṣaṃ ramyaṃ tadā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ \|*  
*tāṃ tithiṃ varṇayiṣyanti karmakṣayakarīṃ manoḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*asyāṃ tithau ca manujo dhātṛvṛkṣataṭe mudā \|*  
*yo'rcayiṣyati yāndevāndevāste tasya vaśyagāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*akṣayā navamī nāma yugādinavamī hi sā \|*  
*lokamaṅgaladātrī ca sarvakilviṣanāśinī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dhātṛmūlatale caiva mālatīṃ tulasīṃ mudā \|*  
*saṃsthāpya vedavidhinā śālagrāmaṃ yajanti ye \|*  
*jīvanmuktāśca te jñeyā pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dhātṛvṛkṣatale gatvā yo vai śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*gayāśrāddhasahasrasya lapsyate ca phalaṃ param \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yaḥ karoti tathā homaṃ sahasramakhasannibham \|*  
*mṛtaḥ sa svargamāpnoti sakulaḥ saparicchadaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

14-19. All the gods including Brahma, after viewing that Purusa, would term that particular day as the one which destroys the karmas. A person, who on that particular day, would delightfully adore the lord seated under a myrobalan tree, then the related gods would be overpowered by him. Because of its being the initial navami of the yuga, it is called Aksaya-navami, which bestows welfare on the people and destroys all the sins. Under the myrobalan tree when the plants like jasmine and holy basil are planted and the people then worship Saligrama, then those who do so are freed from the worldly bondage and satisfy the manes. A person who performs the sraddha seated under the shade of a myrobalan tree, he earns the merit of performing the sraddha at Gaya. Such of the people who perform sraddha under the said tree, they would earn the merit of performing a thousand yajnas. A person who meets with his end under the myrobalan tree, he attains the heaven with his family.

## \|\| 2.161.20-28 \|\|

*ityukte vacane teṣāṃ kalkī devo mudānvitaḥ \|*  
*tathāstvityeva vacanaṃ vadiṣyati surānprati \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ityuktvā bhagavānkalkī paśyatāṃ devarūpiṇām \|*  
*tatraivāntargato bhūtvā suṣuptaśca bhaviṣyati \|\| 21 \|\|*

*gate tasminbhagavati karmabhūmiḥ suduḥkhitā \|*  
*virahāgnimatī bhūtvā bījāṃstānsaṃkṣayiṣyati \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tasminkāle mahādaityāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ \|*  
*prahlādaṃ ca puraskṛtya gamiṣyanti surānprati \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kharoṣṭragṛddhramahiṣakākakarkasamāsthitāḥ \|*  
*siṃhavyāghravṛkārūḍhāḥ śṛgālaśyenavāhanaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*prāsapaṭṭiśakhaḍgāṃśca bhuśuṇḍīparighādikān \|*  
*gṛhītvā vegavantaste garjiṣyanti punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tadā śakrādayo devāstrayastriṃśadgaṇā mudā \|*  
*svāyudhāni gṛhītvāśu kariṣyanti raṇaṃ mahat \|\| 26 \|\|*

*divyavarṣamayaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*mṛtānmṛtānraṇe daityānbhārgavo jīvayiṣyati \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śramabhūtāstathā devāstyaktvā yuddhaṃ samantataḥ \|*  
*kṣīrābdhiṃ ca gamiṣyanti yatra sākṣādhariḥ svayam \|\| 28 \|\|*

20-28. At these words of the gods, the delightful Kalkideva would utter to them- “Be it so,” pleasing them at the same time. Thereafter, in full view of all the gods present there, lord Kalki would disappear from that place. He shall then sleep in the ocean of milk. After the departure of the lord, the Karmabhumi or the land of activity, feeling painful in separation from him, shall destroy the seeds. In the meantime, the daityas living in patala, making Prahlada to lead them, in order to fight with the gods, riding over their vehicles like donkeys, camels, vultures, he-buffaloes, crows, crabs, lions, tigers, wolves, jackals, eagle birds and other vehicles and equipped with the weapons like prasa, pattisa, khanga, swords, bhusundis and parighas, shall arrive on earth with great force and would thunder aloud, listening to which Indra and other gods, with their thirty three ganas, carrying their weapons, shall start a terrific war which shall continue for a divine year without break. In that war, the killed daityas shall be brought back to life by Sukra. Observing that, the fatigued gods shall desert the battleground and flee from that place. They will try to reach the ocean of milk, where lord Visnu would be sleeping.

## \|\| 2.161.29-30 \|\|

*teṣāṃ stutyā sa bhagavāndevamaṅgalahetave \|*  
*svapūrvārddha svarūpaṃ ca kariṣyati sanātanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sa ca haṃso hariḥ sākṣācchatasūryasamaprabhaḥ \|*  
*śukraṃ prahlādapramukhāṃstejasā tāpayiṣyati \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The gods reaching there, would offer prayer to lord Visnu, who getting pleased would take to the form of a swan, which would be eternal, possessing the lustre of the sun. Thereafter, with the same lustre, lord Visnu shall agonise Sukra as well as Prahlada and other prominent daityas.

## \|\| 2.161.31-33 \|\|

*tadā parājitā daityāstyaktvā gāṃ duḥkhitā bhṛśam \|*  
*vitale ca gamiṣyanti mahādevena rakṣitāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*punaste sakalā devā nirbhayā nirupadravāḥ \|*  
*vaivasvatasya tanayaṃ cābhiṣekṣyanti bhūpade \|\| 32 \|\|*

*divyavarṣaśatāyuśca sa ikṣvākurbhaviṣyati \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ ca pramāṇena nṛṇāmāyuścatuśśatam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. As a result of this, the daityas, having been tortured, shall feel miserable. Deserting the earth, they shall proceed on to the Vitalaloka. At that point of time, the daityas would be guarded by lord Siva. Thereafter, all the gods feeling fearless, will crown Iksavaku - the son of Vaivasvata Manu and the king of the earth, who will continue to rule the earth for a divine hundred years. At that point of time, the normal age of the humans would be four hundred years.

## \|\| 2.161.34-38 \|\|

*iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ mano tvayā \|*  
*caturyugānāṃ caritaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak \|\| 34 \|\|*

*catuṣpādā hi dharmasya jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ śamo damaḥ \|*  
*ātmajñānaṃ sa vai jñānaṃ dhyānamadhyātmacintanam \|*  
*manaḥ sthiratvaṃ ca śamo damastvindriyanigrahaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*caturlakṣābdakānyeva dvātriṃśacca sahasrakam \|*  
*tatsaṅkhyayā hi dharmasya pādaścaikaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*prāhṇamadhyāhnasāyāhnaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca bhavetsadā \|*  
*ekaikena padā tasya virājo bhuvi vartate \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yadā dharmo bhavedvṛddhastadāyuścaiva varddhate \|*  
*saptaślokasahasrāṇi khaṇḍe'sminkathitāni hi \|*  
*ataścottarakhaṇḍaṃ hi varṇayāmi mano śṛṇu \|\| 38 \|\|*

34-38. Thus I have given detailed replies to the questions you had asked, which are in the form of four separate stories for each one of the yugas. There are four aspects of life, viz. Dharma, Jnana, Sama and Dama (faith knowledge, bliss and self restraint). Out of these, knowledge denotes self consciousness Dhyana or Dharma relates to spiritual thinking. Sama is meant to control the mind and Dama means the control of the sense organs. The first phase of Dharma has the life of four lakhs and thirty two thousand years, in which there are three Sandhyas known as the earlier, the middle one and the evening. This Dharma always remains present with a single foot on earth. When the Dharma is on the increase, at that point of time, the age of the living beings is increased. О Manu, I have thus narrated seven thousand verses in the part of this Purana. Hereafter, I shall describe the Uttara-khanda. You should listen to it carefully.”
